你的生命之火很强大，但由火焰维系的生命总有燃尽的一天，未来又如何是好。
嗯，我考虑过这件事，深渊的威胁暂时消失，圣火的消耗不会像之前那样剧烈，由我便可维系两三百年的时间。
继任的火神将会寻找新的火源，只要纳塔的传承不灭，夜神之国就能永远延续下去，深渊将再无可乘之机。
又将希望托付给未来吗…
等下，「归火圣夜巡礼」就可以补充圣火的力量啊，为什么不能赋予「归火圣夜巡礼」新的意义，而要由你独自承受这件事呢？
因为我的愿望，就是要修正它。
「归火圣夜巡礼」曾是对抗深渊不可缺少的关键一环，它是伟大而充满荣耀的比赛，但换种说法，也是纳塔所有人的枷锁。
我们生活在对深渊的恐惧和未来的隐忧之下，如果不拿起武器，可能就会招致严重的后果，或是道德的谴责。
——这让纳塔成为了「战争」的国度。
希巴拉克曾在此地战胜了龙，赐予人类肉体的解放，而现在最好的机会又一次到来，纳塔人将获得精神的解放。
「战争」将成为单纯的「竞技」，不再是对灾难的抵抗，而是对未来的畅想。
既然我们已经创造了新的未来，就该让这个未来拥有新的意义，而并非原地踏步。
你很伟大，玛薇卡。但是，有关你个人的事呢？我听不到「你」的愿望。
你也是纳塔的万千子民之一，在我眼中你也没有那么特殊。
虽说事态紧急，修复地脉刻不容缓，但由你独自背负这份责任，实在太沉重了。
这就是你我的不同了，你将所有人类一视同仁，而我深知「领袖」的含义。
「领袖」就应该洞见事实的真相，并迅速做出「最合适」的判断。
更多的时候，并不是选出更好的那一种，而是选出不那么坏的一种。
——献出我剩余的生命，渡过眼前的危机，就是我认为「最合适」的选择。
毕竟，「领袖」是在普通人的信任基础上诞生的概念，无人之地，亦无「领袖」。
人们会信任「领袖」，是因为他们相信这个人能让世界变得更好，能在关键的时刻挺身而出。
我当然要践行这份职责，直到最后一刻。
你还是没有讨论你自己的事…
是因为你觉得根本就不重要吗？
有什么比我们携手创造的未来更加重要的呢？
（她的话确实无法反驳，可能她连我们会赶来都预料到了，才准备了这样的话。）
（纳塔确实应该走进新的时代，她想做出符合「领袖」身份的表率，但…）
（「我们携手创造的未来」，同样应该有她的位置啊…）
玛薇卡即将把生命献给夜神，这算作玛薇卡的死亡，我会全程见证这个过程。
我和希巴拉克几千年前定下的交易，也就在此刻完成了。
想要参与这场仪式的人还没有到齐，我不能不尊重另一人的意见。
唉，不过是简单的「见证代价」，却频生变数。
如果来者的「生命」不足以满足要求，我恐怕就要失去耐心了。
我保证，他同样拥有足够的价值。我是人类的协助者，无论何时，我都要把人类的诉求放在第一位，无论那个人是谁。
好吧，真是死板，但也没办法，这就是天使与生俱来的使命。
哈啊，哈啊…到了，我们赶上了。
你所说的另一人，难道是他？
正是，他和你相似，都怀揣崇高的理想。
玛薇卡，我理解你的想法，如果我只是一个普通人，我也没有阻止你的理由。
可是我和你一样，都等了这一天太久，现在我们拥有更好的解决方法。
这是你开创的未来，它要走向何方，还需要你去引导和定义，你的生命不该绝于此处。
而「死亡」就是我想要抵达的终点，我一路走来，就是希望以我的「死亡」，为他们叩开地脉的大门。
难道是我在梦里看到的灵魂？
没错，五百年以来，他们都在我的身上。
这怎么可能，人类身体里如果容纳那么多灵魂，意识早就四分五裂了…
而且，在「秘源机关」那里的时候，你也没像我一样受到影响啊。
还记得你曾经听到的声音吗？
那来源于我的心脏，它经由坎瑞亚技术改造而成，可以将地脉中的记忆与灵魂转化为知识。
但副作用就是我变得和你一样，对灵魂很敏感，能够意识到周围灵魂的存在…
后来，在五百年前的灾难中，无家可归的灵魂实在太多，所以我放弃了心脏的学习功能，将它当作了容器。
我的战友，还有许许多多纳塔人的「生命」，都在这里。
没错，地脉无法接纳他们。但如果我成为地脉的主人，和夜神融为一体，然后修改这一切的规则呢？
他表达了这种意志，而我给出了肯定的答复。
这样的规则对人类更加友善和公平。此外，「队长」还有另一个目的…挑战「死之执政」的权威，或者说，「复仇」。
多亏了这位死之执政的力量，我拥有「不死诅咒」，也就是绝对的生命。
你能感受到我的决心与恨意吗？
坎瑞亚人犯了重罪，这种诅咒的目的在于让我们亲眼见证所爱之物的消亡，以及经受肉体的无尽折磨。
可是有更多人是无辜的，大家对于五大罪人利用深渊力量这件事毫不知情，我也是其中之一。
当我把生命献给夜神，你就见证了死亡的发生，但死亡又会被你的「不死诅咒」撤销…
如果不解决这个悖论，它甚至可能动摇这个世界的「理」之根基…就算是崇高的「死之执政」，也无法承担这种后果。
你的诅咒，现在就是我逆转人神之位的力量，也是我对你下达的战书。
你必须放弃一个，做出选择吧。
EN: I have grown weary of the endless wait. The fate of this land is of no interest to me anymore.
However, you humans managed to meet the expectations of the Heavenly Principles... For that result, you deserve praise.
Mavuika, as the price for using my power, I shall now bear witness to your death.
And with you, the war that your nation has waged for more than a thousand years shall meet its end.
Ah, you got here sooner than I expected.
Closing the final chapter on the plan that has consumed Natlan for five hundred... no, for the entirety of our history.
We've eradicated the Abyss from Natlan, but its power remains in worlds beyond Teyvat, tremendous and unyielding.
Only by completely restoring the Night Kingdom can we defend against its corrosion in the long run.
But, the architect of the Night Kingdom is near her end. She lacks the power for such a task.
Worse still, if her life force is depleted, the rules of Natlan disappear along with her.
We have no need for the Ode of Resurrection right now, but it remains Natlan's strongest defense should the Abyss return one day.
Yes, my plan is to once again place my life within the Sacred Flame.
Five hundred years ago, I gave my life for the chance to be reborn in this era.
A chance to see all my plans to completion. And now, to sustain the Lord of the Night, I will give my life once more.
I respect your decision, Mavuika, but this method requires an immense sacrifice.
The flames of your life force are exceedingly strong, but a life sustained by fire is one destined to die out one day. What will you do then?

I've thought about that... With the Abyss out of the picture for now, the Sacred Flame's power will be consumed at a much slower rate. My life force should be able to sustain it for another two or three hundred years.
Future Pyro Archons will continue to seek new sources of fire. As long as Natlan's legacy endures, the Night Kingdom will survive, impervious to the Abyss.
Once again, you place hope in the hands of the future...
But, the Pilgrimage can replenish the power of the Sacred Flame! We can give it that meaning! Why shoulder this burden by yourself?
Because, I want the Pilgrimage to change.
The Pilgrimage was an essential part of our struggle against the Abyss — a grand competition full of promise and glory. But, it also chained our people to an inescapable destiny.
Fear and anxiety have been our constant companions. We knew what the consequences would be if we laid down our arms. Morality left us with no other choice.
And so, Natlan became the nation of war.
This is where Xbalanque defeated the dragons and granted our people the liberation of their flesh. And now, in the same place, I have the chance to grant them the liberation of their spirit.
There will be no war, only competition — one fueled by our dreams for the future rather than a desperate struggle for survival.
A new future deserves a new meaning, a chance to take a definitive step forward.
Very noble indeed, but what does any of this have to do with you? You speak of duty, but not yourself.
In my eyes, Mavuika, you are not inherently special — a child of Natlan among countless others.
Yes, the situation is urgent and the Ley Lines must be restored right away, but it is too heavy a burden for you to shoulder alone.
That is where we differ, Lord of the Night. You see all humans as the same, but I understand what it means to be a leader.
A leader is swift and decisive in the face of reality.
Someone capable of making the "right choice" even when there are no good options on the table.
Sacrificing the remainder of my life to help Natlan overcome this crisis... That is the right choice.
After all, leadership is built on the trust of ordinary people. Without them, there is no Archon.
The people look to their leader to make the world a better place and stand up for them when it counts.
For that reason, I must see my duty through to the very end.
But, what about you, Mavuika? You still haven't talked about what you want...
Is it that unimportant to you?
There is nothing more important than protecting the future we built together!
(It's hard to argue with her logic. She probably knew we would come and prepared what to say in advance.)
(It's time for Natlan to enter a new era, and I know she wants to fulfill her duty as a "leader," but...)
(She deserves to have a place in the future she built with her people.)
I shall accept Mavuika's sacrifice for the Lord of the Night as her death, and I will bear witness to the very end.
Thus concludes the deal I made with Xbalanque several thousand years ago.
Lord of the Night, you may now begin.
There is another who wishes to take part in the ceremony, and I cannot disregard their intentions. I must wait for them to arrive.
*sigh* I was to bear witness to a death, and now the situation is increasingly tenuous.
If the life of this second individual fails to meet my requirements, I fear I may lose my patience.
Rest assured, his life will hold equal value. I am the helper of humanity, and I must always place their demands first, no matter who the human may be.
Hm, cumbersome, but there is nothing to be done — such is the duty of an angel.
Thank you for showing me the way.
The other individual you mentioned... It was him?
Indeed. Like you, he carries many lofty ideals.
Mavuika, I understand how you feel, and if I were an ordinary mortal, I would have no reason to stop you.
But, like you, I have been waiting for this day for too long, and I can offer a better solution.
You created this new future, and you deserve to guide its direction. Your life should not end here.
But, death... is the end I have been trying to reach all along. I have come this far to use my death to open the gates of the Ley Lines to my people.
Wait, the souls I saw in my dream?
That's right. They have been with me for the past five hundred years.
But, how!? Carrying that many souls within you... There's no way you could keep your consciousness intact!
Besides, you weren't affected by the Source Mechanism like I was.
Do you still remember the voice that you "heard"?
It came from my heart. With the help of technology from Khaenri'ah, my heart was modified to convert memories and souls from the Ley Lines into knowledge.
As a result, I became extremely sensitive to souls and developed the ability to sense their presence... much like yourself.
After encountering countless lost souls during the disaster five hundred years ago, I forsook the capacity for knowledge granted by the modification and used my heart as a vessel instead.
The lives of my comrades, as well as many Natlanese, have been stored here ever since.
And you want to... send them home?
Yes. The Ley Lines will not accept them. But, by merging my existence with the Lord of the Night, I can become master of the Ley Lines and change the rules entirely.
He expressed this to me, and I agreed.
The Captain envisions a kinder and fairer set of rules for humanity. In addition, he aims to challenge the authority of the Ruler of Death... In a word, his goal is revenge.
After all, it's because of her that I bear the curse of immortality, the curse of absolute life.
I now understand that which you seek...
Then, bear witness to my resolve and hatred.
The people of Khaenri'ah committed grave sins, and for that we were cursed to suffer endless physical torment, cursed to witness the demise of everything we held dear.
But, most of us were innocent. Most of us knew nothing of the Five Sinners' exploitation of Abyssal power... myself included.
If I sacrifice my life for the Lord of the Night, you get the death you desire. But, at the same time, the curse of immortality would negate the very death you seek.
Left unresolved, that paradox could uproot the natural order of this world... Even you, great Ruler of Death, lack the capacity to bear the consequences of that outcome.
Your curse is now the tool with which I will overturn the oppression of the gods. This is my challenge to you...
Forsake one of your rules — the choice is yours.

title: 炽烈的还魂诗·当一切镌刻成碑

CHS: 不死诅咒依然存在，也就是说…他会永远坐在这里？
无须再追逐他的踪迹，对于不死之人来说，摆脱尘世便是最大的安宁。
即便如此，还请转达我最真挚的谢意。
漫长的旅途终于走到终点，对他来说，这种结局应该是圆满的吧。
我难以想象五百年间他究竟经受了多少煎熬，又是以如何强大的意志力才坚守住了心中的目标。
我有个无论如何都想知道的事…在我的记忆中，我似乎从来没见过「队长」睡觉。
在来的路上，我数次追问，他也不肯告诉我是为什么…还是老样子，涉及个人的事，他都一概不提。
灵魂相融之后，其他灵魂的声音就会在脑海中回响，一刻不停。
保持生命最后记忆的灵魂会不停地惨叫，哀嚎，发出绝望的呼喊…更别说他容纳的灵魂数量有如此之多。
难怪戴因延缓肉体衰老的方式…
若非亲历者，一定无法体会「不死诅咒」给他带去多少折磨。
所以他对死之执政的恨才如此强烈吧。
但在最后，借由和夜神合二为一的做法，夜神也获得了永恒的生命…
这一仗，他打得真漂亮啊。
你们可能会想，夜神之国到处都是灵魂，为何地面上流散的灵魂难以被接纳…
因为天理当初改造地脉的目的，就是为了对抗深渊，所以它的稳定性至关重要。
然而纳塔的地脉曾经毁坏过一次，夜神之国重建之后，因为要创造「还魂诗」的规则，也没有重新与其他国家连通。
这个特殊性，就让「队长」看到了机会。
他之前去其他国家尝试过？
没错，但无一例外都失败了。
他想要拯救纳塔，除了想要从深渊威胁中挽救尽可能多的人，也是因为只有这里可能给体内的灵魂一个安息之处。
不久之前，他和我进行了一次「商谈」，确认了计划的可行性。
我确实认为，改变地脉的规则有它的价值——纳塔有太多的灵魂无家可归，未来也可能有外来者在此地离逝…
在天理看来，这种改变的风险很高，或许难以容忍…但我是「天使」，我只是履行了为人类着想的使命而已。
感谢你为我们做了这么多。
茜特菈莉。还记得我把「圣夜旅织」给你和希诺宁的时候，对你说了些扫兴的话吗？
活下去是活多久呢，在我的眼中，十年或者一百年都是没有分别的。
但现在的我，会永远活下去——我十分感谢来自人类的馈赠，也为我的轻视而道歉。
不必这样说，对你来说这也是很沉重的责任。
沉重？并不会，我就是为此而生的。
再见了，创造奇迹的人类，新的时代在等着你们。
她也消失了，应该是回夜神之国了吧。
「队长」最后的目的竟然是这件事…
为了一群逝去的灵魂，战斗到最后，甚至撼动了世界的法则。
他是一位了不起的战士。
他做了本该是由我去做的事，还比我的原计划带来了更好的结果…这场对决，看来是我输了。
他说的没错。战争之后的纳塔该走向何处，原本这是我想交给下一任火神思考的问题，现在看来，就由我继续来做吧。
但在那之前，我想再次向英雄致以敬意。
EN: The curse of immortality still exists. Does that mean... The Captain will never move from this place?
Lord of the Night, is The Captain still with us?
There is no need to pursue traces of him. For those cursed with immortality, release from the mortal coil is the greatest form of peace.
Even so, please pass on my gratitude.
His long journey has finally come to a close. I suppose... this is a happy ending for him.
I cannot imagine how much pain he endured over the past five hundred years... or how much strength it took to never stray from his goal.
There's something I've been trying to figure out... I don't think I ever saw him sleep.
I tried to ask him about it on the way here, but he didn't answer. Just like always, he never talks about himself...
It's probably due to the voices.
When souls merge in a single being, their voices echo endlessly through the mind.
Souls that retain memories of their death often scream and wail in despair... Considering the number of souls inside him, that effect would be even greater.
So, over the past five hundred years, he didn't sleep... at all?
No wonder Dain's method of slowing the decay of his body...
Without experiencing the curse of immortality, we will never truly know his agony.
But, I can see why his hatred for the Ruler of Death was so strong.
In the end, he used that immortality to his advantage and granted the Lord of the Night eternal life by fusing his existence with hers.
You may wonder why the Night Kingdom, a land of souls, was unable to accept the souls adrift on the surface...
The reason lies in the Heavenly Principles' modifications to the Ley Lines. The original purpose was to help counter the Abyss. And so, their stability was paramount.
But, at one point in time, Natlan's Ley Lines were decimated. Even after reconstruction, the rules needed for the Ode of Resurrection made it impossible to reconnect the Ley Lines to other nations.
That unique quality is precisely what drew The Captain to Natlan.
Did he try the same thing in other nations?
Yes, but all those attempts ended in failure.
He fought to save Natlan not only to defeat the Abyss, but because this is the only land where the souls within him could find salvation.
We met not long ago to talk about that very possibility, and I confirmed the feasibility of his plan.
I, too, recognized the need to change the rules of the Ley Lines, not only for the souls that wander this land, but for the outlanders that may perish here in the future...
In the eyes of the Heavenly Principles, that kind of change is extremely risky, if not impermissible... But, as an Angel, I have a duty to serve humanity — such is my mandate.
Citlali, when I gave you the Pilgrim's Chronicle, I said something rather pessimistic to you... Do you remember?
How many years of life are enough? Ten? One hundred? I thought it made no difference...
But, now, I have the chance to live forever. I am immensely grateful to humanity for this gift, and I am deeply sorry I thought so little of it in the past.
You don't need to thank us. You bear a heavy responsibility.
Heavy? No. That responsibility is the purpose of my existence.
Farewell, humans, creators of miracles. A new era awaits you.
Looks like she returned to the Night Kingdom.
So, this was The Captain's goal all along...
He fought to the end for all those souls and challenged the rules of the world in the process.
He took on a burden that was meant for me and even brought about a better outcome... It would seem I lost this duel.
He was right — Natlan needs a leader to guide its future. If not a successor, then that responsibility will continue to be mine to bear.
But, for now, let us pay our final respects to this fallen hero.

title: 炽烈的还魂诗·当一切镌刻成碑

CHS: 检测到受邀者来访，尝试联系中央数据库。
欢迎来到天空岛的统合演算阵列「神之座」。
天空岛…我们真的到天空岛上来了啊。
开始阐述本次邀请的目的：你们已触犯无可饶恕的禁忌。依照预设程序，提瓦特需要进行「重置」。
生命，文明，管理者都需要回归初始状态，以保证提瓦特的稳定。
但你们通过完成试炼，证明了自身的价值，所以圣土化进程现已暂停。
你们很优秀，做得很好，值得肯定。
没想到都闹到这种程度了，你还愿意公正地审视我们。
理应被毁灭的文明并非都是失败的文明，文明最终会步入歧途，也是数据库与规划不完备的体现。
只要你们足够优秀，于我便有价值。
在空之神殿的初次接触，我曾问询，你们为何想要参与试炼，拯救世界。
我已知晓你们的答案，在试炼完成之后，我将基于这份答案给予最合适的奖励。
在最后的42天内，请挑选出你们各自心中最值得保留下来的一位神之眼持有者，也就是「原神」——
他们将作为本次文明最后的记录，登上天空岛。
这算什么合适的奖励啊？你、你难道根本没打算放过我们？！
重申：理应被毁灭的文明并非都是失败的文明，同理，证明自身价值的文明，依旧需要被毁灭。
我那时候告诉你，我喜欢提瓦特这个世界，因为它给我留下了很多美好的回忆，让我认识了很多朋友。
它对我而言非常重要，就像是第二个故乡一样重要，你为什么曲解了我的愿望！
无法理解。你说你因为提瓦特很美好所以想要守护它，所以我给了你们把最好的东西留下来的机会。
他们会作为「命运的向量」，将下一轮文明引导至更好的方向，这是名为永生的超越。
这也是「原神」最伟大的作用，之于提瓦特最重要的价值。
那我不得不提问，曾经已经登上天空岛的原神，比如温妮莎，她现在在哪里？
稍等，数据检索中…完成匹配定位，载入展示程序。
闪亮之处，即「剥离式神识、实在本体与心智存储核心」。
亦可简称为温妮莎的存放处。
存、存放？你怎么把人说得跟杂物一样！
生命的存在形式无关紧要，原神最重要的职责是引导命运，他们只需要专注于此即可。
这就是原神最后的下场…
既然你如此反感生命的僭越，为何不完全框定这所谓的命运，还要用原神来引导变数？
这是经由非常复杂与漫长的计算后得到的最优结果。
唯有运用这种规则创造的人类，才能和数据库中有关人类的记录取得最大程度的拟合。
我所诞生的世界已然消亡，无从获取外部信息，只能利用文明的衍化反哺系统，以取得进步。
简而言之，只有这套系统，才能让你们变得越来越好。
所以，我们只是你的养料，对吗？
极端情况下，是的。以「薪柴」形容更加贴切。
我不认为这应当招致怨恨，虽然真相稍显冷酷，但我已经足够宽容，我的视线也不会只停留在你们身上。
既然你有那么多文明样本，难道没想过反叛是一种必然？
就是，你话都说到这份上了，我们肯定会反抗到底！
世界的命运不该由你决定。
视角不同，结论不同，你们拥有畅想与行动的自由。
期限只有42天，在那之后，真正的毁灭将会降临。
不可理喻，没必要留在这里了。
EN: Invitees detected. Attempting to connect to the central database.
Welcome to the "Divine Throne," Celestia's integrated computational array.
Celestia... We actually made it to Celestia...
Proceeding to explain the reason for inviting you here: Your kind has committed a transgression for which there is no pardon. The default program requires Teyvat to be reset.
Life, civilization, and administrators are to be restored to their initial states to maintain the stability of Teyvat.
However, in completing the trials, you have proven your value. The Holy Soil phenomenon has therefore been suspended.
You have distinguished yourselves and performed admirably. This deserves recognition.
I'm pretty surprised you're willing to judge us fairly after all this ruckus.
Not every civilization that must be destroyed is a failed civilization. When civilization goes astray, it also reflects database and planning insufficiencies.
So long as you are sufficiently distinguished, you are of value to me.
When we first came into contact at the Temple of Space, I asked why you wished to undertake these trials and save the world.
I now have your answer, and with the trials complete, I shall grant you a reward that best meets your terms.
In these final 42 days, each of you is to select a single Vision bearer — or "allogene," as they are also known — whom you deem to be most worthy of preservation.
They shall ascend to Celestia as the final record of this civilization.
What kind of reward is that!? You... So you never had any intention of letting us survive!?
I reiterate: Not every civilization that must be destroyed is a failed civilization. Likewise, a civilization that has proven its value must still be destroyed.
What I told you was that I love this world because of all the friends I've made and the precious memories it's given me.
Teyvat is essential to me — it's like a second home. You've flagrantly misrepresented my terms! How dare you!
I do not understand. You expressed that you wished to protect Teyvat because of the wonderful things it has given you, so I have granted you the chance to preserve the very best of it.
As "Vectors of Fate," they shall guide the next cycle of civilization toward a better future. This is the definition of transcending and attaining immortality.
It is also the highest calling of the allogenes, and their greatest value to Teyvat.
Then I have to ask... Where are the allogenes who ascended to Celestia in the past? Where is Vennessa right now, for instance?
Please wait, retrieving data... Match found, location identified. Loading display program.
The flashing light marks the "Disembodied Divine Consciousness, Essential Self, and Mind Storage Core."
Or, more simply, where Vennessa is stored.
Stored!? How can you put people in storage like they're inanimate objects!?
The form life takes is insignificant. An allogene's foremost duty is to guide fate. They need only devote themselves to that task.
So that's what becomes of the allogenes...
If you find the arrogation of living beings to be so distasteful, why not delineate Fate as you see fit? Why give the allogenes any control over the variables at all?
This is the optimal result arrived at through immensely complex and extremely lengthy calculations.
Only humans created according to these rules can most closely model humanity as recorded in the database.
The world in which I was born is gone, and I cannot receive information from beyond. Progress is possible only by feeding the evolution of civilization back into the system.
Put simply, this is the only system that can allow you to become better and better over time.
So we're nothing more than fodder to you? That's what you're saying?
In extreme cases, that is correct. Although "fuel" would be a more accurate descriptor.
I do not believe this warrants resentment. The truth may appear somewhat cruel, but I have been lenient enough. My gaze extends far beyond you alone.
With so many samples of civilization to draw on, have you never considered that rebellion may be inevitable?
Yeah! After everything you've said, you can bet we're gonna fight back tooth and nail to the bitter end!
The fate of the world should not be yours to decide.
Different perspectives yield different conclusions. You have the freedom to imagine what you will and act as you choose.
Only 42 days remain. After that, true annihilation shall descend.
There is no point staying here. This entity cannot be reasoned with.

title: 寄自彼岸的昨日·叩响终幕之门

CHS: 【系统日志-非公共访问层级 记录者：努-乌尔-盖什图格】
…稍稍做了一些推演。玛歌老师…玛歌洁蒂研究员的研究方向似乎是正确的。
…数学上可以证明，任何足够复杂的系统，在计算能力上都完全等价，并且在观测意义上具备不可分辨的同一性。
…换言之，由高度精密的机械结构（或信息结构）模拟出的自我意识，与常规生命拥有的自我意识，在定义上并无区别。
…她渴望挽回昨日的生命，可是实现的结果却更像是要创造出明日的生命…对她来说，又何尝不是一种讽刺呢…
…今天见面的时候，卢沙里姆研究员向我提出了一个古怪的想法。
…基于他们目前的成果，理论上可以将研究者们所有美好的情感、愿望与理想摹刻为数据，并借助（…）使其诞生为不朽的「生命」——不是说永远不会毁灭（毕竟，只有疯子与毫无常识的蠢货才会相信，我们的宇宙允许永恒不灭的完美之物存在），而是无论毁灭多少次，也能够再度重新诞生。哪怕再度诞生之物已经不再具备龙的形体…
…这样一来，望月者的理想——还有玛歌老师的理想——便能无限传承下去，就像那束在宇宙中飘荡了数十个亿年的光一样。
…他想要将这个还没有诞生的生命称作「宁希姬娅」，意思是信使。毫无意义的感性想法…
…直接告诉他，我没有兴趣。我甚至不知道他为什么要对我说这些，我和他很熟吗？更何况，我是记录者，而非研究者…
…修库特尔王来访。那位性情温和的殿下对玛歌洁蒂研究员的理论相当感兴趣，并表示这与他先前正在进行的研究有相近之处。他希望通过燃素（也就是我们所说的计算素）创造出生命，这样一来，我们在地上的同胞也能稍稍轻松一些，生活也能更幸福。
…与修库特尔王长谈良久，受益匪浅。我不小心向他提及了卢沙里姆研究员的计划，他思索片刻，便给出了许多切实可行的建议…
…真的只是不小心。我已经开始后悔了。我是记录者，而非研究者。与修库特尔王的交谈，只是一时语失——我既不会、也不能、更不愿对卢沙里姆研究员的计划提供任何协助。
…出于记录者的严谨，将修库特尔王的建议转达给了卢沙里姆研究员。
EN: System Log - Non-Public Access Level | Recorder: Nu-ur-Gestug
...I have performed some brief deductions. It appears that Professor Maagees... Researcher Maagees-Geti was on the right path after all.
...Mathematically, the conclusion can be formally derived that any system of sufficient complexity is computationally equivalent and possesses an indistinguishable identity in any measurable sense.
...In other words, a self-awareness simulated by a sophisticated mechanical or informational architecture is, by definition, no different from the consciousness of organic life.
...She yearns to reclaim a life from yesterday, yet the result of her realization is the genesis of a life for tomorrow... For her, what could be more ironic?
...Researcher Lusalim approached me today with a peculiar proposal.

...Based on their current findings, he claims it is theoretically possible to engrave the full measure of a researcher's affections, desires, and ideals into data. Through the application of (...), these fragments could be manifested as an "immortal life." He does not mean "immortality" in the literal sense — After all, only a madman or a fool devoid of common sense would believe the laws of this universe permit the existence of an eternal, flawless object. Rather, he envisions a life that can re-emerge, infinitely, no matter how many times it is extinguished. Even if its new incarnation no longer bears the form of a dragon...

...In this way, he argues, the ideals of the Moongazers, and the aspirations of Professor Maagees could be broadcast across the ages, just like a certain beam of light drifting through the void for billions of years.
...He intends to name this unborn life "Nin-Kiggia," or messenger. Well, I bet it's nothing more than a whim of pure sentiment.
...I told him plainly that I have no interest. I don't even understand why he chose to confide in me. Are we truly so familiar? Besides, I am a recorder, not a researcher...

King Xiuhcoatl paid a visit today. His Highness, with his characteristic gentleness, expressed a profound interest in Researcher Maagees-Geti's theories, noting their parallels to his own ongoing work. He hopes to manifest life through the use of Phlogiston (or what we call computronium), so that our kin upon the surface might find some small relief, and perhaps, a measure of happiness.

...I spoke with the King at length, and I must admit the conversation was most enlightening. However, in a moment of carelessness, I mentioned Researcher Lusalim's plan to him. After a moment's reflection, His Highness offered a wealth of practical, actionable suggestions...

...It truly was a lapse in judgment. I have already begun to regret it. I am a recorder, not a researcher. My exchange with the King was merely a slip of the tongue — I neither can, nor will, nor do I have any desire to provide assistance to Lusalim's project.
...Yet, out of professional rigor, I have forwarded the King's suggestions to Researcher Lusalim anyway.
JP: 【システムログ-非公開アクセスレベル 記録者：ヌ・ウゥル・ゲシュトゥグ】
…少し推演を行ってみた。マーゴ先生…マーゴジェティ研究員の研究の方向性は正しいようだ。
…いかなる十分に複雑なシステムであっても、計算能力の点では完全に等価であり、かつ観測上の意義においては識別不可能な同一性を備えていることは、数学的に証明可能である。
…言い換えれば、高度に精密な機械構造（あるいは情報構造）によってシミュレートされた自我意識と、通常の生命が持つ自我意識との間には、定義上の違いは全くない。
…彼女は昨日の生命を取り戻すことを切望していたが、実現した結果はむしろ明日の生命を創り出すかのようなものだった…彼女にとって、これもまた一つの皮肉ではないだろうか…
…今日会った時、ルシャリム研究員がある奇妙な考えを提案してきた。

…彼らの現在の成果に基づけば、理論上、研究者たちのすべての美しい感情、願い、そして理想をデータとして刻み込み、（…）の力を借りてそれを不滅の「生命」として誕生させることができる——永遠に滅びないというわけではなく（なにしろ、私たちの宇宙に永遠不滅の完璧な存在が許されると信じるのは、狂人か非常識な愚か者だけだ）、何度滅びようとも、再び生まれ変わることができるということだ。たとえ再誕したものが、もはや龍の姿を持たないとしても…
…そうすれば、観月者の理想——そしてマーゴ先生の理想も——数十億年もの間、宇宙を漂ってきたあの一筋の光のように、無限に伝承されていくはずだ。
…彼はこのまだ誕生していない生命を、「使者」を意味する「ニンシジア」と呼びたいらしい。全く無意味で感傷的な考えだ…
…私は興味がないと、直接彼に伝えた。なぜ私にこんなことを言うのかすら分からない。私と彼はそこまで親しいのだろうか？ましてや、私は記録者であり、研究者ではない…
…シウコアトル王が来訪された。穏やかな性格の殿下は、マーゴジェティ研究員の理論に強い関心を示され、ご自身が以前から進めておられる研究と共通点があると仰った。殿下は燃素（すなわち我々が演算素と呼ぶもの）を通じて生命を創り出すことを望んでおられる。そうすれば、地上にいる私たちの同胞も少しは楽になり、より幸せな生活を送れるようになるだろうとのことだ。
…シウコアトル王と長く語り合い、大いに得るものがあった。つい口を滑らせ、ルシャリム研究員の計画について話してしまうと、殿下はしばらく思索し、多くの現実的かつ実行可能なアドバイスをしてくださった…
…本当にただうっかりしていただけなのだ。すでに後悔し始めている。私は記録者であり、研究者ではない。シウコアトル王との会話は、ほんの失言に過ぎない——私はルシャリム研究員の計画に対し、いかなる協力もしないし、できないし、したくもない。
…記録者としての厳格さに則り、シウコアトル王の提案をルシャリム研究員に伝えた。
KR: [시스템 일지-비공개 등급. 기록자: 누르-게슈투그]
…간단히 추론해 보았다. 마게스 선생님… 아니, 마게스게티 연구원의 연구 방향은 아무래도 옳은 듯하다.
…충분히 복잡한 모든 시스템은 수학적으로 동등한 계산 능력을 지니며, 관측만으로는 서로 구분할 수 없다는 것이 증명된다.
…다시 말해, 고도로 정밀한 기계 구조나 정보 구조로 구현한 자의식은 일반적인 생명이 지닌 자의식과 정의상 아무런 차이가 없다.
…그 연구원은 어제의 생명을 되돌리고자 했으나, 그 결과는 오히려 내일의 생명을 창조하는 것에 가까워졌다… 그녀에게 이보다 더한 아이러니가 또 있을까…
…오늘 만났을 때, 루살림 연구원이 내게 이상한 계획을 하나 제안했다.

…지금까지 거둔 성과에 따르면, 연구자들의 아름다운 감정과 소망, 이상을 정보로 새긴 뒤 (…)의 힘을 빌리면, 이를 불멸의 「생명」으로 탄생시킬 수 있다고 한다. 단, 여기서 말하는 불멸은 영원히 파괴되지 않는 완전무결함을 뜻하지 않는다(우주가 그런 존재를 허락한다고 믿는 자는 미치광이거나 상식 없는 멍청이뿐이니까). 몇 번이고 파괴되어도 그때마다 다시 태어날 수 있다는 뜻이다. 설령 더는 용의 형체를 유지하지 못하더라도…
…그 계획이 성공한다면 달바라기와 마게스 선생님의 이상은 끝없이 계승될 수 있을 것이다. 마치 수십억 년 동안 우주를 떠돌아온 그 빛처럼.
…그는 아직 태어나지 않은 그 생명을 「닌키기아」라 부르려 했다. 전령이라는 뜻이다. 아무 의미 없는 감상적인 발상이다…
…난 관심 없다고 말했다. 애초에 왜 이런 이야기를 내게 하는지도 모르겠다. 내가 그와 그렇게 친했던가? 게다가 나는 연구자가 아니라 기록자다…
…슈코아틀 왕이 찾아왔다. 온화하신 전하께서는 마게스게티 연구원의 이론에 상당한 관심을 보였고, 자신이 이전부터 진행해 온 연구와도 유사한 부분이 있다고 말씀하셨다. 그는 열소, 즉 우리가 말하는 연산 소체를 이용해 생명을 창조하고자 했다. 그렇게 된다면 지상의 동포들도 조금은 더 편안하고 행복한 삶을 누릴 수 있을 테니까.
…슈코아틀 전하와 오랫동안 이야기를 나누며 많은 것을 배웠다. 그러다 실수로 전하께 루살림 연구원의 계획을 언급하고 말았다. 전하는 잠시 생각에 잠기더니, 실제로 실행 가능한 제안을 여럿 내놓았다…
…후회가 된다. 나는 기록자이지, 연구자가 아니다. 슈코아틀 전하와의 대화는 그저 말실수였을 뿐, 나는 루살림 연구원의 계획에 어떠한 협조도 하지 않을 것이며, 할 수도 없고, 하고 싶지도 않다.
…기록자로서의 엄밀함 때문에, 슈코아틀 전하의 제안을 루살림 연구원에게 전달했다.

title: 《亚-伊里穆存储阵列索引表·其一》

CHS: 【系统日志-公共访问层级 记录者：努-乌尔-盖什图格】
…「望月者」伊比尼伯龙建造于涅法海姆的轨道定位设施（以下称为「碑铭」）已完成二阶改修。挂载数据储存阵列完成。
…自月面终端至地表接收节点的下行链路测试已完成。信息吞吐量及保真度均显著高于初始预估。
…该冗余节点的部署将有效提升本存储阵列整体的架构稳健性与容错阈值。假设未来发生不可预见的极端事态，致使月面主存储阵列遭受不可逆的损坏（包括但不限于物理损坏与认知污染），后续研究者仍可访问位于涅法海姆的备用存储阵列，以实现对核心研究成果的无损回溯与检索。
…原「碑铭」已进行加固。当前已完成针对（…）与（…）等武器系统的对抗测试，具体记录可参阅附录。尽管并非设计本意，但该设施亦可作为紧急情况下的避难所使用。
EN: System Log - Public Access Level | Recorder: Nu-ur-Gestug

...Phase II retrofitting of the orbital positioning facility in Nephilheim — constructed by Moongazer Ibni-Belum, hereafter referred to as "Engraving" — is complete. The data storage array has been successfully mounted.
...Downlink testing from the lunar terminal to the surface receiving node has concluded. Both data throughput and fidelity significantly exceed initial estimates.

...Deployment of this redundant node will effectively enhance the overall structural robustness and fault-tolerance threshold of the storage array. In the event of unforeseen, extreme circumstances resulting in irreversible damage (including but not limited to physical destruction and cognitive contamination) to the primary lunar storage array, subsequent researchers will retain access to the backup storage array in Nephilheim, ensuring the lossless retrieval and recovery of core research results.

...The original "Engraving" has been reinforced. Countermeasure testing against (...) and (...) weapon systems has concluded. For detailed records, refer to the appendix. Despite its original design intent, the facility is capable of serving as an emergency bunker.
...May the Creator be forever crowned with supreme glory.
JP: 【システムログ-公開アクセスレベル 記録者：ヌ・ウゥル・ゲシュトゥグ】
…「観月者」イビニベルンがネフィルヘイムに建造した軌道測位施設（以下「碑銘」と呼称）の第二段階改修が完了。データ記憶装置のマウントが完了した。
…月面端末から地表受信ノードへの下りリンクのテストが完了した。情報スループットおよび忠実度はいずれも初期の推定値を著しく上回っている。

…この冗長ノードの配置は、本記憶装置全体のアーキテクチャの堅牢性と耐障害性の閾値を効果的に向上させる。将来的に予見不可能な極端な事態が発生し、その結果月面の主記憶装置が不可逆的な損傷（物理的損傷および認知汚染を含むが、これらに限定されない）を被ったと仮定しても、後続の研究者は依然としてネフィルヘイムに位置する予備記憶装置にアクセスすることができ、主要研究成果の無損失での復元および検索を実現できる。
…元の「碑銘」は補強済みである。現在、（…）および（…）などの兵器システムに対する対抗テストは完了しており、詳細な記録については付録を参照のこと。本来の設計意図ではないが、当該施設は緊急時の避難所としても使用可能である。
…無上の栄光が、永遠に創造主に帰さんことを。
KR: [시스템 일지-공개 등급. 기록자: 누르-게슈투그]
…「달바라기」 이브니벨용이 네필헤임에 건설한 궤도 위치 추적 시설(이하 「비석」)의 2단계 개조가 완료되었다. 정보 저장 배열의 탑재도 마쳤다.
…달 표면 단말기에서 지표 수신 노드로 이어지는 하향링크 실험이 완료되었다. 정보 처리량과 보존도 모두 초기 예측치를 크게 웃돌았다.
…해당 예비 노드의 배치는 본 저장 배열 전체의 구조적 안정성과 장애 허용 능력을 효과적으로 높일 것이다. 향후 예측 불가능한 극한 사태로 달 표면 저장 배열이 물리적 손상이나 인지 오염을 비롯한 비가역적 손상을 입더라도, 후대의 연구자들은 네필헤임의 예비 저장 배열에 접근해 핵심 연구 성과를 손실 없이 추적하고 찾아낼 수 있을 것이다.
…기존 「비석」의 보강 작업이 완료되었다. 현재 (…) 및 (…) 등의 무기 체계를 상대로 한 대응 실험도 마쳤으며, 자세한 기록은 부록을 참조하기 바란다. 본래 설계 의도에는 없었지만, 긴급 상황에서는 이곳을 대피 시설로 활용할 수 있다.
…찬란한 영광이 영원토록 창조주께 깃들기를.

title: 《亚-伊里穆存储阵列索引表·其二》

CHS: 姐姐们！我回来啦！快看看我身后的这是谁！
是在未来诞生的，我们可爱的妹妹哦！
那我来介绍一下吧，这位是哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅。
这位是艾莉亚姐姐，恒月女神。
这位是卡侬姐姐，霜月女神。卡侬姐姐，希珀塞莱尼娅她的力量和你好像哦。
哈…你好，哥伦比娅。抱歉，我们刚才只是有些惊讶，也请原谅我们这位有些吵闹的桑娜妲妹妹。
看来是位有些怕生的妹妹呢。不用担心，哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅。在这里没人会伤害你。
…拜托了，我真的需要知道这些。
…这里，是提瓦特原初之主——龙王尼伯龙根，用来囚禁「月神」的监牢。
原初之主，龙王尼伯龙根在亘古的往昔创造了我们，用以维护提瓦特的运转。
但后来，它离开了提瓦特。前往漆黑的宇宙去探寻更广阔的世界。
我等日夜不断，于天空中履行着自己的职责。直到有一天，出现了第一位来到这个世界的降临者…
这是后世给予它的称呼吗？嗯…起初我们并不排斥它的到来，它看起来对这个世界也没有恶意。
我们相安无事，就当是家里进了一位客人。
但渐渐地，我们发现这位「客人」开始对这个世界显露出了某种改造与支配的欲望。
没有。它的规则中存在一种龙王不曾教给我们的「秩序」。
我们想知道，这种秩序对提瓦特来说是好是坏。
好吧，至少我和卡侬想要知道。桑娜妲…对此持反对意见。
后来我们发现，这位「高天的主宰」对一些生灵追寻力量的行为有着近乎偏执的敌意。或说，恐惧。
以至于它会降下代表自身力量的天钉，惩罚地上的生灵。
那已经…远超「惩罚」的范围了…
…没错，就算它的规则能带来秩序，但触碰规则的代价未免太过沉重。
我尽我所能帮助那些受罚之人逃离灾害，但…依旧有太多生灵死在了它的手下。
（那些受帮助的人中，也有着「霜月之子」的祖先…）
而就在我们决定对此采取某些措施的时候，那位原初的龙王回来了。
…原来后世是如此命名这场战争的吗？
…据我所知，葬火之战中「天理」惨胜。最终留在了提瓦特，继续着它的统治…
而那位原初之主，龙王尼伯龙根…就此陨灭…
那…那月亮呢？天空中，依旧有着三个月亮吗？
…你无需顾虑，哥伦比娅。我们已不过是旧日历史中的余辉，对此早有准备。
…天空中，仅余「霜月」。但也被「天理」抛出了虚假之天。
「恒月」和「虹月」…都已在战争中破碎…
果然，我们终究还是逃不过死亡吗…
月神是无法脱离自己的月亮而活的，哥伦比娅。
（她说得对…霜月仅仅是被虚假之天阻隔，就足以让我消失，更不用说是碎裂…）
在这个月宫中的我们神体虽存，但若是属于我们的月亮碎裂…
那我们在离开这里的那一刻，神体也将就此消散…
你无需向我们道歉，亲爱的妹妹。
不如说…该向这个世界道歉的是我们…
如果我们早一些做出决断…而不是彼此争吵的话…
…那我们此刻就更不应该在此自怨自艾了。
不如好好想想，该怎么帮到我们未来可爱的妹妹吧。
难道不是吗？哥伦比娅。我看得出，你的故事还仍未结束。
EN: Sisters! I'm back — and look who I've brought with me!
It's our lovely little sister, born in the far future!
Allow me to introduce you to Columbina Hyposelenia.
This is Aria, the goddess of the Eternal Moon.
And this is Canon, goddess of the Frost Moon. Canon, don't you think Hyposelenia's power is similar to yours?
*sigh*... Hello, Columbina. I apologize for our startled reaction just now... and please forgive our little sister if she's been annoying you — she tends to talk a lot.
You seem shy. Don't worry, Columbina Hyposelenia. No one can hurt you here.
...This is where Teyvat's original ruler, the Dragon King Nibelung, imprisoned the moon goddesses.
Nibelung, our original master, created us in the distant past to maintain Teyvat.
But he left this world and traveled into the dark universe beyond, to explore worlds vaster still.
Day and night, we fulfilled our duty in the heavens... until the day that the first Descender arrived...
Is that what later generations call them? I see... But we did not reject them at first, nor did they seem to harbor ill-intent towards this world.
We co-existed in peace. They were like a guest in our home.
Slowly, however, we came to realize that our guest had a growing desire to change and dominate the world.
No. There was an order to the rules they set up that Nibelung never taught us.
We wanted to know if this order would bode good or ill for Teyvat.
...Alright, Canon and I wanted to know. Sonnet... was against it from the outset.
Later, we discovered that this great ruler of the firmament bore an almost paranoid hostility toward the desire of certain life forms to seek power... Or perhaps they feared them.
They would even cast down celestial nails as manifestations of their power, to punish the civilizations of the world below.
Only... This was far beyond mere punishment...
...Right. Their rules brought order, but the price people paid for merely testing the limits of those rules was far too great.
I did everything in my power to help the punished escape catastrophe, but still... too many lives were lost.
(The ancestors of the Frostmoon Scions were some of the ones that you helped...)
But just when we had decided to take countermeasures, the Dragon King, Nibelung returned.
And so began the war of funerary flame...
...So that's the name the world gave that war in the future.
Well... Who won in the end?
As far as I know, the Heavenly Principles won, although it came at a great cost. They remained in Teyvat, where they continue to rule to this day...
And the world's original master, the Dragon King, Nibelung, was destroyed...
Then... what of the moons? Are there still three moons in Teyvat's skies?
You can tell us the truth, Columbina. We know we are but remnants of a bygone age. We are prepared for the answer.
...Only the Frost Moon remains. But it has been cast beyond the false firmament by the Heavenly Principles.
The Eternal and Iridescent Moons were both shattered during the war...
So death finally came for us in the end...
But... You're still here, aren't you...?
A moon goddess cannot live without her moon, Columbina.
(She's right... That's why I began to disappear — because the Frost Moon is cut off by the false sky. How much worse it would have been if it were outright destroyed...)
Our souls may endure within this lunar palace, but if our moons are destroyed...
...Then we shall disappear the moment we depart from it.
There's no need to apologize to us, dear sister.
If anything, we owe the world an apology...
If only we'd decided to act sooner, rather than arguing amongst ourselves...
...All the more reason not to spend this time in regret and repentance.
Instead, we should focus our efforts on how we might help our future sister.
Don't you see, Columbina? Your story is not yet over. Is that not why you are here?

CHS: 嗯，我们已将三月的权能，全都转交予了哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅。
自此刻起，她就是这个世界上唯一的「三月女神」了。
谢谢…谢谢你们…我的姐姐们…
去做你认为该做的事吧。哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅。
嗯，我们无法将囚牢外三轮月亮的力量也交给你，围绕我们消失后残骸所产生的纷争，在未来依旧会诞生。
…！姐姐们！我的身体…好像感觉有些…
献出了权能与力量的我们，此刻仅余凡人的身躯。「囚牢」已经开始消解这副躯壳了…
没事的，桑娜妲。这不过是任何一个人、任何一位神明都将前往的终点。我和卡侬会陪在你身边的。
…作为我们最后的请求，哥伦比娅。
能请你用三月的力量，送我们离开这里，回到现实吗？
失去了权能的我等，应该不再会受到这个空间的刁难。
但…最后的时光，果然还是想在属于我们三姐妹的「家」中度过。
（想告诉她不要屈服于深渊…不要害怕…但在这种时候，真的应该说这些吗…）
…不，没什么。我很高兴，能有你这样一个姐姐。
嗯…我不会怕的。只要是和姐姐们一起，我就不会害怕…
替我们好好看看这个世界…
接下来…我也该和自己的身体告别了…
…就让它化作月光，陪伴挪德卡莱度过漫长的时间吧。
（原来…这就是挪德卡莱此前不存在「月矩力」的原因…）
（这份力量，是在我将身体洒向挪德卡莱后才出现的…也只在挪德卡莱出现…）
（现实中的「月矩力」之所以能够回应我…是因为那本就是我的身体，它仅仅是在回应我的灵魂…）
（而我一路走来见到的那些金色的力量，那是我即将留在此地的灵魂在指引自己…）
三月的权柄，亘古的月光啊…
我，哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅，在此将自己的身体弃置…将它抛入晦暗的长夜，命它照亮无垠的未来…
让它伴随这片大地…伴随那月下的生灵…
直到…我「归家」的那一刻到来…
…♪愿繁花与美梦盛开在你窗边♪
…♪即便尘埃玷染你洁白的羽毛，即便你不再躺在温暖的怀抱♪
…♪也愿你在梦中与月相伴而眠♪
EN: Yes. We have transferred the authority over all three moons to Columbina Hyposelenia.
From this moment on, she is the Trilune Goddess, the one and only moon goddess of this world.
Thank you... Thank you, my sisters...
Now go, and do what you believe is right, Columbina Hyposelenia.
Be aware that we cannot grant you the power of the three moons beyond these prison walls. The conflict that arose over their remains following our disappearance will still take place.
Now that we have given up our power and authority, our bodies are merely mortal shells. This prison is dissolving them as we speak...
It's okay, Sonnet. The end must come for every god, just as it does for every human. That's all this is — the final destination of our lives. Canon and I will be by your side the whole way.
Could you use the three moons' power to send us back into the real world?
Now that we have lost our powers, I doubt this space will seek to hold us further.
It's just... we would like to spend our final moments together in the only place we ever called home.
(I wish I could tell her not to give in to the Abyss, not to be afraid... But is this really what I should say at this moment?)
...Don't forget... I'm so glad to have a big sister like you.
I'm okay... I'm not afraid. As long as my sisters are with me, I won't be afraid...
It looks like... This is goodbye, sisters...
Take care of this world... in our stead...
And now, it's time for me to bid farewell to my body, too...
...May it become the moonlight that keeps Nod-Krai company through the long years ahead.
(So this is why Nod-Krai was not always home to kuuvahki...)
(It only appeared after I poured my body out upon this land, and only this land...)
(Kuuvahki responds to me, because... it is me. My body, answering the call of my soul...)
(And the golden energy I've encountered on my way here was, in fact, that very soul — which I am about to leave here to guide me...)
I, Columbina Hyposelenia, lay aside my body... Let it be cast into the dark night, to illuminate the future...
May it be a companion to all who dwell beneath the moon...
Until the time comes for me to return home
♪ Sleep, sleep now, my dear little dove ♪
♪ May flowers and lovely dreams bloom by your window ♪
♪ O little dove, child of the moon ♪
♪ Though dust may stain your fair white feathers, though you lie down not in a warm embrace ♪
♪ May the moon be with you in your slumber ♪

title: 《最初的那抹月光》·卡侬、哥伦比娅

CHS: 旅程的终点到了，她就是开启望月者计划的钥匙。
是望月者计划的最后继承者，留在这里的印迹。
我是宁希姬娅，你也可以叫我宁宁，是我的小名。
你叫什么名字？伊比尼伯龙？乌吉恩？玛歌？还是卢沙里姆？
嘿嘿，不用回答我，因为很遗憾，我已经不在了，这只是一段留言。
但反过来想，其实一点也不遗憾，因为你来到了这里，这说明计划成功了，你继承了我们的使命。
你一定还有很多疑惑，比如——「我到底是谁？」。
让我告诉你，你是由月球意志创生的新生命，你是望月者计划的重要一环。
「那这个计划究竟是什么呢？」，你肯定又在这么想…别着急，听我说。
首先，请感谢三月女神，她们容许了我们的僭越，借用了月球本源的创生之力。
其次，感谢我的老师卢沙里姆。他继承了所有人的研究成果，还成功搜集了大家的古月力信息。
这样一来，我才能把信息汇聚于这片月心之海，当本源的创生之力被激发时，「砰」的一下——
一只可爱的黑色月灵，也就是你，诞生了。
你可能会继承信息海洋中某位前辈的名字，也可能不会，但大概你能想起你有一个使命。
原来这就是黑蛋的诞生…
接下来，还要感谢玛歌前辈，她揭开了那位星空访客的本质——一种信息生命，她的研究是你诞生的基石。
还有乌吉恩前辈，他付出生命，传递了那位访客所代表的文明最后向星空传递的消息。
然后，是最初的望月者，伊比尼伯龙，他带着我们登上月亮，睁大了我们的眼睛，永不疲倦地望向璀璨星空。
最后，继承者，还要感谢你，因为你即将献出自己，去望月者高塔启动计划的最后一环。
你的使命，就是继续向宇宙发送我们曾经接收到的信息。
「一束光很微弱，很容易被黑暗吞没，但只要在它消失前有另一束光亮起…」
「那么总有一天，总有一束光，会成为刺破夜幕的曙光。」
说到这里，你应该理解了吧？刚好，我的时间差不多也要到了…但没关系，我马上就来加入大家了。
这样一想，搞不好，你继承的可能会是我的名字呢，哈哈。
该说再见了，去完成你的使命吧。最后…向你和所有的望月者致意。
所有探寻过星空的学者，他们的信息都被融入了这片海洋，借着月球的意志，在未来的某天以黑蛋的模样再次诞生。
它们会本能地互相吞噬，来获取更多信息，直到脑海中的使命变清晰。
然后再走一遍我们所走过的路，来到这里，得知一切。
它们会用自己当作钥匙，打开伊比尼伯龙之眼的望月者模块。向宇宙重新发送消息。
嗯，这个循环可能已经不止发生过一次了。
但是，向未知的星空发出声音，未必是一件安全的事。
龙族的学者一定也意识到了这点，所以开始研究月幕工程。
而在宁宁的年代，世界因为两位至高者的争斗，已是将要毁灭的样子。
可现在，提瓦特已经恢复了平静，至少现在如此。
（如果这次发出的信号，最后却让星空中的黑暗注意到这里…）
我会依照承诺，把钥匙和信息交给宁宁。
但你觉得我们应该阻止宁宁完成她的使命，还是支持她？
嗯，我理解。那我们就返回那座最初的望月者高塔吧。
放心，玛歌会接上她们的。
去那里还有不短的路程。我们可以多考虑一下。
EN: Our journey has reached its end. She is the key to activating Project Moongazer.
An imprint left here by the project's final inheritor.
I'm Nin-Kiggia. You can call me Ninnin. That's what people usually call me.
What's your name? Ibni-Belum? Ungien? Maagees? Or are you Lusalim?
Hehe, no need to answer me. Unfortunately, I'm no longer here. This is just a recording.
But if you look at it another way, it's not "unfortunate" at all. You're here, and that means the plan was a success — you have inherited our mission.
You must still be very confused about a great number of things, such as — "Who exactly am I?"
Let me tell you: You are a new life created through the will of the moon, a crucial part of Project Moongazer.
"And what exactly is this project?" you must be thinking... Don't worry, I'll get to that.
First, please thank the Three Moon Sisters, who permitted our transgression and allowed us to borrow the power of creation from the moon's very origin.
Secondly, thanks are owed to my teacher, Lusalim. He inherited everyone's research and successfully collated all their ancient moon energy data.
That's how I was able to gather that data in this sea at the moon's core. Then, when the primordial power of creation was triggered... "Bam!"—
A cute little black kuuhenki — namely you — was born.
You might inherit the name of someone who came before us through the ocean of data, or you might not, but you will probably recall that you have a mission.
So this is how Eggie was born...
Next, we must say thank you to Madam Maagees, who uncovered the nature of our astral visitor — a data-based lifeform. Her research was the foundation upon which you were born.
And we have Ungien, who sacrificed his life to relay the final message that our guest's civilization sent out into the stars.
Then came the first Moongazer, Ibni-Belum, who led us to the moon, opened our eyes, and tirelessly gazed into the brilliant starry skies.
Finally, dear successor, thank you as well for your imminent sacrifice, which will activate the final step of our project.
Your mission is to continue transmitting the message we once received out into the universe.
"A single ray of light is feeble, easily swallowed by the darkness, but as long as another light shines out before it can fade..."
"Then one day, there will surely come a ray of light that pierces the night like the dawn."
I imagine you understand what I mean at this point, yes? As it happens, my time is almost up... But that's okay. I'll be joining them all soon.
Come to think of it, you might actually have inherited my name, hehe.
It's time to say goodbye. Go complete your mission. And lastly... I salute you, and all your fellow Moongazers.
All the researchers who once explored the starry sky have had their data merged into this ocean. By the will of the moon, they will be reborn at some point in the future in forms akin to Eggie's.
They will instinctively consume each other to acquire more data until the mission becomes clear in their minds.
Then they will walk the path we have walked once more, come here, and learn everything.
They will use themselves as keys to open the Moongazer module in the Eye of Ibni-Belum, and resend the message out into the universe.
Then, they will return to the cycle of life...
Yes, and this cycle may have already happened more than once.
That said, calling out into unknown space is not necessarily safe.
The dragon researchers must have also realized this, which is why they began work on the Lunar Veil.
And in Ninnin's era, the world already teetered on the brink of destruction due to the conflict between two supreme beings.
But peace has been restored in Teyvat, at least for now.
(If the signal sent out this time ends up drawing the attention of the darkness that dwells amidst the stars to this place...)
As promised, I will hand the key and the message over to Ninnin.
But do you think we should stop her from completing her mission? Or should we support her?
I need some time to think.
Mmhmm, I understand. Then let us return to the first Moongazer's tower.
Don't worry. Maagees will pick them up.
It'll be a fairly long journey. We'll have plenty of time to give this some more thought.
Let's go. It's time to leave.

title: 《望月者计划》·宁希姬娅的印迹

CHS: 旅行者，哥伦比娅，看来你们在月心的冒险很顺利！
哦？黑蛋的来历，还有望月者计划的内容，都知道了吗？
嗯，还有打开望月者模块的钥匙，都在这里了。
宁宁，我现在把它交给你。
等你读取了这里的信息，就会知道你的使命是什么。
谢谢你！我一直在等待这一刻。
哥伦比娅？旅行者？你们的脸色怎么都那么沉重呀？
因为她的使命中存在不可知的风险。
等你读取了这里面的信息，你就知道了。
我有点不明白了，黑蛋的使命到底是什么呀？
在黑蛋读取信息的同时，你们将一切告诉了派蒙。
向星空中发送信息？原来这就是望月者计划的内容…
所以风险是…这可能会让提瓦特暴露？怎么会这样…好为难！
哎呀，你先别伤心呀。我们还可以再商量一下对不对？
我不伤心，眼泪也没有流，这只是…这只是…
哥伦比娅，旅行者，派蒙。谢谢你们。
你们是我的朋友，我不想让朋友为难，所以我愿意…放弃这个使命。
没关系，派蒙。我不是第一个执行望月者计划的人。
我的前辈，早就向星空发出了属于我们的声音。
那些充满勇气的声音，一定已经传递到很远很远的星空深处了吧。
只要有那些声音在，星空就不会是一片死寂，那样就足够了。
也许可以最后执行一次望月者计划。
我们真的可以冒一次险吗？
迄今为止，望月者计划已经执行了不止一次。
用来隐藏提瓦特的虚假之天，也已经被打开了不止一次。
霜月曾在虚假之天外存在了数千年。现在月球上也并没有出现深渊污染的痕迹。
哦？你是说，也许并没有想象中那么危险？
可能性有很多，也许深渊不是每时每刻都盯着这里，也许是高天的主宰做了其它措施…
而为了把风险降到最低，我也会用月神的力量，掩护宁宁发出的信息。
月矩力和古月之力本质上都是光界力，我可以将我的力量融入宁宁发出的信息中。
等到那些信息穿越虚假之天后，我还可以通过那些力量，监测附近的情况。
一旦有危险，我可以将信息抹除。这样一来，我们就不会被发现。
哦？这好像是个好办法！但你的力量…可以一直维持吗？
唔，我的力量也有极限，只能坚持到一定距离。
我会尽全力，把它送去我能抵达的极限。届时它的来源也不会被轻易定位了吧。
放心。支持着我们的，是一整个月亮。
那黑蛋你做好准备了吗？一旦决定，可就无法回头了！
为什么你们愿意为我做这些？
我明白了，那么，我做好准备了。
我的诞生，就是为了这一刻。
嗯，向星空发出你的声音吧，提瓦特的月光会送你远航。
很高兴…能够向神秘又浩瀚的星空送出这条讯息…
我不知道，它能否被接收…但我想，它至少能为冰冷的宇宙驱散一些死寂。
如果真有一个你听见了，那说明一定存在着某种特别的引力，像月亮一样，捕捉了我们。
所以，我希望你们的文明知道…在这片无垠的星空下，你们并不孤单。
我们的时代快要落幕了…但我们的勇气、信念、智慧会和这道渺小的讯息一起回荡在星海间。
它微不足道，但它是我们的光…我希望它能鼓舞你们——在这片星空下，你们不是在独自地迎接未知与黑暗。
请继续向星空发出属于你们的声音吧，让它也成为你们的光。
一束光很微弱，很容易会被黑暗吞没，但只要在它消失前有另一束光亮起…
那么总有一天，总有一束光，会成为刺破夜幕的曙光。
最后…我们是…宇宙中一个不起眼角落里的… 望月者…
向所有能听见的你…致意…
朋友们…谢谢…我们在星空下…再见吧…
我没问题。不过接下来，我需要集中注意力，直到我的力量达到极限。
那我们快去找一个安静的地方吧。
再见了，黑蛋，我会永远记得你。
（…似乎因为望月者模块的激活，无意间开启了一段尘封的数据…）
…因为无法准确定位坐标…不知需要多久…回讯才能抵达你…
…我们是在宇宙间…孤独穿行许久的旅者…而你们的声音…就像黑暗森林中突然燃起的篝火…
…这很冒险…却又无畏…让我们感到振奋与温暖…
…我相信…这个时刻…是星海与命运的引力…将你我连接在一起…
…未来…我们会尝试…寻找你们…星球…但很遗憾不是现在…因为还有一些…的麻烦…
…就像你说的，星海广阔无垠，我们并不孤单…
…愿我们有天能在星空下再见…
虽然很遗憾，但我们不能冒险。
如果说，我可以用月神的力量，掩护宁宁发出的信息呢？
EN: 旅行者, Columbina! Looks like things went just dandy for you two at the moon's core, huh?
We did indeed learn a lot.
Oh? So you know where Eggie came from, and what Project Moongazer's all about?
Yes, and the key to unlock the Moongazer module — it's all right here.
I'll hand it over to you now, Ninnin.
Once you've read the information here, you'll know what your mission is.
Thank you! I have been waiting for this moment.
Columbina? 旅行者? Why do you two look so serious?
Because her mission involves unknown risks.
You'll find out by the time you're done reading.
Paimon's a little confused... What exactly is Eggie's mission?
As Eggie reads the information, you tell Paimon everything.
Sending a message into the starry sky? So that's what Project Moongazer's all about...
So the risk is... we could expose Teyvat? Are you serious? This... Ugh, this is a tough call...
Hey, don't be sad! We can still talk this over, right?
Remember those snacks? We can split 'em fifty-fifty, no problem!
I'm not sad. And I'm not crying. This is just... just...
A toast to those who came before.
Columbina, 旅行者, Paimon. Thank you.
You're my friends. I don't want to make things difficult for you, so I'm willing to... give up on my mission.
It's okay, Paimon. I'm not the first to have executed this plan.
My predecessors have long since sent our voices out into the stars.
Those voices, so filled with courage, must have traveled to the farthest reaches of the starry skies by now.
As long as those voices endure, silence cannot reign across the universe, and that is enough.
旅行者... have you made up your mind?
Maybe we could execute Project Moongazer one last time.
Can we really take that risk?
Moongazer has already been executed many times.
The false sky used to conceal Teyvat has also been opened more than once.
The Frost Moon has existed outside the false sky for thousands of years. Yet even now, there are no traces of Abyssal corruption here.
Oh? You mean this might not be as dangerous as we thought?
There are many possibilities. Perhaps the Abyss isn't constantly watching this place, or perhaps the great ruler of the firmament has taken other measures...
And to minimize risks, I will also use my power as the Moon Goddess to shield any message that Ninnin might send.
Kuuvahki and the ancient moon's energy are both, in essence, the power of the Light Realm. As such, I can infuse my power into the transmitted messages.
Once the data passes through the false sky, I can also use that same power to monitor the surrounding area.
If there's danger, I can erase the information. That way, we won't be discovered.
Oh? That sounds great! But... can you maintain your power the whole time?
Well, my strength does have limits. I can only keep it going up to a certain distance.
I will try to shield the message as far as possible. At that point, its source will not be so easily traced.
Don't worry. We have the support of an entire moon here, you know.
So, are you ready, Eggie? Once you've made up your mind, there'll be no turning back!
Why would you do all this for me?
Yes. That's all the reason I need.
I understand. Then, I am ready.
I was born for this moment.
Alright. Now, sing out toward the stars. Teyvat's moonlight shall send you off on your voyage.
I am so glad... to be able to send this message out into the mysterious vastness of space...
I don't know if it will reach you... But, if nothing else, let it at least dispel some of the silence that fills this cold universe.
If "you" are out there and you hear this, then there must surely be some kind of special gravity that, like the moon, has captured us both.
So, I'd like you and your civilization to know... that you are not alone beneath this boundless starry sky.
Our era is drawing to a close... but our courage, faith, and intellect will echo across the sea of stars... via this tiny message.
It is insignificant, but it is our light... I hope it emboldens you. You do not face the unknown and the darkness alone.
Please keep sending your voices out into the stars, and let them become your light too.
A single ray of light is feeble, easily swallowed by the darkness, but as long as another light shines out before it can fade...
Then one day, there will surely come a ray of light that pierces the night like the dawn.
Last but not least... we are... Moongazers in an unremarkable corner of the universe...
To everyone who can hear this... We send you our regards...
My friends... Thank you... Let us meet again... beneath the starry skies...
I'm fine. But I need to stay focused for what comes next, since I'll be pushing my strength to its limits.
Then let's hurry and find a quiet place!
Goodbye, Eggie... Paimon will always remember you.
(...It seems the activation of the Moongazer module has activated a sealed data segment...)
...Unable to... accurately pinpoint your coordinates... I cannot know how long... this reply reaches you...
...But I'd like to... respond... at this very moment...
...We are travelers... who have traversed the universe alone for a long time... and your voices... it is as if a bonfire has suddenly lit up a dark forest...
...You take great risks... yet you are fearless... You inspire us and warm our hearts...
...I believe... in this moment... it is the gravity of the starry sea and destiny... that connects you and me...
...In the future... we will try... to find your... planet... but not now, unfortunately... We're still dealing with... some trouble...
...Aether! Are you ready?/...Lumine, how're we doing?
...Just as you said, the sea of stars is vast and boundless, and we are not alone...
...Let us meet again beneath the starry skies...
I send you all my regards.
It's unfortunate, but we can't take the risk.
And what if I could use my power as the Moon Goddess to shield the messages that Ninnin sends?

CHS: 长久以来，在天领奉行眼中，「荒泷派」是一个虽然偶尔引发麻烦，但还不需要引起高度关注的组织。
该组织常驻人员不足十人，关于它的成立时间，团队内部众说纷纭。
阿晃认为荒泷派成立于一斗从几个小混混手里救下自己的时候。那天一斗被打倒七次仍不肯认输，最后小混混们只好不胜其烦地离开了。一斗把阿晃从地上拉起来，潇洒地抹掉脸上的泥巴，豪情壮志地说：「以后，你就是荒泷派的人了！」
元太和阿守认为荒泷派成立于某年岁末，大家一起蹲在稻妻城郊外烤堇瓜的时候。
那天他们不但身无分文，还都很饿。捧着堇瓜大嚼之际，一斗略带感慨地说：「荒泷派的大家，以后每年都要一起烤堇瓜！」
然而，元太和阿守都觉得这种经历并不值得怀念。
久岐忍则认为，直到自己首次出面把一斗从班房里捞出来，荒泷派才正式成立，因为那是第一次在官方书面文字上留下「荒泷派」的字样。
至于一斗，他确信自己脑海中第一次浮现「荒泷派」这几个字的时候，荒泷派就已经存在了。
可惜这个念头究竟诞生于何时，他已经不记得了。
不过，对于照顾一斗长大的鬼婆婆来说，荒泷派却从未成立过。
这群孩子，只不过是一斗和他的朋友们罢了。
EN: For the longest time, the Tenryou Commission has regarded the Arataki Gang as a group of only occasional troublemakers who do not require that much attention.
This group only has less than 10 regular members and there are many internal disagreements concerning the date of its founding.

Akira believes that it all began when Itto saved him from a few two-bit ruffians. That day, Itto persisted even after having been knocked to the ground 7 times, ultimately causing the punks to back off in annoyance. Helping Akira up from the ground, Itto declared: "Well, guess you're with the Arataki Gang now!"
Genta and Mamoru believe that the Gang was truly founded at the end of a certain year when they all squatted on the outskirts of Inazuma City and roasted Lavender Melons.

That day, not one of them had a single Mora to their name, and they were all very hungry indeed. While gorging himself on a melon, Itto said with a sigh, "We should roast Lavender Melons like this every year!"
That said, neither Genta nor Mamoru thinks that these experiences need much memorializing.

For Kuki Shinobu, the Gang was officially formed the first time she had to drag Itto's sorry behind out of Shogunate gaol, for this was the first time any official records had ever made mention of the Arataki Gang.
As for Itto, he believes that the Arataki Gang existed from the first moment those words entered his mind.
Unfortunately, he no longer remembers when that was.
And as for Granny Oni, who has taken care of Itto since he was young, she believes that the Gang was never formed.
To her, these children are just "Itto and his friends."

CHS: 击败「哈迪斯」后，埃洛伊开始了新的旅程：追寻远古的技术，净化「哈迪斯」所践踏蹂躏的大地。
在漫漫旅途中，她走遍了每一处自己能踏足的「旧世遗迹」，搜寻「先祖」的失落秘密。
在某一间破败的古代实验室中，她发现了过去从未见过的事物：一座闪闪发光的传送门。靠近时，一股强大的力量包围了她，如窥向镜中般她从中见到了自己的形象，产生了宛如同时身处两处空间的奇异感觉。
在一阵闪光后，埃洛伊所知的「世界」从她的面前彻底消失不见，她来到了另一个奇异而美丽、亟待探索的新世界。
EN: After defeating HADES, Aloy embarked on a new journey, pursuing ancient technologies and cleansing the land that HADES had trampled underfoot.
In her long journey, she found every Old World Ruin that there was to be found in search of the Old Ones' lost secrets.

In one ancient, dilapidated laboratory, she found something she had never seen before — a gleaming portal. As she drew close, she was enveloped by powerful energies, and she saw her own image within the portal as one looking into a mirror, feeling as if she were in two places at once.
With a flash of light, the "world" that Aloy knew completely disappeared from her sight, and she now found herself in a strange, beautiful new world just waiting to be explored.

CHS: 只要生得够早，又活得够久，并且还不曾被更超越的存在抹去禁忌的回忆，那么一定会有人记得（提瓦特的确有这样的存在）：在葬火之战还未发生前，受命于尼伯龙根的三月女神曾与天空岛的法则和谐共处过一段时间。
当然如果拿此事去问天空岛，高天之上或许会予以不置可否的答复。三月曾是守护提瓦特的三颗卫星，三月女神则是星球意志的代行。天空岛的法则一度十分「宽容」，不一定非要排除异己。
而对三月女神而言，她们的全部职责只在于维系星球的存续与运转。于是月光便继续照亮着提瓦特的大地。只可惜安分守己的她们最终也不可能置身事外；上位者的争斗总是会波及一部分下属，这也是没有办法的事情。
如果那时黄金的亥珀波瑞亚还留有幸存者，那他们一定有很多话要讲，只可惜作为他们遗民的霜月之子并不了解祖先的怨仇，现在只能空对明月祈祷。
在这群可怜的盲从者中，菈乌玛是相对幸运的一位。她虽不完全知晓以上种种，仍能清晰地感知到，那天上的满月虽然明亮，却是那样死气沉沉；而真正牵动她心绪、让她角冠生长的潮汐，却在更遥远、更无法触及的地方。
这份感受曾困扰她多时。就像让一个人对着画布上的苹果去祈求它能让自己饱腹，菈乌玛总觉得心神不宁。
好在这个问题现在终于有了答案，虽然天空突然「变成」假的了，她却证实了自己感受的真实性。
菈乌玛从不觉得无知是件好事，即便真相更令人无所适从。此生本无法随心所欲，此生本就由矛盾造就，但至少这一切不必掺杂谎言和隐瞒。
EN: If one was born early enough, lived long enough, and one's forbidden memories weren't erased by more transcendent beings, they would surely remember (and such beings do exist in Teyvat) that before the war of funerary flame, the Three Moon Goddesses, who served Nibelung, once coexisted harmoniously with the principles of Celestia for a time.

Of course, if one were to inquire about this matter with Celestia, the high heavens might respond with ambiguity. The Three Moons were once satellites that guarded Teyvat, and the Moon Sisters were executors of the planet's will. Celestia's principles were once quite "tolerant," not necessarily requiring the exclusion of those divergent from itself.

For the Three Moon Goddesses, their sole duty was to maintain the planet's existence and operation. And so the moonlight continued to illuminate the lands of Teyvat. Alas, even they, who kept to themselves, could not remain uninvolved. Inevitably, conflicts between those in power would affect some of those who were subordinate to them.

If any survivors of bygone golden Hyperborea yet endured to the present day, they would surely have many tales to tell, but alas, the Frostmoon Scions do not understand their ancestors' grievances. They can now only pray to the bright moon in vain.

In this, Lauma was relatively fortunate, even amongst blind believers. She did not know anything of the above, but she could nonetheless sense keenly that the full moon in the sky was bright yet lifeless. Rather, the tides that truly moved her heart and caused her antler-crown to grow were somewhere farther away, beyond her reach.
This feeling had troubled her for a long time, and like how one might feel if made to pray to an apple painted on canvas, beseeching it to satisfy their hunger, she was ever restless.
Fortunately, this question was now answered at last. Although the sky had suddenly "become" fake, she had confirmed the authenticity of her senses.

She had never thought ignorance to be a good thing, even if the truth was more unsettling. Life could never be lived entirely as one wished — indeed, life itself was born of contradictions. But at least it need not be tainted by lies and concealment.

CHS: 如同最初那始料未及的大灾祸一般，兹白的命运再次变轨的契机同样来自天外。
在那位金发旅者与好友们的协力下，真实之月重临提瓦特，也让囚禁兹白本质的虚假之月开始了崩毁。
借着另一位故人的援助，兹白那或磋磨、或沉睡、或自在逍遥的三块灵魂本源迎来了再现人间的时刻。
这一切是否为那位注视兹白的影子所预见？这一切又是否成了那最初的天使所见证的实在？
不论如何，古国的指引者终于在漫天心愿的召唤中，重新回到了故土。
即使这里早已不再是昔日的样貌，人们祭祀起了新神，点燃灯火的典仪也改头换面，甚至连关于她的故事也变得面目全非。
但她知道，当年受她庇护的凡人并没有带着辉煌的文明断绝。而是在原来的土地上开枝散叶，并以一种日新月异的样貌传承至今。
正如那位故人所言，若昔年琅玕的美玉没有一块化作今日璃月港下的基岩，此地又何以被称得岩间琉璃云间月？
如今，她已经没有什么不满意的了，连曾经那不可遏制的怒火也变得隐而不见了。
因为她所做的一切没有白费，她也回到了家乡，似乎这样就足够了。
似乎这样就足够抵消她所经历的一切苦与难。
EN: Much like the unforeseen catastrophe that befell the land she loved, the turning point that altered Zibai's fate once more arrived from beyond the heavens.
Thanks to the efforts of the golden-haired traveler and his/her companions, the true moon returned to the skies of Teyvat, while the false moon that had imprisoned Zibai's essence began to crumble.
With the aid of another old friend, the three fragments of Zibai's soul — tempered, slumbering, and carefree — greeted the hour of their return to the realm of mortals.
Was all this foreseen by the shadow that had kept watch over Zibai? And had it now become the true reality beheld by the first angel?
Whatever the truth, the guiding grace of the ancient kingdom had finally returned to her homeland, led by the summons of countless wishes.

Though the land she returned to now bears little resemblance to its former days — the people worship a new god, the rites associated with lighting lanterns are completely transformed, and even the tales that she birthed have become unrecognizable...

Yet Zibai understands that the mortals she once protected did not allow their glorious civilization to perish. Instead, they took root in the soil of their homeland and flourished, carrying their traditions through the ages — their visage may have shifted with the passing generations, yet still they endure to this day.

As her old friend once said, had Lang-Gan's magnificent masonry not become part of the foundations upon which Liyue Harbor now stands, from whence would it gain its reputation as peaks adorning the clouded moon?
And now, starved of all discontent, even the once insatiable fire of wrath has dimmed beyond sight.
After all, her efforts were not in vain — she has returned to her homeland once more. This, it would seem, is enough.
Enough, indeed, to offset the bitterness and hardship she has endured.

CHS: 那维莱特本身并不需要使用神之眼来驱动元素力量。只不过有些事情他也是在最后成为完全之体时才知晓的：
在复仇的大战中受到重创，僭位者机能损毁，无力再凭借自己的绝对威权压制这个世界本来的秩序。为了镇压、调服世界的不甘与愤恨，僭位者与另一位后来者一同制造了「神之心」。世上应当建立起这样的秩序，人因此也只能拥有这七类念想。所有来自原初的碎片被驱使着互相吞并。
在那以后，当人的渴望传达天上，七位物质世界的执政就应当为了他而献礼。尽管并不知晓究竟是何人或者何种愿望通达了神圣的境地，七神仍需分封出自身支配权的碎屑予其人。而当获取了赠礼的人完成使命之后…众神收到的回赠也会更加丰厚。
那维莱特虽然并不听从天上的传谕，但是他认可人类的意义。他也献出了自己的一部分，就像是最传统的龙之宝藏一样，等待着勇敢的人前来领取。
EN: Neuvillette does not need a Vision to manipulate the elements. However, there were some things he learned only after regaining his complete form:

Severely wounded in the great war of vengeance, the usurper had their functions ruined, and could no longer use their absolute authority to suppress the original order of this world. To continue to subdue and control the resentments and loathing of the world, the usurper and one who came after created the Gnoses together. So it came to be that an order was made to be upheld, and thus did humans come to only possess these seven remembrances, and all fragments of the primordial were driven to devour each other.

From that day on, whenever a person's wishes reached the heavens, the seven overseers of the material realm were duty-bound to grant them a gift. Though they might know nothing of who or what wish had stepped into the threshold of the sacred, the Seven Archons still had to impart a shattered shard of their mastery to that person. And when one so gifted completed their duty... the gift the gods would receive in return would be more abundant still.

Neuvillette obeys no edict from the heavens, but he does acknowledge human will. So he too set aside parts of himself, as like unto the dragon-treasure hoards of old, awaiting valiant humans to come and claim them.

CHS: 这里就是「伊比尼伯龙之眼」了吗？感觉的确很不一般…
我想…我会得到有用的信息。
哼，但愿你不要变得更加膨胀。
我激活了…「伊比尼伯龙之眼」…
哦？怎么样？能找到哥伦比娅吗？
嗯…终端监测到…在一个名叫「乌吉恩圈」的设施中…
出现了缺少识别代码的新个体…
新个体？会是哥伦比娅吗？
嗯…虽然不能确定，但是至少有了方向…所以我们要怎么过去？
我来帮忙…看…我们可以通过这个过去…
是基于古月之力运行的…高速换行通道入口…
通过它…就可以抵达「伊比尼伯龙之眼」的下一站…「乌吉恩圈」…
终端记录着…那里生活着许多种类的生物…是生灵的家园…
月球上还生活着许多种类的生物？真是不可思议…
请等一等…终端里还有什么在响应我…
有一个隐藏模块…「望月者计划」…它响应了我…
这个模块…记录着这座高塔的起源…
它来自一位龙族先驱，名字是「伊比尼伯龙」…
我们乘坐的登月飞船…也是他的成果…是他带领着普通的龙族学者来到了月亮上…
好、好厉害！那这座「伊比尼伯龙之眼」一定是为了纪念他吧？
不是这样的…终端里记录了这样一件事…
在那位先驱登陆月球后…就开始了对月亮和近月带的探索…
直到有一天…他在近月带接收到了一个…来自星空深处的神秘信号…
星空深处的信号？那是什么？
学者们没能解读信号的含义…
但那位先驱认为…那是他们前往星海的王…传回的讯息…
是…是那位龙王？！真的是他传回来的信号吗？
不知道…因为学者们无法进入深空…
所以…他们建设了这座高塔…
这座「伊比尼伯龙之眼」…最初其实是一座深空信号接发站…为了再次捕捉那个信号…
后来…过去了很多年…直到那位先驱离世…信号都没有再出现…
再后来…他的学生也放弃了…转去了更加务实的方向。
他们将「伊比尼伯龙之眼」改造成月球表面监测站…方便他们进行更实际的月球研究工作…
好遗憾啊…感觉我们知道了很不得了的事…
不…这些只是我读取到的日志信息…
真正的「望月者计划」被加密了…我无法打开…
咦？你刚才不是说它在响应你吗？那不是应该能直接打开吗？
我的信息与它匹配…但也许因为…数量还不够…
就像是…零食与派蒙匹配…但是两成的零食不够派蒙吃。
听起来黑蛋像是一个钥匙模具。
缺少了内容物，所以打造不出钥匙。
欸？好像感觉就是这个意思！这么想的话，这个「望月者计划」会不会跟黑蛋的使命有关呢？
它居然主动响应黑蛋的信息，感觉就像是等着她来呢。
我不知道…但我想…打开它…
既然是信息的数量不够，那我们去找更多终端就好了吧？
刚才我就发现了，黑蛋每吸收一座终端，说话就更利索一些，个性也更膨胀一些。
虽然我不喜欢这样的变化，但如果和她的使命有关，我也只能支持她了。
哼哼，毕竟黑蛋也有帮我们找哥伦比娅嘛。
你放心吧，黑蛋，既然这里有终端，前面一定也有！跟我们走，总会把你喂饱的。
谢谢…派蒙…那我会尽力…不变膨胀…
嘿嘿，那我们现在该去下一站了吧？
好耶！月球大冒险第二站——「乌吉乌吉圈」！出发！
EN: So this is the Eye of Ibni-Belum? It definitely feels like a special place...
I think... I'll get some useful information.
Hmph, let's hope it doesn't puff your head up even more.
I activated... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...
Oh? Did it work? Can you find Columbina?
Hmm... in the facility known as Ungien's Circle... the terminal has detected...
...The appearance of an unknown individual lacking an identification code...
The system cannot confirm this person's identity...
Looks like we have to check it out in person.
Hmm... We can't be totally sure, but at least we have a lead for now... So, how are we gonna get there?
Let me help... Look... we can use this to get across...
It's the entrance to the high-speed transit lane... it runs on the ancient moons' power...
Through it... you can reach the next stop from the Eye of Ibni-Belum... Ungien's Circle...
The terminal records state that... many species of creatures live there... it is a home for living beings...
So, there are all kinds of creatures living on the moon? That's incredible...
Please wait a moment... Something in the terminal is still responding to me...
There is a hidden module... "Project Moongazer"... It responded to me...
The module... records the origins of this tower...
It starts with a dragon pioneer named Ibni-Belum...
The lunar vessel we traveled in... was his creation... He was the one who led dragon researchers to the moon...
W—Wow, that's amazing! So this place must've been built to commemorate him, right?
Not exactly... The terminal recorded this instead...
After the pioneer landed... he began to explore the moon and circumlunar zone...
Then, one day... while in the circumlunar zone, he received a... mysterious signal from deep space...
A signal from deep space? What was it?
The researchers couldn't decipher the signal's meaning...
But the pioneer believed... it was a message sent back... by their king who had journeyed out into the sea of stars...
And that king's name... was Nibelung.
Th—The Dragon King!? Did the signal really come from him?
I don't know... because the researchers could not enter deep space...
This place, the Eye... It was originally a deep-space signal transceiver station... built to recapture that signal...
Many years went by... the pioneer passed away... but the signal never appeared again...
His students gave up years later... and turned to more practical pursuits.
They renovated the Eye into a lunar surface monitoring station... to make it easier for them to conduct more practical lunar research...
Aww, what a shame... Wow, Paimon feels like we just stumbled on something super important...
No... these are just the log entries I read...
The real project file is encrypted... I can't open it...
Huh? Didn't you say it responded to you? Shouldn't you be able to, y'know, open it?
My data matches it... but maybe because... it isn't enough...
Err, sorry, what do you mean by "isn't enough"!?
It's like how... snacks and Paimon are a match... but twenty percent of the snacks won't be enough for Paimon to eat.
Hey, you're the one who gets twenty percent. Paimon's getting eighty!
Sounds like Eggie is a key mold of sorts.
Some content is missing, so a key can't be forged.
Hmm... Yeah, Paimon feels like that's exactly it! Come to think of it, could this "Project Moongazer" be connected to Eggie's mission?
It responded to Eggie's message. In fact, it feels almost like it was waiting for her to show up!
I don't know... but I want to... open it...
If there's not enough information, then we just need to go find more terminals, right?
Paimon noticed that with every terminal Eggie absorbs, she speaks a little more smoothly — and gets a little more full of herself.
While Paimon could certainly do without the attitude, if this is Eggie's mission, then Paimon's gonna help!
Heh! Well, Eggie did help us look for Columbina, didn't she?
Don't worry, Eggie! Since there's a terminal here, there's gotta be more up ahead! Come with us, and we'll make sure you get plenty to eat.
Thank you... Paimon... I'll try my best... not to puff up...
Hehehe. So, should we head to the next stop now?
Yay! Second stop on our super awesome lunar adventure — the "Ungi-Ungi Circle"! Let's go!

CHS: 乌吉好像安静下来了，所以…其实那些月光藤蔓才是罪魁祸首吗？
但他还在痛苦，我看得出来，他的思维很混乱，没办法与我交流。
是因为他体内的信息…我感觉到了…
他身体里…有乌吉恩圈终端的信息。
还记得吗？那个终端附近…也长了一样的月光藤蔓。
你是说…是这家伙吸收了那里的信息？
嗯…那些信息里…也许保存着望月者计划的内容…那一定就是我的使命。
她诞生在月亮上，是我因为担心，擅自将她送去了离家万里的地方。
为了使命，她在你们的帮助下想尽办法回到了这里，回到了她的家乡。她的决心…很了不起。
哪怕是出于善意被人保护起来，也不是她想要选择的事吧。
就是因为她这么努力，才更让人担心啊…就算她已经进入叛逆期，对我越来越不尊敬了。
等叛逆期过去，成熟期就会到来。
派蒙…如果你能放开我…我会给你比月亮还大的尊敬…
但是这家伙这么大，万一你被他吞噬了怎么办？
如果真是那样…那一定也是使命的一部分。
你这家伙！也太固执了吧！
也可以说这是她此刻心中最强烈的愿望，对吗？
那么，去吧宁宁，我相信你，让这缕月光见证你的决定，并庇佑你的旅途。
黑蛋！你可要顺利度过叛逆期啊！
看来情况没有想得那么糟。
谢谢你们…我得到了非常重要的信息，我知道了乌吉恩圈和星空生物捕捉站发生了什么事…
发生了什么？我也很好奇。
还是那个深空中的神秘信号，它终于再次出现了，虽然那已经是龙族先驱离世的多年，但是没关系…
因为由他设计的望月者高塔——伊比尼伯龙之眼，精准地捕捉到了信号发出的坐标。
终于做到了吗，真是令人振奋！那是从哪发过来的？
从一片距离月球很远的星空深处…那个地方即使飞船勉强能抵达，也会因为能源不足而无法返回。
但是生命领域的研究者乌吉恩，他还是驾驶着一艘名为望月者号的飞船，前往了那个坐标。
他疯了？他不打算回来了吗？
也许对他来说，能够解读信号的真相就足够了。而且那个距离，也许能够将他的发现传递回来…
他就此失踪在星海之中，龙族也没有接收到任何望月者号传递回来的讯息。
不，在那之后，又过去了数年时间，直到一天，星空生物捕捉站突然遭到不明物体的撞击。
紧急修理后学者们发现，撞击捕捉站的物体是一艘隐形飞船。
嗯…就是不知为何隐藏了身形的…望月者号。
乌吉恩的妻子玛歌率先进入了飞船，但她只在内部发现了一只黑色的球形带刺生物…
古月力频谱探测仪显示，那个生物…符合乌吉恩的信息特征。
玛歌进行了一系列检测，发现她的爱人，正在与某种神秘生物融合。
好可怕！那就是发出信号的神秘星空生物吗？乌吉恩被它吃了？他还有救吗？
很遗憾，龙族学者们从来没见过这种状况，他们束手无策，只能眼睁睁地看着乌吉恩转变为一种全新的生命…
而后，乌吉恩醒来了，他向龙族传递了一个消息。
没有关于这方面的内容。
真是的，怎么又缺少了内容？
这样看来，乌吉恩也太惨了…他还想捉人家，结果完全是被人家捉了啊！
并不是这样，飞船的日志显示，那个发出信号的生物并没有攻击乌吉恩，反而是他主动与那个生物融合…
如此一来，那个生物才能突破语言的障碍…将消息传递给龙族…
真是令人惊讶的情况…这样看，那则消息或许就是望月者计划的关键内容，我越来越好奇那是什么了。
看来我们还得去其他地方找找看。
那之后…乌吉恩还活着吗？
在传递消息之后，乌吉恩就开始死去。但玛歌是生命领域的专家，她使用了一种不成熟的技术。
那种技术可以将生命体转化为，纯粹的古月之力。
哦！听起来很像龙族的生命燃素化！
只成功了一半。她挽救了躯体…创造出了月球上第一只非自然诞生的月灵，也就是月灵乌吉。
但是乌吉恩的意识，在这个过程中彻底消失了。
之后的日子，她将所有精力都投入对这种新生命的研究中，直到寿限到来。
然后她拜托学生卢沙里姆对她使用了同样的技术，最终转化为了新生命…
和乌吉恩一样，她的意识也没有保留下来…
原来这就是你们的故事…
既然这样，我想那只星空生物向龙族传递的消息，或许被这位卢沙里姆继承了。
他是否也在某个地方建立了研究设施呢？望月者计划的关键内容应该就保存在那里。
他的研究设施恐怕已经不存在了。
告诉了哥伦比娅关于卢沙里姆、月幕工程和天外降临者的事。
居然是…被天外而来的降临者毁灭了…？
我不得不想到…那位高天的主宰。
能够遮蔽月亮的天幕…听起来又和虚假之天很相似。
是哦…感觉就像是虚假之天的幼年期！
但是他的研究所已经被毁掉了，也许他自己都消失在那场爆炸里了…
我有一个猜测，他或许没有死在那场意外里，他的研究也保留了下来。
你们看，除了月海以外，龙族的其它设施都没有被摧毁。伊比尼伯龙之眼，乌吉恩圈，星空生物捕捉站。
这看起来并不符合那位改造世界的规划。
你是说，是卢沙里姆保护了这些？
嗯，筹码或许就是他所掌握的研究成果，他带着这些…追随了那位高天的主宰。
我觉得你说得很有道理！这样看，他后来很可能还在继续望月者计划，会在哪里呢？
我知道月亮上还有一个地方，如果望月者计划仍被保存在某处，也许就会是那里。
宁宁…你有什么还没告诉我们的吗？
你的同类中，只有你在寻找使命。
对哦，感觉黑蛋的老乡们都很无忧无虑！
别担心，我不是在强迫你回答。我只是…想更了解你一些。
因为在我们见到的终端中，似乎没有一座记录了你的信息。
没关系，我只是好奇，如果你不想说的话，也可以不说。我们相信你。
如果我真的有事隐瞒了你们，会怎么样？
唔…隐瞒不一定是坏事。这是我从一位朋友那里学到的。
但如果我生气的话，或许会摘掉送你的小帽子。
那我也要把留给你的零食丢进月海！
我明白了，我可以承诺，对你们没有半点隐瞒。
那我相信你的承诺了，宁宁。接下来就请跟我来吧。
在月亮的背面，那里有一个基地，我的力量探查到那里非常庞大。
我本来打算留到最后再处理，因为打扫起来大概会很累。
但是现在，清理日程必须要提前了。我有预感，剩下的问题一定都能在那里得到答案。
谢谢你们，我…需要怎么回报这些？
你看，派蒙，宁宁是不是又变成熟了一些？
真的哦…居然谈起回报了！但我们是朋友，不用谈这些啦！
嗯，这一点，还是他/她教我的，宁宁你也可以学一学。
所以，准备好了就跟我来吧。
EN: Whew... Ungie seems to have calmed down. So... were those vines the real culprits all along?
He's still in pain, I can tell. His mind's been thrown into chaos, and he can't communicate with me.
It's because of the information inside him... I can feel it...
He and I... are of the same kind, after all...
His body... has information from Ungien's Circle within it.
Do you remember how there were... Moonlight Vines growing near that terminal?
You mean... he was the one who absorbed the information from there?
Yes... that information... may contain details regarding Project Moongazer... That must be why I'm here.
But you'll be putting yourself in too much danger!
She was born on the moon, and I was the one who, out of worry, sent her to a place thousands of miles away from home.
She did everything possible to return here with your help, back to her homeland, all for the sake of her mission. That determination... It's remarkable.
I don't think she wants to be protected, even if it's out of goodwill.
Paimon's worried precisely because she's trying so hard... Y'know, even though she's hit her rebellious phase and hasn't shown Paimon any respect for a while now.
And maturity is what follows that period of rebellion.
Paimon... If you let me go... I'll respect you so much even the moon will seem less important by comparison...
But this guy's huge! What if he swallows you!?
If that happens... then that must also be part of my mission.
You...! Ugh, how stubborn can you get?
"Stubborn" is one way to put it. But you could also say that this is a wish she holds most dear.
Then go, Ninnin. I have faith in you. Let this ray of moonlight bear witness to your choice and bless you on your journey.
I believe in you, too, Eggie.
C'mon, Eggie! You'll get through your rebellious phase, Paimon knows it!
Looks like things aren't as bad as we feared.
Thank you... I've obtained some critical information. I know what transpired at Ungien's Ring and the Space Lifeform Capture Station...
Alright. What happened? I'm curious too.
It all comes back to that mysterious signal from deep space. It finally appeared again, many, many years after the dragon pioneer's passing...
But even so, the Moongazer Tower he designed — the Eye of Ibni-Belum — captured the coordinates of that second signal.
Wait, he finally did it? Awesome! So, where did the signal come from?
From the depths of space, far, far away from the moon... So far away that the spaceship could barely reach it, and even then, it would lack sufficient energy to return.
But Ungien, the life scientist, chose to pilot a spaceship named Moongazer and set out for those coordinates nonetheless.
Wait, did he go cuckoo or something? Or was he not planning to come back?
Perhaps it was enough for him that he'd be able to decipher the signal. And at that distance, he might have been able to transmit his discovery back...
He disappeared into the sea of stars, and the dragons did not receive any messages from Moongazer thereafter.
No. Years later, the Space Lifeform Capture Station was suddenly rammed by an unknown object.
After emergency repairs were complete, the researchers discovered that the object that had rammed the station was a cloaked spaceship.
Cloaked... Like, invisible? Could it have been...
Yes... It was the Moongazer. Though why it was cloaked is a mystery.
Ungien's wife, Maagees, was the first to enter the spaceship, but she only found a round, black, spiky creature inside...
Archaeolune spectrometers indicated that the creature... matched Ungien's data signature.
Maagees ran a series of tests and thus discovered that her lover was fusing with some unknown creature.
That's terrifying! Was it the mysterious space lifeform that had sent the signal? Did it eat Ungien? Could he still be saved!?
Unfortunately, the dragon researchers had never encountered such a situation before. At a loss, they could only watch helplessly as Ungien transformed into an entirely new lifeform...
Then, Ungien awoke, and he passed a message to them.
There is no information about this.
Ugh, seriously? There's still some missing intel?
Hearing all this, Ungien had it super rough... He tried to capture an alien, but ended up getting caught himself!
Hmm... That's not the case. The ship's log showed that the creature emitting the signal didn't attack Ungien. Instead, he was the one who chose to fuse with it...
In this way, the creature was able to overcome the language barrier... and pass a message to the dragons...
What a surprising turn of events... It seems that message may be the key to understanding Project Moongazer. I'm getting more curious about what it is by the moment.
Looks like we'll have to look elsewhere for that.
So... Was Ungien still alive after all that?
After delivering the message, Ungien began to die. But Maagees, being an expert in life sciences herself, used an experimental technique on him...
One that could convert a lifeform into one composed of pure ancient moon energy.
Oh! That sounds a lot like the dragons' phlogistonization!
To an extent... She saved his body... and created Ungie, the first artificially-birthed kuuhenki on the moon.
But Ungien's consciousness was completely lost during this process.
From then on, she devoted all her energy to researching this new lifeform — until her own lifespan came to an end.
Then she requested that her student Lusalim use the same technique on her, ultimately being converted into a new lifeform...
Just as with Ungien, her consciousness was not preserved...
If that's the case, I think that Lusalim may have been the one to inherit the message that the creature from space transmitted to the dragons.
Did he also establish a research facility somewhere? That's most likely where we'll find the key to Project Moongazer.
I'm afraid his research facility no longer exists.
You tell Columbina about Lusalim, the Lunar Veil project, and the Descender from beyond the skies.
It was... destroyed by a Descender from beyond the heavens...?
In that case, I fear the great ruler of the firmament is the likely culprit...
A veil that could obscure the moon... That sounds very similar to the false sky.
Yeah, like some sort of baby version!
But his research institute has already been destroyed... He might've been lost in that explosion, too...
My guess is just the opposite — that Lusalim didn't perish, and that his research survived.
Huh? Why do you say that?
As you can see, apart from the lunar sea itself, none of the draconic facilities have been destroyed. Not the Eye of Ibni-Belum, not Ungien's Circle, not the Space Lifeform Capture Station...
Their survival doesn't seem in line with the plan laid down by the one who changed the world.
So you're saying that Lusalim protected them somehow?
Yes. He might've struck a bargain using the fruits of his research and followed the ruler of the heavens thereafter.
That makes sense. And if it's true, he might've continued Project Moongazer elsewhere... But where?
I do know of one other place on the moon. If Project Moongazer was hidden anywhere, my guess is that would be it.
Ninnin... Is there something you haven't told us?
Among your kind, only you have a mission you seek to fulfill.
Oh, that's true! Now you mention it, Eggie's buddies all seem super carefree.
Don't worry, I won't force you to answer. I just... want to know more about you.
After all, out of all the terminals we've seen, not a single one seems to contain information about you.
It's okay, I'm just curious. If you don't want to talk about it, you don't have to. We trust you.
...What if I really am hiding something from you?
Hmm... Keeping secrets isn't always a bad thing. I learned that from a friend.
But if I do get angry, I might take the hat I gave you back.
And Paimon'll throw the snacks she was saving for you into the lunar sea!
I understand. I promise I won't hide anything from you.
Then I'll take your word for it, Ninnin. Now, please follow me.
There's a base on the far side of the moon. My powers tell me that it's massive.
I originally planned to save it for last, because cleaning it up would probably be exhausting.
But now, I suppose it has to be moved up the schedule. I have a feeling we'll find the answers to our remaining questions there.
Thank you. I... How can I repay you for all this?
Look, Paimon, don't you think Ninnin's matured even more now?
You're right... She's actually talking about paying us back! But we're friends, so there's no need for all that!
Yes. He/She taught me that lesson, actually. You could stand to learn it, too, Ninnin.
It was, and would be, my honor.
Well then, follow me when you're ready.
I believe in you, too, Ninnin.

CHS: （一座坐落在神秘遗迹中的终端，静候着访问者的到来。）
从「望月者号」外壁上发现的黑色斑斓丝状抛射物具有「反射」的特性，这应该就是使「望月者号」隐匿的关键因素…
乌吉恩老师在与星之黑体融合后，身体表面也开始分泌同样的物质…玛歌老师将其称为「黑体物质」。
实验已揭露，「黑体物质」能够与古月力互相激发，并能与动植物融合，融合后的部分个体颜色会发生由蓝到黑的转变。
真是不可思议的特性，但它能帮上忙——我始终认为，向星空深处发送信息过于冒险。
没有任何证据能证明接收到信息的存在一定对我们心怀善意，那反而可能会引来一场灾难。
然而，玛歌老师现在比任何时刻都需要支持，这是她的决定…
为此我要找出一道保险措施，关键就在「黑体物质」的特性上…
关于「幕形态黑体物质笼」的记录
生态圈的温室培育了数千棵月幽木，玛歌老师的团队在其中择出了与「黑体物质」融合度高的适配个体。
该个体在受到一定强度的古月力刺激后会释放具有反射性质的扩散波。
加强古月力刺激强度，该个体将持续释放扩散波，直至形成幕形态稳定笼，笼的范围超过整个实验室。
这个效果已经超出了最初的预期，接下来的研究重点应该转向如何扩大波的范围…
关于「月幕工程一期」的记录
努尔研究员建议在生态圈进行扩大范围的工程测试。
我还以为他不会对石头和死者以外的东西感兴趣。
不过，玛歌老师也支持，所以就这么办吧。她问我这个工程该怎么命名，我回答「月幕」——用来遮蔽月亮的天幕。
这个名字很合适，估计谁也想不到，它来自宁宁。
这真让人吃惊，在测试「幕形态黑体物质笼」时，宁宁甚至都还不太会说话。
但从她嘴中蹦出不清晰的「月幕」两个字时，她那童真的双眼好像看清了我们在做什么，她仿佛也正为此而来。
我想未来，她也会成为一位了不起的研究者。
关于「月幕工程二期」的记录
一期工程成功了，我们创造了一个遮蔽生态圈的小型月幕，但这没能缓解我的焦虑。
玛歌老师每况愈下，那件事对她打击过大，以致于快要抽走她的理智，她做的事正在摧毁她的生命，她没法再等下去。
伊比尼伯龙之眼的团队为此进行了一次信号发射。我无法也不能阻止玛歌老师最后的意愿，哪怕这意愿并不来自她。
我无法对这次发射保持平静，但我唯一能做的，只有向深入星空的王上祈祷，祈祷这次发射不会招致邪恶与灾难…
接下来，我必须尽快完成完整的月幕，这需要超出一期工程数个量级的能源支持…
我不知那月之女神是否愿意为我洒下仁慈，但我只能去求助她们了…
EN: (A terminal located in the mysterious ruins, waiting for visitors to arrive.)
The black, iridescent filament-like ejecta found on the outer hull of the "Moongazer" possessed a unique "reflective" property. This likely explained why the spaceship remained concealed...
After Professor Ungien fused with the "Stellar Blackbody," his body also began secreting the same substance across its surface... Professor Maagees named it "Blackbody Matter."

Experiments have revealed that Blackbody Matter can mutually stimulate with Archaeolune Energy, and can also fuse with plants and animals. In some fused specimens, coloration shifts from blue to black.
What an astonishing property, but it may prove useful — I have always believed that transmitting signals into deep space is far too risky.
There is no evidence to suggest that whatever receives those signals would necessarily bear us goodwill. On the contrary, it may invite disaster.
Even so, Professor Maagees now needs support more than ever. This is her decision...
I must therefore devise a safeguard, and the key lies in the properties of the Blackbody Matter...

The ecological research team has cultivated thousands of Moonshade Trees. From among them, Professor Maagees's team selected compatible specimens with a high compatibility for integration with the "Blackbody Matter."
After being stimulated by a certain intensity of Archaeolune Energy, this individual released diffusive waves with reflective properties.
