I... When we went to Seirai Island to sing for Kapatcir, I could feel that a piece of me was in that feather.
That's why I'd like you to take that feather of hers on your travels.
This way, I can travel with the two of you as well. We'll even bring Kapatcir with us, too!
We'll go see the outside world, and we'll hear what songs they have to sing.
Yup, you don't have to worry about me!
It was great going outside, but it was real tiring, too...
I'd like to rest for a bit. You can go on ahead first!
Oh, that's right! Could you please thank Big Brother Kama for me?

CHS: 菈乌玛非常感谢月之轮的存在，也非常高兴自己能拥有一枚，但说实话，这东西让她着实有些困扰，因为她不记得自己是如何获得它的了。
莎莱卡奶奶说，她的这枚月之轮是从襁褓中掉出来的。虽然父母当时正被新生命的到来冲昏头脑，记忆有些模糊，但也确认了这个说法。
如果将她的烦恼说给其他人听，他们一定会很困惑：出生起就拥有了一枚月之轮，这不是一件好事吗？有什么值得烦忧的吗？
似乎除了她自己以外，没有人觉得一个婴儿身边出现一枚月之轮有什么问题：「如果是咏月使大人，身上无论发生什么奇迹都很正常呢。」
菈乌玛有口难辩。想要知道一件事的起源是多么自然、多么符合人类好奇心的事情啊，但她查遍了书库的资料，都没能找到令人满意的解答。
她一直没有放下这个问题，以至于在后来见到月之少女时，忍不住询问了此事。
库塔尔的回答极其简单：「哦？」
…因此，最接近的解释还是来自「亥珀波瑞亚」。黄金国历史悠久，可追溯至天空中升起三轮月亮的时期。他们学会了利用月亮的潮汐驱动魔法，但也因此受月之潮汐的影响，有些人的头顶上长出了类似鹿角的角冠。
然而在那个时候，世界上有月之轮这种东西吗？
菈乌玛就这样皱眉思考，大概是不小心自言自语了起来，引得一个路过的小孩大声问道：「菈乌玛大人，你是因为有了月之轮，头上的角才这么长的吗？」
菈乌玛眉头皱得更紧了：「这个…应该…抱歉，我不清楚。」
让小孩失望肯定是菈乌玛不想见到的事情，但意外的是，小朋友似乎并没有因为问题得不到解答而感到沮丧。
「哦！」他恍然大悟，「难道其实是因为头上的角最长，菈乌玛姐姐才拿到了月之轮的吗？」
有那么一瞬间，菈乌玛从内心深处想要接受这个答案。多么巧妙啊，这从前到后、再从后到前的因果轮回，似乎可以拿来解释（搪塞）很多问题。
然后她马上制止了自己，以免陷入谎言的陷阱。
又或许这就是这枚月之轮的作用，是对她的警戒、限制，以及责任的象征。
于是她将那枚令她不解的月之轮握在手心，在心中又默念了一遍三条戒律。
EN: Lauma was very thankful for the existence of Moon Wheels and was delighted to have one, but in truth, it troubled her quite a bit that she couldn't remember how she had obtained hers.

Grandma Sarakka said that her Moon Wheel had fallen out of her swaddling clothes. Although her parents' memories were a bit hazy on the matter, being overwhelmed by the arrival of their newborn at the time, they confirmed this account.
If she were to tell others about her troubles, they would surely be confused. Wasn't having a Moon Wheel since birth a good thing? What was there to worry about, anyway?
It seemed that besides herself, no one found anything wrong with one appearing next to a baby. "A miracle happening to a Moonchanter... Isn't that just normal?"

Lauma found herself at a loss for words. How natural and human it was to want to know the origins of something, yet despite searching through the entire library's records, she could not find a satisfactory answer.
She never let go of this question, so much so that when she later met the Moon Maiden, she couldn't help but ask about this.

...Therefore, the closest explanation must still come from Hyperborea. The history of the golden realm was long indeed, and could even be traced back to the era when three moons rose in the skies. They learned to use the lunar tides to power their magics, but were in turn affected by those same ebbs and flows, and some of them thus had horned crowns akin to deer antlers grow from their heads.
However, had Moon Wheels even existed in the world back then?

Lauma frowned in contemplation, and indeed must have accidentally started talking to herself, prompting a passing child to ask loudly: "Lady Lauma, did your horns grow so long because you have a Moon Wheel?"
Her frown only deepened: "Well... I suppose... I'm sorry, I don't know."
Disappointing children was something she wished never to do if she could help it, but surprisingly, the little one did not seem discouraged by not getting an answer to his question.
"Oh!" He said, as if sudden realization had dawned. "Could you have gotten the Moon Wheel because you have the longest horns?"

Oh, how Lauma wanted to accept this answer from the bottom of her heart at that moment. How clever it was, this cycle of cause and effect that shuttled from front to back, then back to front, which seemed to explain (or rather, gloss over) so many questions.
Then she immediately stopped herself from falling into the trap of lies.
Perhaps this, then, was the purpose of the Moon Wheel — a symbol, to her, of vigilance, restraint, and responsibility.
So she held that puzzling Moon Wheel in her palm, silently reciting the three precepts in her heart once more.

说起来，法尔伽先生了解这位尼可，或者说代号为N的魔女吗？

（咦？他们在和眼前这位女士对话？可是…）

算了，具体说的话未免说得太远，我记得你们的来意是…想要知道去天外之月的办法。

有个办法，源自「葬火之战」后的亥珀波瑞亚人…看你们的反应，我是不是该从「葬火之战」这个概念开始讲…

亥珀波瑞亚人，也就是我曾经帮助过，接受了天使赐予的文明与创造的人类…

（看来这位「魔女」，有着某种特殊的对话方式…是在说和月亮有关的话题吗？）
对，但那时候的人不知道，他们还在祈求月神的怜悯。

自然，结果让他们大失所望，也就是那时候人类才知晓，原来三月女神皆已死去。
听上去，有点让人难过呢…
是啊，那时候人类的处境真的很凄惨，帮助他们的天使不见了，还被「葬火之战」波及，流离失所…
稍等一下，我想问问，这段历史和我们要做的事，关联在哪里？
关联是…嗯，好像不知不觉讲到没有关联的部分了。
最近没什么机会在别人的脑海里说话，一旦开口，语句就像瀑布那样在石缝间迸落溢散，不好控制方向。
我是说，对，我们需要关注的是亥珀波瑞亚人创造的这种仪式。
既然他们能够绕开虚假之天的屏蔽，见到月亮的景象，就说明提瓦特和外界已经建立了连接。
那么只要这种月矩力更强，连接本身更稳固，将一个人送过去，也不是不可能的事。
懂了，简单来说，就是造个传送门，对吧！
怎么了，感觉你有点…沮丧？
没想到你总结得这么好，如果我早点用「传送门」这个词，就不用讲那么多了。
没关系，这些都是非常宝贵的知识，我应当以书面形式将它们记录和保留下来。
是吗？那我可以给你多讲讲，其实是这样的，刚刚说得比较简略…
等等，等等，在那之前我们先总结一下！
因为亥珀波瑞亚人有过这样的做法，那我们需要找到这个建筑，再确保月矩力是充足的。
而「恒月」与「虹月」的月髓都找到了，月矩力自然是不成问题，关键就是找到这个地方，对吧？
是的，但经过那么长时间，我想那个建筑早就消失了吧。

甚至还不用真的去到它还存在的时候，去它被虚影投射出来的时候就行，或者利用我们的投影，折叠一下…
是、是的，有点高级了。听得脑袋…有点胀。
好吧，我想想要怎么表达得简单一点。哦，知道了。
这几天我会在挪德卡莱寻找可以利用的虚影，一旦我认为达成某些条件，就会召集大家。

（…！我的…名字？他们是在…寻找不让我消失的办法吗？）

不介意的话，我晚上会再去你的住处拜访，为你从头细细讲述一遍。

不过等你全部听完，我再叮嘱这些也来得及…那就回头再见。噢，你不用为我准备什么，沏一杯茶就好。
再不系统地从头到尾讲一遍我自己都快忘记了！没想到真的有人愿意听，太好了！

哈哈哈，果然艾莉丝身边都是很有个性的人啊。
接下来，我们商量下要去哪里找月神的名字吧？
嗯，我想想，这么一说，尼可想说的那些事，确实还挺有价值的。
等我听她讲完，我会提炼出来分享给大家的。
另外，我想再查查「霜月之子」的文献。虽然远在亥珀波瑞亚时期，「霜月之子」的先祖就已经建立了信仰…
但有比较真实的资料记载，还是在「库塔尔」降生之后。
感觉愚人众那边也会有线索。
听起来，就像是顺着哥伦比娅在提瓦特的足迹，再走一次呢。

好，这个交给你们，我去联络一下愚人众的人…能帮上忙的，应该还是只有阿蕾奇诺和桑多涅吧。
哈哈哈，这没什么，只是张罗这种事，比调查淑女的童年更适合我。那我们之后再见！
（跟上去吧，如果有什么我能做的…）
魔女们好像都有自己的杯子。
EN: (Where are they going? They mentioned a "mage" and... a name?)
So, Mr. Varka, are you acquainted with this Nicole? Or should I call her Mage "N"?
Ah, not really. We've never met, though she has come up in conversation.
From what I've gathered, Alice kinda took Nicole under her wing. Taught her how to speak in a more ladylike fashion, that kind of thing.
Huh... Hard to imagine Alice as an etiquette coach...
Haha! Yeah, Alice is a larger-than-life personality, I'll give you that. But then again, that's why she's able to draw such an eclectic mix of people into her inner circle.
If I remember correctly, being an "interesting" person is actually one of her main entry requirements. Heh, so if you ever wanted to join the Hexenzirkel, I'm sure you'd both be eligible to apply.
Hey, don't go around making promises on Alice's behalf.
I wouldn't dare! I'm just... trying to paint a picture of the Hexenzirkel for you...
Okay, sure. Anyway, since none of us have ever met Nicole, how are we supposed to find her? We can't just go up to every woman in sight and ask, "Hey, are you Nicole?"
Hmm, maybe something she's wearing will give it away? Like, uh, a Windblume pinned to her chest, or something.
Wait a minute. Alice never said Nicole was from Mondstadt.
That would be... this young lady, then?
Hey there, sorry to disturb you, but... are you Ms. Nicole?
Varka, Knight of Boreas of the Knights of Favonius. Alice might have mentioned me before.
Uhh... Have we got the wrong person? Sorry, sorry!
When I shook my head, I meant "no, Alice hasn't mentioned you before."
Huh? Where is this voice coming from...?
My apologies. For certain reasons, I am unable to speak. This is the only way I can communicate with you.
It might take some getting used to, but I hope you can understand.
Hey, it's fine... I'm more shocked by the fact that Alice never speaks about me! Hahaha.
As for you two... We have crossed paths twice before, but it is nonetheless a pleasure to finally meet you.
It's really you! Thanks for all your guidance in the past...
You're quite welcome. This time, things are different... We have reached the unwritten pages of the story. You might say that we stand at the crossroads of fate...
Now, then. Allow me to formally introduce myself. My name is—
No no no, stop, I...! Ugh, Alice! I can't believe it...
I had a whole speech prepared! I'd agonized over every single word! ...She always picks the worst moments to ruin other people's plans...
I'm so sorry about that... Alice took the liberty of devising some bespoke "Self Introduction Magic" for each member of the Hexenzirkel...
But I could've sworn I deleted all of the triggering conditions for it. How did it bypass everything? ...Oh gosh, this is so embarrassing...
(This is a very different side of Nicole than what we're used to... Is she... not used to face-to-face interactions?)
Uh, d—don't worry about it. We've seen that introduction magic once already, so it wasn't too much of a shock.
Please go on, Ms. Nicole. We'd love to hear what you have to... say, or... well, communicate.
(Huh? Are they talking to this lady? But...)
Will you all promise to forget that horrendously embarrassing introduction?
Among the words that hopped out just now, I saw...
...Yes. My name is Nicole, and I am one of a very few angels who have retained both their preferred form and their power.
旅行者 and Paimon should be no strangers to this concept. There is another of our kind in Natlan — they call her the Lord of the Night.
But we've never seen her in person.
Yes, well, I have retained more of my power than she. It's because I don't have a long-term duty to fulfill. To be more specific...
...Ah, no, we'll be here all day if I get into the specifics. Moving on. If I'm not mistaken... you are here because you wish to learn how one might reach the moon beyond the sky.
That's right. Is that something you can give us any guidance on?
Yes, I do know a way. It began with the Hyperboreans who lived after the war of funerary flame... Hmm. Blank looks. Maybe I should start with the background of the war...
...Or maybe not. It shouldn't be an issue. I'll fill in the gaps for you when we have more time. Anyway, after that war ended, the three moons retreated to beyond the false sky.
The Hyperboreans were humans I once aided. They accepted the civilization and creations bestowed upon them by the angels.
But despite accepting many blessings of the angels, many among them still held onto their faith in the moons. They were reluctant to accept the new order.
Even after the war of funerary flame, they sought to contact the moon goddesses beyond the sky and receive their guidance...
But all three had passed away by that point.
(This mage has a unique method of communicating... Is she talking about the moons?)
Yes, but they did not know. And so, still they prayed for the Moon Goddesses' mercy.
After building titanic structures that consumed vast amounts of kuuvahki, at last they glimpsed the moons and heard their voices...
But of course, they were gravely disappointed. For it was then that they realized: the three moon goddesses were dead.
It is. Humanity was in a very sorry state at that time. The angels who had once aided them were gone, and the war of funerary flames had left them homeless and destitute...
Just a second. I gotta ask... How relevant is all this history to the task at hand...?
Well, I mean, it's... Hmm. Okay, it seems we've drifted into irrelevant narrative waters.
It's been a while since I've had the chance to speak inside someone's head. As soon as I got started, I lost control, and the words just flowed out like a waterfall...
...What I'm trying to say is... Right, yes, that's it: The relevant part is the ritual created by the Hyperboreans.
The fact that they bypassed the false sky and saw the true moons implies that they successfully built a connection between Teyvat and the outside world.
Which means, with enough kuuvahki and a sufficiently stable connection, it should be feasible to send one person over the border.
Okay... so they built some kinda portal?
Oh, uh... Yes, a portal. Yes.
I just didn't expect you to summarize it so well... It turns out I could have said all that in one word, if only I'd managed to think of it.
No, please, it's fine. This is invaluable knowledge. I'll be sure to record and preserve everything in writing.
Oh, really? Well in that case, I suppose I could backtrack and add some more detail. I did gloss over a few things so far...
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Timeout. Let's summarize what we've got first!
The Hyperboreans were the last ones to use this method, right? So we somehow need to find whatever structure they built and make sure there's enough kuuvahki to power it up.
Luckily, we have the moon marrow of both the Eternal and Iridescent Moons, so we're all good for kuuvahki. Which means, the key issue we need to focus on is finding the place. Am I right so far?
Yes, although I expect the structure is long gone by now.
That said, what if we could take advantage of the phantoms to travel back to a time when it still existed?
Well, "travel back" isn't quite accurate. It's more like we'd be creating a handshake between two points in spacetime.

We wouldn't even have to pick a time when it still existed — it could just be a time when it still appeared in phantom form via projection. Or, we could project our own phantoms, fold them together, and...
...You look lost. Was that too hard to follow?
Yeah, things got a little, uh, technical there. Paimon's brain is reaching capacity...
Alright, let me think about how to put this more simply... Okay, got it.
Over the next few days, I'll search for phantoms that we can use. Once I find one that meets the criteria, I'll let you know and we'll regroup.
By completing certain rituals, specific individuals will be able to enter the phantom and make it to the Hyperborean structure.

If everything checks out, and it looks feasible, we'll just need to wait for Moon-Prayer Night and we can send the Moon Goddess back home... I'm really skimping on the detail here. Is this making any sense at all?
I think so. For now, we'll just wait to hear from you.
Great. Counting on you! In the meantime, we'll focus on finding the Moon Goddess's name.
(...! My... name? Are they... looking for a way to stop me from disappearing?)
This conversation was a little all over the place. I didn't catch your name.
I am Lauma, of the Frostmoon Scions.
Ah, I did wonder. I noticed that you listened very intently when I spoke about Hyperborea and the moons' history.
If you'd be interested, I'd love to visit you this evening and go through it again in greater detail.

Also, if you were serious about making a record... It would be too risky to simply write down the raw details as-is. I would suggest some tweaks — maybe rewrite the stories as fairy tales or fables, perhaps even prayers.
...Anyway, we can cross that bridge when we come to it. So, see you later, then? Oh, and no need to prepare anything. Just a cup of tea will do.

Ah, it's so nice to find someone who's actually willing to listen! I've been dying for a chance to finally go through all this systematically, from start to finish... Any longer and I'd probably start forgetting it!
Now Paimon gets why Alice told us to mind our heads...
Hahaha, what did I tell you? Lotta quirky people in Alice's orbit.
Now then, the next order of business is: Where do we start looking for the Moon Goddess's name?
Hmm... Maybe the rest of what Nicole has to say might give us some clues.
Once I've heard her out, I'll summarize the salient points and share them with you all.
I'm also inclined to review our other documents. Yes, our faith was first established by our Hyperborean ancestors...
But many of the more factually accurate records are from after Kuutar's birth.
I have a hunch that the Fatui might know something, too.
Sounds like we're gonna follow Columbina's journey through Teyvat, huh?
In that case, we'll start by heading to the Frostmoon Enclave.
Sounds like a plan. Take this with you — I'll see about getting in touch with the Fatui... it'll probably just be Arlecchino and Sandrone again. They're the only ones who would wanna help.
Hahaha, don't mention it. Honestly, I'm more comfortable dealing with the Fatui than prying into the details of a young lady's childhood. Catch you later!
(I should follow them, just in case there's some way that I can help...)
I recall that each mage has their own cup.

CHS: 终于打开了，刚才真的好冷哦。
「眼镜」的身体应该就能重塑了吧…咦，「眼镜」呢？
怎么回事，连那个蓝色的眼镜都不见了…
不必担心…一度分裂的躯体，依附于死物的意识都已回到了应该回到的位置。
「灰眸」就暂且放在我手中一会儿吧，对我来说这也是种物归原主。
啊，是你…阿克、阿克西妮娅！
是的，我很高兴你记住了我的名字，派蒙。
别担心，他会醒来的，但是得花一点点时间。
哦哦，然后他的身体就会修复如初，变成原来的人的样子了？
不会了，他会进入一具「他人的身躯」…蜕化成真正的「原人」，这可能和你们的想象有些出入。
等等…我有点没有明白，他不是想要找回自己的身躯吗？
对于忘记了过去，一无所知，只有「找回从前躯体」这一念头的他来说，这或许是件残忍的事…
不过他从一开始就并不是为了「回到从前的身躯」，而是为了「融合和改造更高位的身躯」而准备的。
如果他回想起一切，应该也能理解的吧。
「融合和改造更高位的身躯…」咦，也就是说，他的身体和力量都会到别的人的身体里吗？
可是，他自己的身体已经没了，这里哪还有身体可以给他用啦…
原来是盯上了派蒙的身体…
欸，我才不要，不过、唔，不过是「眼镜」的话，也不是不能稍微隔出来一点点…
哈哈，如果融合进派蒙的身体的话，就会变成别的问题了。
旅行者，其实很好猜到哦，在这个地方有一副身躯，白冕宫，这个昔日北国之王的埋骨之地…
啊？白沙皇，他都死了那么多年了，岂不是已经变成一堆骨头了…
白沙皇陛下比较特殊，他的身躯即便是在他的意识消亡后也…保持着活性。
就像，「沙皇白桦」。其实是他从未真正死去的躯壳向外渴求…而不断生长的神经。白桦…唉，这怎么看都不像是树吧。
五百年了，沙皇陛下的身躯仍在渴求…
怎么会…也就是白沙皇身体还活着？身体居然…能够活那么久？
因为他是特殊的，虽然不及降临者，但他仍然高贵。他是古国亥珀波瑞亚科技的最高结晶，拥有以光赋予的魂魄…
亥珀波瑞亚人甚至试图用原初冰龙的血肉作为材料打造他的身体…只为了他能够企及「那一位」曾拥有的权柄。
随提瓦特共同诞生的意志，最原初的光界力的主人，亦称「尼伯龙根」，众龙王的王。
在他被毁灭之后，「原初之人」，也即「那菈延」的座位空悬。
高天之上，不可称名的主人的冷酷又如高悬的利剑…呵，或者说高悬的长钉更为恰当…所以…
他们想要…制造自己的「神明」。
他们因此…造出了白沙皇…唔，不过那时候应该不能叫白沙皇，应该是…「原初之人」？
他们「试图」造出，不过实验失控了，不然黄金城应该仍然屹立在这片土地…甚至此处不会如现在，是冰封千里的冻土。
根据我们在影域中找到的残缺的记录所述，冰之龙王的尸骸，其失控的权能…导致整个至冬化作原初之冰的圣土。
甚至连范围内的地脉都受到影响，变成了凝结纯化的晶矿…直到，那一位垂眸，而高天之钉降下。
呃啊…咦，可是既然失败了，白沙皇到底是怎么来的？
失控了，并非失败…在那场实验和冲击结束的千年之后，沙皇陛下自冰龙的尸骸中醒来。
只是因为实验并未完成，所以他的力量并不完整…而那时亥珀波瑞亚已被没入影域，雪域之国唯有妖精的身影…
世人以为沙皇陛下是某类强大的妖精，实则真实的身份要比那高贵多啦…
制造他的亥珀波瑞亚已然灭亡，他大可以抛之不管，可他还是接受了…接受了自己是「失败的原初之人」这件事。
包括…这代表的一切责任与后果。
他甚至愿意在这魔兽横行的冻土之国接纳人类，仍然愿意…成为真正的「原人」。
这是他不应被辜负的「慈爱」。
而…「眼镜」，也就是那无数次实验后造出的「雏原人」，就是让沙皇陛下成为「原初之人」的钥匙。
本来…本来应该在更早的时候就开始的，如今甚至变成了沙皇陛下的遗志…
不过多亏了你们，旅行者与派蒙，这一伟愿终于有望完成。
这并不是轻松的活，我本来打算花上二十年来做这件事呢。
嘿嘿，虽然没听太懂，但总归是被谢谢了呢…
是哦，之前就一直说的，「无忧的庭院」，到底是什么…
「那是『明日』的世界，舍弃了嫉妒、仇恨、私心的国度。众人如最初那样彼此相爱，而这爱的时间是永恒。」
「如是，光辉的世界将降临，人与人，甚至人与神之间将再无差别。」
…至少这是他向我们述说的愿景。不过在我的理解里，他所说的爱并没有那么复杂，是一种灵性的漫溢。
只是这种漫溢会因为世间诸多苦痛而枯竭，于是，原本的流溢者会变成汲取者，无私变得贪婪，猜忌取代信任…
派蒙很喜欢吃东西，比如，就比如「甜甜花酿鸡」…第一次吃的时候，派蒙一定会吃得很开心吧。
是啊，我一下子吃了两只呢。
嗯…但是第二次吃的时候就没有第一次吃好吃了，第三次吃也没有第二次吃好吃，或许有一天就会吃腻。
应该不会吃腻啦，我相信「甜甜花酿鸡」…不过…唔，确实是第一次吃到的「甜甜花酿鸡」最好吃…
然后你就会想要吃到更好吃的东西，如此反复，结果只是为了填补心中「想要获得第一次吃的感动」的那个空洞。
许多欲与恶如是横生，但是，反过来…不管吃什么，无论什么时候吃，无论是第几次，都能够获得那份感动呢？
哇，这听上去像是什么梦里的世界…
这就是「明日」的世界。无论做什么，内心都能充盈这种感动，而诸多感动中，最为显著的就是爱吧…
那会是不灭的，固定的，永恒之爱，而后，正因充斥这份永恒之爱，世界变为不再苦恼也没有痛苦的国度。
是的，因为…时间与变化是摧折，会在每一秒里伤害爱之永远。
就是所有吃的都会变成一个味道…
欸，怎么回事，我可没听说过会变成这样？
啊…因为吃什么东西都超级开心，所以吃的东西就变得无所谓了？
是呀…派蒙真的比想象中聪明很多呢。
塑造这样的世界，第一步就是利用影域…光或许很快会将目光投射入影域，不过那也需要一些时间…
用影域覆盖至冬，然后是整个世界，让所有的爱都定格在无始无终的空间里，如是达成——「无忧的庭院」。
令选择失去意义，令被选择和不被选择再无差别。这样的世界里，甚至「深渊」也会变得「可爱」起来吧。
「眼镜」，「眼镜」还说等拿回身体要和我们干各种不同的事，「眼镜」肯定也不想要这样的世界！
没关系的，派蒙，旅行者，甚至「雏原人」，无论你们愿意与否…你们都能在无忧的世界拥有一席之地。
真可惜，我以为你们会理解，看来我们的理念有分歧，不过没有关系，最终的理解终究会到来…
那看来，我已经是你们想要阻止的对象了…我，还是不想和你们动手，所以，这是我的选择。
哈哈，真是有趣的笑话，这世上没有人能够动摇或是触碰你。
当然了，也没有人能够融合或者改造你，所以你并不是最好的选择。
EN: We're finally in. That felt really cold just now.
We should be able to reconstruct Goggles' body, now right? ...Hold on, where's Goggles?
What's going on!? Even those blue lenses have disappeared...
There is no cause for concern... The once-fragmented body, along with the consciousness bound to inanimate matter, have all returned to where they rightfully belong.
You may leave the Eye of Graeae in my keeping for a time. In my estimation, it is a form of homecoming for it anyhow.
Yes. I'm glad to see that you remember my name, Paimon.
Don't worry, he will come to. Just maybe not so soon, that's all.
Oh, so he's getting his body back, right? Good as new? He'll be back to his original human form?
No, he will not. He will inhabit "another's form" and metamorphose into the true "Proto-Man." I suppose this might be slightly different from what you imagined.
Hold on... This is all a little confusing. Didn't he want his old body back?
He knows nothing because he has completely forgotten the past. To think that "reclaiming his old body" is the only thought driving him... Perhaps that in itself is a cruelty.
But reclaiming his old body was never his true purpose from the beginning. That was all merely preparation for assimilating into, and reforging, a form of an even higher order.
This is something he should come to comprehend once his memory is made whole.
"Assimilating and being changed into a form of an even higher order..." Eh, are you saying that his body and powers will all go into someone else's body?
But how is that gonna happen when his body's already gone...?
I see now. You're thinking of using Paimon's body.
What? No way!!! But... hmm... if it's for Goggles, Paimon supposes she could make a little room for him...
Hahaha! I fear that assimilating him into Paimon's body will only bring about other complications.
It isn't hard to piece together, 旅行者. There is indeed a vessel left here at the Pale Crown Palace, where the old king of the northern realm has been interred...
Are you talking about... the Belyi Tsar's body?
Huh? The Belyi Tsar? But he's been dead for so many years! He can't be anything more than a pile of bones by now...
His Majesty is different. His body... has remained alive even after the passing of his consciousness.

Think of him as the "Tsar's White Birch." In truth, we're speaking of the ever-growing "nerves" of his husk, a shell that never truly perished, forever extending outward in longing. Hmm, the white birch... it scarcely resembles a tree, does it?
And five centuries on, His Majesty's body has yet to cease its longing...
What...? So the Belyi Tsar's body is still alive? After all this time??? But how can it be...?

You must admit, his existence is truly unique. Although he was not a Descender, he was of noble birth nevertheless. He was the culmination of Hyperborea's most advanced technologies, a being with a soul bestowed through nothing less than light itself...
The Hyperboreans even attempted to forge his body from the flesh and blood of the Primordial Cryo Dragon, just to give him authority equal to The One.
A will born alongside Teyvat, the master of the Light Realm's power at the very beginning, and the King of all Dragon Lords: Nibelung.
Ever since his destruction, the place of Primordial Human, or Narayana, has sat vacant.
But in the heavens above, the cold blades of the ruler who must not be named... Ha, or should I say, the long nails of theirs... continued to hang high and pitiless over the world. And so...
They... sought to create their own gods.
So that's why they created the Belyi Tsar... But they couldn't possibly have called him that at the time. Did they call him the Primordial Human or something then?

Though they attempted to create the Primordial Human, the experiment went out of control. Otherwise, the Golden City would still be standing tall upon this land today... and we would not be standing atop this frozen expanse instead.

According to the record fragments we found inside the Shadow Realm, the corpse of the Cryo Dragon Sovereign and their unchecked authority turned the whole of Snezhnaya into the Holy Soil of primordial ice.
Even the ley lines in the area were affected, to the point that they became veins of pure crystal... That is, until that being witnessed this and sent their heavenly nail crashing down.
Ow... But um, since the experiment was a failure, how did the Belyi Tsar come about?
It spun out of control, but it was not a failure... A thousand years after that experiment and its cataclysmic impact finally cleared, His Majesty awoke from the remains of the Cryo Dragon.

However, his power was not fully complete, as the experiment was never brought to its conclusion... And by that time, Hyperborea had already sunk into the Shadow Realm, and the only ones seen in the land of ice and snow were the fae...
While most people believe the Belyi Tsar to be some kind of extraordinarily powerful fae, his true identity is far more noble...

Hyperborea, which had created him, had already perished. He could have left it behind with ease. But he chose to accept it... He accepted that he was the failed product of the Primordial Human project.
And that... included accepting all the responsibilities and consequences that came with it.
He was even willing to embrace humankind in this frozen land that swarmed with monsters, and he remained willing to... become the true Primordial Human.
This was a love, a grand and all-encompassing benevolence that we must never betray.
And Goggles... was the "Proto Man" that was created after countless experiments, and the Key that would allow His Majesty to become the Primordial Human.
This... is something that should have been started a long time ago. And now, it has become His Majesty's final wish...
But thanks to the two of you, 旅行者 and Paimon, we can now complete his grand design.
Make no mistake, this is no light undertaking. It is an endeavor I had originally planned to spend twenty years completing.
Hehe! Paimon doesn't really get what you're talking about, but Paimon will happily accept your thanks anyway!
I mean, once the Primordial Human is complete...
Oh, that's right! You keep talking about that "Court of Bliss." What even is that place supposed to be...?

"Thus is the world of tomorrow... a realm that had cast aside envy, hatred, and selfish desire. All shall be able to love one another as in the very beginning, and this love shall be, in nature, everlasting."
"Thus shall a radiant world descend, where there will be no distinction between human and human, nor between human and god."
At least, that was the vision he described to us. But I understand it differently... The "love" he spoke of was simply a kind of spiritual overflow.

It's just that this overflow runs dry beneath the weight of countless sorrows. And so, those who once poured love begin to drain it from others, the selfless turn into hoarders, and trust is supplanted by fear and suspicion.
Um... Paimon doesn't get what you're saying at all...
Hmm. You are quite fond of eating, are you not, Paimon? Take the "Sweet Madame," for instance. You must have found it utterly delicious the very first time you tasted it.
That's right! Paimon even had two whole birds in one go!

Yes... But it did not taste quite as delicious the second time, did it? And by the third, the pleasure had faded even further... Eventually, a day will come when you find yourself completely sick of it altogether.

No way! Paimon will never get sick of eating Sweet Madame! Paimon knows for a fact that... But... Wait... Hmm. You're actually right, though. It really was the most delicious the very first time Paimon had it...
Then, you will find yourself craving something even more delicious. This cycle will repeat itself, time and again, simply because you seek to fill the void left by the memory of that very first bite.

And that void is precisely where countless desires and wicked deeds are born. But what if it worked the other way around? What if you could get that exact same feeling out of everything you eat, whenever you eat it, no matter how many times you've had it before?
Wow, that sounds like some kinda dream world...

This is the world of tomorrow. In this world, no matter what you do, your heart shall always brim with that feeling, that sense of being touched at your very core. And of those feelings, love would be the most apparent of all...

It is a kind of love that can never be extinguished, a love that is unchanging and everlasting. And such a world, brimming with such eternal love, will become a realm free from worry and pain thereafter.
But it would also be a world where change is no more.
Yes. That is because... time and change are what ravage all things. Every second that passes is a second that erodes the everlastingness of love.
Wait, what do you mean by "change is no more"?
It means whatever you eat, they will all end up tasting the same...
Huh? Hold on, how does that make any sense?!
Ah! So it's like... because everything you eat makes you feel super, super happy, it doesn't matter what you eat anymore?
That is right... You really are quite the clever little thing, Paimon.
The first step in shaping this world is to use the Shadow Realm... Light may soon cast its gaze toward the shadow, but that would still take some time...

We shall blanket the whole of Snezhnaya in the shadow realm, and then the entire world, so that all love may stand unchanging in a space with no beginning and no end... Thus shall we bring forth the Court of Bliss.
Choice would lose meaning, while the difference between the chosen and unchosen will dissipate. In a world like this, I reckon even the Abyss would become lovable.
Goggles said he wants to get his body back and go on all sorts of adventures with us! Goggles would never, ever want a world like this!
No matter. There shall be a place for all of you in this carefree world — for 旅行者, for Paimon, and even for the Proto-Man — whether you are willing or not.
That's not a world I'm interested in either way...
A true pity. I thought this was something upon which we would share a common understanding. But that matters not, for the final understanding shall eventually come.
I assume this means you will now try to stop me... But I have no desire to raise my hand against you nevertheless. This, then, is my choice.
You're not looking at me, are you?
Hahaha! A most amusing notion. Your existence is such that none in this world can touch or diminish it.
Naturally, it follows that none in this world is able to assimilate or reforge you. That renders you a most unbefitting choice.

title: 《曾为灵魂的木舟》·阿克西妮娅

CHS: …第四百四十六次探索，与「地原胚质」一同发现的记录，其中显示的事实已足够清晰，谨将其记录如下…
…圣徒来到亥珀波瑞亚是为了寻找世界最初被创造时的光…那是创世之初遗留下来的碎片，蕴藏着足以点亮星辰的潜力与尚未逸散的希望。从它投映在传道所中的影像来看，那与使我诞生的光芒别无二致…
…为了确认那束光芒是否真的已经熄灭，他带着天上的东西来到了地上。他向统治尘世的「命运」发起了注定失败的进攻，却也因此受到了惩罚…
…■■是对的，亥珀波瑞亚的命运早在圣徒到来之前便已注定。毁灭的判决已经写下，天使的长女亦无从更改。忠实于未来的人们，他们的全部努力到头来只是让那场审判推迟了三十年到来——仅凭这一点，便足以推翻我之前的全部结论…
…关于「黑玛门尼」的真相，所得出的结论过于骇然，或许我不该将它落于文字…
…未曾分化的白光意味着无限的可能，然而人们却为了追求「确定」的世界将其固定在有限的色域中，于是失去了纯粹的光便在虚空中投下了最初的阴影…
…时间是环形的…正因如此，当我们锚定命运时，深渊也在时间的尽头锚定了我们…
…我想那位圣徒一定早就发现了这一点，或许他自己就曾亲眼见过原初之光耗尽的终末，因此他才不惜一切地扑向了最后的光…
…如果将此结论与各国历史上发生的事情联系起来，过去那些看似孤立的事件，便全都可以说得通了。即便记忆无法留在地脉的记录之中，那些忤逆高天的意志，依然通过少数幸存者如星火般流传下去…
…无论是须弥的那位花神，还是预言了涨水的西比尔，她们都曾试图创造独立于地脉与「黑玛门尼」的系统。即便无法破坏这沉重的世界结构，但只要凿出几处孔洞，也能使命运的编织网出现松动。目前看来，在我所读过的历史中，这些叛逆确实发挥了作用――在纳塔，执掌权柄的并未归于既定的圣主，而是由另外一人成为了王；在枫丹，雷穆利亚的秘法也逃过了高天的视线，以某种扭曲的形式流传了下来…
…如今我终于知晓了我曾被寄予的厚望，以及我本应担负的责任…
…我所犯下的罪责无可饶恕…那贯穿影域的通道，以及至今仍在向凡世渗漏的污秽，皆是我不可推卸的罪业。但在我偿还那份罪责之前，尚有必须要完成的事。或者说，只有将其完成，才能弥补我所犯下的罪…
…唯有登上星陆的宝座，完成前人所未能完成的伟业，才会有逆转毁灭的可能…
EN: ...Foray four hundred and forty-six: The records found alongside the Embryonic-Ichoric-Telluric-Rudiment, or "Eitr" for short, have provided a sufficiently clear picture of the matter, which is noted as follows...

...The Saint had come to Hyperborea in search of that light from the very genesis of the world, a fragment left behind at its inception. It is a light that is undissipated hope itself, a light that holds the potential to illuminate the entire cosmos. From what I have seen of it projected in that house of ministry, it is also the very same light that brought about my birth...

...He brought down something from the heavens merely to ascertain whether that light was truly extinguished. He then launched that advance which was destined to fail against the "fate" that ruled over the entire world, and was consequently punished...

...■■■■ was right. Hyperborea's fate had been sealed long before The Saint arrived. That long-written decree to annihilate the golden realm was one that even the eldest daughter of the angels could not alter, and all the men who remained faithful to the future could do was stave off the execution of that judgment for a mere thirty years. This fact alone is more than enough to disprove all of my earlier conclusions...
...As for the truth about "Heimarmene," I fear that the conclusion I have reached may be far too terrible to put to paper...

...That never-refracted light signified a boundless array of possibilities in its pure whiteness. However, man chose to confine it to a far narrower band of hues in the name of certainty, and so lost that very first shadow which the purest of light had cast into the void...
...Time moves in loops and circles. Therefore, whenever we lay down an anchor into fate, the Abyss will naturally lay an anchor into us at the end of time as well...

...I surmise this is something The Saint had long discerned. Perhaps he had even glimpsed that end of the path where the primordial first light had became spent, and thus resolved to cast himself headlong into the last light...

...Once we place this conclusion alongside the histories of the various nations, once seemingly unrelated events converge into a cohesive narrative. And even if memories cannot be retained in the Ley Lines, that will and desire to defy the heavens will nevertheless endure like twinkling stars through the few who survive and remain...

...Both the Goddess of Flowers in Sumeru and she who prophesied the rising of the waters in Fontaine sought to build systems that would stand independent of both the Ley Lines and Heimarmene. Though one may be unable to inflict substantial damage upon this severe and grinding world structure, a few rents and fissures suffice to loosen the threads of fate. And as the histories I have read attest, these defiers have indeed left their mark: in Natlan, the reins of power have been assumed by one other than a divinely anointed "Sacred Lord," whilst in Fontaine, the Remurians have somehow been able to elude the gaze of the high heavens and transmit their arts, albeit in a fashion distorted...
...Now, at last, I understand the great ambition once placed in my hands, and the responsibility I am meant to bear...

...The sin I have committed is utterly beyond forgiveness... I cannot deny my hand in that passage which traverses the Shadow Realm, nor that filth which continues to seep into the world. But there are other matters I must attend to before I atone for that sin. Or rather, only by attending to these matters can I redress the grave wrong I have committed...

....Only by ascending to that seat high up in the court of the stars and accomplishing that grand undertaking which our forebears could not achieve can the possibility of total destruction be averted...
