KR: 그날, 보육원에 새로운 일원이 찾아왔다. 그녀는 스스로를 고귀한 공주라고 부르는 예쁘장한 이국 소녀였다. 고국이 황금의 신에게 패배했지만 제사장의 딸이었던 그녀는 새로운 신을 인정할 수 없었기에 머나먼 켄리아로 떠나온 것이었다. 그녀는 자신의 이름이 「하늘의 신의 사자와 같다」는 뜻의 안젤리카(각주 1)라고 했다.

아름다운 안젤리카는 언젠가 왕국에서 가장 강한 기사와 결혼할 거라고 말했다. 페룬에리는 관심이 없었지만, 헤레브란트는 안젤리카에게 반하고 말았다. 안젤리카는 왕국의 우물 바다 주변을 자주 산책했으며, 그곳에서 헤레브란트에게 바깥세상의 다양한 이야기를 들려줬다. 참된 벗 페룬에리가 동행할까 걱정한 탓에 호기심보다 질투심이 앞선 그는 안젤리카가 말한 모든 이야기를 의심했지만, 언젠간 두 눈으로 보게 되는 날이 오기를 바랐다.
안젤리카가 온 이후로 헤레브란트는 다른 사람이 된 것처럼 소란을 일으켰고, 다른 기사에게 시비를 걸고 결투했다. 모든 결투에서 이긴 그는 안젤리카에게 자신의 용맹함을 뽐냈다. 하지만 헤레브란트의 모든 공훈을 지켜본 안젤리카는 가볍게 웃을 뿐이었다. 달리기 선수가 거북이를 꺾는다고 어찌 공적이라고 할 수 있겠는가?
「검은 말(각주 2)과 함께하는 뇨르드, 심비원의 전투 1인자 알프, 기사 절반의 통솔자 알베리히, 불패의 페룬에리」 안젤리카는 자신이 마음에 담아두었던 켄리아의 최강자 후보를 털어놓았다.
사랑에 빠진 헤레브란트는 속으로 나름 논리적인 결정을 내렸다. 사람들은 그를 배신자라고 부르거나, 그가 미쳤다고 생각했다. 하지만 그렇다고 한들, 그에게는 페룬에리를 해칠 생각이 전혀 없었다.
그리고 페룬에리는 안젤리카만 죽이면, 참된 벗이 제정신을 차릴 것이라고 생각했다.
무자비한 추격전을 벌인 끝에 세 사람이 국경을 벗어났다. 그 순간 헤레브란트가 자신의 얼굴을 감싸 쥐었고, 입 밖으로 흘러나오는 말도 점차 야수의 울음소리처럼 변해갔다.
마녀 안젤리카가 설명했다. 「헤레브란트는 자신의 신을 버리고 켄리아로 온 백성의 후예야. 저게 바로 켄리아에 고지식한 순혈파 귀족이 존재하는 이유이자 자신의 신을 배신한 대가지」
「그리고 페룬에리, 넌 표류해 온 사람이야. 그래서 네겐 이런 저주가 없지. 한 세계의 숭고함에 비할 수는 없겠지만, 네게도 너만의 운명이 있어」
「그리고 난 신이 죽기 전까지 단 1초도 배신한 적이 없어. 그래서 내게도 그런 저주가 없지. 그런데 말이야, 정말 내가 누군지 알아보겠니?」
그 순간, 태양이 지평선에서 떠올랐다. 밤샘 전투로 지친 페룬에리의 손에서 검이 미끄러져 내렸다. 그는 손등으로 이마를 가린 채 처음으로 태양을 올려다보았다. 그리고 다시 안젤리카에게 시선을 돌렸을 때, 그는 그녀가 리월의 아름다운 소녀나 악독한 마녀가 아니라는 사실을 깨달았다.
「나는 운명에서 벗어난 자유야. 헤레브란트는 힘들게 좇았지만, 넌 손쉽게 얻을 수 있는 것이지」
페룬에리의 앞은 텅 비어 있었고, 오직 광활한 대지만 펼쳐져 있을 뿐이었다.
각주 1: 고대 리월 사람은 이런 식으로 작명하지 않았다. 지금 생각해 보니 그녀의 이름은 「묘음의 딸」이나 「천왕의 종」이었을 것이다.
각주 2: 초판에는 검은 늑대였다. 켄리아 고고학에 따르면 켄리아 연금술로 만든 전투 짐승 중 한 종류인 것으로 보인다. 붉은 달의 왕조가 통치하던 시기에는 연금술과 조련 기사가 나라의 근간이었지만, 검은 태양의 왕이 통치하던 시기에는 기계공학의 발전으로 서서히 쇠퇴했다.
감사말:
데논 씨의 켄리아 고고학이 본 작품에 영감을 주었습니다. (초판)
장·피작 씨의 글과 윤색 덕분에 이야기를 끝맺을 수 있었습니다. (제2판)
장·피작 부인과 장·피작 주니어 씨가 오타를 교정해주셨습니다. (제3판)
카를·잉골드 씨가 기록한 《폐허 도시 고찰 기행》을 정리했습니다. (제13판)
카라사와 씨가 잡학, 박물학적으로 지원해주셨습니다. (제14판)
운 선생님께서 리월 문화 부분에 주석을 달아주셨습니다. (제15판)

CHS: 「坎瑞亚诸贵族的首上啊，赤红的月影早已殒落于渊天，你的血脉也已终于偏盲」
「统领我等的仁善之主啊，若你依然怀有对人子的怜悯，就请饮下这杯中之酒吧」
那是漆黑之日尚未遍照地底的久远时岁，古老尊荣的氏族统治着那广袤的王国。
迂执的祭司说服王座上昏聩的君王相信，高天之上的赤月之骸即是万象的主宰，
因为月光的色泽流淌在凡人的血肉之下，隐匿于渊底的漆黑，亦当由赤月而出。
既然如此，人之王便应以赤月之名自称。依循两界的光与焰，裁定无常的命运。
于是渴盼超越之人筑起无数恢宏的高塔，祷求早已逝去的赤月为他们带来拯救。
直至被斥为异端的星象学者们自虚假之天的倒影中窥见了世间一切命运的本源，
直至再也无法浇灭的质疑与愤怒如野火烧遍无梦的疆土，最终焚向月色的高宫…
待到漆黑之日遍照的时岁，赤月之名早已伴着赤红流尽，秽浊的残痕上唯余厄月之称。
无论是遘罹诅咒的不净者，还是未被命运玷染的无垢者，无人再以月骸的追随者自居。
唯有数人躲过了灭族之祸，藏匿于黑日未能照临的影中，渴盼赤月为仇怨赐敕下报偿——
只是那所谓的报偿终究未曾到来，黑日殒落于同样的愚昧与傲慢。
覆灭再临之时，唯有嗤笑的月光，洒落在早已灼成残灰的日影上。
「命运，命运，可怖而苍白的命运，你何竟卑屈于凶恣的僭君」
「若是厄月之骸早已将你锚定于死，旧日血仇又有何意义可寻」
「若是她编织的命运这般讥嘲我等，我等亦不妨高声讥嘲命运」
「直至烬日最后的残影焚灭旧世界，直至赤月见证无垢的明晨」
EN: "O High Lord of the Nobles of Khaenri'ah, the crimson-red moon has long since fallen into the abyssal firmament, and the blindness of your blood has ended your line,"
"O benevolent lord who leadeth us, should you still pity the children of humanity, then drink deep the wine in this cup."
It was an ancient era, before the dark sun's light illuminated the underground, and an ancient and glorious clan still ruled that vast kingdom.
The dogmatic priests convinced the muddle-minded king upon the throne that the remnants of the Crimson Moon in the sky ruled all,
For it is the color of the moonlight that flows beneath mortal flesh, and the darkness hidden within the bottom of the abyss shall too emerge from the Crimson Moon.
This being so, the king of humanity should take upon himself the name of the Crimson Moon, and by the light and flame of two worlds judge fickle fate.
Thus they yearned for transcendent individuals to build countless glorious towers, and prayed for the long-dead Crimson Moon to bring them salvation.
Until the astrologists branded as heretics glimpsed in the inverted image of the false sky the origin of all the world's fate,
Until the unquenchable flames of doubt and fury blazed across the dreamless realm like wildfire, finally burning to the moonlight-hued palace itself...
By the time of the blackened sun, the name of the Crimson Moon had long faded along with the crimson that had flowed. Only the epithet "Balemoon" remained to stain the lingering detritus.
Whether the unclean who suffered from the curse, or those unblemished ones not yet tainted by fate, none would again consider themselves a follower of the moon's remnants.
Few survived the utter destruction of their kind, hiding in the shadows where the sun did not shine, longing for the Crimson Moon to decree their desire for vengeance be repaid—
But the so-called repayment never came, and the dark sun fell to the same ignorance and arrogance.
When destruction once again was nigh, only the mocking moonlight spilled forth upon the shadow of the sun, long burnt to ash.
"Fate, fate, O terrifying and pale fate, why must you abase yourself and submit to such a tyrannical usurper
If the Balemoon's remnants had already sealed your doom, what meaning could be found in the blood vengeance of bygone days?
If the destiny she wove mocks us so, then let us mock destiny as loudly as we may
Until the last shadow of the ashen sun burns away the old world, until the Crimson Moon witnesses the immaculate dawn."
JP: 「カーンルイアの諸貴族の主よ。赤い月の影は深淵の空へと沈み、そなたの血筋も終に盲となった」
「我らを統べる慈悲深き主よ。もし人の子への憐みがまだ残っているというなら、この盃の酒を飲みたまえ」
漆黒の日がまだ地下に照り渡る前の遥か昔、古き栄光の氏族が広大な王国を支配していた。
迂腐なる祭司は、玉座に座する愚昧な君王に信じ込ませた——高天の赤月の骸が即ち万象の支配者であると。
月光が凡人の血肉に流れているがゆえ、深淵の底に隠れし漆黒もまた赤月に現れて然るべきであろう。
ならば、人の王は赤月を名乗り、双界の光と炎によって無常なる運命を裁くべきである。
——それゆえ、超越者が無数の高塔を建ててくれることを切望し、逝きし赤月に救われることを祈っていた。
異端児と罵られた星象学者たちが、映り出された偽りの空に、世のすべての運命の根源を覗き見る前までは…
もはや抑えきれない疑惑と怒りが、野火のごとく夢無き国土を焼き尽くし、終には月光に照らされた高宮へと広がっていった…
やがて漆黒の日が照り渡った時、すでに赤月の名は深紅の色とともに尽き果て、穢れた残痕にあるのは、凶月の名のみだった。
呪われし穢れた者も、運命にまだ染まらぬ無垢なる者も、月骸の信者と自称する者は誰もいなくなった。
一族を滅ぼす災厄を逃れた数人は、黒い日の光が届かぬ影に身を潜めると、赤い月が復讐を遂げ、怨念を払ってくれることを切望した——
しかし、所謂復讐が叶うことはなかった。黒い日も同様に愚昧と傲慢に溺れ、滅んでしまったのだ。
再び滅亡に見舞われた時、灰燼に帰した日の影の上に、嘲笑うような月の光だけが降り注いでいた。
「運命よ、恐るべき蒼白な運命よ。なぜ横暴な簒奪者にへつらうのだ？」
「凶月の骸がすでにそなたの運命を定めたのなら、過ぎ去りし血の復讐に一体何の意味がある？」
「もし彼女が編み出した運命が我々を斯様に嘲笑うなら、我々もその運命を高らかに嘲笑おうではないか」
「灰燼と化した日の最後の残影が旧世界を焼き尽くし、赤い月が無垢なる朝の到来を見届けるまで」
KR: 「켄리아 귀족의 우두머리여, 붉은 달의 그림자가 심연의 하늘에 떨어졌으니, 네 혈통도 반쪽짜리가 되었구나」
「우리를 이끄는 선하고 인자한 주인이시여, 아직도 인간의 자식들을 불쌍히 여기신다면 이 술잔을 들이켜십시오」
칠흑의 태양이 대지를 비추기 전, 고대 존귀한 일족이 광활한 왕국을 통치하고 있었다.
집요한 사제는 왕좌에 앉은 아둔한 왕으로 하여금, 높은 하늘 위에 있는 붉은 달의 잔해가 바로 만상의 지배자라는 것을 믿게 했다.
달빛은 인간의 피와 살 속에서 흐르니, 심연 바닥에 숨어 있는 칠흑 역시 달에서 나왔을 것이다.
따라서 인간의 왕은 자신을 붉은 달로 칭하고, 두 세계의 빛과 불길로 무상한 운명을 심판해야 마땅했다.
그리하여 초월을 갈망하는 사람들은 무수히 많은 웅장한 고탑을 쌓아, 오래전에 사라진 붉은 달이 그들에게 구원을 가져다주길 기도했다.
이단으로 몰린 천문학자들이 거짓된 하늘의 그림자에서 세상 운명의 근원을 엿보기 전까지
꺼지지 않는 의심과 분노가 들불처럼 꿈 없는 영토를 태우고 높은 달빛 궁전으로 번지기 전까지 말이다…
칠흑의 햇빛이 쏟아질 무렵, 붉은 달의 이름은 이미 붉은빛과 함께 사라진 지 오래였고 더럽고 탁한 잔해에는 재액의 달이라는 칭호만 남았다.
저주에 걸린 불결한 자든, 운명에 더럽혀지지 않은 순결한 자든, 그 누구도 자신을 달 잔해의 추종자로 자처하지 않았다.
멸족의 화를 피한 사람은 극소수였으며, 그들은 검은 태양이 비치지 않는 그림자에 숨어 붉은 달이 원한을 갚아주기를 갈망했다.
그러나 소위 말하는 복수는 오지 않았고 검은 태양도 똑같은 우매함과 오만함에 추락했다.
멸망이 다시 찾아왔을 땐 오직 조소를 머금은 달빛만이 이미 재가 된 해의 그림자를 비출 뿐이었다.
「운명이여, 운명이여, 무섭고도 창백한 운명이여, 어찌하여 너는 흉악한 찬탈왕에게 굴복하는 것인가?」
「재액의 달의 잔해가 이미 너를 죽음에 묶어버렸다면, 과거의 피맺힌 원한에 대체 무슨 의미가 있단 말인가?」
「그녀가 엮은 운명이 이렇게 우리를 조롱한다면 우리는 더 큰 소리로 운명을 조롱할 것이다」
「잿빛 태양의 마지막 잔상이 구세계를 불태우고, 붉은 달이 무구한 아침 녘을 목도할 때까지」

CHS: 很高兴看到各位平安归来。
咦，感觉少了好多人…菲林斯他们呢？奈芙尔好像也不在？
我先回来了。菲林斯正在协助爱诺与伊涅芙布置诱饵机械，为计划争取时间。至于奈芙尔小姐…
老板正在花时间善后，让我们带着收集到的「绝密情报」先过来会合。
原来如此。那就长话短说，直接切入正题吧。
这位是你们找来的帮手吗？
初次见面，我和哥伦比娅是茶会密友，受邀前来帮忙。各位可以称呼我——阿蕾奇诺。
（这个人的眼睛…总觉得在哪里见过？对了！刚刚老板带我们看的猎月人的回忆里——）
阿蕾奇诺。我听说愚人众执行官第四席也叫这个名字，应该不会是单纯的重名吧？
「大团长」先生真是见多识广。来自蒙德，住在挪德卡莱，心里面还念着至冬的人和事。
哈哈，彼此彼此，看来你对我的身份也了如指掌。
（气氛突然变得很压抑…毕竟是愚人众的执行官，哪怕非常时期，也不能轻易信任。）
我还真有点好奇，那位月神小姐已经脱离了愚人众，为何你还会愿意冒着危险来帮忙？
挪德卡莱不属于蒙德，法尔伽先生不也在为这片土地抗争吗？
有些事不需要确切的理由，比起成功后的回报，失控的风险更让人无法接受。
当然，若说一点好处都没有也不现实…但那就是我和哥伦比娅之间的事情了。
这个人曾帮助我们解决枫丹的危机。
请原谅，我无意怀疑您，只是我们面临的许多困扰确实都来自于愚人众。
挪德卡莱有自己的生活方式，但愚人众来到这里后，对待我们的态度却算不上友好。
我充分理解过去双方存在许多不愉快的摩擦。有些事我虽曾竭力避免，但根本的利益冲突注定无法友好解决。
所以这次行动，我只代表我个人参加，与愚人众无关。
为表诚意，我就直说了，我有办法帮哥伦比娅找到虹月的月髓，帮助她进一步恢复力量。
你们还有别的议题吗？可以开始了。
（这个女人…嘴上说着「为表诚意」，却完全跳过了寻找月髓的方案，看来是不想透露太多秘密。）
（她已经把话题拐到了下个议案上，现在也很难问出口。眼下也只能相信她了…执行官第四席，这气场一看就不好惹。）
既然阿蕾奇诺女士如此有信心，我们就开始下个议题吧。雅珂达，是时候分享一下你们查到的「绝密情报」了。
咳咳，各位听好了！首先，「猎月人」的真实身份是坎瑞亚的特务，他的主要工作是诛杀所有的「赤月余孽」。
是啊，回忆里的他说了一堆「赤月」与「黑日」的事情，好像都是坎瑞亚时期的历史。
据我所知，「赤月」与「黑日」分别是坎瑞亚历经的两个朝代。
据说在遥远的过去，坎瑞亚人信奉赤月，从月亮的倒影中取得神秘的力量。
但是随着一场政变，黑日取代了赤月，成了坎瑞亚的象征，这个国家迎来了全新的王朝。
即便赤月王朝覆灭许久，黑日王朝的末代君主「黑王」依旧垂涎它留下的秘密，让「猎月人」暗中抓捕赤月的残党。
那时候的「猎月人」看上去并不疯癫，言行举止都与正常人无异。对了…他还有个未婚妻，叫索琳蒂丝。
维瑟弗尼尔…！莱茵多特…！呃啊啊…索琳蒂丝！索琳蒂丝！
还有别的线索吗？比如他的未婚妻，是个什么样的人？
我想想啊…她是「深秘院」的研究员，不过似乎还隐藏了别的什么秘密。
还有一件事，「猎月人」的碎片里不知道为何混杂了一些索琳蒂丝的记忆，虽然只有很小的一部分。
嗯…线索很多啊。总之我们得出结论，索琳蒂丝还在的时候，「猎月人」看上去很清醒，也很正常。
那么索琳蒂丝应该就是他心中的执念。坎瑞亚人…是纯血还是混血呢？
你问这个干什么？等等，如果是纯血的坎瑞亚人…
如果能找到她的下落，是不是就能让「猎月人」恢复正常了？
有这个可能性，但不能把希望全部寄托于奇迹。
（奈芙尔认识的那位商人…是叫多莉吧？可以试着委托她帮忙调查。）
既然这样，我们现在就继续分成不同小队行动。
旅行者、派蒙、「库塔尔」，以及这位阿蕾奇诺女士去找虹月的月髓。
在赶来的路上，我发现搜捕「库塔尔」的狂猎已经越发狂躁。
再这样下去，生活在这里的普通人也会受到威胁…我打算组织部分信众对它们进行清剿。
我先回秘闻馆，跟老板会合。
大家都有要做的事，这种感觉真不错。
狂猎活动频繁，执灯士们应该也开始行动了，得有人把这个消息告诉菲林斯。
我暂时留守吧，等菲林斯、爱诺和伊涅芙回来，我和他们商量下一步计划。
看来时间紧迫，我们先走一步。
我们也立刻动身，尽量为你们争取时间。
哈哈，不用太紧张。放手去做吧，情况紧急，我也呼叫了支援——用不了多久，就会有新的同伴赶到了。
我们回来了。是来早了一点，还是晚了一点？
哈哈，稍微晚了一点点，其他人已经开始行动了。月神小姐找来了新的帮手，奈芙尔老板也查到了一些线索。
马马虎虎吧，不知道能拖延多久…诱饵被破坏的速度太快了，远超我们的想象。
等会儿我打算再去做一些，但现在我得先歇会儿。太累了！
对了，伊涅芙，你把刚刚我们和菲林斯聊的事情跟法尔伽大叔也讲讲吧。
先前法尔伽大叔曾经提到，自己前往安瓦蒂尼尔湖调查狂猎的源头，却发现那里只是一处疑阵。
但根据菲林斯提供的情报，在法尔伽大叔前往安瓦蒂尼尔湖之前，挪德卡莱曾先后爆发过数次狂猎。
那时候「猎月人」还没有复活，实力非常有限，理论上他缺少在两地「同时作案」的手段。
菲林斯，执灯士们正在联手对抗挪德卡莱的狂猎灾害，他们需要你的帮助。
爱诺，我相信你能做出更好的机械，不仅是诱饵。但在那之前，你先在这里好好休息。
我和伊涅芙再去一趟安瓦蒂尼尔湖，看看有没有别的线索。
好耶！我就说法尔伽大叔会这么说，对吧？按照约定，接下来一周你不许管我吃甜食的事情！
情报已更新，上调爱诺的「预测准确率」。
她们打赌，说你在听到情报后会做出这样的判断。
任谁听到后都会这么做的，这点事情可不值得打赌。
我们已经商量过了，调查安瓦蒂尼尔湖的事情交给伊涅芙，你继续留守。
商讨作战会议的地方不能没人总领全局，再说…你埋伏「猎月人」时受的伤应该还没好利索吧。
…看来我领了最轻松的工作啊。好吧，谢谢各位，回见。
EN: It's a relief to see you all made it back in one piece.
Huh? Feels like there's quite a few people missing... Where's Flins and the others? And what about Nefer?
I returned ahead of them. Flins is helping Aino and Ineffa to set up the decoys and buy us some time. As for Miss Nefer...
Boss is still wrapping things up on her end. She sent us back to fill you all in on the top-secret intel we've been gathering.
I see. Then let's get right into it.
But first — who do we have here? You brought someone else in to help?
Greetings. I was invited here to help as a long-time tea party companion of Columbina's. You may call me Arlecchino.
(Those eyes... Where have I seen them before? Wait, of course! In those memories we just saw...!)
Hmm. The only Arlecchino I know is the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. So either you share a pretty uncommon name, or you're more than just a tea-party buddy.
You're well informed, Grand Master. A man from Mondstadt living all the way out here in Nod-Krai, and yet the people and affairs of Snezhnaya seem to hold a special place in your heart.
Haha, the feeling's mutual. Sounds like you know all about who I am, too.
(The atmosphere in here just got really tense... Guess we can't just start trusting Fatui Harbingers, even at a time like this.)
I must admit, though, I'm a little curious — seeing as the Moon Goddess no longer belongs to the Fatui, what makes you so willing to put your neck on the line here?
Nor does Nod-Krai belong to Mondstadt, Mr. Varka. Yet still, you're fighting for it all the same.
Things don't always have to have a tangible payoff. Sometimes, stopping things from spiraling out of control is a higher priority than chasing the spoils of victory.
Of course, I can't say there's nothing in it for me at all... but that's between Columbina and myself.
Arlecchino was instrumental in helping us save the whole of Fontaine.
Forgive me, I don't mean to doubt you. It's just that the Fatui really have been the source of many of our troubles.
We have our own way of doing things here in Nod-Krai. But ever since they arrived, the Fatui have treated us with nothing but hostility.

I know there's been a lot of bad blood between us in the past. I've done my utmost to avoid friction whenever I could, but sometimes, fundamental conflicts of interest simply can't be settled amicably.
That's why I'm here solely in a personal capacity. This has nothing to do with the Fatui.
As a gesture of good faith, I'll be frank. I can help Columbina track down the Iridescent Moon's marrow, which will help her restore more of her power.
Anyway, what else is on the agenda? Let's begin.
(She says she'll be frank, then completely skips over the details... Looks like she doesn't wanna give away too many secrets, after all.)

(But she clearly wants to change the subject. It'd be awkward if I tried to bring it up again now... Ugh, guess we'll just have to go along with it. She's the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers, after all... One look and you can tell she's not someone you'd wanna mess with.)
Well, since Ms. Arlecchino sounds confident in her ability to handle that, we'll proceed to the next topic. Jahoda, time to share that top-secret intel.

Ahem... Alright, listen up everyone! First, we now know that Rerir was originally a Khaenri'ahn secret agent whose primary mission was to hunt down and assassinate the so-called "Dregs of the Crimson Moon."
Mm-hmm. In the memories, there was a lot of talk about the "Crimson Moon" and "Eclipse," and a whole bunch of other stuff from the time of Khaenri'ah.
To my knowledge, those were the names of two different Khaenri'ahn dynasties.
Long, long ago, it is said that the people of Khaenri'ah worshiped the Crimson Moon, drawing a mysterious power from its reflection.
But one day, a coup saw the Crimson Moon "eclipsed" — hence the name of the new dynasty that replaced it, and how it became the new emblem of Khaenri'ah.

Still, long after the Crimson Moon dynasty had fallen, the last ruler of the Eclipse dynasty, the "Vinster King," still coveted the secrets it left behind. So he sent the "Rächer of Solnari" to secretly hunt down the Crimson Moon's few remaining followers.
In those days, Rerir showed no signs of madness — in fact, he was as normal as any other person. Oh... and he had a fiancee, or at least a would-be fiancee, called "Tholindis."
Just after Rerir regained his body...
Interesting. Anything else? What about this would-be fiancee of his... Do we know anything about her?
Well... She was a researcher at the Universitas Magistrorum, but it felt like she was hiding some kind of secret.
Oh, and one more thing — for some reason, Rerir's fragment also contained some of Tholindis's memories, though only a very small portion.
Hmm... Well, no shortage of potential leads, I'll give you that. In any case, it sounds like we can conclude that while Tholindis was still around, Rerir appeared to be lucid and quite normal.
Tholindis, it seems, must have been the one thing in this world that he couldn't let go of. Tell me, though... Were these "pure-blood" Khaenri'ahns we're talking about here?
Why do you need to know that? Hold on... If she was a pure-blood Khaenri'ahn...
Oh, yeah! Just like how it was with The Captain!
If we could somehow find her, do you think there's any chance Rerir might regain some of his sanity?
It's possible... but it would take a miracle. We can't pin all our hopes on that.
(That merchant who Nefer knows... Dori Sangemah Bay? Maybe we could hire her to look into it.)
Alright then, let's keep working in our separate teams.
旅行者, Paimon, Kuutar, and Ms. Arlecchino will go look for the Iridescent Moon's marrow.
On the way over here, I noticed that the Wild Hunt monsters had grown even more frenzied in their search for Kuutar.
At this rate, the people living here will be in grave danger too. So I'm thinking of gathering together some of our followers to go wipe them out.
I'll head back to the Curatorium and meet up with the boss.
Feels good knowing we've all got something to be getting on with.
Given that the Wild Hunt has been a lot more active lately, the Lightkeepers have likely begun their own operations too. If that is the case, someone will need to pass the news on to Flins.
I'll hold the fort for now, then discuss our next move with Flins, Aino, and Ineffa when they get back.
Well, the clock's ticking. If that's everything, we'll be on our way.
We'd better get moving too. We'll try to buy you as much time as we can.
Haha... Relax, just do your thing. I decided to call in some backup since things are getting so hairy. Our reinforcements should be here any minute now.
We're back. Did we get here a little early... or a little late?
Haha, a tad late — the others have already set off. To summarize: Our resident Moon Goddess has found us a new ally, and boss Nefer has uncovered some promising info.
Everything going smoothly on your end?
Eh, not great. I dunno how long we can stall him for. The decoys are getting taken out way faster than we imagined.
I'm gonna make some more later, but I need a time-out first. I'm soooo tired right now!
Oh, right — Ineffa, could you fill in Uncle Varka on what we just discussed with Flins?
Uncle Varka, you previously told us about how, when you went to investigate a source of the Wild Hunt in Amsvartnir, you discovered that it was just a diversion.
But according to Flins's intel, several outbreaks of the Wild Hunt had already occurred in Nod-Krai in the period leading up to that.
That was before Rerir had regained his body, when he was far from regaining his full strength. In other words, in theory at least, he still lacked the means to act in two places at once.
Flins, with everything that's been happening, the Lightkeepers across Nod-Krai are rallying to fight back against the Wild Hunt. They're gonna need your help.
Aino, I'm sure you're capable of coming up with something far more effective than decoys. But for now, you should stay here and get some rest.
Ineffa and I will head back over to Amsvartnir to see if there's anything I missed.
Hehe, I told you Uncle Varka would say that, didn't I? A deal's a deal! Not a word about my snack intake for the next week!
Database updated. Reliability of Aino's predictions increased.
They were betting on how you'd respond after hearing their intel.
It's the obvious choice, isn't it? That's hardly worth betting on.
We already decided that Ineffa should go investigate the situation over at Amsvartnir on her own. You might as well stay here and keep watch.
Someone needs to hang back and oversee our strategy meetings, and besides... you still haven't fully recovered from ambushing Rerir.
So I've ended up with the easiest assignment, hahaha... Well, I appreciate it everyone. See you when you get back.
I'm confident we can trust her.

title: 如月长存：哥伦比娅与菈乌玛

CHS: 那是罪人们尚未铸成大错的年代，地底构筑的属世王国深处。
王国中的人们不曾见过大海，当然也从未目睹过真正的太阳。
但即便是在这暗无天日的地方，亦有人妄图窥探群星的秘密。
不过他们并非仰望星空，而是在镜面虚假的倒影中寻觅真实。
或许是因为位置实在特殊，在王国境内所映出的星图中常有异象闪烁，
占星学家们将之记录下来，称为「渴真之天象」，其意即为渴望真实。
「或许镜中所倒映的不过虚假的幻影，真相唯有穿透幻影才能到达。」
摸索着冗长的星表，久而久之，占星学家们自然也产生了这般的想法，
只是那时的哲人们还不知道，他们已然窥见了永恒无限的魔天的一角。
不知过去了多少年，久到地上的神明纷纷陨落，久到黑日取代了赤月。
那时，已有人知晓了深罪的秘密，因此窥探星空也成为了禁忌的知识。
如今王国中仅有少数人享有逾越禁令的特权，以便为独眼的君王服务。
然而凡事总有意外，当无知的学僧拭去遮蔽焚真之镜的浮尘，
那环绕着深邃视界的奇境天光，便再次照亮了狭小的观星室。
漆黑的乐园是何等的美丽，何等的璀璨，又是何等的…亵渎。
仅是一瞥，便已占据了年轻的拉乌斯万格全部的心智与渴望。
而这便是日后高颂天外渊薮的妖僧，一切故事与罪行的开端…
EN: Those were the days when the sinners had yet to commit their unforgivable offense, somewhere deep within the earthly subterranean kingdom.
The people of the kingdom had never seen the sea, nor had they ever seen the real sun.
But even in this dark, sunless place, some tried to reach for the secrets of the stars.
However, they gazed not at the stars but sought the truth in the mirror's false reflection.
Perhaps because of the kingdom's unique location, strange phenomena often appeared in the star charts within its bounds.
These phenomena were recorded by astrologers as "Signs of Truth," reflecting their deep desire to uncover truth.
"Maybe, even if the mirror shows nothing but illusions, it is only by piercing through them that we can reach the truth."
This was the conclusion the astrologers reached over time as they pored over their voluminous star charts.
But unbeknownst to the philosophers of their time, they had already glimpsed a tiny fragment of the infinity that was the eternal bedeviled sky...
Many years passed, long enough for the earthly gods to fall, one by one, and for the atrous sun to rise where the crimson moon once hung.
Even then, there were those who had already uncovered the secret behind the great sin, and so, the study of the stars became a forbidden pursuit.
Only a select few within the kingdom were then granted the privilege of sidestepping the ban, so they might better serve their one-eyed ruler.
Yet the unexpected always finds a way, just like the moment when an unwitting novice monk brushes away the dust that has concealed Apaosha's mirror,
unveiling the wondrous light that encircles the distant horizon and filling that tiny stargazing chamber with brilliance once more.
How beautiful the pitch-black Elysium is, how dazzling... and yet how utterly... profane.
In the blink of an eye, it consumed young Rauthvangi's every thought and desire.
Thus began the tale and transgressions of the mad monk, who in later days would sing the praises of the abyss beyond the heavens...
JP: これは、罪人たちがまだ過ちを犯す前の時代、地底に築かれた王国の奥深くで起きた出来事である。
王国の人々は海を見たことがなかった。当然、本物の太陽も見たこともなかった。
しかし、この暗闇に包まれた地でも、星々の秘密を探ろうとする者がいた。
ただ、彼らは星空を見上げるのではなく、鏡面に映る偽りの倒影の中で真実を探っていたのである。
特殊な場所にあるためか、王国内で映し出された星図には、しばしば異常なものがちらついていた。
占星術師たちはそれを記録し、「真実を渇望する」という意味を込めて、「渇真の天象」と名付けた。
「鏡に映るのは虚偽の幻影のみ。真相へ至るには、幻影を突き破るほかない。」
膨大な星表を読み解くうちに、占星術師たちは自然とこのような考えへと行きついた。
そのときの哲学者たちは、すでに永遠にして無限なる魔天の一角を覗き見ていたことに、まだ気づいていなかった。
悠久の歳月が流れ、地上の神々は次々と崩御し、黒日が赤月に取って代わった。
そのときにはすでに、深罪の秘密を知ってしまった者がいた。そのため、星空を覗くことは禁忌の知識となった。
独眼の王のために禁令を破る特権を持てるのは、王国の中でも数名しかいない。
しかし、どのような事にも予想外というものはつきまとう。無知なる学僧が焚真の鏡を覆う埃を拭い去ったとき、
深邃なる視界を覆う不思議な天光が、再び狭い観測室を照らしたのである。
漆黒の楽園はあまりにも美しく、あまりにもまばゆく、あまりにも…冒涜的だった。
一目見ただけで、若きラウスヴァンギの意識と渇望を隅々まで満たした。
それが、天外の深淵を讃え続ける怪僧の、すべての物語と罪の始まりだった…
KR: 죄인들이 아직 큰 죄를 짓지 않았던 시절, 지하 깊은 곳에는 속세의 왕국이 있었다.
그 왕국의 사람들은 바다를 본 적도, 진짜 태양을 본 적도 없었다.
하지만 그런 어둠의 땅에서도, 누군가는 뭇별의 비밀을 엿보려 했다.
다만 그들은 밤하늘을 올려다보지 않고, 거울에 비친 거짓된 투영 속에서 진실을 찾으려 했다.
지리적 특수함 때문인지, 왕국 내부의 천문도에는 반짝이는 이상 현상이 자주 포착되었다.
점성술 학자들은 이를 기록하며, 진실을 갈망한다는 의미에서 「진실을 갈망하는 기상」이라 불렀다.
「거울에 비친 것이 거짓 환영에 불과할지라도, 환영을 뚫고 나아가야만 진실에 도달할 수 있다」
끝없이 이어진 성위표를 더듬다 보니, 점성술 학자들도 자연스럽게 그런 생각을 품게 되었지만
그때의 철학자들은 그들이 이미 영원하고 무한한 마천의 일각을 엿봤다는 것은 알지 못했다.
얼마나 흘렀을까. 지상의 신들이 하나둘씩 세상을 떠나고, 검은 태양이 붉은 달을 대체했을 무렵.
누군가 그 깊은 죄의 비밀을 알아차렸고, 별하늘 연구는 금단의 지식이 되었다.
지금 왕국에는 금지령을 어기는 특권을 누릴 수 있는 자가 극소수 존재하는데, 그들은 외눈박이 왕을 위해 봉사하는 자들이다.
하지만 예외는 언제나 존재하는 법. 무지한 수도승이 진실을 불태우는 거울을 가리고 있던 먼지를 닦아내는 순간
그윽하고 기묘한 하늘의 빛이 비좁은 별 관측실을 다시 비췄다.
칠흑 낙원이 어찌나 아름답고 찬란하며… 모독적이었는지.
그저 한 번 바라보는 것만으로도, 젊은 라우스방기의 마음과 갈망을 송두리째 집어삼켜졌다.
그리고 이것이 바로 훗날 하늘 밖의 심연을 찬미하는 요승의 이야기와 죄의 시작이었다…

CHS: 你们针对现状，再次向维摩庄的村民们收集了线索，直到天色暗了下来…
原来你们是接到了那样的委托，才来到这里的么…
「似乎只存在于记忆中的人」…的确令人在意，我也并不认为这会是一起普通的失踪案，但还不能确定与深渊教团的联系。
除此之外，就只有丘丘人的躁动这种浮于表面的线索了，还是没什么收获。
就是旅行者血亲的记忆里，那个神秘的声音，好像是什么…「罪人」，他到底是谁？
旅行者，你会认为…你的血亲「背叛」了你么？
是么…在彻底弄清真相之前，我看出了你的犹豫。
在任何不可挽回的事情出现之前，你们的关系完全还有回旋的余地。
不像你们想要了解的那个「罪人」，他和其他「罪人」一起，早已背叛了国家，也背叛了我…
他的名字…是「预言家」维瑟弗尼尔。
虽不愿提起，但他确实也是我的血亲，我的「哥哥」。
你们之间究竟发生了什么？
「罪人」共有五人…也即是坎瑞亚的「五大罪人」。
「贤者」海洛塔帝，「预言家」维瑟弗尼尔，「黄金」莱茵多特，「极恶骑」苏尔特洛奇，以及「猎月人」雷利尔。
无论我的记忆如何磨损，这些名字都不会忘却，终有一天…我会向他们所有人复仇。
这些名字！很多都很熟悉…创造阿贝多的莱茵多特，丝柯克的师父苏尔特洛奇…
还有我们刚刚知道的，引导克洛达尔创立深渊教团的，戴因的哥哥…「预言家」维瑟弗尼尔…
一切在冥冥之中连接在了一起…
（这么说的话，在枫丹遗迹内发现的预言石板，大概率也是出自维瑟弗尼尔之手吧？）
他们都曾是在坎瑞亚被寄予厚望的人，是各个领域同辈中的翘楚…
计划本应是由包含我在内的六人一同前往阻止灾厄的发生，阻拦黑王继续动摇世界的根基。
然而心底埋藏着各自欲望的那五人，没能禁得住「深渊」的诱惑，瓜分了那些足以毁灭世界的力量。
他们成为了「罪人」，也成为了超然的存在，每个人所掌持的力量都能与世界相匹敌。
而后坎瑞亚灾变发生，他们却没有任何一个人站出来阻止这场悲剧…我无法原谅。
…没错。如果继续放任，我相信他们终有一天，也会将整个世界「背叛」。
提起这些想必很不好受吧。
没什么，我说过的，我不准备回避你的问题。
那么戴因，之前那段时间，你有调查到什么吗？
我继续在追查关于「命运的织机」的问题，自那份「命运的织机原动计划」启动，已经过去很多时日了。
尽管我们曾经通过夺取「世界上第一颗耕地机的眼睛」，阻止了他们计划的某个阶段…
我记得，是说要改造魔神奥赛尔什么的？
嗯，不过…很明显，那应该也只是某种技术性试验…
即便他们还尚未得到那颗不可或缺的「耕地机的眼睛」，但他们选择跳过了试验阶段，依然在以某种方式推进着计划的执行。
有很多迹象都能表明这一点…
当务之急…是要弄清楚命运的织机究竟是用来做什么的，以便由此反推深渊教团的目的。
根据我目前所掌握的线索，我猜测命运的织机…应该和「地脉」有关。
上次旅行者能够看到血亲的记忆，其原因便是那一带的地脉不稳定。
而最近，我在追查深渊教团的期间发现，只要是他们活跃的地带，都会伴随着一系列的地脉问题。
提瓦特的地脉中流淌着「记忆」…
欸，那按照戴因的说法，这次我们来维摩庄要找的那个「似乎只存在于记忆中的人」，或许也可以关联上了？
（记忆…地脉…命运的织机…只存在于记忆中的人…）
（连接这一切的究竟会是什么…？）
你们说的这些不无可能。明天我也会加入你们的调查，这次的事件的确可能会成为某种契机。
又要和戴因一起行动了吗，那我们赶快养精蓄锐，明天去稍远一点的地方再看看吧。
哈欠——昨天有点用脑过度，现在还是困困的…都怪戴因说了那么多难懂的话…
我们去找戴因吧，今天还有很多事情要做呢。
谢谢你能把这些都告诉我。
我的血亲，接触了你的哥哥。
当时的坎瑞亚究竟发生了什么？
大概已经算是一种背叛了吧。
EN: You return to Vimara Village to gather intel based on what you've learned. You question the villagers until, eventually, the sky grows dark...
Ah, so that was the commission that brought you here to Vimara Village...

"Someone who seems to only exist in people's memories"... That is indeed quite intriguing. I would agree that it's unlikely you have a simple missing person's case on your hands. However, any possible connection to the Abyss Order is still unclear.
It appears all we have by way of clues is increased Hilichurl activity, and that is certainly not much to go off of.
Right! That mysterious voice he/she heard in his sister's/her brother's memory... The one who called himself a Sinner... Who is he?
旅行者, let me ask you this... Do you believe your sibling to have betrayed you?
I want to have faith in her/him.
Hmm... I sense hesitation in your words. After all, you still haven't figured out the whole truth of what happened.
There's still hope for the two of you to reconcile. Irreparable damage has not yet been done.
The Sinner you wish to know about... His situation is different. He and his fellow sinners have long betrayed me, and long betrayed their nation.
I'm loath to admit it, but... He is also my kin. My older brother.
What happened between the two of you?
There were five of them... The Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.
"The Wise" Hroptatyr, "The Visionary" Vedrfolnir, "Gold" Rhinedottir, "The Foul" Surtalogi, and "Rächer of Solnari" Rerir.
No matter how eroded my memory may become, I will never forget their names... One day... I shall have my vengeance.
Wait! Some of those names sound really familiar... Rhinedottir is the one who created Albedo, Surtalogi is Skirk's master...
And the one we just learned about... Dain's brother, Vedrfolnir... If he was the voice of the Sinner, then the one who inspired Chlothar to create the Abyss Order... was him!
(If that's true, then the stone slates we found in that ruin in Fontaine... The ones that outlined Fontaine's prophecy... That was likely Vedrfolnir's doing as well.)
They were once people of great esteem in Khaenri'ah, those who carried the hopes of the nation. They were the best of their peers, outstanding in their respective fields...
The six of us, together... We should have been the ones to prevent the disaster, the ones to stop the Vinster King from continuing to rock the foundation of the world.
Yet, deep within, the five of them craved something more. They could not resist the call of the Abyss, and divided among themselves a power that could destroy the world.
So they became Sinners, but also transcendent beings, each in possession of world-shattering power.
And when the cataclysm occurred, not one of them stood up in defense of their nation, not one came forward to prevent the tragedy... And for that, they shall never have my forgiveness.
...Indeed. If they are not stopped, the day is sure to come when they will also betray the entire world.
It must be hard to talk about all of this.
Of course. As I said, I never intended to hide anything from you.
So, Dain, what have you been looking into all this time?
I've continued to investigate the questions surrounding the Loom of Fate. It's been quite some time since the initial operation was launched.
By retrieving the eye of the first Field Tiller, we were able to stop part of their plan from coming to fruition...
Oh, Paimon remembers! Weren't they gonna use it to corrupt Osial and make a god or something...
Indeed... However, it's obvious that was just some kind of technical experiment...
The eye was integral to their plan, yet somehow, despite failing to obtain it, they've skipped the experimental phase and found some other way to keep moving forward.
There are many signs pointing to that effect...
Then, what should we do? It's not too late, is it?
Our most pressing concern... is to determine the purpose of the Loom of Fate. From there, we'll be able to deduce the Abyss Order's true objective.
Based on the intel I've gathered so far, I suspect the Loom of Fate is related to the Ley Lines in some way.
旅行者, you were able to observe your sibling's memories last time, yes? I believe that was due to the fact that the Ley Lines in that area were unstable.
My recent investigation has shown that Abyss Order activity in a particular area is usually followed by a series of issues with the Ley Lines.
And one of the things that flows through the Ley Lines... are memories.
Wait, then our commission here in Vimara Village... The person who seems to exist only in people's memories... Could it be connected?
(Memories... Ley Lines... The Loom of Fate... The missing person that doesn't seem to exist...)
It's certainly possible. I'll join your investigation tomorrow. This missing person's case could very well turn out to be the key to unraveling these mysteries.
Well, if we're teaming up with Dain again, we're gonna need all the energy we can get! Let's try investigating somewhere a little further away tomorrow.
*yawn*... So tired... Paimon used way too much brain juice yesterday. It's all Dain's fault, saying all that complicated stuff...
Well, let's go find Dain. We've got a lot to do today.
But thank you for telling me.
My sibling came into contact with your brother.
What really happened in Khaenri'ah back then?
In a manner of speaking, yeah.
How about the intel you promised me?

title: 不应存在的记忆：戴因斯雷布

CHS: 啊！奈芙尔小姐，亲爱的老板，你果然来了。
我过来同步情报，会议结束以后我打算继续深入调查猎月人的事，反正都要回去，就让雅珂达留在秘闻馆待命了。
欸，我怎么记得有人说过什么「只此一次下不为例」来着…
你小声点！现在形势一片大好，万一人家想起来后悔了怎么办！
咳…法尔伽先生刚才有说什么吗？
唔？我没说过话啊，对吧菲林斯。
是青蛙吧，这附近的青蛙确实很热闹，有时还会在夜里举办音乐会。
言归正传。首先，介绍一下在场诸位。这么多有来头的人齐聚一堂，我很荣幸担任本次讲解。
挪德卡莱本地宗教团体「霜月之子」的咏月使，菈乌玛小姐。秘闻馆的老板，优秀的情报工作者，奈芙尔小姐。
奈芙尔小姐负责深入调查猎月人的信息，雅珂达小姐与菈乌玛小姐担任她的助手，她们的行动想必很顺利。
执灯士的一员，废弃灯塔的看守者，菲林斯先生。他在先前的行动中负责引开狂猎，为大家争取行动时间。
蒙德西风骑士团调查小队队长兼知名炼金术士，阿贝多先生。随他一同前来帮助我的新朋友，杜林先生。
月之少女，同时也是前愚人众执行官，哥伦比娅小姐。
旅行者，说到他/她啊，头衔可就太多了，请允许我不展开说明。以及他/她最好的伙伴，提瓦特向导，派蒙。
好多人啊，这回真是大阵仗呢。
另外，奈芙尔小姐可能会接到新委托。生意兴隆总是一件大好事啊。
我是谁在此刻并非主要议题。我希望你能探查更多有关猎月人的情报。
秘闻馆不是不能接匿名委托，但对你，我认为不行。你看起来很特别，接你的工作大概会赔本。
你是坎瑞亚人吧？还戴着面具，难道不喜欢以真面目示人？无论如何，坎瑞亚人能活到现在就已经很稀奇了。
我叫戴因斯雷布，确实是坎瑞亚人。猎月人原本叫做雷利尔，这点你已经知道了。他曾是我的…旧识。
那您想必也是不可多得的绝世人物。
您客气了。在如今，这些毫无意义。我只想借此说明我委托奈芙尔小姐调查雷利尔的动机。
同为坎瑞亚人，我猜你们以前是朋友？你的朋友为何会成为五大罪人，你难道不清楚吗？
关于这点，我将分享我所持有的情报。坎瑞亚曾经的事，五大罪人的名字与身份…我都记得很清楚。
过去我从未坦白过这一点。正如人们所说，五大罪人各有欲望。而深渊分化坎瑞亚、诱惑他们堕落的方式，就是放大欲望。
解读未来的「预言家」维瑟弗尼尔、司掌学识的「贤者」海洛塔帝。
渴望创造的「黄金」莱茵多特、追求至强的「极恶骑」苏尔特洛奇。
以及，疯狂撕咬月亮的「猎月人」——雷利尔。
那五个人里，我唯一不明白的就是雷利尔。他从没有堪称远大志向的念头，为什么一夜之间也与其他人一样？
也就是说，你并不知道他遇到过什么，他的变化对你而言是突兀的？
你提到深渊诱惑他们，使他们堕落…具体是什么场面？前后还有什么关联事件，方便透露一下吗？
…真到这一刻，竟不知该从哪里开始诉说了。
那是坎瑞亚黑日王朝时期的事。我的哥哥，预言家维瑟弗尼尔受黑王传召，进宫觐见。随后，他被黑王刺瞎双目投入大牢。
得知此事的我异常愤怒，便召集了一切能拉拢的人手，约定在一个夜晚杀入王宫，营救维瑟。
即使过去数百年，那个夜晚…仍像不会结束的噩梦一般。我们制定计划，冲破王宫大门，各奔目标，然后…
…然后，他们背叛了我。就连本该是营救对象的维瑟弗尼尔，也在那个晚上瓜分了深渊之力，弃我而去。
原来你们之间还有私人恩怨。那么你打算支付何种报酬？戴因斯雷布先生，你应该知道一切都有代价。
我也不知道怎样的价格才配得上这份委托，但雷利尔从前并不疯癫，他只是一个服务于坎瑞亚特务机关的普通人类而已。
查清雷利尔的经历是你们必经的环节。在你做出决定之前，我会再向你分享一些有关雷利尔的事，帮助你们制定对策。
那太好了，我们像是站在路边一扬手就拦住了一个跟猎月人有仇的高手。
主要也是靠我平时积德做好事啦…
就算是我也没有几个坎瑞亚朋友…
多么厉害。旅行者，留给我一幅你的画像，我要挂在灯塔里照明用。
喂，你自己不就有灯吗！还不够用吗？
只是一种夸奖而已。看来你们不喜欢这种程度的夸奖？下次我会减轻力度。
戴因斯雷布先生的话我会认真考虑，会后我们单独聊聊吧。
在那之前，我有一些事想分享。
你仔细讲述了你和「少女」遇到「仆人」的过程，以及你们在赤月空间中探索打捞虹月月髓的事。
三月之心都已集齐的话，你的力量将大幅提升。但目前看来，似乎还没有达到那样的状态。
是的。我想还需要一些时间。
你们帮助了我许多，所以，我想坦诚地告诉各位：现阶段我状态已经好了不少，但恢复大概会是一个持续的过程。
我的力量自诞生起便慢慢流失，这是因为我没能被提瓦特接纳。遭到世界拒绝的后果，似乎并不会因为齐聚的月亮而消失。
目前我还没找到办法…也许它会一直伴随我，直到终有一日我离开这里。
不过…我依然会尽我所能，与你们一同驱逐猎月人。就像阿蕾奇诺说的，这不是「回报」，更像是…一种亲近的感谢。
（比起刚见面的时候…她似乎对周围人和事的态度都积极了不少。）
击退猎月人难度极高，在我恢复力量的同时，我们也需要更多情报。
自然如此。他从不是一个好对付的敌人。
我们考虑了一些可行方案，但选择哪种，取决于几个问题的结论。
猎月人是否能被杀死？他经历过什么？他想要什么？
其中，第一个问题，我认为可以交给专业的炼金术士阿贝多来研究。
而后两者，恐怕要靠奈芙尔小姐。劳烦你绝非本意，但现阶段，我们只能再次寄希望于你过人的本领。
把希望寄托在我身上了，是吧？
是啊，感谢你的帮助，对我来说这实在有些…不敢相信呢。
咏月使的口气还真多变，懦弱起来像雅珂达，虚情假意起来像菲林斯。
噢女士们，我可不是那种人。你们拌嘴吧，忘了我。
嗯…很有趣呢，都不想离开这个房间了。
我有种预感，奈芙尔小姐会帮助我们直到最后一刻的。我信任她。
哦？凭什么这样认为？万一我嫌酬劳太低呢？
不是钱的问题。我能感觉到，你似乎对猎月人有些嫌恶。以你的性格，这就足以构成动机。
天哪，多么了解彼此的两位女士！
法尔伽大团长这口气，是赶着想做下一个「虚情假意」的男人了。
呵，菈乌玛小姐，我可不是你，丝毫不喜欢被人期待。
是这样吗？但我愿意期待别人，也不畏惧向你这样可靠的人给出信任。
好了，既然有方案，就抓紧时间行动吧。
戴因斯雷布先生，我们谈谈。旅行者，接下来没安排的话，你跟我走。
最近我有些新感悟，比如遇到问题的时候，让菈乌玛小姐去搞定奈芙尔小姐，比我出面可行多了。
我实在不愿这么说，朋友，但你的话真令人发笑。
正因为太对了才笑啊。你怎么就明白得这么晚呢。
奈芙尔和戴因斯雷布聊了好一会儿，两人神情都十分专注，看得出对接下来的行动十分重视。
你和派蒙静静等候着，并无怨言。你乐于见到有条不紊推进目标的场面。
EN: Ah, Miss Nefer! You made it after all.

I'm here to give you an update on how things are going on our end. Once this is over, I'll be heading straight back to continue my work. I left Jahoda back at the Curatorium to watch over things while I'm gone.
Heh, so much for "just this once"...
Shh, not so loud! We're on a roll here... What if she remembers and suddenly decides to back out!?
Huh? I didn't say anything... right, Flins?
Hmm, must have been a frog. They get so noisy around here at nighttime, it's like they're putting on a concert in the background.
Anyway... Before we begin, there's a few introductions to make. Let me start by saying that it's an honor to be speaking before so many distinguished colleagues and collaborators.

First up, we have Miss Lauma. As Moonchanter, she's the leader of the Frostmoon Scions, a local religious community in Nod-Krai. Then there's Miss Nefer, boss of the Curatorium of Secrets, and intel-gatherer extraordinaire.
Nefer is leading the investigation into Rerir's background, assisted by Jahoda and Lauma. From the little I've heard, they're making some great progress.
Over here, we have Mr. Flins — a Ratnik, and guardian of the abandoned lighthouse. In our last operation, he courageously distracted the Wild Hunt to buy time for the rest of us.

For those of you who've never met, this is Mr. Albedo, a renowned alchemist and Captain of the Knights of Favonius Investigation Team. By his side is a new face for us all, myself included — Mr. Durin, who has come to lend his aid.
Next up, we have the Moon Maiden and former Fatui Harbinger, Miss Columbina.

Then we have 旅行者 — who's earned more titles than I can possibly hope to list out, so I'll spare you the rundown — and Paimon, the ultimate travel companion and quite possibly the best guide in all of Teyvat.
Wow, that's a lot of people. Great turnout!
Miss Nefer, it looks like you might have another job coming your way. So uh... congratulations on the booming business, I guess...
...You think I haven't got enough on my hands as it is? Who's looking for me now?
That would be me, Miss Nefer. I have a commission for you.
Who I am doesn't matter right now. What does matter is that I'd like you to gather more intelligence about the Rächer of Solnari.

Hmm, well it's not as if we never take on anonymous commissions... but in your case, I'll have to decline. I'm gonna take a wild guess and say your job's probably more hassle than it's worth. Something about you seems like bad news.
Khaenri'ahn, I assume? And what's with the mask — are you trying to hide your identity? In any case, the fact that you're even still alive raises an awful lot of questions for me.
My name is Dainsleif — and yes, I am from Khaenri'ah. As I'm sure you're aware the Rächer of Solnari's real name is Rerir. He was once... an acquaintance of mine.
Really? Then you must have been quite an influential figure yourself.
You flatter me, but none of that matters anymore. My point was simply to clarify why I have asked Miss Nefer to investigate Rerir's background.
So you're both from Khaenri'ah, and it sounds like you used to be friends? What am I missing here? Surely, you already know how he became one of the Five Sinners?
I'll tell you everything I know. The history of Khaenri'ah, the names and identities of the Five Sinners... I remember it all like it was yesterday.

I have never spoken openly of this before, but the truth was exactly as people say. The Five Sinners were each driven by their own desires, and it was by playing upon these that the Abyss tempted them to their fall, tearing Khaenri'ah apart in the process.
The Visionary Vedrfolnir, who wished to foretell the future. "The Wise" Hroptatyr, who sought limitless knowledge.
Gold Rhinedottir, who desired to create life. "The Foul" Surtalogi, who pursued supreme strength.
And last, but not least, "Rächer of Solnari" Rerir... ravager of the moon.
Of the five, Rerir is the only one who remains a mystery to me. He never harbored grand ambitions — so what changed in the space of a single night? How did he come to fall like the others?
In other words, you're saying that his change came as a shock to you, and you have no idea what actually happened?

You mentioned how the Abyss tempted them, which led to their fall... But what did that look like in practice? And what other context can you give me about the events of that time? The more detail you can give me, the better.
...Strangely, now that it comes to it, I hardly know where to begin.

The fateful night took place during the era of the Eclipse Dynasty. One day, my elder brother, "The Visionary" Vedrfolnir, was summoned to the palace by the Vinster King — only for the king to gouge out his eyes and cast him into the dungeons.
When I came to hear of this, my fury knew no bounds. I gathered together every ally I thought I had, and together, we set a night to storm the palace and free Ved.
...Centuries on, the memories of that night still haunt me like a never-ending nightmare. We broke through the palace gates, just like we had planned, each striking towards our separate targets...
...But then, I was betrayed. Even Vedrfolnir — the very person I had come to rescue — abandoned me and partook of the Abyss's power.
So it's personal, after all. Then tell me, Mr. Dainsleif — what price are you willing to pay? You of all people must know that nothing comes for free.

I cannot say what price would be worthy of such a commission... But know this: Rerir was not always a madman. Believe it or not, there was a time when he was just an ordinary man, working for the Khaenri'ahn intelligence service.

Uncovering the truth of Rerir's past is the only way to unravel this mystery. But before you decide if you will accept my commission, I will tell you more about him — enough, I hope, to help you plan your next move.
Sounds pretty good to me. Hahaha, feels like we just flagged down a random passerby, only to discover he's actually a master strategist who has a score to settle with our enemy...
Must be all that good karma I've been building...
Who knew having a Khaenri'ahn friend would come in this handy...
Heh, can I borrow your halo? It could be useful in the lighthouse.
Hey, enough with the wisecracks! Besides, isn't that lamp of yours bright enough already?
Relax, it was meant to be a compliment. If that was a little over the top for your liking, I'll make sure to tone it down next time.
I'll give your proposal some serious thought, Mr. Dainsleif. Let's speak in private once the meeting is over.
Before that, there's a few things I'd like to share.
You recount meeting The Knave, and how the Iridescent Moon's marrow was retrieved from the Crimson Moon space.
Now that we've united the hearts of the three moons, your power should be greatly enhanced. But it seems like that hasn't happened yet?
Mm... I believe it will take a little longer.
You've done so much for me, so I want to be completely honest with you all. Even though I'm doing a lot better now, the truth is, my recovery will likely be an ongoing process.
From the moment I was born, my power has been slowly ebbing away — and that is because Teyvat has never accepted me. Even with the moons united as one, it seems my rejection cannot be undone.
So far, I have yet to find a solution. It may turn out to be a problem that will plague me until the day I finally leave this place behind.

Even so... I will do everything in my power to help you drive out the Rächer of Solnari. As Arlecchino put it, this is not about chasing the spoils of victory... it's just a gesture of heartfelt gratitude.
(She seems a lot more energetic and positive than she did when we first met...)
Defeating the Rächer of Solnari will be no easy task. While my strength slowly recovers, we'll also need to gather more intel.
Mm, naturally. We should take all the help we can get if we hope to defeat him.
We've considered several viable plans now, but our choice hinges on the answers to a few key questions.
Is it even possible to kill Rerir? What experiences shaped the person, or monster, he became? And what's he really after?
Given Albedo's expertise in alchemy, I think we should leave him to try and answer the first of these questions.
As for the other two, I'm afraid we'll have to count on you again, Miss Nefer. Believe me when I say, it's not my wish to burden you — but right now, relying on your skills is our only option.
So you're placing all your hopes on me, huh?
Mm... We can't thank you enough for agreeing to help us. Honestly, I... can hardly believe how lucky we are.
You sure have a talent for changing your tune, Miss Moonchanter. Timid like Jahoda one moment, then Flins's insincere flattery the next.
Ladies, please... I must object to your portrayal of me. ...That's all. Feel free to keep bickering — just pretend I'm not here.
Mm... I almost don't want to leave this room. I'm curious to see how this plays out.
I have faith in you, Miss Nefer. Something tells me you'll stand by us until the very end...
Oh? And what makes you so sure of that? What if I suddenly decide that my compensation is insufficient?
This isn't about the money. I can sense that you've got a deep-seated distaste for Rerir — and knowing you, that alone is motive enough.
Look at them getting along so well. Like two peas in a pod!
And I'm the one they accuse of insincere flattery. There is no justice.
Hah... Miss Lauma, you have to understand something. Unlike you, I don't actually enjoy having everyone's hopes on my shoulders.

Is that right? Well, maybe the fact that I'm willing to put my hopes in other people says more about me than you. But the fact is, I also trust you, and that's because I know that you're someone we can count on.
Anyway, we've got our plan, so let's get moving.
Mr. Dainsleif, let's talk. And 旅行者 — once we're finished, if you've nothing else planned, I'd like you to come with me.

This whole experience is teaching me a lot. For instance, I now know that when other issues come up in the future, I'll have far more luck getting Lauma to convince Miss Nefer than trying to do it myself.
Hate to say it, friend, but that's one of the funniest things I've heard in a while.
...Why? You think I've got it wrong?
Haha, quite the opposite. But what makes it so hilarious is how long it's taken you to realize.
Nefer and Dainsleif converse intently for quite some time. From the gravity of their expressions, you can tell how heavily the next stage of the plan weighs upon them both.
You and Paimon wait patiently for Nefer, content to see how well everyone is working together.

CHS: 真的。前提是你不被任何人发现。
我知道。我会非常小心，不让任何人知道我来过。
放我走的话，你的任务不就完不成了吗？
是啊。要不然你就留下吧。
不行！不行，我想回到外面去，我想…我想…
嗯！我、我知道你说话算数…放我走吧，好不好？
不过记住，别让任何人知道你被抓住过。否则，我们很快又要见面了。
黑暗中的影子也应有其道义。但你拯救不了所有人。
这些日子你一直在我耳边絮絮叨叨，维瑟弗尼尔。是你在干扰我的精神？
你渴求解法，我才劝告。放弃那个女人，或者失去你的所有。
那么你需要更多力量和适当的警戒。你应擦亮双眼，关注这世界何时变化得对你有利。
（过去十分模糊的声音，在此刻已经能听出它究竟来自何人了…维瑟弗尼尔。）
（他拒绝告诉我改变这一切的办法，却又对我百般引导。他到底想干什么？）
（维瑟弗尼尔的声音消失了。他像一个鬼魂，总在我烦躁时干扰，却不在我渴望时作答。）
黑日王朝对赤月后裔实施肃清…不，应该用屠杀来形容。而这些似乎都跟黑王进行的研究有关。
王醉心深渊力量，坎瑞亚未来局势难以明朗。难怪雷利尔的职责和生活都不稳定。
至于索琳蒂丝…没法称她为雷利尔的未婚妻，她还没答应雷利尔。因为她不幸与赤月有关，是他们的旁系后裔。
这样的两个人，居然能隐瞒彼此这么久…如果黑王不做出什么激进举动，他们可能会就这么互相欺骗着过完一辈子。
而维瑟弗尼尔，戴因斯雷布的兄长，他为什么对雷利尔欲言又止？哼…这家伙的脑子里藏着不少秘密呢。
人的大脑如同混沌无边的沙海。顺着记忆的流势去了解，只能看到当事人可以见光的部分。
我们一直处在名为「雷利尔」的思绪中，对他的解读就是搜集信息。
现在，棋盘上积攒了足够多的线索，足够进入拟定势态。
棋盘将运算出我想知道的事。当然了，正如其名字，也只是拟定加计算，好在准确率还算高。
建立对观察对象的认知存档，验算其行为逻辑…看一看那些雷利尔隐藏起来的「真相」。
EN: I am. As long as you can guarantee that no one will find you.
Don't worry, I'll be extra careful... No one will know I was here.
If you let me go, you won't be able to complete your mission, will you?
Hmm, good point. In that case, maybe you should stay.
No, please! I just... want to see the outside world again. To...
Yes! I know you're a man of your word... So please, just let me go.
If I let you leave, what will become of me?
But remember, don't let anyone know you were caught. We'll be seeing each other again very soon if you do.
Even shadows in the dark must live by a code. But you can't save everyone.
You've been whispering in my ear for days now, Vedrfolnir. What are you trying to do? Break me down?
I only say this because you long for an answer to your problems: Let her go, Rerir, or you risk losing everything.
Then you'll need a little more vigilance, and a lot more power. The world is changing, Rerir... Keep your eyes peeled for your moment of opportunity.
(That voice used to be so unclear, but now I know exactly whose it is. It's Vedrfolnir.)
(He won't tell me how to actually resolve any of this, but he keeps trying to manipulate me like a puppet. What's his game here?)
Tell me, then, what will this "moment of opportunity" look like?
(And... no answer. He's like a ghost — always disturbing me when I'm on edge, but never answering when I need him most.)
So, the Eclipse Dynasty was purging... well, massacring the descendants of the Crimson Moon. And it seems like it was all connected to the Vinster King's research.
The king's obsession with Abyssal power left the future of Khaenri'ah hanging in the balance. No wonder every aspect of Rerir's life was so unstable...
And it looks like this Tholindis, Rerir's would-be fiancee, herself belonged to a sub-branch of the Crimson Moon dynasty's descendants...

It almost defies belief that a couple like them could hide the truth from each other for so long. If the Vinster King hadn't intervened in such a drastic way, they might have gone on deceiving each other for the rest of their lives.
And why does Vedrfolnir, Dainsleif's older brother, keep talking in Rerir's head? Huh... This guy kept more secrets than I ever imagined.
The human mind is like a vast desert of shifting sands. When you follow the flow of someone's memories, you only ever see the parts they're willing to let surface.
Time for something a bit more creative.
We've been inside Rerir's mind this whole time, building up a picture of his psyche.
There's already enough clues on the board to start reading between the lines and mapping out the rest.
Now, we can finally begin to put the pieces together. Sure, it'll only be a reconstruction — part simulation, part reasoning. But it's usually pretty accurate.
Once we've built up a cognitive profile, we just need to cross-check the logic behind his actions... and then we'll be able to take a sneak peek at whatever it is that Rerir has really been hiding.

heading: 回望湮灭的月光 · 皆为预言

CHS: 不知道其他人那边进展如何？希望一切顺利…
啊，快看，他们刚好也回来了呢！
喂，菲林斯，菈乌玛，你们那边怎么样？
感谢关心，我们这里一切都好。不过奈芙尔和雅珂达需要留在秘闻馆整理信息，暂时不在。
回来路上我遇到了伊涅芙小姐和爱诺小姐，她们正在依计划调查，估计还赶不回来。
菲林斯先生似乎心情不错。
是的，不仅执行了该做的事，还有额外收获，心情自然好。
战斗容易让人乏味，要不是在外面遇见了这两位年轻骁勇的战士…
找你们的过程很顺利，真让人高兴。
我与狂猎战斗的过程中意外获得了这两位的帮助。听说他们是法尔伽先生的同僚，我也丝毫不觉得意外。
优秀的人总是扎堆出现，所以，听说你们彼此认识当然也没能让我产生多少惊讶。
「这两位」？除了阿贝多还有别人吗？
不过来跟大家打个招呼吗？
一位绅士，看起来不苟言笑。怎么？他不是你们的朋友吗？
头上的角？等等，难道你是…！
该说初次见面，还是好久不见…
是的，是我。见到你们真好。
据他本人说，现在不在名字前面加个「小」字也没问题。
毕竟我的个子也没那么小了。
不觉得很有趣吗？融入人类社会的第一步，就是在意起自己的名字和外形是否匹配了。
天啊，你、你现在这样…这样很好呢，看到你这么健康真是太好了。
谢谢，派蒙。我知道大家的习俗，为表达对你的尊敬，我也不该再管你叫「小」派蒙。
哦？一下就变得很会说话，很有礼貌了呢。嘻嘻，这样好像也不错，就叫我尊敬的向导派蒙吧！
我也觉得派蒙小小的模样非常讨人喜欢哦。
只有可爱的人会被赠予可爱的称号，这不正是社会关系的体现吗？
菈乌玛小姐所言极是，所以说，我的这位兄弟在人情世故方面还有很长的路要走。
说起来，库塔尔…哥伦比娅小姐不是跟各位一起出门了吗？怎么没见到她？
她的话，忙着跟老朋友闲聊，可能绕路去喝茶了吧？
呀，有人聊起我？不要是什么不好的话题哦。
（和以前的同事见面，似乎让她心情变得不错。）
瞧各位的表情，这次任务应该很顺利。
好多人呢，我去霜月之子搬几把椅子…
没关系的，椅子这种东西，用炼金术制作就行。
诚挚感谢绅士与女士们的周全，我只是护送这几位朋友回来。
我和桑多涅还有事要谈，稍后约了在她那里见面，所以，各位，我们就在这里告别吧。
感谢你能和我们一起行动。
若是真正的朋友，彼此之间不必太过拘泥于礼节。我愿意将这份亲近给到你们。
我明白了，那么，先再见啦，阿蕾奇诺。
哈，真热闹！虽然刚走一个，但这个基地里依然塞满了我们，和我们的同事与朋友。
听你的意思，难道椅子真不够了？
可不是嘛。进来看看就知道了。
你们在门口唠叨的那些我都听到了。哥伦比娅小姐的同事刚刚离开，现在这里除了原本的参与者，还有我的同事。
既然如此，这位又是谁同事？
这位应该是来找我们的…
诚然，这里我只认识你和派蒙。
这位是伟大向导派蒙和提瓦特最强冒险家旅行者的同事…呃不是，朋友，戴因斯雷布先生。
由别人报出名号，想来是不得了的身份。
（话说慢了，被派蒙抢先报出名字…啧。）
戴因来找我们，绝对是有重要的事。我猜你也听说了狂猎的事，对吧？
你们似乎要开会。假如我说，狂猎是我们共同的敌人，会议上是否有我的座位？
同样的敌人指引你和我们走到一起。这里当然有你的位置。
只不过，其他人的位置就不一定了。阿贝多，得给他们准备两把椅子了！
这么久不见，法尔伽团长的第一道命令竟然是制作椅子，真怀念啊。
他不是你兄弟吗？这种事还要问我们？
我在谈吐方面还有很长的学习路要走，一上来就试图理解阿贝多的语言风格，对我来说有点难度…
原来是这样。没事啦，也有人活了很久都掌握不了这些呢，相比起来你已经非常厉害了。
根本就是鼓励型教育大师…
奈芙尔那边还没结束吗…
也许你应该去看看她的情况？谁也不能说菈乌玛小姐就不是最适合邀请奈芙尔小姐的人选。
我才刚从「秘闻馆」过来。另外，菲林斯先生怎么没有去看看的兴趣？
奈芙尔小姐一看就是不愿分享秘密的类型，而获取情报是她的长项，很可能涉及到不能被分享的秘密技术。
我怎么能如此不识趣地去做这个讨嫌的人呢？
那我去讨嫌就没关系吗？
这当然是因为咏月使小姐亲和力远胜他人啊。再说，二位都是女性，比跟我在一块儿有话题多了。
她真的去了，而且没有谴责你。这一点我非常钦佩，朋友。
亲爱的菈乌玛小姐早晚会明白，生活的智慧就是在该他人承受责任时潇洒地出现，而在自己可能承受什么时有选择地出现。
或者装作自己没有出现。
是的，您果真是拥有智慧的人物。
看起来我们还不能马上进入会议时间。既然如此，各位，先休息一会儿。
自由活动时间，尽情地寒暄吧。在那两位女士抵达前聊会儿愉快的天，也趁着我们还没正式忙起来。
＊ 在等待的间隙与众人闲聊
两位都很沉默呢。我来起个话题吧。
是否有人为你们绘制过肖像画呢？如果没有的话，我可以帮忙。
听起来是很好的事。你擅长绘画，对吗？
他画得非常好。桌子、椅子、人、龙…都很擅长。
假如有机会，我也想试一试。
好的，我记下了。杜林呢？喜欢哪种风格的画像？
你想画成什么样都没关系，嗯。
嗯，画的时候看手感好了。
可以，带样图给我就行。我会试着向你喜欢的风格靠拢。
＊ 在等待的间隙与众人闲聊
你居然跑这里来了，也不提前跟我们说一声！
如果你有印象的话，我一直都是说来就来。
对哦，你也要住旅馆的吧！要不要跟我们一起？说不定人多可以打折呢。
我先记下来，到时候安排一下。
这样一来，戴因斯雷布就可以当我们的保镖了呢！真不错。
你有这个想法，大可以直接告诉我。我会为你们实现。
欸…原来可以直接说啊…啊哈哈，不过那个其实是玩笑啦。
既然遇到了，就住得近一点，有事的时候也能彼此关照。我们跟朋友一直都是这样的哦。
＊ 在等待的间隙与众人闲聊
实话跟你说吧，我好久没参加过这么多人的会议了。
我又何尝不是呢，朋友。我们的团队很难凑出这么多人齐聚一堂探讨正事。
哈哈，可不是嘛。我一共就认识两位执灯士，你，还有那个名叫叶洛亚的小兄弟。
不得不说，叶洛亚善良，正直，还会定期送些物资到我那灯塔。他显然比我更像一位真正的执灯士。
噢，难道你就是一个虚假的执灯士吗？我不觉得你想表达这个意思。
为什么在这种时候沉默？很尴尬好不好。
抱歉，我还是不愿意撒些无谓的谎。朋友，你不是早就有所察觉了吗？
这里又有什么沉默的必要呢。
有些事你知我知就好，还是不要让叶洛亚知道了。
当然不能告诉一个年轻的朋友太多。
还有谁知道你的身份吗？我猜，旅行者和派蒙？
太敏锐的人容易招致杀身之祸，你应该明白。
那我向风神巴巴托斯起誓好了，绝不将你出卖给叶洛亚。
你在酒桌上说过巴巴托斯是你的至交好友，这句誓言真能算数么？
算的，算的。我和巴巴托斯很熟的事，你也千万别告诉别人！
好啊。互相要挟当然算是友情的一种了，真叫人高兴啊。
啊！奈芙尔小姐，亲爱的老板，你果然来了。
我过来同步情报，会议结束以后我打算继续深入调查猎月人的事，反正都要回去，就让雅珂达留在秘闻馆待命了。
欸，我怎么记得有人说过什么「只此一次下不为例」来着…
你小声点！现在形势一片大好，万一人家想起来后悔了怎么办！
咳…法尔伽先生刚才有说什么吗？
唔？我没说过话啊，对吧菲林斯。
