title: 秋分布道听记·关于末日

CHS: 究其根源，古代教团所谓的「密合」，其本质是分属象限的贯通。如同各位所见，这是由「王国」上方的三质点促动的奇术——但其形而上的本源则是「高天」下的四质点的流溢。坎瑞亚的炼金术师往往会忽视形而上的情感，转而寻求物质世界中属于愚昧之人的黄金，这也是他们那些粗浅的研究无法与我们今日将要成就的、基于古雷穆利亚理型论的伟业相提并论的原因。
三是表象，四是本征，将二者交叠得到的七，即是垂直超越之径的数目。
我们将上述交叠的过程称作「密合」，因为两者在媒介下的结合，恰如相爱之人的婚约。
观测并计算导向图示中的「通道」。解构与逆转它的效用，带来可能的创想。
然而，各位仍需谨记一件事。解决前半部分的问题，后半部分则无需费心攻破。世间万象皆置于明处，而另一些——尽管并非全部——则理应被放置在暗处。这不是因为它们具备不应被触碰的神圣性，而是因为它们对「世界式」毫无裨益。只有愚蠢到一定程度的庸人才会去主动触碰那样的禁忌，因为在无知者眼中，「禁忌」与「珍贵」永远是同义词，殊不知禁忌亦如常理一般，大多缺乏深究的价值。
请注意，我们所说的是用你的梦去覆盖神的梦，用你的律法、意志与星空，去覆盖不可言喻的牺牲与苦痛。我们所说的不是依循流溢的逆转，实现通往众神的扬升。后者依然是凡俗的，是蛋壳中注定沦丧的梦。我要教你们的是超越的道理，是无限的空间，以及其中无限的星星。你们也要这样做，没有任何束缚——为了结合的机会而选择分裂，即是「密合」的必经之径。
归根结底，奇术是按照意识使变化发生的科学与艺术。「密合」是实现艺术的画具，既非涂抹的主体，也非被涂抹的客体。主体永远是——且只可能是——意识。万无意识薄弱之缺陷者，既不屈服于众神，也不屈服于死亡。
EN: Fundamentally, what the ancient orders designated as "marriage" was, in essence, an interpenetration of ontologically distinct Orthants. As you can see, it is a magick set in motion by the three particles above the "Kingdom." Yet, its metaphysical origin lies in the emanations of the four particles beneath the "Firmament." The alchemists of Khaenri'ah are prone to disregard metaphysical sentiment and affect, pursuing instead the gold of the ignorant within the material world. It is for this reason that their crude inquiry cannot be compared to the great undertaking we are to achieve today, one that is founded upon ancient Remurian-style theory.
Three pertains to appearance, while four pertains to the intrinsic. Seven, obtained through their overlap, constitute the number of paths for vertical transcendence.
We designate this process of overlap as "marriage," for the union of the two through a mediating medium is akin to the matrimonial covenant of those bound in mutual love.
"Observe and compute the "pathway" displayed in the guidance diagram. Deconstructing and reversing its effects could generate potential ideas..."

Nevertheless, there is one thing everyone must keep in mind. Solve the first half of the equation, leave the second unattacked. But you have all in the clear light, and some, though not all, in the dark. This is not because they possess any sanctity that renders them untouchable, but because they offer no benefit whatsoever to the "world-formula." Only mediocre minds foolish beyond a certain measure would actively seek to trespass upon such prohibitions, because in the eyes of the ignorant, "taboo" and "precious" are semantically identical. They fail to recognize that, in most cases, taboo, like convention, lacks merit for deeper inquiry.

Take heed: what we speak of is the act of overlaying your dream upon the dream of gods; of overlaying your law, your will, and the starry sky, upon ineffable sacrifices and despair. We do not speak of following emanations to achieve ascension to the ranks of gods. This is a base dream doomed to perish within an eggshell. What I aim to teach you all is the principle of transcendence, the infinite expanse, and the innumerable stars within it. You, too, must act in this manner, unbound by any constraint. To choose division for the sake of convergence is the necessary path of "marriage."

At its core, magick is the science and art of effecting change according to the consciousness. "Marriage" is the instrument through which the art is realized. It is neither the subject that creates art, nor the object that art is created upon. The subject is always, and can only ever be, consciousness itself. One who is free from the weakness of consciousness bows neither to the gods nor death.
JP: 根源を探れば、古代教団がいう「密合」とは、本質的に各象限間の貫通に他ならない。皆さんの見ての通り、これは「王国」上方の三質点が促す奇術である——しかしその形而上の本源は「高天」の下にある四質点の溢流にある。カーンルイアの錬金術師たちは往々にして形而上的な感情を軽視し、物質世界における愚者の黄金を追い求める。これこそが、彼らの浅薄な研究が、古代レムリア理型論に基づく僕たちが成し遂げようとしている偉業には到底及ばない理由なのだ。
三は表象、四は本質、その二つを重ね合わせた七こそが、超越への道に垂直する数だ。
僕たちは上記の重なり合いの過程を「密合」と呼ぶ。なぜなら、媒体における両者の結合は、まるで愛し合う者たちの婚約のようだからだ。
図示した「ルート」を観測し、計算する。その用途を解析し、転換することで、新たな創造の可能性が拓けるだろう。

しかし、皆さんが心に留めておくべきことが一つある。前半部分の問題を解決すれば、後半部分を気にかける必要はない。この世の万象は明るみに置かれているが、その一方で——すべてではないが——暗所に置かれるべきものもある。それは触れられるべきではない神聖性を有しているのではなく、「世界式」にとって何の有益性もないからだ。そのような禁忌に進んで触れようとするのは、愚かな凡人だけだ。無知な者の目には「禁忌」と「貴重」が常に同義語に映るのだが、禁忌もまた普通のことと同じく、深く追究する価値のないものがほとんどである。

注意してほしいのは、僕たちが語っているのは、あなたの夢で神の夢を覆い、あなたの律法、意志、そして星空で、言い表せないほどの犠牲と苦痛を覆うことだ。僕たちが語っているのは、溢流の逆転に従うことで、神々への昇華を実現することではない。後者は依然として凡庸であり、卵の殻の中で必ず失われる夢なのだ。僕が教えようとしているのは超越の理、無限の空間、そしてその中にある無限の星々のことだ。あなたたちもそうしなければならない。何の束縛もなく——結合の機会のために分裂を選ぶこと、それこそが「密合」への必然の道なのだ。
つまるところ、奇術とは意識に従って変化を起こす科学と芸術なのだ。「密合」は芸術を実現する画具であり、塗る主体でもなければ、塗られる客体でもない。主体は永遠に——そして唯一——意識だ。意識の弱さから解放された者は、神にも死にも決して屈しない。
KR: 근본적으로, 고대 교단이 말하는 「밀합」의 본질은 상한에 속한 것들의 관통이다. 겉으로는 「왕국」 위의 세 질점이 일으키는 신비술처럼 보이지만——그 형이상학적 본질은 「하늘」 아래 네 질점의 분출(발출)에 있다. 켄리아의 연금술사들은 종종 형이상학을 무시한 채, 물질세계에서 어리석은 자들의 황금을 좇곤 했다. 따라서 그들의 피상적인 연구는 오늘 우리가 이루고자 하는, 고대 레무리아 이론에 기반한 위대한 업적과는 비교될 수 없도다.
3은 표상이고, 4는 본질이며, 이 둘을 중첩하여 얻은 7은 곧 수직적 초월의 길의 수이니라.
이 중첩 과정을 「밀합」이라 부른다. 매개체를 통해 결합하는 모습이 밀합한 부부를 닮아서다.
도식 속 「통로」를 관측하고 계산하라. 효력을 와해 및 역전시켜, 새로운 가능성을 가져오라…

하지만, 이것만큼은 반드시 명심해야 한다. 앞부분의 문제를 해결하면 뒷부분은 저절로 해결되니 굳이 신경 쓸 필요가 없다. 세상 만상은 밝은 곳에 두어야 하지만, 또 다른 것들은——비록 전부는 아니지만——어둠 속에 두어야 마땅하다. 그것들이 건드려서는 안 될 신성함을 지녔기 때문이 아니라, 「세계식」에 아무런 도움이 되지 않기 때문이다. 오직 어리석음이 극에 달한 범부만이 그런 금기를 자발적으로 건드리려 한다. 무지한 자들은 「금기」와 「귀중함」을 구분하지 못하니 말이다. 금기 또한 상식처럼, 대부분은 깊이 파고들 가치가 없다는 사실을 그들은 모른다.

주의하라. 내 말은, 그대의 꿈으로 신의 꿈을 덮어쓰고, 그대의 율법과 의지로 말할 수 없는 희생과 고통까지 덮어쓰라는 뜻이다. 분출(발출)을 역전해 신에 오르는 승격이 아니다. 그런 승격은 여전히 속물적이며, 결국 알껍데기 속에서 몰락할 운명의 꿈일 뿐이다. 내가 그대들에게 가르치려는 것은 초월의 이치, 무한한 공간과 그 속의 무한한 별들이다. 그대들도 따르길 바란다. 어떠한 구속도 없이——결합의 기회를 위해 분열을 선택하는 것, 그것이 「밀합」으로 가는 필연의 길이로다.
결국 신비술이란, 의식이 이끄는 대로 변화를 일으키는 과학이자 예술이다. 「밀합」은 예술을 구현하기 위한 도구일 뿐, 칠하는 주체도 칠해지는 객체도 아니다. 주체는 오직 의식뿐이다. 의식에 흠이 없는 자는 신에게도, 죽음에도 굴복하지 않으리라.

title: 秋分布道听记·密合的解释

CHS: 不可能…我明明已经登达了「不退还」之位阶。为什么，跌落到了如此境界。
对原始胎海的掌控也彻底丧失了。
为什么，为什么会这样？为什么，为什么你们要这么做！
新世界无法诞生，所有人都要在蛋壳之梦里死去了！
你才是早点从自己的梦里醒过来吧。
世界末日这种事，当然是全世界的人一起想办法解决的事情啦。
我明白了，是圣剑。它没有站在我这边。它每一次挥动都切削了围聚在我周身的众生意志。
直到最后，我懦弱的凡人性——我的人格也回到了我的体内。
胎海泛滥并没有那么快。
我已经有所察觉，最早填入「世界式」的输入值出现了变动。
有谁掌控了生命之力，又有什么人开辟了兽之国度。
还有一个「变量」，那就是你啊。
注定见证吞食一切之鲸败走的人，一切的见证者。
原来是这样，原来是这样。
我也做过这样的梦，想要成为你这样的事物。不过这个梦，刚刚破碎了。
我所做的一切都毫无意义，就像是一个空虚的梦。
不，甚至不如一个梦。至少梦是无害的。而我……不，你们，还有他们却为这件事付出了那么多。
你能知道我究竟是谁吗？
名字只是一个称呼。混在你灵魂里的两种颜色，我都是再熟悉不过了。
莉利丝院长不知道发生了什么，她只是抱住了一息尚存的玛丽安。
她理解不了过于复杂的当下与未来，只是想要留住过去。于是她做了她唯一会做的事情。
你在说什么奇怪的话。从一开始我的规划就有着崇高与神圣的目的。这中间没有私心。
没有人能评价我，没有人能审判我，没有人能原谅我。
你的目的或许是崇高的，但是你的疯狂伤害了很多人。
你连算式的输入都没填对。犯错然后被原谅，有什么问题吗？
然后纳齐森科鲁兹，你和我们回去吧。你需要见一见其他人。
虽然这家伙好像变得很好说话了，但是这种要求…
欸！一般不是要做点心理斗争然后让我们劝个半天的吗？
正如我之前所说，我并未觉得自己有任何负罪。如今伟业惜溃，但是世界注定得救。
任由他人责骂与嘲笑我吧。我的内心已经空落，徒余一种渴望。
我也想回到最开始的时候。水仙的勇者还没有踏上旅程的时候。
不过这已经办不到了。决定人命运的终究不是人自己，如今我连让自己做什么梦的力量也丢失了。
那，旅行者骑士，准备好之后我们就去重新封印胎海然后离开这里吧。
EN: Impossible... I had already reached the stage of "no return." How have I fallen to this point?
And I have lost all control of the Primordial Sea.
Why, why has this happened? Why, why did you do this?
The new world cannot be born. All will die in a shell, a husk of a dream!
Paimon reckons you're the one who should try waking up from your dream.
The end of the world is the kind of thing that everyone should work together to stop.
I see. The Holy Blade is not on my side. With each swing, it cuts through the universal will that surrounds me.
Until, at last, my weak, ordinary self has returned to its physical body.
The Primordial Sea won't overflow its banks so soon.
Indeed, I can sense changes in the values originally entered into the world-formula.
Someone has seized control of the life-force, and someone has opened the beast-realm.
And then, there is one more variable. That is you.
The person fated to see the all-consuming whale put to flight. The one who shall witness all.
I once dreamed of becoming one just like you. But that dream is now shattered.
All I have done is meaningless. An empty dream.
No, less than a dream, even. A dream is at least harmless. But I... No, you, and they... have paid so much for all I have done.
Oh, it's you. I didn't see you there.
Do you know who I actually am?
Names are just labels. But yes, I am most familiar with the two colors that mix in your soul.
Director Lyris does not know what has happened. She just holds onto Mary-Ann, who herself still clings to life.
She cannot understand such a complex present and future, and hopes just to retain the past. And so, she does the only thing she can.
I am willing to forgive you.
What an odd thing to say. From the very start, my plans have had lofty and sacred aims. Selfishness has never come into it.
None may judge or criticize me, nor do I need forgiveness.
Your aims may have been lofty, but your insanity has harmed many.
You did not even enter the formula correctly... and what's wrong with being forgiven for a mistake?
So please, Narzissenkreuz, come back with us. There are other people you need to see.
This guy seems to have become much more cooperative. But a request like that...
Huh? Doesn't this sorta thing usually require some inner struggle and hours of persuasion?
As I have said before, I do not feel that I have done anything wrong. My mission has failed, but the world is still fated to be saved.
Let others mock and curse me. I am empty within now. Only one desire remains.
I, too, wish to return to the very beginning — to the time before the Narzissenkreuz heroes set off on their journey.
But that's impossible. We are not masters of our own fate. I no longer even have the power to determine my own dreams.
Well, Knight 旅行者, when you're ready, we'll proceed to reseal the primordial waters, and then we'll leave this place.

title: 大梦的醒转：纳齐森科鲁兹与安

CHS: 玛丽安，现在对你而言，你最想去的地方是哪里呢？
我想想…「玛丽安」在过去的回忆，在想象的世界里待得太久了。
现在的世界，应该跟几百年前有了很大的变化吧。
我想亲眼看看，玻璃幕墙外的世界。我想看到新的故事。
虽然知道故事一定会有结局，但是很难想象一切就这样结束了。从我诞生的时刻开始，水仙十字王国就是我的全部…
我明白，你比我更加不安。你是为了这个故事才诞生的。可是从今往后，你要去开启真正属于「安」的故事了。
而我，也要从过去的巨大影子里逐渐迈出脚步。无论是莉利丝的回忆，还是玛丽安·吉约丹的回忆，都不能代表现在的我。
我们都有好长的路呢，安。
但我相信，你一定没问题的。
如果害怕了，我们就回到这里。
即便已成废墟，只要有种子飘到这里，就会开出新的花朵。只要我们还存在于此，就能建起新的家园。
EN: Where would you most like to go right now, Mary-Ann?
Well... I've remained for far too long in that imaginary past-world.
The world must have changed a lot after hundreds of years.
I want to see this world beyond the glass wall. I want to experience new stories.
I know stories end, but I find it difficult to imagine that everything would end like this. From the moment I was born, the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom was everything to me...
I understand that you're feeling more uneasy than I am. You were born for this story. But from now onward, you must start your own story... Ann's story.
And I must slowly step away from the looming shadow of my past. Neither Lyris's memories nor Mary-Ann Guillotin's represent who I am now.
We have a long path ahead of us, Ann.
But I know you'll be alright.
If you find yourself feeling afraid, we can come back here.
Even if only ruins remain, a seed that drifts here will bloom. So long as we remain, we can always rebuild a new home.

title: 溪舟的尾波：玛丽安与安

CHS: 没错，你们可以理解为一种十分罕见的神之眼。它的显现原因至今仍未被完全判明。
但在至冬，准确来说是「愚人众」的过往研究里，一般认为它同「第三降临者」有些许联系。
「第三降临者」？我们以前只知道「神之心」是他的遗骨。但没听说过和「星之楔」有关的事。
你们连遗骨的事都知道了？好吧…既然是你，仔细想想也没什么好奇怪的。
总之，天理用第三降临者的遗骨造了七枚神之心，用来巩固其建立的七执政体系。
而神之眼正是七执政体系的产物。换言之，神之眼的显现一定程度上也与第三降临者有关。到这里为止能跟上吗？
「神之眼」的持有者能借助神之眼驱使元素力，「星之楔」的持有者也不例外。
不同之处在于，「星之楔」持有者在操控元素力时，偶尔会展现出某种特殊的，似乎来自提瓦特之外的力量性质。
这种力量被认为是神之眼显现时，混入了第三降临者遗骨中的杂质所导致。所以称之为「星之楔」。
我记得说只要一个人愿望足够强烈，那么他就有可能获得神之眼。那本质上和它类似的「星之楔」，是不是也同样…
嗯？别这么看我。早就说过了，我没什么特别的愿望，讨厌的事倒是有一堆。我也不知道这东西为什么会在我面前显现…
不过我的核心在战斗中损毁过于严重，「遗产」没有启动。也多亏这枚「星之楔」的显现，才激活了阿兰留给我的第二次机会…
核心重启后，我修复了自己受损的躯干。并将普隆尼亚尚存的部分算式与「数秘阵列」想办法容纳进了现在这副身体。
…很遗憾。但恐怕是无法被修复了。
抱歉…另外，你刚才提到「最后的遗产」…
嗯，阿兰在世的时候，也和我聊过「愿望」的问题。
我猜，他认为我有一天或许会不惜付出生命也要达成某个愿望吧。他给这样的我留下了个重来的机会。
阿兰曾说我是他最为骄傲的杰作。这话听起来像自夸，但事实却毋庸置疑。
阿兰去世后，我试着研究过自己和普隆尼亚的内在构造。普隆尼亚本质上为算式机械，搞明原理不难。
但在审视自己的构成时，我才再次真切感受到阿兰——那位「奇械公」的伟大。
我模仿自己的机理构造，创造了你们所熟知的「凯瑟琳」，但那都仅仅是临摹了这具身体的皮毛。
欸？！但…但能造出凯瑟琳已经很了不起了吧！第一次知道她是人偶的时候，我们都吓了一跳！
不，这和阿兰的技术比起来根本不算什么。一些牵扯到「我」内核的技术原理。我自己至今都未完全参透。
藏下一个「遗产」，对阿兰来说简直是轻而易举。
只可惜，这个机会被我浪费在了对付多托雷的时候。我那时只是绝不想看到他得逞罢了。
你给了世界第二次机会。
哈，照你这么说，那这个世界欠我的可太多太多了。
咦？但聊了那么多，我反倒更不明白桑多涅你为什么会出现在这里了。
听公爵说你租下了这艘船，还办了什么…「捕鱼执照」？
哦，那是因为我想回一趟曾经的家。就是阿兰在世的时候我和他住的地方。
「遗产」的留言中提到，除了这第二次机会，阿兰还给我留下了些其他东西。它们应该存放在我和阿兰过去的家中。
说不定…它们还能帮我解决重启的核心中存在的某些「错谬」，让我了解自己为什么会获得「星之楔」。
那你直接回去不就行了，这和「捕鱼」有什么关系？
亏你们还解决了「枫丹」的危机。你不会忘了过去几百年，枫丹的水位一直都在上涨吧？我曾经的家早就被淹没在水下了。
水位上涨，加上地形变化…我要回家就得找到曾经的住址，还得清理淤积与阻碍。
但枫丹法律规定，不允许未经批准的个人和组织私自挖掘水下遗迹。我下水第一天就被一只美露莘给逮住了。
那你去申请一个许可不就得了？
得了吧，我还住在这边的时候，就知道枫丹廷的办事效率了。
更何况我还是「愚人众」执行官，光是这里面涉及到的外交问题就够那些沫芒宫复律官头大的了。
所以我干脆办了个在枫丹最容易申请的「捕鱼执照」，需要提交的资料也不多，用「吉约丹」这个名字就能顺利申请到。
这…这算不算钻了法律的空子…
有吗？那水下的家原本就是属于我的资产。我不过是在「捕鱼」的过程中顺带找找回家的路罢了。
当然，偶尔还是得抓两条上来放水族馆里做做样子的，这样遇到来抽查的复律官也好交代。为此我还专门招了个前台。
好吧…但难得申请了个水族馆的营业执照，还租了这么大一艘船，总觉得有些可惜呢。
你们真想办水族馆就去办好了，我反正不拦着。船上的设施也随你们用。
我现在只想回到之前那个家，看看阿兰说的「遗产」究竟是什么。
所以…到头来你们究竟为什么会出现在我的船上？
EN: You can think of it as a rare kind of Vision. As for what causes one to manifest, well... That's still unknown.
But in Snezhnaya — or in the Fatui's research at least — it's believed to have some connection to the Third Descender.
"The Third Descender"? We knew his remains were used to create the Gnoses, but this is the first we're hearing about a Stellar Linchpin.
You knew about the remains? Right, of course. Look who I'm talking to.
Yes, the Heavenly Principles used the remains of the Third Descender to create the seven Gnoses as a means to consolidate the archon system.
Visions result from that same system, so extrapolating from there... It's clear that the manifestation of a Vision is also, to some extent, related to the Third Descender. Still following?
For those that wield them, Visions serve as a means to channel elemental power. The same is true of Stellar Linchpins.
The difference is that, when wielding elemental energy, Stellar Linchpin-users often exhibit a unique kind of power that seems to come from beyond Teyvat.

It's believed that, when a Stellar Linchpin manifests, impurities from the remains of the Third Descender get fixed in place. Hence, the name. That's also believed to be the source of the strange power I just mentioned.
We've heard that Visions can appear when someone has a really strong wish or desire. Stellar Linchpins sound kinda similar, so does that mean...
Huh? Oh, don't look at me like that. I've never had any grand wishes or aspirations. Just a list of things that drive me up the wall... So, if you're asking why this thing appeared, I have no clue...
All I know is that, without it, the "Gift" Alain left me — this built-in second chance — never would have triggered. The damage to my core was too severe...

But thanks to the Stellar Linchpin's manifestation, it did trigger, and after my core rebooted, I was able to repair the damage to my body. I also managed to import the numerological array, along with some of Pulonia's surviving algorithms into this form.
Wait, does that mean Pulonia is...
Oh, we're... so sorry to hear that... But, you also mentioned something about a "Final Gift"...?
Yes. Alain often spoke to me about wishes and desires when he was alive.
I suppose he thought there might come a day when I wished for something, and was willing to sacrifice my own life to fulfill it, so he left me a chance to start over.
Alain once said I was his proudest masterpiece. That might sound boastful coming from me, but it's also an undeniable fact.
After Alain died, I started studying how Pulonia and I worked. Pulonia is essentially a computational machine, so it wasn't difficult to figure out the mechanical principles there.
But, when it came to my own structure, that's when Alain, the Lord-Artificer's true greatness struck me once again.
I attempted to imitate it when I created Katheryne, but in the end, she turned out to be nothing more than a superficial replica.
What!? B—But... As creations go, Katheryne is super impressive! We were shocked when we first found out she was a puppet!
No, she's nothing compared to what Alain was able to create. Some of the mechanical principles of my own core are still a complete mystery to me.
Keeping that "Gift" hidden wasn't even a challenge for him.
Just a shame I had to waste it on fighting Dottore. I just couldn't stand the thought of him coming out on top.
You gave the world a second chance.
Hah, if you put it that way, the world owes me a whole lot then, doesn't it?
Wait, but all this still doesn't explain what you're doing here.
Wriothesley said you rented this ship, and even had some kind of... fishing permit?
Ah, that's because I'm trying to go back to the place Alain and I lived when he was alive. My former home, I suppose you could say.
The second chance wasn't the only part of the "Gift." According to the message, Alain left me a few other things that are stored in the house we shared together.
I'm hoping that whatever he left me can help fix certain "anomalies" in my rebooted core... and help me understand why I received a Stellar Linchpin in the first place.
Okay, so go back then. What does that have to do with fishing?

Heh, and to think I'm talking to the saviors of Fontaine. Did you forget that the water levels have been rising for centuries? I can't just go back to the place I used to live, because now, it's underwater.
With the rising water levels and changes in terrain... It's not just a matter of finding where it is, but also clearing away any sediment or debris.
But Fontaine law prohibits unauthorized individuals and organizations from excavating underwater ruins. A Melusine caught me the minute I even made an attempt.
Why not apply for authorization, then?
And face the endless slog of Fontainian bureaucracy? No thanks.
Besides, I'm a Fatui Harbinger. The diplomatic implications alone would be enough to give the Gestionnaires at the Palais Mermonia a headache.
A fishing permit, on the other hand, isn't difficult to obtain at all. Minimal paperwork required, and under the name "Guillotin," the application was a cinch.
So, you're... exploiting a legal loophole?
Am I? That underwater home belongs to me. If I happen to chance upon it while doing some "fishing," what's the issue with that?
Of course, I do have to catch some fish to put in the aquarium, just in case the Gestionnaires come to check up on things. That's also the reason I hired someone to man the front desk.
Huh... But, isn't that kind of a waste? You went to all the trouble of getting a business license, and rented out this giant ship... just for show?
If you want to run an aquarium that bad, be my guest. Use the facilities however you want. I'm certainly not going to stop you.
All I want is to go back home and see what other gifts Alain wanted me to inherit.
Hold on, enough about me... What are you two even doing here?

title: 若我们再次相见：桑多涅

CHS: 结束了。说了这是很简单的事。
那个怨意的集合体，不过是众多无家灵魂聚合在一起的产物。其中混杂着许多污秽与邪念。
我不过是将它们最原本的灵魂与污秽分离，让它们得以被现在的世界规则容纳罢了。
「世界式」的原理是「发散」。从一个原点出发，解构与重组世界的可能性，从中寻找答案。
而利用「数秘阵列」反向运算「世界式」，就能达到归拢收束与还原的功能。即术式的反转。
这类似数理中的同调归约，在不改变群体本质的情况下，将他们还原为更简单和实质性的存在。
所以…呃，算了。看你们的样子也不是真的想搞明白这些…
我好像理解外地人听烟谜主萨满讲东西是什么感觉了。
总…总之我知道很了不起就对了！你果然很厉害呢！桑多涅。
笑话，我一直很厉害！哈哈哈。
差…差不多该走了！我去把格式塔内部的机关还原一下。我们岸上见！
EN: Yep. Told you it'd be a piece of cake.
How did you do that back there?
That creature was nothing special. Add a bunch of souls with nowhere to go, a touch of malicious energy, a few impurities, and a whole lot of resentment, and that's what you get.
All I did was separate the original souls from the rest of the filth, allowing them to be accepted by the current rules of the world.
The principle behind the world-formula is "divergence." Starting from a point of origin, it deconstructs and reconstructs the possibilities of the world to find certain answers.
So, it would follow that reverse-calculating the world-formula allows us to achieve convergence and restoration instead. Using the numerological array, I was able to do just that.
It's similar to the concept of homological reduction in mathematics. I reduced them to the basic, fundamental essence of their being, without changing their underlying nature.
That meant... Ugh, never mind. Judging by all the blank stares, I'm guessing you don't actually care.
I think I finally understand how outlanders feel when I ramble on about Shaman stuff...
P—Point is, it was super impressive! You really are amazing, Sandrone!
Hah, you're just realizing that now?
I'd expect nothing less from the Unraveller of All Reason...
W—We should get going! I'll go reset the mechanisms inside the tower. See you back on land!

title: 那些我们所留驻的：桑多涅

CHS: 没错，这恐怕就是你在欧庇克莱歌剧院附近睡不好的原因。露景泉是枫丹水系的汇流点，水中蕴含的情感会在那里交汇。
等等等等…如果真是灵魂那一类的东西，我不该只会觉得不舒服呀。照理说我甚至都能听到它们说话才对。
嗯，我毫不怀疑以你的能力能做到这些。但问题在于，它们恐怕已经不是完整的灵魂了。
你刚才说它们是怎么变成这样的来着？什么切割之类的？
灵魂的切割。是「水仙十字结社」雷内的技术。
简单来说，在知晓枫丹灭亡的命运之后，雷内寻求灵魂的永存来拯救世界。切割灵魂便是他研究的第一步。
遗憾的是，他当时的四象限理论并不完善，中途的失败导致他形体消散。
水仙十字的另一位成员雅各布为了继承雷内的理想，也为了复原雷内的形体…将一些阻碍他的人，作为了研究的实验品。
也就是，切割了他们的灵魂？
在雷内成功苏醒后，他们也继续着救世的研究。那之后被切割的灵魂都融进了雷内的意识中。
而最终在你们拯救了枫丹，也就是将枫丹人变为真正的「人」后，这些灵魂也回归了地脉。
但在雷内苏醒前被切割的灵魂，则因为无家可归，沦为了永远在枫丹水中飘荡的游魂。
简直就像不幸游离于世界之外的存在，既不被地脉承认，也不被命运承认。难怪我的感知会出错。
（脱离命运…这也是当初雷内的目的之一。）
他们恐怕在漫长的时间中，渐渐同他物融合，心中的怨念引来邪物，慢慢变为了某种污秽的聚合体。
而且我猜，这恐怕是最近才有的「质变」。不然枫丹的那位最高审判官恐怕早察觉到了。
不对，他应该已经察觉到了，不然不会派逐影庭的美露莘到水下巡视。我说怎么捞东西都能碰上警官呢！
既然这样的话，干脆我们去找那维莱特，一起解决这件事吧？
一来虽说还没去至冬报到，但我暂时没有退出「愚人众」的打算。这里面涉及的外交麻烦事多得要死。
二来，呵，我有足够的自信轻轻松松解决这个问题。用不着把其他人牵扯进来，让事情复杂化。
我现在需要的，仅仅是拜托茜特菈莉，帮我找出这个污秽聚合体的位置罢了。能做到吗？
小菜一碟。这可是我熟悉的领域，比前台小妹的工作拿手多了。
灵魂的事你打算怎么解决？这听起来连我都觉得不简单，牵扯到了些复杂的东西。
没事，交给我就好。我有适合这次事件的解决办法。
呜…看你这么有信心的话，那我们就先按你说的来办吧。
不过我有些好奇，为什么你会突然想帮枫丹解决这个问题呢？你应该和雷内他们都不认识才对。
哼，我的确觉得这事和我没关系，也不想去认识什么「水仙十字」的人。
但…阿兰晚年的时候和我倾吐过，说自己很遗憾没有在挚友需要的时候去帮助他。
他也很抱歉自己当时沉迷机械创造，没怎么照顾玛丽安。
我想，如果他仍在世的话，也会做出和我一样的选择。挚友留下的烂摊子，他或许会一边骂两句一边帮他解决吧。
朋友间还是不要相互怨恨，不要留下遗憾的好。我只不过是帮他完成这个心愿罢了。
嘿嘿，总感觉你的确有些不一样了呢。
啧，啰嗦！如果真的和以前一样，刚才那一趟不是白去了吗？
哼，至少先从刮掉过去留下的污秽开始。
（水族箱？这又是什么形容？可恶！他/她们刚才去了哪儿？怎么随随便便就和别人有我不懂的暗号了？！）
那么，茜特菈莉。位置的事情就拜托你了。
啧…！你！现在就陪我去德波大饭店喝酒去！
为什么？你还敢问为什么？
吉约丹小姐，位置我明天一早就给你答复。但我得去喝两口才有精神。
给我走…！我可要好好给你清算清算…
EN: You couldn't get comfortable sleeping near the Opera Epiclese, right? Well, I bet that's why. The Fountain of Lucine is where all the water in Fontaine gathers, so that's where the emotions within the water converge as well.
Hold on... If it's souls we're dealing with, feeling uncomfortable should have been just the beginning. I should have been able to hear their voices or something.
And under normal circumstances, I'm sure someone of your talents would have. The problem is, these souls are no longer complete.
Remind me how they ended up like that again? You mentioned something about them being split apart?
Yes. It's called soul-severing. Rene of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo came up with it.

After learning of Fontaine's impending doom, Rene thought if he could find a means for the soul to live on in perpetuity, it might ensure the world's salvation. Soul-severing was the first step of his research.
Unfortunately, his theory of the Four Orthants was imperfect at the time, and a failure along the way caused his physical form to dissipate.

Jakob, another member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, sought to carry on Rene's legacy and restore his physical form. He even used some of the people who stood in his way as test subjects for his research.
Yes. After Rene successfully awakened, the two continued their research, and all the severed souls ended up merging into Rene's consciousness.
After you saved Fontaine by turning Fontainians into true "humans," these souls returned to the Ley Lines.
But the souls severed before Rene awakened had nowhere to go, doomed to forever wander the waters of Fontaine as listless spirits.
Almost as if they exist outside the bounds of this world... unrecognized by the Ley Lines or fate. No wonder I couldn't sense them.
(Breaking free from fate... was also one of Rene's goals back then.)

Not only that, but over time, they began to fuse with other entities. Their inner resentment lured in all sorts of evil beings, which corrupted and defiled them into nothing more than accumulations of filth.
But the full transformation must have been recent. Otherwise, the Iudex surely would have noticed.
Wait, no, he must know already! That would explain the underwater Melusine patrols. No wonder I kept running into officers from the Marechaussee Phantom earlier!
In that case, let's go find Neuvillette, and we can sort it out together!
For one, the diplomatic hassle alone would be a nightmare. Even though I haven't reported back to Snezhnaya yet, I'm not planning to leave the Fatui anytime soon.
Heh, besides, with me here, success is a done deal. Involving other people would just complicate things.
All I need is for Miss Citlali to help pinpoint the location of this monstrosity. Think you can do it?
Pfft, with my eyes closed. This is what I do. I'm a lot better at it than manning a desk, at least.
But, uh, how exactly do you plan on resolving this soul stuff? Even to me, there's no obvious answer. Seems pretty complicated, all things considered.
Just trust me. I have the perfect solution.
Uh, alright. If you're that confident, we'll follow your lead.
Huh, why the sudden interest in helping Fontaine with this, Sandrone? You never knew Rene and the others, right?
No, I didn't. And you're right, this problem has nothing to do with me. I wouldn't get within ten feet of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo or its members.
But... In his later years, Alain told me he regretted not helping his best friend when he needed it the most.
He also felt sorry towards Mary-Ann, for being too lost in his mechanical research to look after her properly.
If he were still with us, I think he'd do the same. He might have a few choice words to say about it, but even after everything, he wouldn't leave his friend's mess for someone else to clean up.
Friends shouldn't hold grudges or leave behind regrets. Fixing what happened between him and Rene was one of his greatest wishes. All I'm doing is fulfilling it in his stead.
Hehe, y'know, you really do seem a little different now.
Tch, you mean everything that just happened wasn't for nothing? Why, thank you for pointing out the obvious, Paimon.
Giving those aquarium tanks a good cleaning, huh...
Hmph, just washing off the grime of the past. Turns out, a lot can build up after being ignored for so long.
(What's this about aquarium tanks all of a sudden? They go off on some grand adventure, and what? Now they have their own private code? Hmph, stupid.)
Alright then, Citlali. Tracking this thing down is up to you.
Tch...! You! Come with me to Hotel Debord for a drink. Right now!
Miss Guillotin, I'll report back on the location tomorrow morning. Just need a drink or two first to bolster me up.
Well... Don't let me keep you.
Alright, you. Time to go! I've got scores that need settling...

title: 那些我们所失去的：桑多涅

CHS: 昨天茜特菈莉喝得还挺多，也不知道她现在醒没醒…

其他人好像还在下面讨论有关「最后一幕」的事情。

哟？这不是翘班的灯光师和场记吗？

哦？那是想拍个相见的结局还是不相见的结局？

骂孙子骂了半小时、抱怨烟谜主工作抱怨了半小时、分享轻小说分享了一小时…还有…呃，好像后面我也睡着了。
她们？哦，是说剧组吧。已经走了，我们刚好在甲板碰上。
不过，既然你都解决了自己的问题，为什么还不去见哥伦比娅呢？她明明很想见你。
我…我想先处理完手上这烂摊子再去见她。再说了，这么好一个吓她一跳的机会，我肯定得多计划计划呀！
不说这个了。那个污秽聚合体的位置找到了吗？
当然，黑曜石奶奶我说办得到就办得到。
莫尔泰区…嗯？这不是格式塔吗？
果然还是对自己灵魂被切割时的地方怨意最深吗？还是说，这是对「水仙十字」的怨意…

好吧，那就辛苦你了。谢谢。
嘿嘿，那么事不宜迟，我们这就出发吧！
要我现在开始举行仪式吗？
先等等，我们把这层格式塔的水排空吧。这样更容易行动。
当然可以。在阿兰和雷内不约而同观测到枫丹命运之后，二人就曾分享过一些建筑防水的方法。原理是…
咳咳，跑题了。总之你们照我说的，按顺序解开几个机关就行。
嗯。我会先尝试着和他们沟通两句。
但这些灵魂的聚合体恐怕已经失去了理智，如果无法沟通，事态很可能演变为一场战斗。
好，假如变成了最坏的情况，我会找个地方好好躲着的。
嗯，真打起来的话，最后一击让我来，你们不要出手。相信我。
…随潮汐飘摇的游魂，我呼唤你们。被分离、被遗弃、被迫沉默的碎魂啊，循着旧日的气息归来吧。

那边的人，或者说里面的人，能听懂我说话吗？
我是枫丹「奇械公」，阿兰·吉约丹的后人。我有办法帮你们恢复原样，回归地脉。只需要你们稍微配合…
嘁…这架势，看来是怎么都劝不动了啊。
好吧。那就陪你们发泄发泄。
借助着「数秘阵列」反向运算「世界式」，桑多涅剥离了「怨意」内的污秽与邪念，让众多无家的灵魂重归清净，使他们获得了安眠。

这类似数理中的同调归约，在不改变群体本质的情况下，将他们还原为更简单和实质性的存在。
所以…呃，算了。看你们的样子也不是真的想搞明白这些…
我好像理解外地人听烟谜主萨满讲东西是什么感觉了。
总…总之我知道很了不起就对了！你果然很厉害呢！桑多涅。
笑话，我一直很厉害！哈哈哈。
差…差不多该走了！我去把格式塔内部的机关还原一下。我们岸上见！
好了好了！过去的烂摊子总算收拾完了。真是浑身都轻松了不少。
偶尔这么做一件好事，还挺开心的嘛。
你在挪德卡莱也帮了朋友们很多忙啦，明明一直都很好！
呵，这可说不好。我之后可是要回愚人众的，你们这么相信别人真的好吗？
哼，到时候吃了苦头可别怪我没提醒过你们。
我们接下来去哪儿？回船上吗？
对啊，桑多涅你自己的事也解决完了，过去的事也解决完了。是时候让朋友们知道你没事了吧。
大家见你回来，一定会很高兴的！
哈…换作以前，我恐怕绝对不会承认，不过…嗯，我的确也想大家了。
但哥伦比娅是个例外！这次我一定要把她老是来烦我的仇给报了！
桑多涅被传入了一个未知的空间，见到了对她的归来感到难以置信的哥伦比娅。最终，桑多涅主动拥抱了这位久别重逢的挚友，而在下一刹那，她们又再次回到了映影的拍摄现场…
闭嘴。早就说过不许把我随便传到奇奇怪怪的地方。
哦！太棒了！简直太棒了！这就是我想要的结局！我想要的画面！
你刚才去哪儿了？哥伦比娅小姐。怎么一转眼就从片场消失，又突然…呃，和这位小姐一起出现。拥抱着。
事情发生得太突然，留影机一直在运转，刚才的画面也拍下了。
嗯，她就是我最好的朋友。没想到真的能和她再次相见。我好高兴。
看来，这部映影有了个好结局呢。桑多涅。
果然…果然我还是觉得你好烦人啊！！哥·伦·比·娅！！！
EN: Citlali sure drank a lot last night, huh... Wonder if she's even awake...
Waah! C—Columbina! You, uh, sure know how to make an entrance... What are you doing here?
We just finished filming a last-minute scene, so I came up to get some fresh air.
The others are still down below discussing what the final scene should be.
You mean, how it should end?
Yes. They're torn between whether the heroine should reunite with her old friend or not.
Ah... Because the whole point is that she came to her friend's homeland to search for her, right? Paimon almost forgot the plot...
Yes. Director Furina and Miss Chiori think a tragic ending where the two never meet would be more poignant.
But Director Xavier thinks having the two reunite would make for a more touching and heartwarming ending.
On a personal level, of course I want to see her again... of course I want to experience that moment where we reunite... even if it's just for the Kameras.
But that means... an actor would have to take her place, and that makes me feel...
Don't stress about that for now.
Yeah! Don't look so worried! Making a film is supposed to be fun!
B—Besides, it's all gonna work out! You can trust Paimon on that!
It'll all get tied up in a nice little bow. You'll see.
I'll just focus on having fun for now.
Well, well, look who we have here! 旅行者 and Paimon!
Aw, the lighting specialist and clapper loader that never were...
Uh, yeah... We kinda went AWOL didn't we. Sorry about that.
Hehe, seriously, don't worry about it. Everything's going smoothly on our end, so just do what you need to do.
We'll definitely make it up to you...
You seem to be in better spirits now, Miss Columbina. I apologize if our earlier discussion put you on the spot...
It's okay, I'm fine now. 旅行者 and Paimon talked me through it.
So, what are your thoughts on the ending then? Should we have them reunite or not?
We should... tie everything up in bows.
Well, yeah... We weren't the ones who drank our weight in alcohol yesterday.
Heh, what? Are you suggesting granny can't handle her liquor? It takes a lot more than that to get me drunk.
Really? 'Cause, uh, you stopped making sense after a while...
Uh... Did I? Huh, news to me. I didn't say anything... too crazy, I hope.
Let's see... You spent half an hour badmouthing Ororon, half an hour complaining about work, an hour talking about light novels... and, uh, Paimon kinda fell asleep after that.
Hm? Oh, the crew? Yeah, we bumped into them on the deck, but they just left.
Wait but, now that everything with your core is sorted out, what's stopping you from seeing Columbina? She misses you a lot!
I... I just want to deal with this mess first. Besides, this is the perfect chance to make her jump for once. I have to plan it out more.
But, enough about that. Were you able to pinpoint the location of our target?
Of course. When Granny Itztli promises something, she delivers!
The Morte Region... Wait, this is the Tower of Gestalt.
The place the souls were severed... Is that the source of the resentment? Or is it the Narzissenkreuz Ordo in general?
Let me come with. This thing's movement isn't fixed. If it's not at this location when we get there, I can use a ritual to summon it.
You've already gone to more than enough trouble...
I don't mind. These old bones have nothing better to do anyway. Summoning a spirit isn't going to do me in.
(Besides, if I don't go, they'll just have more inside jokes I can't join in on!)
Hah, there's no time to lose. Let's head out!
＊ Check the space within the Tower of Gestalt
Huh, no sign of it so far...
Should I start the summoning ritual?
Let's drain the water from this floor of the tower first. It'll make it easier to move around.
Of course. Alain and Rene both saw the future that awaited Fontaine, and even shared a few methods for waterproofing buildings. The principle behind it is...
...Ahem, not important. Just unlock the mechanisms in the order I tell you.
＊ Wait for Citlali to start the ritual
Yeah. When this thing appears, I'll try talking to the souls inside.
But, more than likely, they've already been driven to madness. If communication fails, we'll have a battle on our hands.
In that case, Paimon better find a hiding spot.
If a fight does break out, I should be the one to deliver the final blow. Trust me on that.
...Wandering spirits drifting along the tides, hear me now. Broken souls, silenced, torn apart, and forsaken, follow the traces of the past and return to us.
...Let resentment recognize resentment. Let vile entities be drawn together, and in this place, take form once more!
(Ugh... This is exactly why I deal in math not magic. How are we supposed to know what stage the spell is at? It's like there's no logic to speak of.)
(Mechanical science is so much easier to—)
Hey, you! Or whoever's inside of you... I need you to listen to me.
I'm a descendant of Fontaine's "Lord-Artificer," Alain Guillotin. I can make you whole again and return you to the Ley Lines. You just need to work with me here...
Tch... Looks like talking this out is off the table.
Alright, plan B... Time to blow off some steam!

By using the numerological array to run the world-formula in reverse, Sandrone is able to strip away the corruption and malice that resided in that resentment, allowing countless lost souls to find peace and purity at last.
Yep. Told you it'd be a piece of cake.
How did you do that back there?
That creature was nothing special. Add a bunch of souls with nowhere to go, a touch of malicious energy, a few impurities, and a whole lot of resentment, and that's what you get.
All I did was separate the original souls from the rest of the filth, allowing them to be accepted by the current rules of the world.
The principle behind the world-formula is "divergence." Starting from a point of origin, it deconstructs and reconstructs the possibilities of the world to find certain answers.
So, it would follow that reverse-calculating the world-formula allows us to achieve convergence and restoration instead. Using the numerological array, I was able to do just that.
It's similar to the concept of homological reduction in mathematics. I reduced them to the basic, fundamental essence of their being, without changing their underlying nature.
That meant... Ugh, never mind. Judging by all the blank stares, I'm guessing you don't actually care.
I think I finally understand how outlanders feel when I ramble on about Shaman stuff...
P—Point is, it was super impressive! You really are amazing, Sandrone!
Hah, you're just realizing that now?
I'd expect nothing less from the Unraveller of All Reason...
W—We should get going! I'll go reset the mechanisms inside the tower. See you back on land!
Well, that's one old mess for the books. Glad to have that over and done with.
Feels nice to do a good deed every once in a while.
You helped everyone out a bunch in Nod-Krai, too! Kinda seems like you're just a good person at heart!
Heh, I wouldn't be so sure. I'll be heading back to the Fatui soon enough. You two are too trusting sometimes...
Well, at the very least, we know we can trust you.
Hmph, fine. Just don't say I didn't warn you when it comes back to bite you.
Well, where to next? Back to the ship?
Yeah! Your personal business, the Narzissenkreuz thing, it's all resolved. That means you can "see the people that need seeing" now, right Sandrone?
Everyone's gonna be so happy you're back!
Heh... You wouldn't catch me dead admitting to this before, but... Yeah. I really have missed everyone.
Columbina's a special case, though! This time, I'm definitely getting her back for all her annoying antics over the years!

Sandrone is transported to an unfamiliar space, where she sees a Columbina who is utterly gobsmacked by her return. Eventually, Sandrone steps forward to embrace her dear friend, and in that moment, the two of them return to the film set...
Don't ruin the moment. Or I'll start thinking about how you teleported me to a random location after I explicitly told you to stop doing that...
Aaand... Scene! Bravo! Bravo! We got it! This is exactly the ending I was hoping for!
Where did you just go, Miss Columbina? You vanished, and then the next second you were back, hugging this, um... new friend here.
Yeah. Well, the Kamera was already rolling, and it happened so fast, so... Yeah.
Yep, my best friend. The one I was looking for. I never thought I'd actually get to see her again. I'm just... so happy.
Plus, the film got a happy ending too. It's all thanks to you, Sandrone.
You couldn't stop being annoying for one second!? Columbinaaaa!

title: 那些我们所留驻的：任务叙述

heading: 巨龙与自由之歌 · 尾声的尾声

CHS: 这位就是教会方面负责回收天空之琴的专员，祈礼牧师芭芭拉。
虽然比起代理团长，我可能没资格说这话…
但，我还是要替蒙德感谢各位的努力！
幸亏是和平解决！如果真的调动军力与龙开战，很难想象要怎样收场…
而且，「愚人众」那边也不能多说什么。
事情变成这样，他们一定在暗中气恼吧。
这一次，他们失去了向西风骑士团施压的最佳借口。
只印证了至冬国使臣蛮横无理的形象，却没有得到实际的外交进展呢。
好啦，所以你们把天空之琴带来了吗？
代理团长的担保也不是无限的，枢机大人已经催了一阵子了…
倒…倒是带来了，只不过…嗯…这个…稍微有点…
嗯？放心，不会收你们租金的，教会一直有专门的供奉拨款…
＊ 将天空之琴交给芭芭拉
看到天空之琴已经面目全非，虔诚的芭芭拉吓坏了。无可奈何的温迪只得用幻术「修复」了天空之琴，趁芭芭拉还没发觉，你们一行人悄悄离开了教堂。但在教堂外，「愚人众」执行官「女士」突然出现，抢走了温迪的神之心，并在将你打昏后匆匆离去。
唔…他的状态，说不上是「没事」吧。
刚才我发现你们晕倒在教堂外，就用元素力为你们治疗…
啊！芭芭拉小姐不要听{PLAYERAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_HE|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_SHE]}说胡话！
咦？嗯…好的，总之，刚才我发现你们晕倒在教堂外，就用元素力为你们治疗…
看来她应该多给你浇点水，帮你激活一下脑子。
那位诗人是先醒的，但奇怪的是，我的治疗对他的伤几乎没有效果…
这种病人，我还是第一次遇见。他自己却说着「这很正常」之类的话，想要离开教堂…
「蒙德英雄的象征」…他是这么说的。
我想阻止他，但琴…琴团长却说，「让他去吧」。好奇怪。
我记得以前，温迪也在那棵树下疗过伤…
（是因为风神和风起地之间的联系吧，琴团长应该也猜到了，但不能和芭芭拉说呢…）
树间的风很好，有我喜欢的气味…
哈哈，上次我也是这么说的呢。唉，为什么每次说这句话，都是在运气不顺的时候呢？
唉…这本来不是能和普通人谈论的话题。但，悄悄告诉你也没关系。
你应该知道，「神之眼」是这世上极少数人才拥有的外置魔力器官。他们通过「神之眼」来引导元素力。
其实，每一位「神之眼」的拥有者，都是有资格成神的人，因此被称作「原神」，拥有登上天空岛的资格。
「原神」？以前好像从来没听过这个词…
哼哼，因为这是真正神灵才知道的秘密呀。总之，我们是不需要「神之眼」这种初级器官的——
作为替代，神灵的魔力器官与天空岛共鸣相连…也就是「神之心」了。
欸嘿。只是发光的玻璃球而已，用来避免无谓的猜疑啦。
又欺骗感情，但我已经习惯了。
那么，刚才那个见面就把我吹飞、还抢走温迪「神之心」的坏女人，到底是谁…？
她是「女士」——愚人众十一执行官的第八席，代号「女士」。
愚人众的每一位执行官，都像她一样，被至冬国的女皇赐予了神灵般的权柄，获得超越了凡人的力量。
至冬国的…女皇？那不就是…
嗯，七神之一，端坐于至冬宫的「冰之女皇」，全体愚人众执行官的唯一效忠对象。
虽然七神之间的关系，并不全都非常融洽，但我也没想到，她居然正在谋夺其他神灵的「神之心」…
我认识「五百年前的她」，但对「现在的她」已经很陌生了。
五百年前的一场大灾之后，她就断绝了和我的一切交流…
不过，有关冰之神和愚人众的事，还是过一会再说吧。
旅行者，你要寻找全部七神，旅途中恐怕还有许多艰难之处。
先往蒙德的邻国去吧——那里的「岩」之神与我不同，亲自治理着「璃月」全境。
他每年只会正式降临一次，赐下神谕，指引这一年里经营璃月的方向。
即使是这样，听起来工作频率也比某位大人高多了呢。
…总之，今年的「请仙典仪」好像就快开始了。嗯，错过的话，就要再等一整年咯。
哇？！这么重要的信息怎么不早说？那就再见了，旅行者，我们快走——
不好意思，擅自借用了七天神像的风…
哈哈，心怀感激地用吧——能请我一杯蒲公英酒就更好了。
旅行者…当你重新踏上旅途之后，一定要记得旅途本身的意义。
提瓦特的飞鸟、诗歌和城邦，女皇、愚人和怪物…都是你旅途的一部分。
终点并不意味着一切。在抵达终点之前，用你的眼睛，多多观察这个世界吧…
嗯！风神的告诫到此为止！接下来是温迪时间。
想多聊些什么的话，就趁现在聊吧。因为吟游诗人，可不会总在一个地方驻唱的。
特瓦林…到最后也还记得「四风守护」的职责。
所以，我也并不打算强行卸下他身上的责任、把我理解的「自由」强塞给他。
——而是希望，特瓦林能自己选择、自己理解，何为自由。
因为我在成神之前，也是这样被一个朋友…教导了「何为自由」的。
…原来如此，深渊教团里有一位「{MATEAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_BOYD|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_GIRLD]}」，主导了腐化特瓦林的计划？
看来是想把特瓦林改造成深渊的战争兵器吧。话说回来，我可从没听说过，深渊教团里有什么「{MATEAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_BOYD|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_GIRLD]}」…
看来那不是教团的古老传承。
但最近才出现的「{MATEAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_BOYD|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_GIRLD]}」，又为什么能走上统领深渊教团的位置呢…？
刚才的愚人众执行官，抢走「神之心」以后，马上就离开了呢。
这是为了避免出现「骑士团的目击证人」。
毕竟这种事要是留下把柄，就等于公开毁灭与西风骑士团的外交关系了吧。
做出这种事来，却还好意思继续当蒙德的盟友吗？！
唉…面对深渊教团的威胁，人类的七国本该结成联盟。
「愚人众」拥有七国最强的武力，却用来盗窃天空之琴、觊觎神力、借龙灾对骑士团施压…
啊，说到「天空之琴」…那时，好像听迪卢克提过这个名字。
他说，「愚人众」能够横行七国、威胁西风骑士团，完全是由于这十一位执行官的存在。
是的，就像我刚才说的，他们被冰之神赐予了权柄，获得了超越凡人的力量。
「冰之女皇」…五百年没见了，她究竟在想什么呢？又在计划着什么呢？
这件事的答案，或许也会对你寻找七神的旅途，产生未知的影响吧…
刚才说过，「神之眼」的拥有者，被世界称作「原神」，拥有登上天空岛的资格。
「神之心」是更高位的元素控制中枢，是七神之座的象征。
对不起，我不知道是七神中的哪一位，带走了你的{MATEAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_BROTHER|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_SISTER]}。
呀，话说回来，身为七神之一，我自己的嫌疑都还没洗清…！
你长得和那个神一点都不像。
相处这么久，不用继续怀疑了。
可是，「卖唱的」只是化身形象，不能作为判断依据——
相处这么久，不用继续怀疑了。
啊哈哈，我们确实是很好的搭档呢。等你找回{MATEAVATAR#SEXPRO[INFO_MALE_PRONOUN_BROTHER|INFO_FEMALE_PRONOUN_SISTER]}，有没有兴趣来当新的「四风守护」啊？
嗯？旅行者，你好像不太热衷的样子？
那么卖唱的！如果当了「四风守护」就有民众供奉好吃的话，不如考虑一下…我？
那么，就往璃月去吧。错过今年的「请仙典仪」的话，就要再等一整年咯。
EN: ＊ Meet Jean and Venti at the Cathedral
This is Barbara, the Deaconess of the Church. She is here to retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel.
May the Anemo Archon protect you.
I'm not really in a position to speak compared to our Acting Grand Master...
But I still want to thank you all on behalf of all of Mondstadt for your assistance!
Fortunately, everything was resolved peacefully... I can't imagine how an all-out war between the military and the dragon would have ended...
Now the Fatui have no choice but to keep their mouths shut.
They must be annoyed that things didn't turn out as planned for them.
This time, they even lost their best excuse to pressure the Knights of Favonius.
Diplomatically speaking, they gained nothing, and on the contrary simply proved just how vexatious they can be.
Sounds like quite the story. So, did you bring the Holy Lyre with you?
We cannot ask you to keep defending the lyre forever. The Seneschal has been pressing me for a while now...
We ahh... did bring it with us... Ummm... It's just... it's a little...
Oh, don't worry! I'm not here to collect rent! The Church has always received special funding...
＊ Give the Holy Lyre der Himmel to Barbara

The sight of the badly damaged Holy Lyre causes the pious Barbara to panic. Venti sees no choice but to use a magical illusion to "fix" the lyre, and the rest of you quietly leave the Cathedral before Barbara has the chance to see through it. But just outside the Cathedral, Fatui Harbinger Signora appears, steals Venti's Gnosis, knocks you unconscious, and hastily departs.
Um... I wouldn't say he's "alright," exactly.
I found you lying unconscious outside the Cathedral, and used my elemental powers to heal you...
Ah! Don't listen to his/her nonsense, Miss Barbara!
Ahh... Um, okay, well basically, I found you lying outside the Cathedral, unconscious, and used my elemental powers to heal you...
Paimon thinks you could still use a final splash of ice-cold water to the face.
That bard awakened first, but strangely, my healing powers had almost no effect on him...
This is the first time I've encountered such a patient. But he just said "it's completely normal," and then got up and left the Cathedral...
He left? Already? Where'd he go?
The Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero, that's what he said.
I wanted to stop him, but Jean— I mean, Master Jean said to let him leave. How strange.
Paimon remembers Venti healing under that tree before...
(It's probably due to the connection between Windrise and the Anemo Archon. Master Jean has figured it out as well, but we can't tell Barbara...)
The wind amongst the branches is good, I love the way it smells...
Haha, I said the exact same thing the last time. *sigh* Why do I only say these things when I'm down on my luck?
*sigh* This isn't something I'm meant to discuss with ordinary people. But I suppose I can let you in on the secret.
As you know, Visions are external magical foci that only a small minority of people possess. They use these Visions to channel elemental power.
In truth, every wielder of a Vision is one who can attain godhood and ascend to Celestia. We call such people allogenes.
Allogenes? Paimon's never heard of them before.
Hehe, that's because this is a secret that only archons are privy to. We don't need primitive tools like Visions.
Instead, each archon has an internal magical focus that resonates directly with Celestia itself... known as a Gnosis.
What about the thing hanging off your hip?
Eh-he. It's just a glowing glass ball I carry around to avoid suspicion.
I feel cheated... but I guess I'm used to that by now.
So who was that nasty woman who sent Paimon flying and stole your Gnosis?
Her name is Signora, No. 8 of the harbingers.
She and the rest of the harbingers have been given god-like executive authority by the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, and with it, strength surpassing that of other mortals.
The Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya? Isn't that...
Indeed. She is one of The Seven, the Tsaritsa who reigns from the Zapolyarny Palace, and the one person that the Fatui Harbingers all answer to.
The Seven don't always get along well, but still — I never thought that she would plot to steal another archon's Gnosis...
What sort of god is the Tsaritsa?
Ah... How should I put this?
Five hundred years ago, I knew her well. But I can't say the same is true now.
You see, a certain catastrophe happened five hundred years ago, and after that, she cut off all ties with me.
But we can save discussion of the Cryo Archon and the Fatui for another day.
旅行者, if you seek the rest of The Seven, many difficulties lie ahead of you still.
You should head for Mondstadt's neighboring nation of Liyue. The Geo Archon who reigns there, unlike me, administrates his entire region personally.
He only descends once every year to give his divine predictions, which set the direction for Liyue for the rest of that year.
Even so, it sounds like he works much harder than a certain someone.
...In any case, this year's Rite of Descension is soon to begin. If you miss it, you'll just have to wait another year.
WHAT!? Why didn't you tell us before? Well then bye. 旅行者, we're going!
Sorry for borrowing the statue's Anemo power without asking...
Haha, just use it gratefully — or, better yet, treat me to a glass of dandelion wine.
Traveler, as you set off on your journey once again, you must remember that the journey itself has meaning.
The birds of Teyvat, the songs and the cities, the Tsaritsa, her Fatui and the monsters... they are all part of your journey.
The destination is not everything. So before you reach the end, keep your eyes open. Use the chance to take in the world around you...
Great. So that's that for the Anemo Archon's admonishments! Back to Venti Time!
If you want to chat, now's the time — a bard stays not always in a single clime.
Up till the end, Dvalin remembered his duty as one of the Four Winds.
As such, I don't intend to forcibly strip him of that duty and force my ideals of freedom onto him.
I just hope that Dvalin will be able to choose for himself and understand what freedom is.
Before I became an archon, I too was taught the meaning of freedom in this way by a friend.
Kaeya shared some new intelligence, you say?
...I see. So, the Abyss Order has a Princess/Prince who orchestrated the plan to corrupt Dvalin?
They were probably trying to turn Dvalin into a weapon of war for the Abyss. But that said, I have never heard of any such Princess/Prince of the Abyss Order.
Not an Abyss Order tradition, then.
So this is a recent development...
Apparently, but how does a Princess/Prince come out of nowhere and take command over the entire Abyss Order?
That Fatui lady didn't hang around, did she? She just grabbed your Gnosis and left!
She wanted to avoid any eyewitnesses from the Knights of Favonius.
The slightest slip-up here would have destroyed the Fatui's diplomatic relations with the Knights.
So they're just gonna keep acting like Mondstadt's allies as if nothing happened!?
*sigh*... If only the seven nations had banded together against the Abyss Order in the first place.
The Fatui possess the strongest military among the seven nations. Yet they've used it to steal the Holy Lyre, covet the power of gods, and use Dvalin as a bargaining chip against the Knights...
Speaking of the Lyre... didn't Diluc say something like this before?
He said that the Fatui can only run amok across the seven nations and threaten the Knights because of the harbingers.
Yes. As I said earlier, the Cryo Archon has given them authority and strength beyond that of other mortals.
The Tsaritsa... I haven't seen her in five hundred years. What is she thinking? What's her plan?
Whatever the answer is, I have a feeling it's only going to make your search for The Seven all the more difficult...
As I said before, Vision wielders are known as allogenes and may ascend to Celestia.
A Gnosis is a higher-order nexus of elemental manipulation and is emblematic of an archon's status as one of The Seven.
But as for which of The Seven took your sister/brother... I'm sorry, I don't know.
...Wait, as one of the Seven, I'm not clear of suspicion yet either, am I?
You don't look like that god at all.
We've known you long enough to trust you.
Hang on a hot second! Tone-Deaf Bard is just one of Barbatos' many incarnations, who's to say—
We've known you long enough to trust you.
Haha, we're a great team indeed! Say, once you find your sister/brother, how would you like to become one of the new Four Winds?
Hmm, you don't seem too into it, 旅行者...
Hey, Tone-Deaf Bard... If being one of the Four Winds means free food, you can consider Paimon!
Well then, best be off to Liyue. If the descension ritual you fail to tally, then another year you must dally.

title: 巨龙与自由之歌·尾声的尾声

heading: 千手百眼，天下人间 · 千手百眼

CHS: 雷电将军，可能不会那么轻易放我们走吧？
感觉空气中的气氛突然变得好压抑…是来自雷电将军的威压吗…
女士就这样死在了雷电将军的刀下…
虽说这是她罪有应得，但还是有些感慨。
这些执行官…收集神之心的目的到底是什么呢？
振作一点…我们还是赶快离开吧，我有…不好的预感。
说起来…斩杀女士的时候，那招「无想的一刀」果真强大到不可思议…
如果那一招真的无敌的话，击败雷电将军也就无从谈起吧…
记得八重神子要我们在千手百眼神像前，再次进入「一心净土」…
可是现在，我们已经自身难保了吧？计划就先搁置一下吧…
空气中好像不停有电流的声音…胸口闷得喘不过气…
旅行者，你还好吗？怎么都不说话…
好像听到天守阁外面传来了乱糟糟的声音…是起了什么冲突吗？
那些守卫好像也很紧张的样子…我们去看看究竟发生了什么吧？

你在昏昏沉沉之中，走出了天守阁。巧合的是，反抗军的众人已击破群龙无首的幕府军，来到了天守阁下。你与他们许久不见，正要向前，雷电将军忽然在你身后现身，那传闻中「无想的一刀」正向你砍来。眼看神罚即将落下，万叶随身携带的那枚神之眼空壳中竟然再度亮起雷光。万叶挥刀迎上，直面并奇迹般地接下了那一刀。随后，受到万叶此举的激励，反抗军众人的压抑情绪被点燃，向雷电将军发起了最后的冲锋，而千手百眼神像上的神之眼，也随着它们曾经的主人的冲锋而亮了起来。可是你深知反抗军并非将军的对手，而且此刻或许是实施八重神子计划的好机会，于是你转身挥刀砍向将军。果然如你所料，「一心净土」在你面前展开…
＊ 与「一心净土」中的雷电将军对话
让我想想，究竟是什么，让你再一次来到我的面前？
你的愚勇，是为了庇护那些民众，还是说…觐见我才是你的本意？
愚人众诱导了雷电将军。
哦？将我从永恒的冥思中唤起，该不会就是为了说这些吧。
那你是否有些过于小觑我了。眼狩令的事，我当然知晓。
并非如此，我知道的只是一切关于「永恒」的事。
包括眼狩令的颁布，也是由我所默许的。
而那些愚人众的所为，尚未构成对永恒的威胁，否则…他们早已被肃清。
让稻妻的人民失去了很多。
愿望本就是不利于永恒的东西。
你或许还没有意识到，追逐愿望…往往会让人失去更多。
正如，收缴神之眼一事本身，并不会有人因神之眼离身而丧命…
丢掉性命的，反而会是那些执意要追逐愿望的人，不是么？
旅者，你在我眼中的确是特殊的存在。
你的身上似有数之不尽的不确定性，换言之，你与「永恒」相距最远。
所以，我无意要你理解其中意义，仅由此身为这天下人间代行「永恒」之道便好。
是由你的意识所构成的空间，对吧？
没错，你居然会清楚这些…
罢了，你是在寻找…动摇我意志的机会，对么？
好吧，「违逆永恒之人」，让我看看…你的觉悟。
你再次与雷之神正面交锋，正在此时，八重神子也借助着那枚送给你的御守现身在「一心净土」之内。在她的提醒下，你感觉到了早已汇聚身上的万千「愿望」…
为什么不能相信你的子民，相信他们愿望的力量呢？
那些愿望已经超脱了距离、超脱了空间与时间，已经是无人能将其扼杀之物了。
当人们全力以赴前进时…
甚至将神明的工作取代。
这是你在璃月的旅途收获么？
人类向前奔跑，将神明甩在身后的国度吗…
可我们又为何要自顾自…一厢情愿地放弃前进呢？
…前进所带来的那些失去，你也同我一起见证过。
唯有永恒，唯有永恒才能…
影讲述起了自己的过往，以及对「永恒」的执念的起源。她曾作为影武者，跟随她所信赖的前代将军。然而每次前进都会伴随着失去，直至最后，稻妻连前代将军也失去了。影不再如前代将军一样信奉「须臾」，而将「永恒」视为稻妻应当前进的道路。
天理…对我来说是不知所谓的东西。
总而言之，你只是想永远地守护你心爱的稻妻，是么？
你说得有些太过轻描淡写了。
可是这个国度，是否有永恒存在的价值呢？
失去了愿望，失去了变化，就仅仅是存在而已的国度，不过是一具空壳。
呵，那样的话，就算毁灭了又何妨呢？
千世万代不变不移的永恒，这是我给予臣民的许诺。
可你的臣民需要的，并非是你的许诺，他们想要的是你的「注视」啊。
人类的寿命仅有百年，他们无力承担那些失去。
经历过一切的我，才会选择指引他们去往正确的「永恒」。
…可是「永恒」对你来说，太过残酷了啊，影。
你不仅不再去注视世人，也已经不再注视自己了。
几百年来，一个人在这里，一定很寂寞吧。
不前进的话，也会错过很多啊…在此静止直到永恒的你，不也在失去着吗？
明明忍受着这样的孤独，却又要为了永恒，而把这份孤独的时间尺度无限拉长…
告诉我，为何此地的天空曾是那样晦暗…而偏偏此刻又泛起了光芒？
这里是你的「一心净土」，是你的内心世界。
所以…其实你很开心可以再次见到我，你早已无法忍受此地的孤独了，对吗？
呵呵，那我可有说不尽的话要和你讲，哦对了，就让我把这几百年间的事情讲给你听吧。
几百年间的事，要讲多久？
狐仙的记忆力可是很好的，几百年间的每一个细节我都不会忘记。
所以大概要讲个几百年吧。
呵…呵呵…神子，我本以为已经不会再有机会与你这样会面了。
能见到你，是永恒之中的变数…也算是惊喜。
呵呵，既然你老老实实承认了，还可以继续做朋友哦？
不过，既然我输给了你们的计划，那我便会依照你们的意志，废除眼狩令。
但关于「永恒」，关于这个国家是否应该前进，我需要再考虑考虑。
哎呀，自始至终小孩子气的，都是你啊。
人民的愿望最终叩开了雷电将军锁闭的心扉。后来，她如约废除了眼狩令。在一心净土之外，她在世人的眼中同样见到了「永恒」。有些愿望足以抚去伤痛，带来胜机，唤起希望。有些愿望，即便拥有它的人已然身殒，魂归高天，却依旧一如诞生时的模样，真挚而炽热，直至「永恒」。
你们在雷电将军的「一心净土」里到底做了什么呀？
眼狩令居然真的废除了。
主要是八重神子的功劳。
是人们的愿望传达到了。
欸，这样啊…我还担心得很呢。
所以神子这次找我们，难道是要跟我们道谢吗？嘿嘿…快过去找她吧。
EN: The Raiden Shogun isn't gonna let us off just like that, right?
The air feels suffocating... it must be the Raiden Shogun's almightiness...
One strike from the Shogun, and now Signora's gone...
She got what she deserved, but Paimon still can't help but feel upset.
Why are they doing it... Why are the Harbingers collecting all the Gnoses?
Hmm? Traveler, you got a headache?
Chin up... let's get out of this place, Paimon feels... unsettled.
Also... when the Shogun executed Signora with the Musou no Hitotachi... it was unbelievably powerful...
It seems impossible to defend against... and if so, we've got no hope whatsoever of defeating her in combat...
So to recap, Yae Miko wants us to go back inside the Plane of Euthymia by the Statue of the Omnipresent God...
But... we'll be like lambs to the slaughter, won't we? M—Maybe we could put this plan on hold for a while...
There's the sound of Electro zapping in the air... Paimon can barely breathe...
Traveler, are you okay? You're so silent...
It sounds like there's a lot of noise coming from outside Tenshukaku... Has a fight broken out or something?
The guards seem really nervous... Let's go see what the situation is, shall we?

You stumble out of Tenshukaku gloomily. By chance, the resistance forces have broken through the leaderless Shogunate troops, arriving beneath Tenshukaku. Having not met them in some time, you step forward, but just then, the Raiden Shogun appears behind you, unleashing her legendary Musou no Hitotachi. Just as it seems that divine punishment will be meted out, the Masterless Vision Kazuha carries crackles to life. Wielding his sword, he meets — and miraculously blocks — that strike head-on. Encouraged by his bravery, the resistance troops charge at the Raiden shogun, and the Visions inlaid upon the Statue of the Omnipresent God glow in response to their former masters' courage. Yet you know that their valiant effort will not avail them against the Raiden Shogun and that this may yet be the moment to execute Yae Miko's plan, and so you turn to strike the Shogun. As expected, the Plane of Euthymia opens before you once more...
＊ Talk to the Raiden Shogun within the Plane of Euthymia
Indulge my curiosity. What is the reason that I find you standing here before me once again?
Do you hope your foolhardiness will shelter those people? Or... was it simply a means of seeking an audience with me?
The Fatui have deceived the Raiden Shogun.
The Vision Hunt Decree should never have existed.
Oh? Surely you didn't rouse me from my state of eternal meditation only to tell me this?
If so, then you underestimate me. I am quite well-informed about the Vision Hunt Decree.
You know everything that's going on outside?
Not so. Only everything that pertains to eternity.
The Vision Hunt Decree has my tacit approval.
The Fatui's actions thus far do not constitute a threat to eternity, otherwise... they would have been purged long ago.
But the Vision Hunt Decree is damaging.
It comes at a great cost to the people of Inazuma.
Individual ambition is inherently incompatible with eternity.
What you might not realize is that all too often... people have far more to lose by chasing their dreams.
Consider this — no one will lose their life on account of having their Vision taken away...
Rather, those who have lost their lives are the ones who insisted on pursuing their own aspirations, are they not?
Traveler, your existence is unique in my eyes.
There seems to be limitless uncertainty in you. To put it another way, you are the furthest thing from eternity.
So I won't insist that you comprehend the meaning of my actions. What matters is that I tread the path of eternity on my people's behalf.
This is your Plane of Euthymia...
It is created by your consciousness, yes?
That's right. I'm surprised you understand it so well...
Anyway. You're looking for a chance to shake my will... aren't you?
I'm not here to debate your ideas.
So be it. Well then, you who would defy eternity... Time for you to enlighten me.

Once again, you face off against the Electro Archon. It is also at this moment that Yae Miko — with the aid of the omamori given to you — appears in the Plane of Euthymia. With her help, you begin to sense the thousands and thousands of wishes that have already gathered within you...
Why can you not trust your people, and in the power of their ambitions?
These ambitions have transcended space and time. They are something that no one can snuff out.
When people move forward with all their might...
They can surpass the gods' expectations.
And even take over the work of the gods.
Is this the lesson you learned from your journey in Liyue?
There are nations where humans cast their god aside and stride forward...?
So, are we to just abandon the notion of progress... for the sake of wishful thinking?
...You and I have both witnessed the great loss that progress can bring.
Eternity... eternity is the only way...

Ei explains her past and the origin of her pursuit of Eternity. She was once a kagemusha who followed the previous Shogun, in whom she trusted. But each instance of progress came alongside loss, until at last, even the previous Shogun ceased to be. Ei thus turned away from "transience," which the previous Shogun had believed in, seeing "eternity" as the path that Inazuma should take instead.
The Heavenly Principles... Irrelevant nonsense as far as I am concerned.
When all's said and done, all you really want is to protect your beloved Inazuma, forever and ever. Isn't that right?
That would be something of an oversimplification.
But is this nation worth existing for eternity?
Stripped of ambitions, stripped of the potential for change, it does nothing more than simply... exist. It is a hollow shell of a nation.
Huh. I wonder what loss would it really be to anyone if such a nation were destroyed?
Never-changing eternity is the promise I made to my people.
But what your people need from you is not your promises. They want your attention... your divine gaze.
Humans have a lifespan of barely a hundred years. They cannot afford to bear any extra losses.
But I have experienced it all. That is why I have chosen to guide them along the correct path toward eternity.
But eternity is far too cruel a fate for you, Ei.
Not only have you stopped paying attention to the world, but you have stopped paying attention to yourself.
It must have been terribly lonely here, all alone, for centuries on end.
You will miss much by refusing progress... You seek to prevent loss, but have you considered all you are losing by remaining here in stasis for all eternity?
You are obviously lonely, and yet for the sake of eternity you choose to stretch your loneliness out to infinity...
Tell me this. Why is the sky here that was once so dark glowing again? Why now?
This is your Plane of Euthymia. It's your inner world.
So it can only mean... that you are happy to see me again. You have found the loneliness here unbearable for a long time now, haven't you?
I... have nothing to say to that.
Hehehe, oh, but I have so much to say to you. Let me tell you all that has happened over the last few centuries.
As a fox envoy, I have an excellent memory. I recall every detail of the last few centuries with perfect clarity.
So it will probably take me another few centuries to relay it to you.
Heh... hehe... Miko, I never thought I would have the chance to meet with you like this again.
*sigh* Seeing you again is a change to eternity... and a very nice surprise.
Hehe, since you are willing to admit that, I suppose that means we can still be friends?
What a childish conversation this is.
Anyway. Now that I have been defeated by you and your plan, I will honor your wish to abolish the Vision Hunt Decree.
But with regards to eternity and the question of whether this nation should move forward, I need time to give it some thought.
Hehe, you are the one who's been acting like a child from the very beginning.

Finally, the people's wishes penetrated the Raiden Shogun's locked heart. As promised, she abolished the Vision Hunt Decree. Beyond the Plane of Euthymia, she saw what eternity means in the eyes of the world. Some ambitions have the power to heal wounds... to bring victory... to inspire hope. But some ambitions outlive their masters, long after the soul ascends. They remain as they were in the beginning, burning bright and true... for all eternity.
So what did you guys do in the Raiden Shogun's Plane of Euthymia anyway?
Is the Vision Hunt Decree abolished?
It was all thanks to Yae Miko.
We conveyed the wishes of the people.
Oh, gotcha... Paimon was super worried, y'know.
So maybe the reason Yae Miko is looking for us now is 'cause she wants to thank us? Let's go find her.

title: 千手百眼，天下人间·千手百眼

CHS: 我原以为你无法超越过去，看来我还是太过武断，轻视了你的灵魂。
永不磨损的意志，终究是无法拥抱未来啊。
你无需担忧未来，也无需独自前行。
我最懂得你的强大，若只凭我一己之力，这场决斗的败者必然是我。
然而出刀的理由，决定了武艺的格局与极限。我所背负的是投向天光的万千视线。
每思及此，我就能感觉到这把「梦想一心」中传来的异动。
这把从真手里接过的刀，像是在试图提醒我…激励我。
我也感觉到了，方才激战中，它似乎释放出了全新的力量。
这份力量，甚至在我的认知之外。
这是真的佩刀。可能在我真正理解并认同她的时候，刀才会全力回应我。
握紧「梦想一心」，让我有了与她再次并肩的感觉。
熟悉而又陌生…从不挥刀的她，始终在我身旁。
你崭新的意志并非源于磨损。我不会再阻碍你试图修改法则的行为。
从今往后，此身依然是你的协助者。
我不会再设下什么绝不容更改的法则了。
你曾代表我的过去，但从今天起，你——就是我。
真从没把我当成无惧无畏的武器，我也不该将你视为工具。
…呵，你真的变了。这就是人类常说的「成长」吧。
我明白了，我会成为你的影子，就像你曾经是真的影子一样。
我将履行的职责不会改变。
但作为武者，我很期待以后还有像这样战斗的机会。
单论胜负本身，你仍心有不甘，是吗？
只是从来没有过这样的感觉，很新奇，值得回味。
打完了？这就算，全部结束了吗？
你们好啊，影，还有在此的见证者们。
我是雷电真，没能尽到职责的前代雷神，为你们留下了无数的麻烦。
我很开心，我知道如果是你的话，一定能走到这一步。
我在「梦想一心」中留下了些许微弱的意志，你发挥出它所有力量的那一刻，我也会被释放出来。
至于为什么要用如此迂回的方法——因为那时的你深信自己的想法，什么都听不进去嘛。
可我没有时间等待你回心转意。请原谅，我只能以这种方式等待你的归来。
但你从未向我提起这些…
一切来得太过突然…抱歉。
我一直觉得很愧疚，突然就将稻妻托付给了你。
这些道理，本应由我循序渐进地传授给你，让你不再执着于「无想」。
那时你就感知到坎瑞亚即将发生的事了吗？
嗯，多少有点吧。无论是对于哪位尘世执政来说，「那边」都是不容忽视的存在。
现在的我已经无法感知到时间了。我不知道我们阔别多久才重逢，也不知道在此期间稻妻经历了什么。
但我知道，你一定走过了极其艰难的路，一定有许多次想要落泪，对吧？
我考虑到这种可能性，才特地为你留下一份礼物，以缓解稻妻的痛苦。
来吧，在我最后的意识消逝前，收下它。
不过，最重要的一步还是要由你亲手…
EN: This is the end. You have won.
I believed you were incapable of transcending the past. But it seems my belief was baseless and I underestimated your spirit.
But a will that cannot be eroded has no way to embrace the future.
You need not worry about the future, and you aren't alone.
I know your power more than anyone else. Had I relied upon my strength alone, I would have lost this duel for sure.
Yet my reason for fighting redefined my martial prowess and redrew my limits. I now carry the gaze of the myriad of expectant eyes that look to the light in the heavens.
And whenever I think of this, I feel something stirring within Musou Isshin.
The blade that I inherited from Makoto seems to be trying to guide me... to encourage me.
I noticed it also. Just now, in the heat of battle, it seemed to unleash a new and unfamiliar power.
This power is beyond the limits of my understanding.
This blade belonged to Makoto. Perhaps it can only respond to me with its full power when I truly understand and believe in her.
When I clasped Musou Isshin in my hands, I had the feeling that she was by my side once again.
It was at once a familiar feeling and a strange one... Makoto barely wielded a blade in her life, and yet her blade brings me closer to her.
Your present will is not the product of erosion. I shall no longer stop you from attempting to modify the rules.
From this day forth, this body will remain your assistant.
I won't design any more rules that can never be changed.
You used to represent my past, but from today onward, you are me.
Makoto never saw me as a fearless weapon. Likewise, I should not regard you as a mere tool.
...Heh, you truly have changed. I suppose this is what humans call "growth."
I understand. I shall become your shadow, just as you were once Makoto's shadow.
The duties I perform will not change.
But as a warrior, I look forward to the chance to fight like this again in the future.
Do you say this because you have not yet reconciled yourself with your defeat?
It was simply a new experience for me. One that is worth reliving.
Have you finished fighting, then? Like, for real this time?
Hello Ei, and greetings, those who have come to bear witness.
I am Raiden Makoto, the previous Electro Archon, who failed in my duties and left you all to pick up the pieces.
I'm so happy. You've come so far. I always knew you would make it here in the end.
I left a faint fragment of my will in Musou Isshin, so that in the moment that you unleashed its full power, I too would be released.
A convoluted way to reach you, but... Well, you held such deeply entrenched views at the time that you wouldn't have listened to a word I said.
There was no time to wait for you to have a change of heart. Please forgive me... All I could do was find some way to wait until you came to me.
But you never mentioned this to me...
Everything happened so suddenly... I'm sorry.
I've always felt terrible for having to entrust Inazuma to you all of a sudden.
I should have been the one to impart these ideas to you a little at a time, to dissuade you from your pursuit of stillness.
Did you know what was about to happen in Khaenri'ah?
I had some sense of it. That place... was not somewhere that any archon could afford to ignore.
In my present form, I can no longer perceive time. I don't know how long we have been separated before this reunion, and I don't know what Inazuma has experienced in the meantime.
But I know that this must have been an extremely arduous journey for you... and I'm sure you must have wanted to shed tears many times along the way.
It was with this possibility in mind that I left a parting gift for you... something to soothe Inazuma's pain.
Here, take it. Before my last shred of consciousness fades away.
But it is you who must take the most important step...

title: 天下人之章·须臾百梦·熠熠生辉之樱

CHS: 离开意识空间返回神社后，你们向八重神子讲述了一切…
如今的影亲手在意识空间里种下神樱树，它在过去的稻妻发了芽…
无论怎么想，都是不可思议的事呢。
这些都归功于真的力量。对于永恒，她的理解比我更深。
「永恒」是与时间息息相关的概念。一旦触及永恒，时间的概念就会变得模糊。
进入空间时我看到了奇妙的景象。
时间既在前进，又在后退。
时间本身不具有意义，也无法以常理诠释…原来，这就是我感受到的「湍流」。
或许，这正是你们能顺利返回这个时间节点的原因。
不过，那种紊乱感已经完全消失了。
我还不能完全理解。但直觉告诉我，一切的根源…就是那颗种子。
我倒觉得，只靠真的力量，或许…
我明白你在想什么。或许真有「更高层次的力量」参与其中。但无论如何，她的这个办法在最后关头保护了我们所有人。
要是没有神樱树，稻妻可能早在几百年前就被灾难与污秽完全吞没了。
我知道你对神樱树有奇妙的感知，可对我来说，神樱树一直都存在。
以前你还想向我证明这棵神樱树与真的意识空间存在关联，可惜没能成功，对吧？
嗯，现在我明白了。因为那个时候神樱树甚至都还没有被种下去。
可是，你们不觉得那棵树跟现在这副样子差别很大吗？
神樱树可是种在我的地盘里，当然要根据我的趣味进行修剪啦。
开玩笑的。发芽至今，这棵树也经历了很多。多亏狐狸的悉心照料，它才能有如今这副模样。
和我也不是完全无关的哦。
你们离开又再次进入空间，按理说间隔很短，可内部的恶战已经持续了几百年，没错吧？
如果我没猜错…旅行者，你一定像我说的，一直默念着心中的愿望吧？
那时我感知到影的所在地，也同样察觉到内部的「时间」有异常。
如果「时间」也是我们追寻所求之物的要素之一，那只知道「位置」是不够的。
不过幸好，凭借你们顽强的意志，湍流带你们去到的，正是一切心愿汇聚的时间交点——最具有可能性的那个瞬间。
湍流的走向或许受到了真的影响，但能帮到影，每个人的努力都不可或缺。这一次确实要谢谢你们呢。
难道说，我们碰上那场决战不是偶然，而是我们一定会遇到、见证的场面…
我本以为，空间内外的时间流动一致，所以旅行者再度出现，令我非常震惊。
那一刻我首先想到，「莫非稻妻遭遇了巨大的灾难？」
结果原来是你想要救我…你们为我而来，帮助我迎来了最好的结局。
多谢二位。你们为我做了许多，我铭记在心。
身体完全恢复了，将军的意志不再和我对抗。
身体当然很重要啦，但我更想知道，你的心情平复了吗？
你见到真的意识了，对吧。
只是听到了她的声音，不算是见到…
没关系，有点怀念而已。我已经决定向前了。
但这一次又让我坚信，真确实很厉害，她在那时就预料到了稻妻未来的种种可能。
甚至，连我的这份不成熟，都被她计算在内。
稻妻能迎来今天，也是她的功劳吧。
我只是种了一颗种子而已。
你和她的意志，缺一不可。
对啊！你是凭自己的本事回到她面前的，很厉害了！
直到今天，你和稻妻才真正从几百年前的阴影中完全走出来。
真和你，是稻妻不可或缺的「过去」与「未来」。
难得从你这里听到安慰的话，我也收下了。
哎呀，那不还是因为以前的你根本听不进去嘛。
真的吗？那将军的位置，是不是也可以给我坐两天呢？
算了算了，这种麻烦事我才不要。
玩笑就到此为止。接下来，我还有很多事要做。
我会和将军一起仔细审视如今的稻妻，整理现状，斟酌未来。
随后…我将下令解除锁国。
真的吗？这是不得了的大事呀！
我已决定不再追逐静止的「永恒」。既然如此，没必要再封锁这个国度。
接下来，稻妻一定会面临更多挑战…
却是由无数努力积淀而成。
EN: After leaving the realm of consciousness and returning to the shrine, you relay everything to Yae Miko...
So the Ei of the present planted the Sacred Sakura in the realm of consciousness, and it took root in the Inazuma of the past...
No matter what you make of it, it's quite incredible.
All of this is thanks to Makoto's power. Her understanding of eternity is much more profound than mine.
Eternity is a concept intimately connected with time. When you begin to touch on eternity, the concept of time becomes murky.
I saw wonderful things inside that place.
Time was moving forward and backward at the same time.
A place where time is meaningless and cannot be understood with ordinary logic... So, that was the "turbulence" I was sensing.
Perhaps that is the reason why you were able to return precisely to this point in time without any problems.
And yet, that sense of disorderliness has now completely disappeared.
I don't fully understand yet. But my intuition tells me that the reason for everything... it's that seed.
Hmm, well I'm not convinced that it was Makoto's power alone...
I know what you mean. Perhaps a higher power really was involved in all of this. But whatever the explanation, her solution is what saved us all.
Without the Sacred Sakura, Inazuma would likely have been completely swallowed up centuries ago by that disaster and the filth.
I know you've always perceived there was something special about the Sacred Sakura. But to me, it has always been there.
You've tried in the past to prove to me that there is a connection between the Sacred Sakura and Makoto's consciousness. But unfortunately, you never did persuade me, did you?
No, but I understand why now. It was because the Sacred Sakura hadn't even been planted then.
Umm, but don't you think that tree looked a lot different than how it does now?
The Sacred Sakura is within my purview at the shrine, so obviously I get to prune it exactly how I like it.
Ugh... Now we see who's pulling the strings...
I'm joking. That tree has been through a lot since it first sprouted. We have the loving care of kitsune over the ages to thank for how it appears today.
And obviously I played my part, too.

It's fair to say that very little time passed between the moment you came out of that realm and the moment you re-entered it. But in that same time, centuries of battling took place on the inside, did it not?
Traveler, if I'm guessing correctly... You were repeating your wishes to yourself in your mind, weren't you?
At that time, I could sense Ei's whereabouts, but I also sensed anomalies in the flow of time within that space.
Suffice to say, time added a whole new dimension to our search. Simply establishing a location was not sufficient.
Fortunately, your will was strong enough that the turbulence carried you to the moment in time most likely to be the intersection of all that you were wishing for.
The flow of turbulence may well have been influenced by Makoto. But it took everyone's efforts combined to ultimately help Ei. So this time, it looks like thanks are due to you.
Does that mean... it wasn't by chance that we ended up at the final duel? We were always meant to be there to witness what was going to happen?
Perhaps this is what the Shogun meant by...
I thought that the flow of time was the same on the inside and the outside. So it was a great shock to me when the Traveler re-appeared.
My first thought was, "Has a great disaster befallen Inazuma?"
But it turned out you had come to rescue me... You came for my sake, to help me reach the best possible outcome.
You two have my thanks. You have done much for me, and I will never forget it.
Ei, how are you feeling now?
My body has fully recovered, and the Shogun's will no longer fights against me.
Always thrilled to hear you're in good health. But I was really asking about your emotions. Have you managed to calm down?
After all, you saw Makoto in there, didn't you?
I only heard her voice. I wouldn't say I saw her...
I'll be fine. It brought a few things back, of course. But I've made my decision to move forward.
I have to say, this has reminded me once again just how brilliant Makoto was. She predicted all the ways in which Inazuma's future could unfold all the way back then.
She even factored my immaturity into her plan.
It's all thanks to her that Inazuma lived to see this day.
Your will and hers were both indispensable.
Yeah! It was thanks to everything you did that you got to see her again. That's amazing!
The final act might be a simple one.
Just because the cause and effect ended up a bit back-to-front...
Today, at long last, you and Inazuma finally emerge from the shadows cast by the events of centuries past.
Makoto and you are Inazuma's past and future, and both are indispensable.
It's rare to hear such comforting words from you. I graciously accept them.
Oh, come on, you only think it's rare because you never used to listen to a word I say.
Makoto said the exact same thing.
Great minds think alike, hmm? I wonder, does that qualify me to, maybe, take the position of Shogun for a couple of days?
Actually, no — forget that. Far more trouble than it's worth.
We will have to end the frivolities there. There is much work to be done.
The Shogun and I will closely review the Inazuma of today to find out where things currently stand. Then, we will give careful consideration to the future.
After that... I will abolish the Sakoku Decree.
I am no longer pursuing an eternity defined by stasis. In which case, there is no further need to keep the nation under lock and key.
I don't doubt that many challenges lie ahead for Inazuma...
But out of those challenges will be born new opportunities.
...doesn't mean you should undervalue the part you played.
But getting there was the result of countless efforts coming together.
But Ei, you made a crucial contribution, too.

title: 天下人之章·须臾百梦·熠熠生辉之樱

CHS: 一只披着野狐皮毛的怪兽混入到狐群中。它们日夜作伴，以朋友互称，相处良好。
偶尔，怪兽也会在夜里脱下狐狸皮，对着水中的自己哀叹：我这样怪异，它们却笨得看不透真相，实在可惜。
不过很快怪兽便释怀了，因为狐群中的异类不只有它，还有一只白色树木雕刻出来，遭人遗弃的小猫。
小猫也想变成狐狸，但它尾巴太细小，又长不出富有色彩的皮毛。其他狐狸见了，安慰道：就算如此，你也是我们的同伴。
怪兽厌恶这种美满，在山中点起一把火。动物们异常惊慌。为了扑灭大火，它们必须做出牺牲。
一只灰色的狐狸站起来，与怪兽交谈。它说：你是如此聪明，一定能想到帮助我们的办法。
怪兽笑着将灰狐狸带到火边，杀死了它。灰狐狸的心被制成一颗剔透美丽、纤尘不染的水珠。
怪兽将那颗水珠交给小猫，告诉它：大家已经想好让你牺牲了。带上这个，去为你的狐狸同伴而死吧。
大火被扑灭了。小猫离开那里，与一只折断翅膀的小鸟共同生活。
它们说好要相依为命，可小鸟的寿命太短，一下就没了呼吸。小猫埋葬它之后，便离开了那座山。
…它再也没有爱过山中任何一片树叶与任何一只动物。它流浪在每一个夜晚，对着月光磨牙。
它要吞下月亮，嚼碎所有月光。只要一切回归黑暗，它就感到快乐安心。
「我会成为新的月亮，成为大家的唯一。这样谁都不会知道世上原本有鸟、狐与猫，更不会知道它们有所区别。」
我都想起来了。我竭尽全力保留的备份里，是散兵自己的记忆。
为了成为神明，他接受了大量试验和改造。因为是人偶，才能在那样严苛的过程里坚持下来。
这份记忆就是当时学者们从他身上抽取出来的，或许他们留下这些是为了防备散兵…
创造神只是第一步，还有人想操控神。所以他们才要备份他的记忆，留待后用。
我将那些保存在自己的深梦之中，又在外部包上一层被转写过的故事，这样才能使它不被篡改。
竟然真的有过这样的人…他、他明明跟我们见过那么多次面，老是跟我们作对…
可是，我却完全忘记了他，他就像一阵烟似的，好像从来没有存在过…
散兵答应帮我搜寻有关降临者的信息，虽说这方面没有收获，可他还是帮到了你。
消失前他留下了最重要的线索，让你知道你的血亲曾降临在坎瑞亚。
只是我们还不清楚世界树内信息变动会对愚人众上层造成多少影响…他们很可能不会记得组织内曾有过这位执行官。
听你说的，我并不喜欢那个人，可这个结局我也不喜欢。
这正是为什么智慧无法解答所有的问题。我们仰视，我们认知，我们懂得，我们依然困于问题。
答案不是唯一…世间生命所渴望的，总是追逐真相、解决困难。
将真相还给一个人，等于把命运的选择权交还给他。
在旁人看来或许有些徒劳，不过，能像这样顺着自身意愿消失，对他而言，一定有其意义。
请不要忘了，即使在黑暗的云层下行走，沿途诸多苦难，智慧的灯火仍会指引我们与好的结果相见。
而这正是你一直在做的。
嗯，纳西妲说得对，打起精神来呀。或者我们先去吃点东西，等会儿再讨论这个沉重的话题吧！
是个好办法呢，那就拜托派蒙带旅行者外出散散心了，可以吗？
包在我身上！好啦，我知道你心情很复杂，先到外面走走吧。
生命的重量比不上一片羽毛。
EN: There once was a lone monster draped in fox fur. The monster found a family of foxes, joined them, and they became friends. The monster lived with the family, day and night, and everyone treated it as one of their own.

Once in a while, the monster would take off its fox fur at night, and lament to itself as it gazed at its reflection in the water: "I am a monstrosity, yet they are too foolish to see it... I pity them."
But the monster soon found solace when another came to live among the foxes who was not their kin: a kitten, carved from the wood of a white tree, who had been abandoned by the humans.

The kitten, too, wished to become a fox, but its tail was too slender and it could not grow a coat of richly colored fur. Yet when the other foxes saw this, they spoke words of comfort to the kitten: "Even without a tail and fur like ours, you are still one of us."
Furious at this happy resolution, the monster lit a fire on the mountain. The terrified animals panicked as the fire spread. The only way to extinguish the flames was to make a sacrifice.
A gray fox stood up and addressed the monster. It said: "You are the cleverest among us. Surely you can help us find a way to solve this."
The monster smiled, led the fox toward the fire... and murdered it. The gray fox's heart was turned into a beautiful drop of water, clear, spotless, and pure.
The monster gave the heart of water to the kitten, telling him: "The foxes have decided. You are the one who must be sacrificed. Take this, quench the flames, and die for your fox kin."
The fire was extinguished, but the kitten lived. It left that side of the mountain and found a little bird who had a broken wing.

The two promised they would spend their whole lives together, but the little bird did not have long left to live. It passed away soon after. After burying the bird, the kitten left the mountain for good.
...Never again would it cherish a single creature, nor a single blade of grass that stood on that mountain. The kitten spent the nights wandering aimlessly, gnashing its teeth at the moon.
How it wished to swallow the moon and devour the moonlight. If the world could only return to darkness, then it would finally be peaceful and content.
"I will become the new moon, the answer to everything. Then, no one will know that there were once birds, foxes, and cats in this world. And no one can know that they were different."
I remember now. This is not just The Balladeer's story... it is his very own memories. I made a backup so that it would be preserved, no matter what happened.
To become a god, he was experimented on and modified countless times. It was brutal torture, and the only reason he was able to survive is that he was a puppet.
This memory was extracted from him by the scholars. Presumably, they kept it to have something to defend themselves with...
Creating a deity was just the first step. Some of them wanted to be able to control it. That's why they backed up his memory for later use.
I buried it deep inside one of my own dreams, and then hid it inside an allegorical story so that it wouldn't be altered.
It's hard to believe that this person really existed, let alone that he tried to... get rid of us on more than one occasion...
Paimon has no memory of him at all. He completely vanished, like a puff of smoke...
The Balladeer agreed to help me look for information about the Descenders, and although he was unsuccessful, he still helped you.
Before he vanished, he confirmed an important detail: that Khaenri'ah was where your twin first came into this world.
...We still don't know how the change to Irminsul will affect the senior ranks of the Fatui, but in all likelihood, they won't even remember their own Harbinger.
I've never had this feeling before...
It sounds like Paimon wouldn't like this guy a whole lot if he was still around. But still, Paimon doesn't like the way it all ended that much better.
This is why wisdom alone cannot answer all our questions. We look, we see, and we comprehend, but the question still troubles us.
So the answer is not everything. People yearn to find the truth and then conquer the troubles they face.
When you give someone the truth, you give them a chance to choose their own destiny.
To others looking on, this may seem like a pointless endeavor. But for him, the chance to act on his desire to disappear must have meant a lot.
Never forget that even when we walk beneath dark clouds along a road filled with suffering, the light of wisdom is always there, guiding us toward a better destination.
And that is what you have been doing all along.
Yeah, Nahida's right. Cheer up! How about we go get something to eat? We can pick up this heavy conversation again later!
Good idea. Paimon, why don't you take him/her out for a walk to clear his/her head?
You got it! C'mon, 旅行者, you need to get out of your head for a while. You'll feel much better after taking a walk.
...It feels like life is as insignificant as a feather.

title: 倾落伽蓝·幕切——倾奇之末

heading: 倾落伽蓝 · 如朝露一般

CHS: 欢迎回来，旅行者，派蒙，散兵。
呼！感觉经历了很长的旅途…累死我了。
莫非你是对这个名字感到不满？
没什么。只是在想，我也该换个名字了。
明知「博士」做了那么多事，我怎么可能继续采用跟他有关的称号。
我不打算也不可能回到愚人众那边。一定有许多人被这次的事影响，未必还能记得第六席是谁。
意思是你要脱离组织了？
正如你所说，小吉祥草王。一切看似徒劳，但并非没有意义，至少能让不少人忘记我。
可那也不意味着你身上的往事就此消失。
另外，你倾尽全力去追求的事，它最核心的目的…并没能达成，这一点还请你明白。
改变世界、改变过去…改变他人命运，并不是那么容易的。
你所渴望的答案是极致的毁灭…它本质是虚妄。即便世上再没有「散兵」，世界也不会遵循你的意志而动。
为这样的结果做到这种地步…不会后悔吗？
哪怕我一文不值，世上也从来没有值得后悔的事。
小吉祥草王，世界树里的信息，是你故意留在那里的吧。
为了让你尽可能自然地收获信息，我也费了不少心思呢。
为什么不惜做到这一步？你也想拉拢我吗？
必须诚实地说，过去的经历使你成为了一个对我和须弥有用的个体。拉拢你的确是我计划的一部分。
但在那之前，我想把过去的真相告诉你。如果只是利用，我就与「博士」毫无分别了。
这大概是我应具有的美德吧。
对他人有用就是价值。所以即使身为罪人，我也重新拥有了被利用的理由。
纳西妲并不是那么想的。
噢对，差点忘了…你们是「正义」的一方，与我不同。
不好意思，我看待事物的角度略有不同。但我不会称这一切为算计，你的智慧注定了你会拥有更好的帮手。
旅行者，未来我还会进一步研究并挖掘世界树里深藏的秘密。
包括你血亲被记录在世界树中的旅程之始。前后究竟还有什么？我也想知道呢。
那就拜托你为我寻找了。
为什么在我跳进世界树的信息洪流之后，你就去了稻妻？
因为我想知道你改变了什么。
…所以才打听到了那些人被改变后的命运吗。
不管怎么说，你帮了我的忙，这份恩情我都会尽力偿还。
请不要说得像是我在勒索你。
个体与个体之间只存在「借」和「还」的关系。我们迟早会两清，你不需要在意。
不是这样的哦。人与人的关系，绝不是轻易就能抚回原状的白纸。
你一定感受过。生命中出现过的人不会像水滴蒸发一样消失，世上不存在真正的「两清」。
正因为有些事不能挽回也不能改变，人间才会有情感。
你感受的所有东西都是真实，你欠下的事物也不会被弥补。
背负裂痕生活下去是人的行为。你可以选择是否成为人。
没有缺失心脏的人类，不是吗？再说，我早就不想成为人类了。
没有心脏的你依然能理解痛苦。你只是封闭了感情。
过去不会被撼动，但你可以继续走。只要未来的线够长，总有一天「过去」会变成比例尺上很短小的一段。
听起来，你已经想好怎么安排我了。
很多事情混在一起，都说不清楚了，反正最重要的是，你最好跟随纳西妲，否则我们为什么要做这么多嘛！
…那就让我作为黑暗中的助力与你们同在吧。
很高兴你能接受我们的提议。为表庆祝，不如给自己起个新名字吧？
快快快，我也要给你起个难听的绰号！
因为…因为我还是不怎么喜欢你呀！
哼。那以后我们最好不要经常见面。
「名字是人生第一份馈赠」——虽然你没明说，但我知道你是这么想的。
这次旅行者和派蒙帮了你不少忙，假如你无法决定要叫什么名字，可以问问他们的意见。
不行，我只会起绰号，不会起正经名字…交给你了！
这么一来，你也是有名字的人了哦。
慢慢想。在你想好之前，我们暂时不必见面。
那些构陷我令我陷入不幸的人，迟早都会付出代价。
立场变化了呢，相信未来你的道路也会因此改变。但不是现在…你还需要一些时间来整理自己。
如今稻妻还有一些雷电五传的后人。他们中有人知道…或者说，本该知道我与雷电五传的关系。
我暂时不打算离开须弥，假如你在稻妻遇见他们，大可以告诉他们，我就是令雷电五传陨落的凶手。
…哪怕这件事已经从世界上抹除，他们也应该得到真相。
原来如此…这是你的选择。
没什么，只要他们愿意，大可以用刀子捅进我的胸膛。…说不定本来就该是那样。
你那是什么眼神？不用露出这种表情，我知道自己在做什么。
再会了，贤明的神，还有你们。
最近发生的事对他而言，简直像是突然过完了一生。任何人都需要时间来平复心情吧。
唔，也是。虽然他还是那样，但语气变得不那么激烈了呢。
这下我们总算可以去吃饭了吧？我都快饿死了！
辛苦你们了，请找一个令人放松的地方尽情休息一会儿。
我想好了！小说的结尾可以放在御舆长正身上。
