Wait just a moment! Do you mind me asking a few questions? You know, about how you felt before the duel, about what it was like facing down a god... There's lots of exciting material there, I'd bet!
Forget it. I'm sure you can find a better theme than that, Miss Charlotte.
Ugh, I see you're the same as always... Couldn't you do me a favor, for Navia's sake?
Well, if we're talking about doing things for my sake, you might as well just take a few more photos of me — or of 旅行者! It's better than wasting time persuading Clorinde, at any rate.
Of course I will — I'm not gonna let him/her off that easy. Alright! Then everyone who wants to be in the photo gather up... and smile!
How did it go? Was it a good shot? Did Paimon look cute in it?
Not bad. Your addition really helped the composition of the picture... Alright, hang on a moment, let me snap a few more shots...
Charlotte takes more pictures of Poisson to the clicking of shutters, and also does some rapid-fire resident interviews...
Alright, that should do it. I'll be back here later, anyway, so let's call it a day.
Speed is of the essence when it comes to the news, and freshness is the key!
Also, not to brag, but I'm pretty good at building connections. Who knows, I might eventually get that interview with you after all, Miss Clorinde.
Wow, you really do have that never-say-die spirit. I'm impressed.
I'll hazard a guess that this is how you got that interview at the Fortress of Meropide.
You already knew she was going?
Whoa, you're well-informed. Let me make a guess, too. I asked Sigewinne, who told Monsieur Neuvillette, and he told you, right?
That's a... very complete information chain.
In truth, all Monsieur Neuvillette asked me was "When did the Fortress become so friendly towards the media?"
I told him that it was best not to speak too soon — there's no guarantee that Wriothesley will make a personal appearance.
You're right. I've gotta treasure every moment I have with them — in which case, I'll be making a move first!
Stay safe, now! And tell me if you hear anything interesting — I'll treat you to afternoon tea in exchange!
Wow, guess we're here again, huh? There's a real nostalgic feeling to this place.
Looks like you've been missing us.
Duke! Did you come all the way to the entrance to greet us?
Of course. I'm here to welcome you and our dear Miss Charlotte, whom our good Head Nurse recommended to me.
It's an honor to finally meet the much rumored Duke. Thank you for consenting to my visit to the Fortress, sir.
No need to thank me — but that said, I shouldn't be the focus of your interview. I trust you recall our agreement?
Hmm? Hey, no need to be so nervous. I've already taken all the photos we need.
Um... Miss Charlotte... Do these pictures really need to be published on the cover of The Steambird?
It would seem that Miss Lourvine doesn't want her face to appear beside that of Mr. Jurieu, hmm?
Sir, please don't say things like that!
Ah, but it looks like dear Mr. Jurieu denies it. Might this interview be very important to you, then?
No! I—I just... This is my first time being interviewed, and I'm very thankful to The Steambird for...
Haha, now, I might not look it, but I did actually meet Mr. Edwin once, and I'll be honest, I enjoyed chatting with you more — you've definitely got more of that "genius" vibe going on!
The boat that brought about a miracle, the ark that saved the people! Why, you recreated a myth back there, like an emissary of legend!
...Still, if I might ask, where's that flying ship now?
Heh, looks like Charlotte's trying to get herself another exclusive scoop...
I have to apologize, but that ship is presently in the bowels of our factory. I'm afraid it won't be easy for you to get a shot of it.
Really? Then in that case, could I have an interview with you to make up for that loss?
(She really does know how to squeeze opportunities for all they're worth...)
You already know my answer, I'm afraid. Best you interview our Head Nurse instead — or perhaps you'd like to take another photo of this couple of researchers?
Did you really have to use the word "couple"!?
Well, then, two solo photos will do!
Is my hair messed up? Please, someone help me have a look...
Things sure are getting pretty lively here... Uh, we've seen this kind of thing before...
Ooh, seems like everyone's here! Would any of you like to try this new drink I came up with...
Ah, uh — Hey, Miss Charlotte! Why don't you, ah, take some pretty photos of our Head Nurse?
Hmm? Uh, sure! C'mon, Miss Sigewinne, over this way. Let's find a brighter spot...
Huh? Oh, sure... Do I have to smile?
So, how've things been at the Fortress?
Same old same old, as you can see. Fontaine's undergone some changes, but this place's still more or less the same.
Other than that flying ship. It got a tad too much attention, I think...
That's why I decided to let the interview go through. We should direct more public opinions toward the behind-the-scenes heroes — am I right, Mr. Jurieu? Miss Lourvine?
You're too kind, sir. I believe that you, too, should have your day in the sun — not that you would want that, which is a pity.
Hahaha, I'll just leave the spotlight to you two.
You walk with Wriothesley for a while and share news from above ground with him...
I see. Lots of things happened that day, huh? Anyway, regarding that Harbinger, I'm not sure you remember, but his three young followers are still waiting for his return.
He sure did win them over, huh...
I'll tell them that there's good news and bad news — the good being that their boss seems fine, and the bad being that they must face extended sentences for abetting his escape.
Oh, actually, what about you? Are things gonna change for you, too?
What change can there be? The Fortress will keep chugging along, and so will my duties.
As to what Miss Furina's departure will mean for the nation, and if our laws and governance will be transformed... We'll leave those to the folks in the overworld.
Good. In that case, let's call it a day here.
Thanks for your cooperation. C'mon, 旅行者, let's go. Till next time, everyone!
Maybe! Who knows? I might write a story about the underwater factory next time. Until then!
＊ Talk to Lyney and the others
Paimon sees them! They really are here. How did you know?
Navia mentioned that she stayed in touch with Lyney and the others after working together. Apparently, they've been at the docks distributing these strange pockets the whole time since.
旅行者, Paimon — ah, and Miss Charlotte, too.
Would you like a Magic Pocket?
What sort of gadget is it?

It's a wondrous bag that can be used to carry many things. The water level has returned to normal, but if you see any of your things floating around, you can use this to carry them — or you could trick a friend into doing it for you.
Trick a friend? Huh, I wonder which of my friends would fall for that...?
You could just make a friend like Freminet here. Isn't that right, Freminet?
Is this what you meant by "I'll help you make some more friends"...
To be honest, that sounds pretty sweet! Could I have your contact, please?
Uhh... Oh, um... sure. Please, write down my address.
Lynette sure is working hard to help Freminet socialize...
He was the one who proposed doing this — he even wants to assist in our magic shows.
Sounds like that would suit him.
Yes, I was planning to first introduce Pers as an assistant, and later Freminet himself. In the future, I think we can leave underwater escape magic to him, too.
That said, would anyone want to see a diver escape underwater?
Oh, it'll work out. Every journey begins with a first step — he'll become a part of our show eventually.
Lynette, could you come over? Miss Charlotte says she wants to take a picture of us...
My, that Charlotte is rather perceptive. She got rid of everyone the moment she realized I had something to say to you... So. How've things been, 旅行者?
"Father" says that you did a great deal during the latest events. She's very grateful for your contributions to Fontaine.
Aw, that's alright. We were more than happy to help... So, what's she doing now?
Oh, I guess you haven't heard. Well...
After Lady Furina left, "Father" and Monsieur Neuvillette opened negotiations, during which he gave Fontaine's Gnosis to her as a "diplomatic gift."
Yes. I was quite surprised at first, myself. But when I thought it over, there were actually a number of things going for it...
It could have been done as an apology for the incident with Lord Childe, or as thanks for his help in tying the All-Devouring Narwhal down...
Furthermore, "Father" did also lend significant aid to Fontaine and Poisson.
Well, that's true, but this is a Gnosis we're talking about. Doesn't this seem a bit... irresponsible?
I would agree, but I've also heard that... It seems that Monsieur Neuvillette has had a significant change of heart regarding the matter.
Huh? So there's some reason for this that only Neuvillette knows about?
I suspect you'll have to ask him about that yourself. Ah, yes, speaking of which, I did see him strolling around the entrance to the Fortress of Meropide a while back.
Huh. Isn't he real busy and stuff? Paimon didn't think he'd have the time for that.
But back to the topic, the Gnosis was given to The Knave, right? What about Childe?
They say that he's returned to Snezhnaya to recover from his wounds. I hear that the recent disaster really did a number on his health.
Well, I guess I can now call him one of my "war buddies."
That's true. When you think about it, we've had loads of run-ins with the Fatui. To think we'd be allied with them this time...
So shocked by such a simple switching of sides?

Well, well, what do you know? Come to the docks to see how my children are doing, and meet the Traveler by chance. Please do not pay my accomplishments in Fontaine too much mind. I would have done them regardless.
Are you going to... take the Gnosis back to Snezhnaya?
That is our duty as Harbingers, yes.

Don't be too preoccupied with "sides." The goal of the Fatui concerns not a single place or person, but the entire world. With such a grand goal in mind, it is inevitable that we must wear many masks.
Switching my masks is something I've always done.
Will you keep to your position?
That depends on many things, no one truly knows what the future holds. What good is honesty if you can't rely on it forever?
As for you, I very much look forward to our next collaboration. Good things cannot be achieved alone, and you've proved yourselves to be great partners.
Actually, I just remembered something... Please help us deliver this.
A Vision? ... Ha, alright. I'll remember to return it. Thank you for keeping it safe for him this entire time.
And that's a wrap for me! ...Huh!? You... You're...
Ah, um... Hello. If I'm not mistaken, there are diplomatic channels I'll need to report to to take a photo of you...

That is correct, so forgive me, but I will not be able to serve as a subject in your article. However, feel free to write as much as you'd like about our dear magicians — and our upcoming rookie talent.
The sea breeze is quite pleasant. I shall continue my walk while the weather remains so agreeable. Farewell.

...She has such an intimidating presence... I didn't even dare to take a picture... Thankfully, I've already wrapped up all of my prescheduled interviews. Thank you all — this'll be more than enough for me to write about, I'm sure.
Don't be too nervous. Why don't you take a Magic Pocket before you go? Here, 旅行者, Paimon, you take one too.

That's right. Funny — I was giving out Magic Pockets when we first met, too, and what do you know? I'm doing the exact same thing right now. So many things have happened, but the Pockets are still the Pockets.
I guess this must be "life." We will all follow our own paths, and serendipity will lead you to your fated friends.
Alright then. We'll be handing out pockets in some other districts later, so we'll get going now. Have a good day, you two!
So you really are here, Neuvillette! Paimon didn't think you were going to have free time this hour of the day.
"Really"? Ah, I suppose you must have met Mr. Lyney. He took the time to greet me earlier when he passed this way.
In any case, you came at a good time. I was just considering reaching out to you to set up a meeting, so I may explain some things that I haven't had the time to before.
Aww, Paimon's glad that you remembered! Thank you for keeping us on your mind, what with you being busy and all.
Alright, let's have it, then. How was Fontaine actually saved? That whole business is still quite the mystery to us.
...Hmm. It is strange, how words can often leave a bitter taste in the mouth when it finally comes time to say them out loud.
Neuvillette sighs softly, before telling you the truth concerning what he saw that day...
"Focalors deceived the Heavenly Principles, and used Furina's endless performance to save Fontaine."
I only saw Furina's part, myself.
Focalors destroyed the divine throne of the Hydro Archon and restored your power to you, transforming you into a fully-fledged elemental dragon sovereign...
But Paimon still doesn't quite get what you did to save the Fontainians from dissolving.
For me, the "authority of the ancient dragons" refers to absolute control over the Hydro element.
Fontainians were "incomplete humans" born of Egeria's use of the power of the Primordial Sea, with constitutions similar to that of mimics...

But so long as those primordial energies remain within them, I could use the ancient dragons' authority to grant them true "blood," after the fashion in which life was first brought into being on this planet.
In other words, when I gave my verdict, Fontainians became "true humans," and thus would naturally no longer be dissolved by water from the Primordial Sea.
Focalors must have counted on you to make that decision as well... Your verdict was the key to making the prophecy appear to have come true while saving everyone.
You could say that it was at that moment...
That the Fontainians were finally truly "born."
Yeah, and in a manner of speaking, Focalors finally managed to fulfill the original Hydro Archon's wish to turn Oceanids into real people, too.
It seems, from your expressions, that you still have more things you wish to ask.
Ask away. I will tell you the truth as I know it.
About the initial verdict that was passed on Childe...
About the next stop on my journey...
I have investigated his case along many avenues, and I have learned that he once fell into an unknown chasm when he was young. There, by chance, he awakened the All-Devouring Narwhal.
But, whether it be by sentiment or reason, that should not have been enough to consider him the root cause of the disaster. At most, he would have had tangential liability.
As for the judgment passed by the Oratrice during the trial...
Whether it was due to that liability by association, or Focalors deliberately using him to buy time for us on the assumption that he would be able to hold the creature off... I cannot say.
Guess Focalors had Fontainians in mind the whole time. In the end, it was thanks to her that they finally became real humans...
Uh, hang on a second! Paimon's suddenly got another question.
Back when Fontainians hadn't yet become real humans, were the children they had also transformed Oceanids?
Life has always flowed like water. Do you recall how Fontainians would often come to the Fountain of Lucine to pray for children?
Yeah. Lynette said that the Fountain is where all the waters in Fontaine converge...
In truth, even those couples did not know that such prayers were no mere custom, but instead a form of ritual...
Those Oceanids who were blessed within the spring water would later descend as new humans in the coming months.
Uh... Paimon... sorta gets it now? Either way, seems like this ritual won't be of any further use — but it'll probably live on as a local custom!
Yeah, about that, Wriothesley said Furina has already left. What's that all about?

Ah, Lady Furina... The people are only aware that her death sentence has not been carried out. She abdicated the post of Hydro Archon and left affairs related to that title to me, before leaving the opera house.
I related Focalors' words to her faithfully and completely. After hearing them, she seemed neither saddened nor comforted...
She simply said that... she was tired, and needed to rest.
Having said that, she then packed her things and moved out of the opera house, not unlike how an ordinary person might.
Erm... But she's still got a place to stay, right?
You need not worry. I will make arrangements to ensure that she will not want for food, clothing, board, or travel.
In truth, I am... somewhat happy for her. The wear and tear on her spirit will, of course, take time to heal...
But now that she no longer has to play the role of "Focalors the Hydro Archon," she can finally lay down her burdens and lead a normal life.
What about you, then? What are your plans, now that you've regained your full powers as the Hydro Dragon?
After Focalors passed on, the Oratrice also ceased to function.
This matter will directly affect our trials. After much careful consideration, I've decided to take over its role in our courts. From now on, I shall hear cases and pass verdicts by myself.
Looks like you're still considering stuff from the perspective of the Iudex, huh.
As an elemental dragon, there are indeed many things that I must do. But this power, and this duty... In a manner of speaking, you could say that both were granted to me.

As such, before I attend to my other responsibilities, I must first and foremost continue to serve Fontaine as its highest judge. The duty of the Hydro Sovereign and the duty of the Iudex shall coexist within my person.
Additionally, the Hydro Archon's departure has brought about another problem... Which is that the opera house shall no longer produce Indemnitium.
That's true. That power was derived from the peoples' faith in the Hydro Archon, wasn't it?
Wait. But the various meks and machines in the city are all still okay. Where are they getting their energy from?
As I am now, I have full command over Pneumousia, and it can serve as a complete substitute — another reason why I cannot quite leave Fontaine immediately.
Wow. This ancient dragon's authority stuff is really quite useful, huh?
Ooh, that's right. They say you've given it to The Knave as a "diplomatic gift," or something...
Leaving aside their intentionality, the two Fatui Harbingers have indeed done much for us during this crisis.
Their sole remaining goal in Fontaine, at least at this point, would seem to be the Gnosis.
The Oratrice has ceased to function. The Hydro Archon's divine throne is now no more. And I do not need the Gnosis's power...
As such, it has lost all meaning for Fontaine.
If the Fatui have impure designs, then we might as well accede to their request now... and avoid unnecessary conflict.
Gah, what complicated considerations... Paimon thought you were just giving it to them out of gratitude to The Knave, and as an apology to Childe.
You will soon be heading to Natlan, I presume?
I'm afraid that I have little talent as a travel guide, so all I can do is tell you what I know about that land.
As far as I'm aware, Natlan can be said to be "a nation of dragons."
A nation of dragons? You mean, like you?
No, I suspect that I would not find myself welcome there.
Unlike ancient dragons such as myself, the dragons of Natlan have undergone long years of development and evolution. Large numbers of them have entered a form of coexistence with humanity.
Natlan is also the nation of "war." War ravages those lands like an undying flame.
There is one other piece of information I got incidentally from my negotiations with The Knave that I believe may be useful to you.
...The Harbinger known as The Captain has thrown his hat into the endless ring of war.
"The Captain"... Sounds like a real tough customer. Seriously, everywhere you look, there's a Fatui Harbinger doing their thing!
I suggest that you fully prepare yourself before going to Natlan. In the meantime, Fontaine's doors will always be open to you.
Uh, hang on a sec. Paimon's still got a question about the Gnosis...
When we spoke to Lyney earlier, he mentioned that your attitude towards giving away the Gnosis had clearly changed...
We guessed that there might be some reason for it that only you were aware of...
Hmm. No wonder the House of the Hearth is the Fatui's intelligence division. They are certainly sharp.
So, regarding this specific issue, I was just getting ready to share something with you.
In truth, I exchanged some further words with that lady named Skirk after sending you two back to the surface. It went something like this...
...Well, we're going to head topside to see what's going on. You hurry over soon as well, alright, Neuvillette...
Hmm. The All-Devouring Narwhal isn't here, so I'm no longer getting any interference.
I can finally catch the scent of your power... what it's made of.
It is the authority of the planet's primordial dragons, but with something very similar to a god's "curse" mixed in... It's quite a novel blend.
I'm sure I've encountered something like this before. What was it again...
I do not know what you speak of.
Ah, of course... How could I forget:
You should have the "remains of the Third Descender" on your person, yes?
Remains? I've never heard of any such thing.
Huh... According to your parlance, I believe it may be called a "Gnosis"?
...Well, that much is true. After Focalors' divinity faded, she handed her Gnosis to me.
But I fear I have never heard it described in the manner that you just did.
I've been training with my Master, "The Foul," ever since I was young, and I have never returned to the surface since, so most of the information I possess, I got from him.
It is only natural for those who are greater than humanity to possess a different sort of common sense, which is why there are so many problems in our attempts to communicate with humans.
Regardless, you should probably get rid of objects of "misfortune," to prevent any disasters from befalling you.
To live is in itself a blessing. But once a person dies, the bonds he once had with this world shall all turn to curses.
What do you mean by that?
No need to fret. These are just my... personal thoughts — and my reason for no longer wishing to return to the surface.
This Third Descender you refer to. Who are they? And when did they die?
Master never mentioned them to me. Perhaps it just wasn't that important for me to know.
If you're interested, though, I could ask him. I'll be sure to pass the answer on to you next time.
Next time... You believe we will meet again?
I do... Wait, I have a disciple of my own, don't I? He can be the messenger, then.
...That's what she told me. Whether it would prove useful or not, I wanted to pass that information on to you.
The remains... of the Third Descender?
So that's what the Gnoses actually are? Paimon just thought that they looked like chess pieces. How could they be a person's remains?
All the same, assuming that there was no misunderstanding or special metaphor at play, that is what she meant to say.
And she said that it would bring "misfortune" and that you should chuck it, which is why you gave it to the Fatui...
If she speaks the truth, then I would simply be putting Fontaine at unnecessary risk by keeping it here.
(A Descender... She mentioned one of them...)
For me, this information means two things.
One, that the Gnoses are related to Descenders.
And two, that the one who came before me has already died.
I had guessed that you might already be familiar with this concept, but I did not expect you to be one of them.
That means that the Gnoses, which are exceedingly element-compatible and can even enhance elemental abilities, do indeed come from the Third Descender.
Hmm, I wonder... Does your body also possess similar properties?
Like... Uhh, like being able to use elemental powers without a Vision? That does sorta count as special compatibility, right?
No, no, let's not think about this stuff right now. It just feels creepy...
...Comparing 旅行者 to the dead Third Descender and all...
Don't worry, I won't die so easily.
That's what you say, but this topic still feels like bad luck.
Once Childe recovers, let's get some more answers out of him — or go look for his Master and get the answers that way!
I, too, believe it unwise to make too many blind guesses when information is lacking. The same is true of being at court.
Alright. Whatever the case, it seems like the crisis here in Fontaine's over for now.
Yes. All of Focalors' efforts were for this moment as well.
But... She sacrificed herself in the end as a god, and she suffered through all those years as a human... Was that really what she wanted?
...I suppose that would be the mystery of a god's will.
Can you understand the will of the gods?
I suspect not. But once in a while, I too would guess that if wishes were like the clouds in the sky, they will one day return to the earth as raindrops...
Life flows like water, and rain is the final answer. The water levels may sometimes tilt one way or another, but the rain falls fairly upon all.
And what, ultimately, is the difference between the rains that fall upon all of us?

title: 罪人舞步旋·终幕礼

CHS: …明明菲林斯才是更合适的人选吧？
小少爷又在妄自菲薄了。
不是啦！你看，我很少来那夏镇，和各方势力的大人物们都不算熟悉。
人际交往本就是个循序渐进的过程，你需要多给自己一些时间。
要这么算的话，你的进度已经比我快得多了吧？
算得不对，你分明已经得到过那个事实了。朋友们并不了解我的习惯。
一位踏实、正直，擅长照顾他人，又能在团体活动中获得自我价值实现的人士，无疑更适合成为「执灯人」驻联合会的代表。
别说得像是你不能满足这些。
噢，那你确实过于抬举我了。
别光叹气啊，小少爷，多自信一些。我想执灯人的各位都能认同，你是一位前途无量的年轻人。
所以老执灯长尼基塔才那么放心把重要的工作交给你。
我想大伙也都能认同，如果有事想找菲林斯先生商量，在口干舌燥之前是很难有结果的。
真抱歉，出门在外，没有养成随身备水的习惯。
算了，我接下了。顺带一问，这个联合会的成员还有谁啊？
哦，那可够丰富的。「霜月之子」的咏月使、「秘闻馆」的老板、「伏尼契商会」、甚至是可爱的「蛋卷工坊」…
与他们打交道，一定也会成为你就任之后的一大乐趣吧。
好吧。虽然没有承担过类似工作，总有点害怕在不熟悉的领域里一不小心就出个纰漏…
但这毕竟也是履行执灯人的职责，而且…是为了让挪德卡莱变得更有温度。
多么可敬的想法啊，光源已经点亮，距离突破风雪只差最后半步了。
互相帮扶，将家园重建为「乐园」…这对挪德卡莱来说可是第一次，一定也是不可错过的一次。
行，行吧。也是…我会努力的。
我已经看见不少老朋友过来了。我们差不多过去吧。
EN: ...Aren't you the better pick for this job, Flins?
You underestimate yourself yet again, Master Illuga.
Not at all! I rarely come by Nasha Town. I don't know any of the big shots here.
All in good time. Socializing is a step-by-step journey.
But you're much further ahead on that road, aren't you?
You're not seeing the full picture. You know the truth now. My friends do not understand my habits.
There is no question about it. The Lightkeepers need a representative in the League. Someone who is upright, cares about other people, and can realize their self-worth through group action.
You say it like you wouldn't make the cut.
I am most flattered that you think I would.
Sigh a little less, Master Illuga, and have more faith in yourself. All the Lightkeepers agree that you're a very promising young man.
That is precisely why Starshyna Nikita felt safe delegating such important work to you.
I'm sure we all also agree that we would sooner die of dehydration than manage to wrangle anything out of you in a discussion.
Hah... My apologies. I am not in the habit of bringing water with me when I go out.
Whatever. I'll take the job. By the way, who else is part of this?

Oh, it's quite the who's who of Nod-Krai. There's the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, the Boss of the Curatorium of Secrets, a representative of the Voynich Guild, and even someone from the adorable Krumkake Craftshop...
I'm sure you will find speaking with them to be a genuine pleasure.
If you say so. I've never done this work before, so I'm honestly a little scared of making mistakes...
But I'll do it. Not only is it our duty as Lightkeepers, but... because I want to make Nod-Krai a more welcoming place.
An admirable attitude to take. The beacons are lit, Illuga. We're but one step away from breaking through the blizzard.
We have the chance to band together and build our shared homeland into an Elysium... This is unprecedented for Nod-Krai. An opportunity not to be missed.
Yeah... You're right. I'll do my best.
Quite a few familiar faces have arrived. Let's go, shall we?

CHS: 看起来你们状态调整得不错。
虽然还没人问，但我知道你们想问，所以我就抢先回答了：我们也一切都好。
唉，也有美中不足，这段时间真是闷死人了，为了休养身体，连酒都不能喝。
哈。在外奔波那么久，法尔伽团长也想念蒙德了吧。
是啊，听说到的消息越多，就越是想要亲眼看看啊。
…等忙过这阵，也是时候回家了。
你们几位看得见吗？要不要我帮忙把谁举起来？
呃…我在后面听听就可以了。
机会难得，我想学学官方场合应该怎么发言。
你尽管学，回头我再给你安排一个练习的机会…有了！干脆就让你代我们向骑士团做报告吧。
法尔伽先生，您是不是忘了，我甚至不是西风骑士…
没关系啊，给你封一个，喜欢什么称号？
试着分辨吧，这也是个学习的机会。
我很荣幸，能够受邀成为此次联合会开幕仪式的主持人，同时也作为伏尼契商会驻联合会代表在此发言。
（难道说这位也是被真正的「大人物」推上台的「代表」？哎，看来遇到这种事的不止我一个…）
…我们渡过了昨日的灾厄与苦难，从中我们学到了团结与合作的重要。
（来了来了！呃…爱诺果然听得打瞌睡了。欸？老板怎么也一副打瞌睡的样子…？）
…挪德卡莱，我们的家园，我们赖以生存的大船。希望它能够继续乘风破浪，将我们带向富饶、自由与希望…
…看来之后我们会有更多机会走动了。
咏月使大人脚程飞快，想去哪里向来都不是问题。
可惜的是，秘闻馆琐事繁忙，还有别国的人脉要运营，恐怕不能每次都抽出时间来接待你。
没关系，我会提前和雅珂达确认你的日程，雅珂达不在的话，我可以问阿舍鲁。
你这人…给我的员工增加工作量还不够，连别人的猫也不放过？
增加工作量的事，奈芙尔也没少做吧？
你的措辞真有自信。莫非是月神大人的回归给了「霜月之子」不少底气？
哥伦比娅的回归令所有关心她的人高兴，你我同属其中。
至于如今的霜月之子，我们正学习着不再依赖月神…
迈出自己的步伐，让家园变得更加宜居…加入联合会，也是在此理念下做出的尝试。
我喜欢「尝试」这个词，它进退自如，在结构上留有不少空间。
嗯？你不看好霜月之子的未来？还是不看好联合会？
准确地说，是没你那么乐观。
「霜月之子」应当感激有你这样一位固执又进取的领导者…
但要把目光投向整个挪德卡莱，形形色色的人多了去了。他们不爱被领导，也未必爱听正确的话。
难不成…秘闻馆的露面，真的只是出于形式？
目前是这样，除非我看到未来会有足够多的回报。
勉勉强强够本吧。但我也承认它对挪德卡莱来说，确实是开了一个好头。
行了，别劝了。你再多念叨两句，我就要申请加入「霜月之子」了。
菈乌玛，奈芙尔，辛苦你们啦！你们刚刚在聊什么呀？
在聊奈芙尔不希望我给「秘闻馆」增加工作量，而她正在考虑加入「霜月之子」。
呵呵，这里的对话一如既往的有趣。
至于你们两位，动身前往下一个地方前，要不要先来喝杯茶？
尼可？你在哪呢？今天你不露面吗？
我听出了你的遗憾，但抱歉我暂时分身乏术。
需要安慰的话，我会说无论如何变化，外表都是距离内核最远的那层存在…
也许将注意点放在「伟大魔女的特别联络」上会觉得好些。
如果我算魔女…应该恐怕似乎还是能算的吧。
噢…噢，好的。是出什么事了吗？
没有，或者说，目前还没有。
就当这是一次定期联络，确认我们之间的沟通畅通，或许也算加固感情。
哎，早说嘛，我还紧张了一小下。
不过，加固感情这种事，以后最好还是当面吧？
只有我们两个对着空气喝茶，一边自言自语，总觉得有点奇怪的。
可以关心下你在忙什么吗？
嗯，世界边界的灾害怎么样了？
艾莉丝才给我来过消息，说把大家都累得够呛，最后还算控制住了。不过…也不能掉以轻心。
这次灾害引发的扰动，让提瓦特在宇宙中变得更容易被观测到。
她会等到情况基本稳定之后，再重新安排她的蒙德度假计划。
至于我，我认同阿帽的观点。这是一段「变数」层出不穷，情况不断发生变化——大多还不是些好变化——的时期。
为了防止余烬阴燃，以谨慎之心保持对世界的观测是很有必要的。
就像我虽然知道葬火之战后挪德卡莱这片土地上的力量发生了变化，但因为它们都属于光界力就没过多在意，也没提起。
哎，看来以后在「观测」的同时，还得再多审视一下这些现象之间的联系啊。
职责所在，差不多也算本能了。
真要说起来的话，就要从天使的质料来自于…
呵呵，算了。派蒙的建议不错，还是当面炫耀更有成就感。
对了，不是要邀功，但出于自尊心多少得提一下。你们应该收到了吧？那份来自魔女会的「礼物」。
与艾莉丝给多莉的礼物相似，不过这一次是改良版的——特制护身符。
哦！难道说，被多托雷那家伙暂时控制住的伙伴们是被这个保护着才没出事？
正是如此。而且为了防止对手察觉，我们费劲地把那些特地改成了无法被看见的款式呢。
啊哈哈，听着好高兴呢。不过，这话并非是想让你道谢才说的，只是想告诉你，伙伴有时也在看不见的地方守护着你们。
总之，如果有新情况我会再联络你们。除此之外的没有消息，都是好消息。
啊，出于天使的本能，我必须告诉你们——
接下来该前往码头了，不然你们的朋友就要登上返程的船喽！
EN: I know no one's asked, but I'm sure you all wanna know. So let me just say: We're doing great, thanks.
Well... great, but not perfect. I'm starting to lose my mind from boredom... Can't drink a drop of alcohol while I'm waiting for my wounds to heal.
I'm sure you had a sneaky swig or two...
Heh. I'm sure you must be missing Mondstadt after all these years away, Grand Master.
Yeah, you can say that again. Every time I get news from Mondstadt, it makes me want to go back and see the place for myself.
...Honestly, once things are wrapped up here, I think it'll be time to head back home.
Hey. Looks like someone's taking the stage.
Can everyone see okay? Anyone need a boost?
Uh... I'll just listen from the back, it's fine.
You're taking this pretty seriously, huh, Durin?
Well, it's not everyday I get the chance to see how people speak in official settings.
Soak it up like a sponge. I'll make sure you get a chance to practice for yourself later down the line... Actually, I know just the thing! You can debrief the Knights of Favonius for me.
Mr. Varka, are you forgetting that I'm not a Knight of Favonius...?
Eh, I can knight you. Any particular title you'd like?
...Is he joking? I really can't tell.
You'll have to figure this one out for yourself. It'll be a good learning experience.
It is my honor to host the opening ceremony for the League, and to have this opportunity to speak to you all in my capacity as Voynich Guild representative.
(Could this person also have been pushed onto the big stage by the real big shots? Guess I'm not the only one, then...)
...We come here today having weathered the trials and hardships of yesterday, and having learned from them the importance of unity and cooperation.
(Alright, here we go! ...Uh-oh, looks like Aino's off in dreamland already. Wait, Boss is looking kinda drowsy too... What's up with her?)
(...Come on, get this speech over with already...)

...Nod-Krai is our home, the land we rely on for survival. And as we chart a course for the future, may we persevere through the storms ahead as we sail towards a new era of prosperity, freedom, and hope...
...Looks like we'll have more opportunities to travel in the future.
I'm sure you'll cope, Lady Moonchanter, given how fleet of foot you are.
Unfortunately, I suspect I'll be too busy at the Curatorium to act as your host. We have a busy schedule, not to mention an international network of contacts to manage.
It'll be alright. I'll just check your schedule with Jahoda well in advance. And if she's not available, I can simply ask Ashru.
You... Ugh, so giving my employees extra workload isn't enough for you? You're really going to drag my cat into this, too?
I thought you'd approve. Aren't you forever increasing your employees' workloads?
Hmph, that's a bold statement... Are all the Frostmoon Scions feeling more audacious now that your Moon Goddess has returned?
Columbina's return has brought joy to all who care about her. That includes both you and me.
As for the Frostmoon Scions, we are learning how to thrive independently, without relying on the Moon Goddess.
It is up to us to make our home a more livable place. Joining the League is one of the steps we are trying towards that end.
I like the word "try." It's nice and non-committal. You can opt out at any time and still say you tried.
Hmm? You don't see a bright future for the Frostmoon Scions? Or did you mean the League?
I'm just not as optimistic as you.
The Frostmoon Scions should count themselves lucky that they have a leader as stubborn and enterprising as you...
But Nod-Krai's a big place with all kinds of people. Most of them don't enjoy answering to a leader, or even listening to reason.
Well, that's where you and your methods come in.
Unless... the Curatorium of Secrets is only here for appearances?
For now, yes. And that won't change until this venture becomes worth my while.
What would make it worth your while?
Getting out more than I put in. Right now, I'd barely break even. But I'll grant that it's a good start for Nod-Krai.
Then maybe it's worth a try.
Alright, you can stop now. Or do I have to join the Frostmoon Scions before you'll get off my back?
Hmm... You'd be very welcome to join us.
Whew! That was a tight squeeze...
Hey, you two. Congrats on all your hard work! What are you chatting about?
Nefer was trying to dissuade me from adding to her employees' workload. Also, she's considering joining the Frostmoon Scions.
Hehehe, your conversations are always the most interesting.
Would you two care to join me for some tea before heading to your next destination?
Nicole? ...Wait, where are you? Aren't you gonna show up today?
Sadly not — I'm otherwise occupied right now. I'm sorry Paimon. I can hear how disappointed you are.
If it's any consolation, let me say that how things appear on the surface is a far cry from what they are at their core...
Perhaps you'll feel better if you focus on the fact you have a special line of communication with the great mage herself...
...Assuming I still count as a Mage... which I suppose I probably do. I think?
Well that's not ominous at all...
Is there something we should be watching out for...?
Just think of this as a general check-in to make sure this communication system is still running smoothly. Besides, it's good to chat once in a while if we want to maintain our friendship.
Ugh, you could've just said so. Paimon got all worked up for nothing...
Still, the best friendships are built through face-to-face interaction, y'know?
It's never gonna stop being weird having tea with you when you're not there, and just... talking to thin air.
Alright, fair point. I'll bear that in mind for next time.
Mind if I ask what's keeping you occupied?
Yeah, any update on that crisis at the world's borders?
Alice just informed me that they had their work cut out for them, and now everyone's thoroughly exhausted, but they did finally get things back under control. Still, we can't let our guard down yet.
The disruption caused by this disaster has made Teyvat easier to detect from the outside universe.
She plans to wait for things to stabilize, then reschedule her Mondstadt vacation plans.
As for me, I agree with Hat Guy's perspective. This is a time when many new variables are emerging and the situation is changing constantly... plus, most of this change is for the worse.
We have to remain vigilant and ensure that the embers of chaos are not rekindled.
I did notice that the energy in Nod-Krai changed somewhat after the war of funerary flame, but since it was still aligned with the Light Realm, I never gave it a second thought.
*sigh* It looks like I'll have to examine the connections between phenomena I observe more closely in the future.
Sounds like you've got a lot on your plate.
Just doing my duty. It's more or less second nature by now.
Of course, to give you the full picture, I'd have to start with the substance from which Angels were formed...
Heh, never mind. Paimon's right — showing off my knowledge would be much more satisfying in person.
By the way, you did receive the gifts from the Hexenzirkel, yes? I'm not trying to claim credit or anything, but my pride demands that I at least mention it...
They're quite similar to the protective talisman that Alice gave Dori, but with some very special enhancements!
Ohh! So that's what kept our friends safe when Dottore trapped them?
Indeed. We went to great lengths to make sure they were invisible to his eyes.
Ahaha... I'm so happy they came in handy... Still not fishing for gratitude, by the way. I just want you to be aware that sometimes, your friends may be protecting you in ways you cannot perceive.
Anyway, I'll contact you if anything else crops up. If not, you know what they say — no news is good news.
...Oh, my angelic instincts are tingling! They say...
You should head to the docks next... your friends are about to board their ship home!

CHS: 大战过后，你们回到了那夏镇…
得知危机解除后，人们陆陆续续回到了挪德卡莱…
…不对不对，画得不对。现在的月亮，应该是长这样的！
嗯？孩子们，你们在画什么呀？
新的月亮呀！妈妈。月亮长得和以前不一样了不是吗？
对了妈妈，我今天可以买一份糖雕吗？就一份！
…好吧，今天也算个好日子，就当过节了。
号外！号外！最新一期的「那夏快报」！
「灾后新章！那夏镇在新的月亮下迎来重生！」
「今日起航！联合会带来前所未见的全新明天！」要来一份吗？
…没想到连天上的月亮都变得不一样了。
听说是新的月神诞生了。
新的月神？「霜月之子」那边的？
好像是吧？我也没弄明白。反正月亮照升，日子照过。
都走到这里了啊。干脆…领份饭菜再走？
向来不管那么严的，更何况大家都算同甘共苦过了…不说了，闻着好香啊，我肚子都饿了…
快点！去得早才能抢到好位置！
小点声，这里可是住宅区，万一有人还在睡觉呢？
EN: After the battle, you return to Nasha Town...
After learning of the crisis's end, people gradually return to Nod-Krai...
...No, you're doing it wrong. The moon looks like this now!
Hmm? What are you drawing, children?
The new moon, Mom! It looks different than before, doesn't it?
Um, also — can I go buy a sugar sculpture today? Please? Just one!
...Alright. I suppose today is a special day, after all. Almost like a festival.
Extra, extra! Get the latest Nasha Express here!
"Post-Disaster Report! Nasha Town reborn beneath a new moon!"
"The voyage begins today! The future looks bright thanks to the League!" Want a copy?
...I knew things would be different, but I didn't think that would include the moon.
They say a new Moon Goddess has been born.
A new moon goddess? Who's saying that? The Frostmoon Scions?
I guess so...? I'm not too clued up on the details. As far as I'm concerned, the moon's still in the sky, and it's business as usual.
Hey, since we've come all this way... Shall we grab ourselves a free meal while we're here?
Are you a convert now? Or are you just here for the free lunch?
Oh, come on, what does it matter? After everything we've all just been through... Mmm, that smells good. Alright, that's it. I'm hungry. Time to eat.
Come on! We gotta get there early, or there won't be any good spots left!
Shh, keep it down! This is the residential area. What if people are still sleeping?

CHS: …到这里为止，名单上的人都已经迁回原处了。
很长的路，但我们总算把大家都送了回来。
我会为所有人祈祷。但愿这一次留下就不再需要离开，但愿我们可以永居于自己挑选的宁静乐园。
乐园…缄默之殿的记载里，这个词语有其特殊象征，它代表着神明对栖身处的期许与渴望。
人们总是觉得流离失所的只有自己，却忘了神也需要落脚地。
像羊之王所说，「神无子民将不复存在」，神明与信徒本就是相互需要的。
千百年来，沙漠信仰削弱了多少只有我们自己清楚。可我们依然谈论神明，仿佛他们是我们生活的一部分。
神与人相处的方式各异，他们本就是我们生活的一部分。迪娜泽黛称草神大人为朋友，也是基于这样的道理。
朋友这个说法倒是不错。削弱了差距，减少了隔阂。
朋友…要是早些年告诉我如今会有这么多朋友，我一定不信。
信与不信是选择，结交或不结交也是选择。我们已经通过战斗做出正确的选择，不是吗？
接下来我得回一趟缄默之殿，听说羊之王和鹮之王跑我们那儿去了。你们呢？
我们回阿如村。那边还有要分发的物资和需要关照的人。
下次见，朋友，有空来阿如村找我们玩吧。
你们也是，有空可以来缄默之殿坐坐。
七柱中的另外两位，谢斯芬赫和贝努，说不定也会去缄默之殿串门。你们身上佩戴着他们的力量符号，很适合来看望他们。
串门？他们把缄默之殿当邻居家？
缄默之殿是由赫曼努比斯建立的神殿，那对他们来说，确实就是邻居家吧…
我们会找时间去看看的。你回去路上注意安全。
EN: ...Well, that's the last of them. Everyone on the list is already back where they should be.
It was a long, hard road, but we've finally finished escorting everyone back.
I just pray that we'll never need to leave again. I hope we can stay here forever in this peaceful paradise of our own choosing.
Paradise... In the annals of the Temple of Silence, that word carries great significance. It represents the hopes and desires of the gods — their longing for a place to rest.
I wouldn't think gods need such a place.
People always think they're the only ones who can lose their homes. They forget that gods, too, need a place to reside.
As the Goat King once said, "A god without his people shall cease to exist." Gods need their believers every bit as much as their believers need them.
Only we can truly understand how much the desert faith has faded over the centuries. But we still talk about the gods as though they're a part of our lives.
Given the myriad ways in which gods and humans interact, I'd say they really are. How else could Dunyarzad consider the Dendro Archon a friend?
Well, that sounds about right to me. Describing them as "friends" sure makes us feel a whole lot closer.
Hah... If you'd told me a few years back that I'd have this many friends, I'd have called you a liar.
Belief is a choice, just like friendship. We've made our choices through battle — the right ones, wouldn't you say?
I'll be heading back to the Temple of Silence. I heard the Goat King and the Ibis King decided to pay us a visit. How about you?
It's back to Aaru Village for us. Still plenty of supplies to distribute and people to help.
Until next time, old friend. As long as you can find the time, you're always welcome to visit us in Aaru Village.
Right back atcha. Make sure to drop by the Temple of Silence the next time you're free.

Word is that two of the other Seven Pillars, Shesepankh and Bennu, might also be dropping by. Since you're wearing the symbols of their power, it'd only be fitting if you came to see them for yourselves.
"Dropping by"? That makes it sound like they're visiting a neighbor's home...
Well, the Temple was founded by Hermanubis, so I guess to them, that's exactly what it is...
Alright, we'll make sure to find time to stop by. Stay safe on your journey home.

title: 道成千壑，因果异灭·你的往事如一座花园

heading: 往冥府的安魂歌 · 于饯别之时散落的黑羽

CHS: 你终于来了，茶都快凉了。什么事耽搁了这么久？
没什么，和「丑角」聊了一会儿。
来了就好，有你在，再加上派蒙，四个人的话勉强能找回一些曾经茶会的感觉。
你比我想象得还要怀念那个时候啊，桑多涅。
只是想说两个人喝茶算不上茶会而已，没别的意思。
那这次是怎么忽然想到要喝茶呀？
为了透透气，你们没感觉到吗，那种大战前的气氛…除了压抑还是压抑。
嗯，要对抗若娜瓦的事，就算不刻意去想，现在也压在每个人的心头。
毕竟是「四影」之一，连世界的规则都掌握在手里，要打败这样的家伙…
是啊，这么看大家已经表现得很从容了。
反倒是我…好像应该再有紧张感一些才对，呃…
皮耶罗现在压力一定很大，这也是我愿意积极配合邪眼研究的理由之一。
女皇陛下的话…谁知道呢？
女皇陛下的内心，像是早已冻结的湖面，没有任何事情能让它再起什么涟漪。
湖水看上去纯净透明，但当你以为能够看清一切、望向湖底的时候，却又发现它是那么深邃…自己简直一无所知。
并不算夸大的形容。令人安心的是，敌人眼中的女皇想必也是如此令人捉摸不透。
何况她应该从很久以前就预料到会有这一天了，甚至在她登神之前，可能就在为了正面对抗天理而做准备。
你们都相信着女皇呢，「丑角」也说了类似的话。
「相信」这东西是对等的，越是相信，自己越想要变得值得对方相信，也算是一件麻烦事。
与其猜测女皇的想法，不如把分配到自己手上的工作搞定。
桑多涅这些天在忙什么？
暂时就是修缮工事，给各级战力升级装备，还有布置那些不一定用得上的战场。
若娜瓦的事很可能只是个开始，没人知道未来的至冬还要面临什么，再多的准备都不会多余。
我这边的话…在「邪眼」的新方案投入实验阶段之前，看来可以短暂休息一下了。
你也怪不容易的，阿蕾奇诺。好了，快聊点别的吧，再这样下去都不知道是茶会还是工作会议了…
「四个人的茶会」开始转向一些轻松的话题，奢侈地享受着平淡而惬意的时光…
此后的几天，整个至冬在女皇的秩序下有序地「运转」着，不知不觉来到了与莱茵多特约定的日子…
…桌布上不能有一丝灰尘，注意茶具摆放的轴向，不要混淆。
特罗皮娜，灯光亮度比预期要暗，光线问题我说过是关键，你确定擦过全部灯具了吗？
