至冬这个文明，从很久以前就命悬一线了，如今你也是彻头彻尾的共犯…我不会为你开脱的。
我还以为你现在就有办法呢。
依我看来，同为天空岛上的造物，派蒙要比你了不起得多。
你说她没有力量，也没有权能…还打算像回收一件物品那样，将她回收。
但这一路上，她引导着我，许许多多的人们见证了我们的旅途，也潜移默化地影响了许多人的命运。
这是人类，是生命之间才存在的牵绊，派蒙也在书写着自己的命运。
而你才更像是一件工具，一样物品…
你是自身都未曾拥有过自由，还被天理用来禁锢人类的一副镣铐罢了。
（我是不是说得有点过头了…本来想用聊天来拖住她，结果想到派蒙的事就一不小心…）
本来觉得你们应该已经得到教训了，这次准备就到这里…
可现在…很好，我改变主意了。
既然天理不允许我彻底杀死你们，我也的确没必要这么做。
死亡是一种安歇，只有活着才能感受无尽的痛苦。这方面…我有的是手段。
我会让你们恨天理，恨天理为什么不允许我把你们彻底杀死。
（呃…糟了，这下可真的没有退路了。）
时间也差不多到了，现在只要等莱茵多特将你们复活…
…这么看来，你对天理的敌意，更多是为了至冬的理想和未来，而非过去的那些仇怨啊…
坎瑞亚有你这样的「母亲」应该感到骄傲，只可惜现在坎瑞亚已经不复存在了。
怎么了，你看起来好像状态有些不好。
与我聊天会让你感到不舒服么？我应该已经收起作为「生之执政」的威压了。
对了，我其实从一开始就想问你…你在这里「招待」我，与我聊天喝茶真的没关系么？
不论是你们至冬子民中的精英，还是那些特地请来的「外援」，此刻应该都在拼上性命对抗若娜瓦吧。
如今已经拥有六颗神之心的你，如果选择全力参战的话…
或许可以把胜利的可能性从零拉高到万分之一哦。
不，我认为和你聊天更加重要。
不需要去面对若娜瓦，不管对谁来说都应该算是件幸运的事。
别看她那副样子，似乎是在热心工作，其实她本质上是个随心所欲的女人。
就像刚才，我能感知到她又在大开杀戒…你押宝的那些武装力量，应该已经全部「死过一次」了。
那么…愉快的聊天就到这里吧，我也到了为这位任性的同事进行「善后工作」的时间…
若娜瓦察觉到复活并未如期进行，准备离开寻找原因，而你、戴因斯雷布与「丑角」使出浑身解数阻止了她的离开，并最终导致若娜瓦的权能被天空岛回收。视线来到至冬宫，一切的根源竟是手持六颗神之心的冰之女皇对莱茵多特周围的时空动了手脚…
就连天理「监测周期」的事都被你们调查清楚了？天空岛的确低估了你们反叛的决心啊。
同样，天空岛也低估了第三降临者遗骨的增幅效果…
用冰元素来影响时间和空间，小范围内改写世界运行的规则，这显然不是魔神能够拥有的力量。
神之心只是一部分，其中也有千年来我自己的领悟。
明明只是「魔神」而已…居然能够达到这种境界。
所以在你那超越常规的冰元素力的影响之下，我们所处的大厅内，时间的流速变得明显比外界要慢…
换句话说，在我和你悠闲聊天，毫无紧张感的时候…外界的时间正在飞速流逝。
为了规避「周期」，我与若娜瓦约定的「复活」时间也在我完全没有察觉的情况下就错过了…
若娜瓦的情况，现在应该不太好。「死之权能」大概已经被回收了。
复盘没有意义，我知道这种计策对你们只能用一次。
还有，现在你可以复活那些被若娜瓦杀死的人了，这依旧是你的职责吧？
没错，从天空岛监测到这次事件开始，便给出了处理方案。
此时此刻，天空岛的指令正回荡在我脑内，要求我使用权能来弥补若娜瓦的过错。
我只是不喜欢有「弃子」的战术。
那么，安娜丝塔夏女皇，事已至此，你觉得接下来我会怎么做呢？
可惜这种「反叛」行为无法被天空岛所判定，也远远达不到降下「判罚之钉」的标准。
但是就她个人而言，刚才的权能越界行为也已经足够构成「惩戒」的理由了。
…呵呵，别那么紧张，跟你开个玩笑。
若娜瓦刚刚受到惩罚，我和纳贝里士可以说也算「共犯」，现在正被天空岛紧紧盯着。
我可不想「生之权能」也被回收。
…为什么要用这种借口？你是真的打算放过冰之魔神？
顺便我很欣赏你的胆识和谋略，是值得尊敬的「对手」。
今天就先到这里吧，作为客人继续叨扰的话，主人要感到困扰了。
抛开「生之执政」的身份，以「魔女R」或者坎瑞亚的「黄金」的立场上来说…
我开始怀疑至冬或许真的能够成就一些「大事」了。
我并不满意你的处理，莱茵多特。至冬在这件事以后一定会变本加厉…
啊…？你刚刚说什么，纳贝小姐，我这边好像信号不太好。
权能…你们这些家伙，是算计好的…
回到现实了吗…怎么样，莫非已经成功了？
回来了就做好战斗准备吧，她不可能就这么善罢甘休。
尽管失去了最棘手的「死之权能」，可若娜瓦本身的实力应该不会打折扣。
不明是非…不知所谓…居然就这么夺走…
也好，反正我早就受够了「管束」…现在，终于可以肆意地带来死亡。
我承认你们暂时得逞了…可为我打开枷锁的代价，你们承受得住么？
＊ 击败失去权能的若娜瓦
尽管失去了权能，若娜瓦依旧具备着四影级别的实力，而此刻的她将会使出全力。战况变得愈发惨烈，终于慢慢来到了终局…
得益于你和戴因斯雷布的牵制，「丑角」那燃烧灵魂与生命的一击成功命中了若娜瓦。待到烟雾散去之时，若娜瓦已不见了踪影。毫无疑问，你们胜利了…
结、结束了吗？若娜瓦…死了？
其实在她的权能被天空岛回收的一刻，至冬就已经达成了目的…
但走到如今的这一步，几乎是必然的。
或许从「不死诅咒」降下的一刻开始，就注定会是一场「不死不休」的恩怨了。
这下至冬科技的封锁算是解除了，「槲寄生计划」终于也可以继续推进了。
如果早知道打败死之执政会成为计划必要的一环…我当初一定会再慎重考虑一下是否加入的。
你最后的那一击，有没有彻底杀死她的把握？
除非她用了什么我们没有察觉的手段逃离了战场…
可即便如此，也应该受到了不可逆转的重创。
不管怎样，此后的时间里我们都需要提防可能受到的报复…
在与神的对抗之中，没有谁能彻底看得清命运的全貌。
…结束啦结束啦。原本这次来见女皇之前还有点紧张，现在来看…
简直就是一场公开表彰大会嘛，咱们可是出尽了风头呀。
明明受女皇表彰的人那么多…
听你说的好像只有我们的功劳。
嘿嘿，其实我觉得女皇自己的功劳才最大。
我们一群人对付若娜瓦，她自己就把莱茵多特给对付了，应该找个人表彰一下她自己。
你可以代表天空岛来表彰她。
我、我可不敢！我还一直觉得…女皇会不会担心我是天空岛的间谍什么的…
有我担保，没人能怀疑你。
欸，戴因在前面，我在宫里的时候就想说，真没想到这种场合他也会来呀…戴因！
你这么着急走干嘛，是要去哪里呀。
就只是着急离开，这种场合让我觉得别扭。
别扭为什么还要来？说实话我完全没想到你会来觐见女皇呢。
她不一样。只是简单觐见一下的话，我不可能不给「坎瑞亚的母亲」一个面子。
嗯…「母亲」看来是世界上最有分量的身份呢。
说起来，皮耶罗兑现承诺了吗？你有没有去见「贤者」呀？
那个年轻的「贤者」最大的价值可能就是用来叙叙旧了，他还完全没有接触过坎瑞亚的阴暗面。
倒是艾弗提尔维特那个家伙，现在很热衷于把手上的工作拿去和他讨论。
只能说…他比我想的要「不计前嫌」一些。
不过也有可能是为了对抗「磨损」吧。
与若娜瓦的那一战，他的精神与灵魂的消耗有些过于严重了。
要掌控那么强大的力量，必然要付出一些不可逆的代价。
怪不得今天都没见到他，是应该好好休息一下了。
对至冬来说，这次已经可以算是大获全胜了…毕竟那可是「死之执政」若娜瓦。
五百年前，灾变中的坎瑞亚人仰望她的时候，所有人都只会觉得那是不可触及的神。
意味着一个新时代的开始。
嗯，但可以确定的是…不会是一个安稳的时代。
身为「死之执政」，若娜瓦第一次亲身感受到「死亡」的临近。虚弱的她将「地原胚质」与至冬的「判罚之钉」融合，企图让「死亡」的感受随圣土化一同降临整个提瓦特。
EN: Finally. The tea's about to go cold. What took you so long?
Nothing much, I was just chatting with The Jester for a bit.
Nothing much. Thanks for the tea.
Better late than never. With you and Paimon here, that makes four of us. Just enough to make it feel like one of our old tea parties.
You have more nostalgia for those times than I expected, Sandrone.
All I'm saying is that two people drinking tea doesn't count as a tea party. That's all.
So... what made you suddenly wanna hold a tea party, anyway?
To get a much needed breather. Don't you feel it too? That looming feeling that a huge battle is just around the corner... It makes the atmosphere so suffocating.
Agreed. The thought of having to fight Ronova is at the back of all of our minds, even when we're not choosing to think about it.
She is one of the Four Shades, after all. They have the power to enforce the rules of the world itself. It's gonna be so tough to defeat someone like her...
I think the main concern is...
We cannot afford to fail. The cost would be devastating.
Yeah... Geez, when you look at it like that, everyone's been doing a pretty amazing job of keeping their cool!
If anything, Paimon of all people should probably be a little more nervous than she is, considering... Ugh...
Pierro must be under a great deal of pressure right now. That is one of the reasons I am so willing to cooperate with the Delusion research.
Her mind is like a lake frozen to the very bottom. There are no ripples on the surface, nothing to reveal what lies underneath.
The surface might look pure and transparent, but just when you think you can see to the bottom, you realize it's so profoundly deep... you actually can't see anything at all.
I wouldn't even call that an exaggeration. Though it is reassuring to think the Tsaritsa must seem just as impenetrable to her enemies.
Regardless, I believe she has anticipated this day for a long time. It's possible she's been preparing to confront the Heavenly Principles since before she even ascended to godhood.
You guys really trust the Tsaritsa, huh. The Jester basically said the same thing.
Trust goes both ways. The more you trust someone, the more you want to prove yourself worthy of their trust. It's honestly kind of annoying.
Point is, I don't make a habit of trying to get in the Tsaritsa's head. Better to just accept the work assigned to you, and get it done.
Speaking of, what have you been up to, Sandrone?
Oh, y'know, repairing military fortifications, upgrading equipment for all ranks of combat personnel, fortifying battlefields that might not even be used...
Our altercation with Ronova is likely just the beginning. No one knows what Snezhnaya will face in the future, so one can never be too prepared.
For now, at least, I suppose I can take a short break before the experiments for the revised Delusion project are ready to begin.
No rest for the weary, huh, Arlecchino... Alright, let's talk about something else. This is supposed to be a tea party, not a work meeting...
The tea party shifts to more lighthearted topics. Overall, it's a relaxing and peaceful time.
Under the methodical command of the Tsaritsa, things proceed as normal over the next few days. The day of the appointment with Rhinedottir arrives before you know it ...
＊ Return to Podvorye Restaurant for a rest
...There must not be even a speck of dust on the tablecloth. Pay attention to the table settings. I don't want a single utensil out of place.
And the lights seem dimmer than expected, Tropina. I told you this was a key element. Are you certain you polished all the fixtures?
Oh, uhh... Apologies, Miss Danica. I'll check at once.
This lack of focus is unlike you. What's going on?
N—Nothing. I'm... just a bit nervous...
You know the identity of today's guest, then. Who told you?
N—No one! I just overheard it by chance. I'm sorry, I didn't know it was a secret...
It's not a secret. The guest arriving today is Lady Rhinedottir, the Ruler of Life. I chose not to inform everyone in advance because there was no need to do so.
As maids, the standard for our work is always the same — we accept perfection and nothing less. The identity of the guest has no bearing on that... I'm sure I've told you that many times.
Whether our guest is an envoy of the heavens or a beggar on the street, all visitors are to be received with the utmost care and courtesy. Understood?
Of course. Forgive me, Miss Danica.
All is well. There is nothing different about the palace today than any other day. It is up to us to give our guest a good first impression...
... We'll leave the rest to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.
＊ Return to Podvorye Restaurant for a rest
Phew, the Tsaritsa's meeting Rhinedottir today, isn't she?
It's finally time to make our move.
How nerve-wracking... Well, it's still early. Should we go to the palace and see how everything's going?
I doubt Danica wants to be disturbed.
True, Danica definitely takes her work very seriously. So where should we go? Paimon can't just sit around here and wait...
We can meet up with Mitya.
Ooh, good idea! Maybe there's something we can help out with over there.
Even though we don't know the whole plan, based on what Pierro said, this is definitely where Mitya should be right about now...
But I think... I see another familiar face.
Huh? Where? Who are you talking about?
Huh? I didn't expect you to be the first people I'd run into after getting off the train.
I appreciate you coming all this way to welcome me. I hope you haven't been waiting long.
We didn't exactly plan this, but it's great to see you.
You're late. We've been waiting forever.
You're always finding new ways to make an entrance, huh, Dain... Paimon's almost used to it by now.
So, what brings you to Snezhnaya?
Eftirvit contacted me, so here I am.
His officers were quite relentless in their search for me. I was half-convinced the Fatui was out for my arrest.
The Jester did say he wanted to unite all possible allies. If he called you in, guess he means business.
Well, it makes sense. Rhinedottir isn't just the Ruler of Life. She's also "Gold"... one of The Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.
Whenever a Sinner or the Abyss Order shows up, Dain's never gonna be far behind. It's basically a law of the universe at this point...
I'm not just here for Rhinedottir's visit...
Ronova, the architect of my torment over the past five hundred years, the one who inflicted the Curse of Immortality upon me... She also makes it worth the trip.
Not to mention, Eftirvit relayed to me via his subordinates that Snezhnaya has found a way to converse with a past incarnation of The Wise...
He fled Teyvat like a coward... I have many things to say to him. Many things indeed.
(Considering when that version of Hroptatyr is from, he probably doesn't have the answers Dain is looking for...)
Well, you definitely have a good reason to join the cause... Speaking of, are you and Pierro close? You share a homeland, after all.
We're merely acquaintances. We crossed paths a few times in the royal court, but that was the extent of our interactions.
For now, Eftirvit has asked me to "set aside my own agenda and focus entirely on fighting Ronova"... I suppose I can humor him this once.
As much as I wish I were the one confronting Rhinedottir in the Tsaritsa's place...
The Jester knows what's at stake.
We need you on our side more.
Hmph. You think I don't know what's at stake? ...Forget it, we'll do as he says.
So, what's your next move? What is Eftirvit planning?
He's researching a secret weapon, but we're not sure if it's ready yet. We were gonna go meet up with our Snezhnayan friend, Mitya. You should come with us!
...This is the last batch of equipment. Once this is delivered, we'll be all set!
Thanks for the efficient work everyone! ...Oh, 旅行者, Paimon. What brings you here?
Hey, Mitya! We're here to help! Oh, Vodyanitsa! You're here too!
It's been a while, 旅行者 and Paimon! You're both looking well!
We don't really need any help, actually. We've had a bunch of support from the military, thanks to Valeriy and Miss Vesna...
Plus, my friends from the Rokot know their way around the station, so they helped me get everything sorted out in no time.
*sigh*... Could you be a little more discreet when mentioning the Rokot, Mr. Mitya? You make it sound like we're a public organization.
Ahaha, sorry. Honestly, though, I don't think it'd be that bad if everything you did was out in the open. I think the people of Snezhnaya appreciate you all a lot.
Wait, let me guess... Your friend must be here to help us fight Ronova. Is he an old acquaintance of The Jester, then?
Yep! This is Dainsleif. Sounds like you guessed already, but he's a Khaenri'ahn survivor from five hundred years ago. Did you figure that out from his eyes?
Hello, Mr. Dainsleif. It wasn't just the eyes that gave you away. I also recognized the signature of the Curse of Immortality... It's the same one I sense on The Jester.
Ever since my soul was marked with the sign of Ronova, I've become sensitive to things like that.
Likewise... Hmph, every time I hear Eftirvit referred to as "The Jester," I can't help but feel as if I have more cause to mock my fate than he does.
So. What are you guys transporting to Snezhnograd?
Haha, nobody told you yet? It was top secret at first, but as of today I'm free to divulge all the details to you.
During some time off a while back, an idea suddenly popped into my head... a way we just might be able to bypass Ronova's technological blockade.
Get this: We're going to turn the theater into a fully fledged laboratory.
This is all newly purchased equipment for the new lab. Transporting it was the only hard part — it'll be quick to set up once we're there.
Wanna guess whether I got a choice in the matter? Nope, of course I didn't. *sigh*...
...Anyway. The recent incident at the theater proves that even if someone dies inside, their soul will be trapped there for a short while, unable to return to the Ley Lines.
So I'm thinking... as long as we have enough people in the theater, even if the Curse of Death gets triggered, there's still a chance of completing the experiment in the afterlife.
Huh? What are you talking about, experimenting in the afterlife?
My soul bears the mark of Ronova. That means, I can remember everything that happens while I'm dead.
If the experiment succeeds, then as long as I'm around, I can bring the findings back to the real world.
The Ley Line issues at the theater go way back, so I doubt Ronova has the means to fix them anytime soon. Could be just the opportunity we need.
This plan seems fraught with unpredictability...
Gotta say, I have my doubts too... Let's not forget, the afterlife is Ronova's territory. Won't she be able to interfere with the experiment somehow?
Also... Well, not that Paimon's the expert here, but how do you know that any research findings from the afterlife will even apply in the real world?
Mm, hmm, all good points — you raise some excellent questions. Yeah, who knows? None of us can be certain that this plan will succeed. But by the same token...
...Nor can Ronova be certain that this plan will fail.
So you're counting on Ronova not to leave it to chance. Correct?
Basically. All we need to do is make sure Ronova won't turn a blind eye to—
I hope you're enjoying causing trouble for me.
Tch... Earlier than planned, and it's the wrong location... Vodyanitsa, get Valeriy and Vesna! Tell the Rokot to evacuate the locals!
A short while earlier, Rhinedottir, the Ruler of Life, paid a visit to Zapolyarny Palace at the Tsaritsa's invitation...
I saw the same look in many people's eyes on the way here... But yours is different. I see no fear in your eyes at all.
I understand that you are this world's Ruler of Life. But for here and now, for my purposes, you are but a guest at Zapolyarny Palace.
As a maid of the host, I should not, and need not, be afraid.
You've made quite an impression on me. Thank you for escorting me here, my lady. You are an excellent maid.
Now, it is time for the host and your guest to speak privately.
Although complimenting one's host is only proper, your elegance and beauty really are quite striking. I mean that sincerely.
Thank you for honoring our arrangement, Lady Rhinedottir. You seem to be in a good mood today.
Indeed. This land is brimming with primal and untamed natural power...
To behold a civilization built in such a place... One can feel an intense pulse of life everywhere. It's quite refreshing.
I shall take that to mean you appreciate how the Snezhnayan people have thrived in defiance of fate. Please, take a seat.
...I wonder, did you ever visit the royal palace of Khaenri'ah? Before the Cataclysm, of course.
Only once, and it was after the Cataclysm.
Is that so? It merely struck me that your aesthetic taste differs so vastly from that of the Vinster King.
Hm, quite lovely. It almost makes me want to speak up on your behalf and ask the Heavenly Principles to stay their hand a little longer.
When it comes to the value of a civilization's continued existence, I believe aesthetic beauty holds little weight.
My dear Naberius, I seem to recall you saying you had no interest in attending this meeting. Please refrain from popping in and interrupting my train of thought.
You make it sound like Snezhnaya's destruction is an inevitable eventuality.
Do I? I don't recall using those words.
I have no interest in announcing a civilization's impending doom. It's an incredibly thankless task, and one that will most certainly fall to someone else.
I see. Then we should get to the matter at hand.
So soon? Very well. I thought we might enjoy an engaging conversation first, but you are much more... restrained than I imagined.
Recently, I caught sight of Asmoday, the Ruler of Space.
It was during my expedition to subdue an unknown beast that had found its way into Snezhnaya, bringing with it an unrelenting snowstorm...
The monster grew increasingly powerful the further it advanced, and the power emanating from it quickly became too much for my subordinates to withstand.
Sounds like an interesting creature indeed.
I had no choice but to venture deeper into the storm alone. The ferocity of the blizzard completely obstructed my vision...
Until I reached the heart of the storm. Finally, I was able to see the monster clearly. But, more importantly, I saw two figures standing close to it.
The first figure was wearing a hood, so it was difficult to identify them, but the other... I'm certain it was Asmoday.
Asmoday is indeed hard to mistake. This hooded figure, though... Who could it be?
I could not say for certain, but I was able to overhear parts of their conversation...
"This is indeed something worth witnessing — the end of the ███████████████'s story..."
Before long, they seemed to notice my presence. Asmoday then used the power of space, and the two of them disappeared.
The figure said they came to "witness" something? Witness what, I wonder... The monster's existence, or its death?
So, what happened next? You killed it?
Yes. The creature was barely conscious. It put up some resistance, but only on a purely instinctual level.
Valuable information indeed. Could there be something special about that monster...?
It certainly wasn't on Celestia's radar, but that comes as no surprise. If your godly powers were enough to slay it, the creature can't have been much of a threat.
I received no warning either. A case like this would be classified as spontaneous monster evolution and nothing more.
That leaves us with many questions that need answering. Why would Asmoday be interested in that monster in particular?
And that hooded figure, is it possible that was... Asmoday's "new master"?
You still haven't given up on that theory, Rhinedottir? More likely than not, it was an idea Istaroth had on a whim. I doubt she even gave it a second thought.
As usual, my meticulous nature forbids me from overlooking the possibility, Naberius.
Now that we know about this monster, we have a new direction to investigate at the very least. Thank you, Your Majesty.
You're welcome. It is what I promised, after all.
Well, I know for certain you didn't offer up this information to curry favor with the Heavenly Principles.
So, then... What do you want in return? What is it you wish to know from me?
Tell me the current state of the Heavenly Principles, and when they will awaken.
How very direct, Your Majesty. Even more so than I imagined. One might expect you to leave your intentions a bit more to the imagination.
I suggest we end the meeting here, Rhinedottir.
My apologies, Tsaritsa Anastasya. I find myself unable to provide an answer to that question. Given my position, it's hardly the most reasonable request.
In the interest of ending things in a dignified manner, let's wrap this up here.
Very well, Madam Rhinedottir. I respect your wishes. The fault is mine for expecting too much.
It would seem possessing absolute power means Celestia feels little need to treat its rivals with respect. Consider the intel on Asmoday a gift, then.
Is that not what we are? Your unwillingness to share intel shows that you're treating Snezhnaya with even more caution than I expected.
Hardly a clever attempt to goad me. Surely you're not under the delusion that my leaving this meeting... means Celestia recognizes Snezhnaya as a rival?
You're the one leaving. You could just as easily choose to stay and finish this pot of tea with me.
As disgusted as I am by her words... Upon reflection, perhaps we were a little too hasty just now.
Very well. I will play the part of a proper guest and finish this tea with you. But only because I choose to.
Just as it is my choice not to answer your question. So let us change to a different topic entirely.
We could talk about your own past... Of how much of it are you currently aware?
That question is impossible for me to answer. Ever since the Heavenly Principles manipulated my memories, I have long since lost trust in my own recollection.
If you're referring to the part I was forced to forget, the Belyi Tsar once told me about it...
But it sounded like someone else's story. It did not feel real at all. Besides... I never had much trust in the Belyi Tsar either.
Hm, the situation may not be as dire as you assume, you know.
The only thing the Heavenly Principles erased from your mind... was the Third Descender and all memories related to him.
And it wasn't just you. At that time, the Heavenly Principles used Irminsul to erase all traces of the Third Descender's existence from the world...
By fleeing into the Shadow Realm, only the Belyi Tsar was able to retain some memories of him. In all likelihood, what he told you was true.
It matters not whether those past events are true or false. As long as the Heavenly Principles are allowed to exist and have their way with this world, I choose to live in the present.
Hm, is that so... Well, I have my own perspective, of course. I could share it with you if you were so inclined.
After all, I once reviewed the records in Celestia concerning the Third Descender incident. It made for quite fascinating reading.
Very well. I can't say I've ever had the opportunity to listen to someone tell my own story over tea before.
I'm not sure it's appropriate to reveal that which you are about to reveal. I would proceed with caution.
Just think of it as a small token in return for her intel on Asmoday... Besides, you can turn a blind eye every once in a while, you know.
First, as a Khaenri'ahn, I suppose I should pay my respects to you... "Mother of Khaenri'ah."
As I'm sure you know already, all Khaenri'ahns are descendants of a bloodline that began with you and the Third Descender.
I am aware, although I have no memory of it. I found out about it much later... I've just never known how to face you all.
I don't blame you. In fact, I understand that sentiment quite well... as a "mother" myself.
Maternal love is instinctual. But it's not an instinct that can be triggered simply by being told that one is a mother.
Not to mention... The love that compels you as a god has been twisted and warped by the Heavenly Principles.
You were forbidden to love those who were owed your affection. Instead, all you have left is the love the Heavenly Principles bestowed upon you.
How unfortunate the people of Khaenri'ah were. We lost your love, and that misfortune can be traced back to the very incident in question.
On that fateful day, the Belyi Tsar incited you — a mere herald of the court at the time — to open the gate to the Abyss alongside the Third Descender.
This single act triggered the numerous Abyssal disasters that have plagued the world over the past millennium.
It was, without a doubt, an unforgivable sin, but in all honesty, the true blame should lie with the Belyi Tsar as the instigator.
However, at the time, the Heavenly Principles cared little for such details, and immediately erased your existence as punishment.
The Belyi Tsar, on the other hand, escaped all consequences by fleeing to the Shadow Realm, and was never pursued further.
Meanwhile, the Third Descender ascended to Celestia to negotiate with the Heavenly Principles, willing to trade his own life to bring yours back.

There was something special about his physical constitution. He possessed an unparalleled affinity for the power of Teyvat's Human Realm, and could even amplify the power of the various elements. This is what he would use as his bargaining chip.
As long as the Heavenly Principles agreed to resurrect you, and promised to never lay a hand on his descendants — those who would later be known as Khaenri'ahns...
He consented to have his remains be split into seven pieces to consolidate the system of rule established by the Heavenly Principles.
Then, he was naive. Attempting to negotiate with a higher being... Any promise made would be nothing more than empty words.

Actually, he was more resourceful than you give him credit for. He had his own way of holding the Heavenly Principles to their word — a curse, profound and complex, one that would only take effect if the promise was ever broken.
Of course, the Heavenly Principles had conditions of their own. They agreed to resurrect you, but everything about him would be forgotten...
After all, his power, his knowledge, his final acts upon this earth... They all made him dangerous in the eyes of the Heavenly Principles, and there was zero tolerance for such uncertain variables.
So, when the Cataclysm occurred in Khaenri'ah, it must have triggered the Third Descender's curse... That's why the Heavenly Principles are asleep.
I suppose that answers my initial question regarding the current state of the Heavenly Principles. Thank you for that.
Ah, no, no, no. No need to thank me. That was just a story — your story, in fact. I certainly wasn't answering any particular question.
I am somewhat surprised, however. You learn of the sacrifice the Third Descender made on your behalf, and yet, your focus remains on the Heavenly Principles.
Like I said, I choose to live in the present.
Oh? What do you suppose you're doing? Preparing to fight me?
I must say, you surprise me... Surely, you don't really think you have what it takes to face me head on?
I didn't know gods liked to trash-talk their opponents.
Heh. I had only planned on punishing a few researchers to teach you a lesson before leaving.
But under the circumstances... It looks like a higher caliber of divine punishment is in order.
Seeing everyone ready for battle, Ronova prepared to mete out "divine punishment." With a single devastating strike, she transformed Rankova Zorya into a battlefield where judgment would be passed.
...Back so soon? Hmph, you're getting awfully comfortable with death.
Unacceptable. I'm seriously considering destroying your body completely the next time I kill you...
(This is it... The Jester's plan, the mission he gave me... The moment has finally come to act.)
As for the precise action you will need to take, the details are as follows...
...On the day that the Tsaritsa meets with the Ruler of Life, Mitya will make a delivery of equipment from Rankova Zorya to Snezhnograd.
All you need to do is wait for the right moment. Wait until Ronova appears and kills everyone... then, stall her. Do not let her leave the scene.
Hey, are you even listening to me?
You kill me... and now you want to chat?
Hmph, how obnoxious. I truly do not know what it is that the Heavenly Principles values so much about Descenders like you.
But don't push your luck. If you don't behave yourself, you will soon find that neither the Heavenly Principles' tolerance of you, nor my own, is limitless.
And lest you think this to be an empty threat, consider the clear precedent before you. The Third Descender's remains have been the playthings of the gods for centuries now...
If I were you, I would carefully consider the consequences of my next steps... then, I would either live with the utmost caution, or simply leave this place.
If I were you, I'd think long and hard about whether living like this is really worth it.
You act high and mighty, like you can dictate people's fates at will, holding all the rules in the palm of your hand...
But the truth is, you are bound by a far greater number of rules than those under your control. You can't do whatever you please.
Do you really presume that I have no way to kill you and your cohort once and for all?
I simply need to wait for Asmoday to return, and the Four Shades can jointly activate our authority... Or until I find the conclusive evidence I need for a conviction...
Failing that, I simply need to bide my time until the Heavenly Principles awakens...
The civilization of Snezhnaya has been hanging by a thread for a long time, and you have made yourself a willing accomplice in their schemes... I will not make excuses for you.
I thought you would have figured out a way to get rid of me for good by now... Guess I was wrong.
The way I see it, as creations of Celestia go, Paimon is far more impressive than you.
You say she has none of Celestia's power or authority... and you talk of "reclaiming" her like she's a mere object...
But all along, she's the one who's been there to guide me. Countless people have witnessed our journey, and she has subtly influenced many of their fates.
These are bonds that exist only between humans — between living beings. Don't you see? Paimon is writing her own destiny.
But you? You're the one who's more like an object. You're just someone else's tool.
All you are is a set of shackles used by the Heavenly Principles to keep humanity under control. And you've never even known true freedom yourself.
(Maybe that was going a little too far... I only meant to stall her, but thinking about Paimon made me lose my cool...)
I really thought you would have learned your lesson by now. In fact, this is where I was planning to leave things for today...
But now? Hmph. I've changed my mind.
Since the Heavenly Principles won't allow me to kill you completely, there is no need for me to do so.
Death is a relief. Only the living can experience endless torment... And I have plenty of methods of inflicting that.
I will make you hate the Heavenly Principles more than ever... You will hate them for not allowing me to kill you completely.
(Uh-oh... Well, I guess there's no backing out now.)
The time is almost here. Now, I just need to wait for Rhinedottir to resurrect you...
...What's going on? Why hasn't the resurrection started yet?
...So your hostility toward the Heavenly Principles... It doesn't necessarily stem from past grievances. It's more about Snezhnaya's ideals and future...
Khaenri'ah would have been proud to have a "mother" like you. It's just a shame Khaenri'ah no longer exists.
Is something wrong? You look a little out of sorts.
Is this conversation making you uncomfortable? I made sure to rein in my authority as the Ruler of Life, so that shouldn't be the cause.
Ah, actually, there's something I've been meaning to ask you from the beginning... Do you really think it's appropriate for you to be playing host and sipping tea with me at a time like this?
The best of your people, and the outside help you've enlisted... They all must be risking their lives fighting Ronova right now.
You have six Gnoses in your possession. If you joined the battle with all that strength...
...You might just be able to raise the odds of victory from zero to a snowball's chance in hell.
It's quite alright. I have deemed talking with you to be of greater importance.
Not having to face her is something for which you — or anyone, really — should be truly grateful.
Don't let her appearance fool you. She may seem serious about her work, but at her core, she has a capricious temperament indeed.
Yes, there she goes again. Another massacre... I do hope you weren't counting on those armed forces of yours too heavily... I believe they've already died once by now.
Well then... As much as this has been a pleasant chat, let's end things here. Time for me to clean up after my willful colleague...
Hmm? Wait... The flow of time, it's...

When Ronova realized the resurrection had not gone as planned, she prepared to leave and find out why. You, Dainsleif, and The Jester threw everything you had into stopping her, and in the end, Celestia reclaimed her authority. Meanwhile, at Zapolyarny Palace, the true cause behind it all was revealed: the Tsaritsa, with six Gnoses in her possession, had tampered with the space and time around Rhinedottir...
You uncovered the Heavenly Principles' "monitoring cycle" as well? It would seem Celestia gravely underestimated your determination to rebel.
As well as the amplifying effects of the Third Descender's remains...
Using Cryo to influence time and space, rewriting the rules of the world on a small scale... Obviously, this is power beyond what a god should be capable of possessing.
The Gnoses are just one aspect. My own insights gained over the past thousand years also played a part.
To think a mere god could reach such heights of power...
So, under the influence of your amplified Cryo power, the flow of time within this hall has become significantly slower than the outside world...
In other words, while you and I were leisurely chatting without any sense of urgency... Outside, time was passing rapidly.
And the window of resurrection that Ronova and I agreed upon to bypass the Heavenly Principles' monitoring system... It must have passed by without me even noticing.
I doubt things are looking good for Ronova right now. The Authority of Death has most likely been reclaimed.
You may analyze it all you want, but there is nothing to be gained from it. I know this strategy isn't going to work on you twice.
Now, it's about time you resurrected those killed by Ronova. This is still your duty, is it not?
Indeed. Celestia has detected this incident, and thus, a directive has been provided.
In fact, it's echoing in my mind at this very moment, demanding that I use my authority to rectify Ronova's mistake.
Though, I'm sure you were counting on this all along as well...
What can I say? I don't believe in sacrificing pawns as a means to an end.
Very well. They shall be resurrected.
Now, as for you, Tsaritsa Anastasya... You've been very bold indeed. Just what shall we do with you, I wonder?
Unfortunately, this act of "rebellion" cannot be judged by Celestia, and falls far short of the threshold for casting down a nail of retribution.
But as far as the Tsaritsa is concerned, she has quite clearly overstepped the bounds of her authority, and that is sufficient grounds for punishment.
...Haha, just kidding. No need to be so nervous.
Ronova was just punished, and Naberius and I could arguably be considered accomplices, so Celestia is keeping a close eye on us right now.
I'd rather not have the Authority of Life reclaimed as well, if it's all the same to you.
...You're using that as an excuse? Don't tell me... You intend to spare the Cryo Archon?
I must say, I've gained a lot of admiration for your courage and resourcefulness. You've proven yourself to be quite a worthy rival after all.
I think we'll leave things here for today. It's hardly polite for a guest to impose upon their host for too long.
I do hope your stay wasn't too unpleasant.
Allow me to set aside my identity as the "Ruler of Life" for a moment, and speak solely as Mage R, "Gold," descendant of Khaenri'ah...
I'm beginning to suspect Snezhnaya might be capable of achieving some monumental things indeed.
I am most dissatisfied with how you've handled this, Rhinedottir. Snezhnaya will surely escalate things after this...
Hm? What did you say, Naberius? The signal seems to be quite poor on my end...
The authority... You... You really are a conniving crew...
I think I'm back in reality now... Well? Did we succeed?
If you're back, then prepare for battle. She will not take this lying down.
Her Authority of Death may have been the biggest hurdle to our success, but even without it, Ronova's strength is still formidable.
This is pure folly... It makes no sense... They stripped it from me, just like that...
So be it — I am quite finished with showing restraint in any case. Now... I can kill without further consequence.
I will admit that you have gotten your way for now... But we will see if you can bear the cost of breaking the shackles that bound me.
＊ Defeat Ronova, who's now been stripped of her power

Even without her authority, Ronova still possessed power befitting one of the Four Shades, and now she was ready to unleash it in full. The battle grew ever more brutal, slowly but surely drawing toward its final clash...

With you and Dainsleif keeping Ronova occupied, The Jester was able to land a devastating blow at the cost of his own soul and life force. When the smoke cleared, Ronova was nowhere to be seen. There was no doubt — you had won...
Is... is it over? Is Ronova... dead?
Can the Ruler of Death even die at all...?
In fact, Snezhnaya achieved its goal in the moment that her authority was reclaimed by Celestia...
Yet, it was all but inevitable for things to end this way.
From the moment the Curse of Immortality was cast down... it created a feud that, perhaps, was also destined never to die.
Whew... Now that the blockade on Snezhnayan technology has been lifted, Project Mistilteinn can finally move forward.
If you'd told me on day one that defeating the Ruler of Death would end up being a necessary step in our plans... I definitely would have thought twice about taking the job.
Are you certain that your final strike finished her off?
Unless she used some means to escape the battle that went undetected by us all...
But even so, she will have sustained fatal and irreversible damage.
Regardless, from this point on, we all must remain on guard against potential retaliation...
For in our struggle against the gods, no one can see the full picture of fate.
...It's over, it's over! Paimon was a little nervous before meeting with the Tsaritsa this time, but there was really no need, huh?
It was basically an awards ceremony! And we totally stole the show.
The Tsaritsa commended many people besides us...
You make it sound like we deserve all the credit.
Hehe... Actually Paimon thinks the Tsaritsa herself deserves the most credit.
It took a whole bunch of us to deal with Ronova, but she handled Rhinedottir all by herself! Someone ought to commend her, too.
You should do it. You're the perfect candidate.
You can officially commend her on behalf of Celestia!
No way! Paimon wouldn't dare! That's one thing she's been worried about... What if the Tsaritsa secretly suspects that Paimon's a spy from Celestia, or something?
With me to vouch for you, no one will be suspicious of you.
Alright! Paimon's sticking with you, then!
Hey, Dain's over there. Paimon was gonna say back in the palace — he's the last person Paimon would expect to show for this kind of event... Dain!
What is it? You need something?
Why are you in such a hurry to leave? Where are you going?
I just can't wait to get out of here. I find occasions like this uncomfortable.
...If it makes you so uncomfortable, why'd you come at all? Honestly, Paimon never expected you to show up for an audience with the Tsaritsa.
She's different. I could never deny the Mother of Khaenri'ah the courtesy of a straightforward audience.
Hmm... Seems like "Mother" is the most powerful title in the world.
How about Pierro — did he keep his promise? Did you get to see The Wise?
I did. It was a little disappointing.
The most that The Wise as a young man can offer is the chance to reminisce about the past. He hasn't been exposed to the dark side of Khaenri'ah at all.
Eftirvit, on the other hand, seems rather eager to discuss his work with him.
What can I say... he's more forgiving than I expected.
Although, it could also be an attempt to resist erosion.
That battle with Ronova took an exceptionally heavy toll on his mind and soul.
To wield the immense power that he did, one always has to pay an irrecoverable price.
No wonder we haven't seen him all day. He definitely needs to get some good rest.
Snezhnaya has every right to consider their victory absolute... They finally defeated the Ruler of Death, Ronova.
Five hundred years ago, when the Khaenri'ahns looked up at her during the cataclysm, all anyone saw was an untouchable god.
So this is a milestone moment...
The beginning of a new era.
Yes. Although, one thing is certain... It will not be a peaceful era.

For the first time, Ronova, the Ruler of Death, felt "death" drawing near. Weakened, she fused the Embryonic-Ichoric-Telluric-Rudiment with Snezhnaya's Nail of Retribution, hoping to make all of Teyvat experience that same sensation as the Holy Soil spread across the land...

title: 于饯别之时散落的黑羽

CHS: 这就是我说的光之镜——无恒预设应答终端。它是天理所造，在主人沉睡期间，可以按照既定规划代行其意志。
天理四影都有访问它的权限。为了确保安全，我们用阿斯莫代的身份来操作，事情就不会牵涉到其他人。
以此地主人之名，查询有关「圣土化」的信息。
经死之执政见证、因「地原胚质」引发的圣土化已正式开始执行。
目标为重置提瓦特至初始状态，消除所有生命遗留的痕迹，为全新的可控文明诞生做好准备。
距离圣土化加速进程剩余时间：30天。
那那那，有办法停止圣土化吗？
其实…嗯…这是一个坏家伙故意触发的，我们想把它停下来！
收到问题。无法回答。需输入特定文字。
不用紧张。既然我们要查询判罚之钉引起的圣土化，那特定文字应该就是光束周围漂浮的那些。
有点像开启秘密的钥匙？阿斯莫代不是那种随身携带钥匙的神明，多半会将它存放在空之神殿各处。
我们去附近看看。相信我，大魔女艾莉丝的直觉可是很准的。
EN: This is Esoptron, a Variable-Response Query Terminal. Built by the Heavenly Principles, it is capable of acting on its master's behalf within certain parameters.
Each of the Four Shades has the right to perform queries using the terminal. It'll be safest if we use it under Asdmoday's identity, that way no one else will be implicated.
In the name of the owner of this place, search "Holy Soil phenomenon."
As witnessed by the Ruler of Death, the Holy Soil phenomenon is currently in effect, triggered by the Embryonic-Ichoric-Telluric-Rudiment.
The goal is to reset Teyvat to its original state, remove all traces of life, and make way for the birth of a new, manageable civilization.
Time until Holy Soil phenomenon is accelerated: 30 days.
Okay, so, so... is there any way to stop it?
Because, um... yeah, actually this is all the bad guys' fault, so we need to make it stop!
Query received. Unable to process. Please enter the required text.
Now, now, don't worry. Since our query is about a process set in motion by the Nail of Retribution, the special text presumably refers to those symbols floating around that beam of light.
Looks like some sort of key for unlocking a secret...? But Asmoday doesn't strike me as the sort of god to carry a key around with her, so I suspect she scattered it around the Temple of Space.
Let's take a look around. Have faith, for I, Alice, the Great Mage, have excellent intuition for these sorts of things.

title: 坏灭肇始之时·迈向未来的一步

CHS: 上次七神有机会相聚，还是在浩劫中的坎瑞亚。
五百年过去，许多熟悉的面孔已经不在，危机却一如既往。今日会议，就是要商定出合适的方案。
安娜丝塔夏女皇。你的名字我听过很多次，今天总算见到本人了。
五百年前我们虽有机会碰面，但出于各种原因没能齐聚。比如我，当时就不得不提前返回纳塔。
像这样坐在一起商议事情的场面，我印象里从来没有过。
坎瑞亚未曾覆灭时，我们就做过研究与分析：对天理而言，七国彼此孤立要远好过紧密团结。
毕竟，为数不多能够动摇秩序的神之心由七位神明保管，疏离虽然会带来许多弊端，却能维持天空岛的统治经久不衰。
这倒是一个全新的观点，从天理的角度来解释事物的合理性。但若不留意，也会滑落到阴谋论的边缘。
而且这听上去也像开脱自己的借口，用来搪塞我们之间曾面临的严重外交事故。
消除隔阂、建立联系有很多种途径，「争端」是其中最恶劣的选择。
一上来就火药味十足啊。
这也是必要的过程哦。往事并不会随风而散，我们都将面对它，而「正面」是我推荐的角度。
关于这点，我赞成珊瑚宫小姐的发言。
各个国家、各个组织之间的摩擦不胜枚举，仅用对错的表象加以评判就落了下乘。
但璃月同样有「定是非以理」的传统。为此我们曾有许多书信往来，而那些回信大多出自普契涅拉先生。
现在，我想听听「你」对过去那些事的态度。
「天权」女士，你的话里似乎藏着某种逼迫的意味。
我认为这是合理的要求。
无妨，这并非不可言说的事情。
愚人众计划收集神之心时，曾讨论过和平的方案：通过召开一场会议，以言语说服各位支持我们。
但那并不现实。众神对反抗天理态度不一，「魔神爱人」的诅咒，也让决策受到掣肘。
甚至对那些有意同行的人，我们也不得不借助一两次「表演」，将风险降至最低。
制定最可能成功的计划，而非寄望于渺茫幻想，这是至冬的行动逻辑，也是我的理念。
为此，我向所有被计划波及的人致以歉意，但我并不后悔开启这一切。
天权凝光，我理解你所说的「定是非以理」。我更喜欢另一句：「无心者公，无我者明。」
恰如其分的引用。有这个态度，我们可以谈合作。
哦？这位凝光女士意外地好说话？
危机当前，合作势在必行。态度友好、歉意诚恳，足以构成合作的基础。
当然，也仅代表「此刻」。至于更久远的未来——也许保持友好，也许摩擦不断，谁又说得准呢？
国家的意志，应当与国民的意志同向而行，并不因我们的喜怒好恶而改变。
嗯…虽然我也支持在危机面前保持合作，但很少听到这么贴切的表达。
我同意。虽然这次危机因至冬而起，但我认为并不能全部归咎女皇与属官。
死之执政若娜瓦，如果她真的是为了报复至冬，完全可以只启动这里的判罚之钉。
但她并没有这么做，这是一封给我们所有人的战书，当然应该由我们共同解决。
我们的态度不必多说…这种团结的感觉真不错。
浮世流云，须臾聚散。当前后际断，今此一心。
海祇岛会保持戒备，但不影响接下来的合作。
看来，我们当中的大多数都达成了一致。保持沉默的这位先生…
哎呀，这就是下一个要讨论的话题了呢。
取回完整权柄的水元素龙王，枫丹的最高审判官…那维莱特先生，这应该是你与我们的初次见面。
兹蹻曾目睹若陀与帝君并肩作战，没想到除却那撼动山岳的岩之龙，还有其他甘愿守护人类的龙王。
审判官先生，虽然我们发出邀请，但并未预期你会回应。
放任圣土化进行，元素力会被还原成提瓦特最原始的光界力，这对龙族来说并非坏事。
坦率地说，坐在这里，与各位商讨各项事宜，我的心情也十分复杂。
和「争端」、「摩擦」不同，龙与神之间是难解的「死仇」。
纵使我并非初代之龙，坐在这里，也能感受到体内躁动的恨意。
这一点我们非常理解。站在龙族的角度，天理和我们都是「卑鄙的僭越者」。
感谢你的理解，草木之神布耶尔。
我今天并非为复仇而来，审判终会落下，但不是现在。
枫丹虽然没有判罚之钉，但圣土化早晚会波及此地民众。我既已赦免枫丹人的罪业，天理便无权判他们死刑。
「无权」，这个说法我喜欢。或许是因为我是从人类登上的神位，天理对我来说很遥远。
比起它如何创造世界、规划未来，我更在意后果。保护好我们国家的人，这是最优先的事情。
龙与神的关系远比想象中复杂。我曾帮助草龙王阿佩普，也曾向它寻求帮助。
旧的关系被打破，我们都在探索应该如何相处。
这么看来特瓦林真是温柔的龙呀。只要带着诗歌与美酒，它就会不厌其烦地倾听我们的想法。
在纳塔，我们与龙也有独特的相处方式。等你有空，欢迎过来看看。
当然，如果有一天你要降下审判，也欢迎你来纳塔，我们痛痛快快地打一场。
各位，我并不打算与你们结下虚假的联盟，无论过去多么漫长的时间，龙也不会原谅神明的僭越。
但我想，天理也未曾预料到尘世之神会与它敌对。至少此刻，我们有相同的目标。
很好。那就让我们交换已知的讯息吧。
关于圣土化…它由判罚之钉开启，是天理灭亡地上文明的终极手段。
因为研究进度受限，火神之心也下落不明，我们短期内无法对天理进行清算。
火神之心，真的不在你们手上吗？
如果我们拿到火神之心，眼下的局面自有办法应对，无需劳烦各位亲至。
火神之心，很长一段时间由我保管，我对它最为熟悉。
但现在，我感知不到它，我们之间仿佛隔着一道看不见的墙。
愚人众已在全力搜寻火神之心，但我们要讨论的，就是在神之心尚未集齐的当下，如何停止圣土化。
在海祇岛，我们应对过圣土化的危机。
咦，珊瑚宫小姐有解决圣土化的方法吗？
知晓一些原理。皮耶罗先生说圣土化是由判罚之钉开启、天理灭亡文明的手段，这个说法并不全面。
光界力变得强势，土地回归原初状态…这种情况都可以归类为圣土化。
为了应对这种危机，我们曾通过「海祇御灵祭」，用海祇大御神的生命力唤醒珊瑚王虫。
珊瑚王虫…难道说，它能逆转圣土化？
没错，珊瑚王虫能够将光界力变回元素力，让土地重新恢复富饶。只是…
蛇神既殁，王虫稀少。即使将它们全部唤醒，也难解提瓦特的困局。
但至少是个好的方向。如果没有更好的办法，我们就全力培养那些王虫吧。
其实，纳塔也曾因为燃素富足、光界力充沛，遭受过判罚之钉的改造。
这根钉子还真是喜怒无常…既不允许光界力扩张，又把元素力打回光界力来惩罚文明。
创造与毁灭，不过随心而已。高天上的主宰有这种想法，不足为奇。
…我的故乡琅玕，本是生产晶砂珠玉的宝地。因为坠入了漆黑恶意，判罚之钉就要将一切摧毁。
我曾违抗高天意志，因此知晓它的冷漠。人类创造的文明，命运却不由人类主宰，连反抗都被视为罪行。
这正是我们想要改变的。
通过可靠渠道，我们已经得知，停止圣土化需要完成六个「僭续试炼」。
与已启动的判罚之钉数量相同。「试炼」…是天理给我们出的题目吗？
有趣，就像是要我们证明什么。
哼…无非是证明「我们有资格存在」。
或许靠近那根钉子，敲一敲，钉子就会突然打开，邀请你进去聊聊天呢。
真的假的…不过就算想靠近判罚之钉也很难，「圣土化」的状况且不论，纳塔的判罚之钉还在夜神之国。
只能先选一个国家进行尝试。
…从须弥开始吧。曾有一位沙漠的魔神研究过判罚之钉，我们留有相关知识。
须弥还在恢复元气，交给我们更合适。圣土化在纳塔也不算新东西，从圣火储存的知识里总能找到办法。
既是凶险之事，便由我们当先。此身武艺，正为今用。
无需争论。事情因至冬而起，我来承担责任，理所应当。
何况我与「已故」的岩王帝君有过契约，于情于理，都应由我来做。
（呵呵，看来不需要继续争论了…老爷子，你做起事来还是那么出人意料。）
EN: The last gathering of The Seven was in Khaenri'ah, during the cataclysm.
Five hundred years on, many familiar faces are no longer with us. Yet the circumstances that bring us together are no less grave. Today, we meet to discuss our options and agree upon a plan.
Hello, Tsaritsa. I've heard the name Anastasya many times in my life. Good to finally meet you in person.
Although we did have the chance to meet five hundred years ago, all sorts of things ended up getting in the way. For my part, I had no choice but to return to Natlan.
I don't believe we've ever had the occasion to sit down and discuss things in this manner.

Before the destruction of Khaenri'ah, we conducted research on this point. Our conclusion was that, for the Heavenly Principles, it is far better for the nations to operate in isolation than in unity.

After all, the Gnoses are the only things with the potential to disrupt the order of the world, and each is in the hands of a different archon. For all the disadvantages that isolation brings, it allows Celestia's rule to prevail.

This is a novel perspective — I don't think I've ever heard things framed in terms of the Heavenly Principles' rationale. But we must speculate with care, or we risk crossing the line into the conspiratorial.
It also sounds like a convenient excuse to explain away the serious diplomatic controversies that have arisen in the past.
There are many ways to overcome the estrangement between our nations and establish lines of communication. Conflict is by far the worst option of them all.
Whew, we're already firing on all cylinders... alright then...
It's all part of the process. Even the wind can't blow off the past — it has to be faced, in which case I suggest we do so head-on.
There has been all manner of friction between our nations and the various organizations within them. To seek to apportion blame based on superficial appearances alone would be beneath us.

Nevertheless, we have a long tradition in Liyue of determining right and wrong through reasoned argument. To that end, we have corresponded with Snezhnaya numerous times in the past, but most of the replies we have received were signed by Mr. Pulcinella.
Today, I would instead like hear to hear you, Anastasya, account for the controversies of the past in your own words.
Lady Tianquan, might I advise you to rephrase your words as a request, not a demand...
I happen to think it's a perfectly reasonable demand.
Very well. These are hardly matters that cannot be spoken of.
When the Fatui was planning the retrieval of the Gnoses, a peaceful option was tabled: Hold a meeting, and verbally persuade the other archons to support our project.

But it was not realistic. The gods hold differing opinions on the notion of defying the Heavenly Principles. Moreover, they are all cursed with a love for humanity that would impair their decision-making.
Even with those who wished to support us, we had no choice but to stage a performance so as to minimize the risk of failure.
Snezhnaya's approach was to devise a plan that might succeed, not rely on a far-fetched fantasy that could never be. It is also the philosophy I live by.
I apologize to all who have been negatively impacted by our plan, but I do not regret starting down this path.
Lady Tianquan, in the spirit of reasoned argument, I would appeal to one of your Liyue proverbs: "Only the impartial see things fairly, only the selfless see with clarity."
Very apt indeed... I respect your position. I believe we can work together.
Already? You took less persuading than I'd imagined, Lady Ningguang.
The crisis we face compels us to cooperate. Under the circumstances, the Tsaritsa's amicable tone and sincere apology are enough for me to work with.
In the short term only, of course. Who can say what the future holds? Maybe this will be the start of a new, more amicable era, or maybe there's a whole lot more friction ahead. We'll have to see.
A nation's will has to reflect the will of its people, not our personal preferences or emotional whims.
Mm... couldn't have put it better myself. I'm all for coming together in times of crisis too.
I agree. Even though Snezhnaya is the source of the present crisis, I don't think we can simply place all the blame on the Tsaritsa and her government.
If Ronova, the Ruler of Death, truly wanted to take revenge on Snezhnaya, she could easily have activated only the Nail of Retribution located here.
Yet, she chose otherwise. Her actions are a declaration of war against us all, and we ought to respond as a united front.
Not much to add from our side, but... It feels great to stand in solidarity with you all.
Worldly affairs are transient as clouds, forming and vanishing in the boundless sky. Let go of these, and all that prevails is this present moment, in which we are of one mind.
Watatsumi Island will remain on guard, but this will not impede any collaborative action.
Looks like most of us are agreed, then. But we have yet to hear from the gentleman who has remained silent so far...
Yes indeed... Which brings us to the next topic we need to discuss.
The Iudex of Fontaine — the Hydro Dragon, with his full authority restored... Monsieur Neuvilette, I believe this is the first time we have met.

Zijiao bore witness when Rex Lapis fought side by side with the great Geo Dragon, Azhdaha, at whose slightest touch the very mountains quake. Never did I think I would encounter another member of dragonkind willing to protect humanity.
Monsieur Iudex, your attendance today comes as a welcome surprise, even though you were very much invited.
To let the Hallowing run its course would restore Teyvat to its original state, turning elemental energy back to Light Realm energy once more. In the eyes of dragonkind, this is no disaster.
I won't deny that as I sit here to partake in these discussions with you all, my mind is filled with a complex array of emotions.
The rift between dragons and gods goes deeper than any "conflict" or "friction." There is a staunch animosity to which I see no easy resolution.
I may not be a first-generation dragon, but even so... as I sit here, I feel a rancor stirring within me.
We completely understand. From the dragons' perspective, both we and the Heavenly Principles belong to the same despicable breed of "usurpers."
Thank you for your understanding, Buer, God of Verdure.
I do not come here seeking vengeance. The day of reckoning will come, but today is not that day.

Though there is no Nail of Retribution in our nation, it is but a matter of time before the Hallowing spreads to Fontaine. But I have absolved the Fontainians of their sins... The Heavenly Principles has no right to cast down the death sentence upon them.
"No right" indeed... I like how you put it. Maybe it's because I'm a human first and a god second, but the Heavenly Principles seems so far removed from everyday life.

I don't care so much about how they created the world or their grand plan for the future — I'm more concerned with dealing with the consequences for Natlan. Protecting the people of my nation will always be my number one priority.

The state of relations between gods and dragons is actually far more complex than you might imagine. For instance, I've helped out the Dendro Dragon, Apep in the past, and sought her help in my hour of need.
From the ruins of a broken relationship, we're all searching for the best way to co-exist.
Now I think about it, Dvalin really is the gentlest dragon. As long as I bring some wine and song with me, he'll patiently listen to whatever I have to say.
We have a pretty unique relationship with the local dragon population in Natlan. We call them saurians. Come see for yourself sometime.
Of course, you're also very welcome to visit when that day of reckoning comes around... It'll be a duel for the ages.
...I will be frank — I have no intention of forming a feigned alliance with the present company. No matter how many eons go by, the Dragons will never forgive the gods for their usurpation.
Yet I doubt that the Heavenly Principles ever envisaged the gods of this world rising up in rebellion against them. In this moment, at least, we share a common goal.
Good. Then let us exchange what information we have.
Regarding the "Holy Soil" phenomenon, or Hallowing... It is a process initiated by the Nails of Retribution — the Heavenly Principles' final recourse, a means of destroying civilization entirely.
Due to roadblocks in our research, we have yet to locate the Pyro Gnosis. Without it, we have no immediate means of challenging the Heavenly Principles directly.
Why should we believe that you haven't acquired the Pyro Gnosis already?
Were it in our possession, I assure you we could resolve this crisis quite swiftly without any need to burden the rest of you.
I'm probably the most familiar with the Pyro Gnosis, since I looked after it for a very long time.
But I can no longer sense it. It's like there's an invisible wall separating us.
The Fatui are searching for it as we speak. But here and now, we must focus our discussion on how to put an end to the Hallowing without the full set of Gnoses to aid us.
We've dealt with the same phenomenon before on Watatsumi Island.
Oh? Then, do you know of a way to resolve it, Miss Sangonomiya?
To an extent, at least in principle. Pierro describes it as a means for the Heavenly Principles to wipe out civilization via the Nails of Retribution, but this isn't the complete picture.
Whenever Light Realm energy increases in intensity, causing the land to regress to its original state, this is a manifestation of the Holy Soil phenomenon.
When we've faced this crisis in the past, we hold a ritual called the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, which awakens the Sangacorexes using the Watatsumi Omikami's life force.
Sangacorexes... They can reverse the Hallowing process?
That's right. The Sangacorex has the ability to convert Light Realm energy back into elemental energy, rendering the land fertile again. However...
The Serpent is dead, and few Sangacorexes remain. Even if we managed to awaken them all, I don't think it would be enough to save Teyvat.
Still, it gives us somewhere to start. If no better ideas come up, we can go all-in on breeding Sangacorexes.
You know, once upon a time, Natlan's terrain was rich in Phlogiston and Light Realm energy, until a Nail of Retribution was sent to change that...

What a temperamental nail it turned out to be... First, it doesn't allow Light Realm energy to spread unchecked, then, it starts turning elemental energy back into Light Realm energy to punish civilization.
One moment a creator, the next a destroyer, all depending on its mood... If that's the way the ruler of the high heavens thinks, it would come as no surprise.

...My homeland of Lang-Gan was once a prosperous land that produced all manner of precious ore and stones. But the moment that we were beset by the dark malice, the Nail of Retribution was ready to destroy it all.

I opposed heaven's will then, and now I know its sheer indifference all too well. Humans created that civilization, yet they were denied any choice over their fate. Even to protest the fate they were handed was treated as a grave sin.
It is precisely this state of affairs that we wish to change.
We have learned from a reliable source that to stop the Hallowing, six so-called "Trials of Usurpation" must be completed.
Six nails, and six trials... So this is the Heavenly Principles' way of testing us?
Interesting... It must want us to prove something.
Hmph... All it wants us to prove is that we deserve to exist.
That, we do not yet know.
Maybe someone should go up to the nail and knock. It might suddenly open and invite you in for a chat.
Are you serious...? In any case, getting close to Natlan's nail would be pretty difficult — not just because of the Hallowing, but because it's hidden away inside the Night Kingdom.
We should pick one nation to test it out first.
...Let's start with Sumeru. There was once a god of the desert who researched the Nail of Retribution, and we still have the records of what he had learned.

Isn't Sumeru still getting back on its feet, though? Natlan would be a better choice. The Hallowing is nothing new for us, and with all the knowledge stored in the Sacred Flame, we're bound to figure something out.
Inazuma should take the lead. It is to face perils such as this that I mastered the martial arts.
There need be no debate on the matter. This started in Snezhnaya, thus is it my responsibility to bear.
Besides, I made a contract with the "late" Rex Lapis. I am obliged, both by conscience and principle, to do this myself.
(Hehe... Well, that should settle the debate... I doff my cap to you, Sir — you truly do work in mysterious ways.)

title: 坏灭肇始之时·迈向未来的一步

CHS: 虽然还有不少遗憾，但我们能做的就到此为止了。
保险起见，我们不能在这里停留太久，该准备离开了。
至冬还是和以前一样冷。不过嘛，相较于上次过来，这里好像又有哪里不同了。
为什么要说「也」？我可不想和那个冷冰冰的装置相提并论，我只是一时间没想好该怎么表达。
哦，我明白了。约安娜以前向我抱怨过，说亟待处理的事情茫茫多，评议会每天都忙到无法喘息。
这次来的时候我还特地去看了看。评议会虽然还是争吵不歇，但很多事已经没那么紧迫了。
紧迫的事情被你一件件解决了，对吧。我说娜丝塔夏，这几百年你有好好休息过吗？
此事不必再提，远未到我能休息的时刻。
就知道你会这么说。约安娜要是还在肯定会念叨你，她不在，我替她代劳几句吧。
但说到底，这是你自己的选择。保重啦，娜丝塔夏，下次再见。
还有亲爱的两位，别忘记阿姨的嘱托哦，好好生活、好好旅行，照顾好自己。
有什么情况可以联系我们。你们在做的事…我们也会看着的。
再见啦，艾莉丝、尼可！谢谢你们帮忙，嘿嘿。
陛下，还有两位贵客。魔女会的女士们已经离开了，事情有什么进展吗？
简单跟丑角传达了在空之神殿发生的事情。
六个僭续试炼…与提瓦特存在的判罚之钉数量相同。
虽然不清楚试炼的具体内容，但想要完成，多半离不开其他国家的配合。
在圣土化进程加快后，我们收到了许多封来自其他国家的质询。对于现状，他们也充满苦恼。
请各个国家的领袖来这里，我会和他们商议。
EN: I'm sure this will come as quite a disappointment, but I'm afraid there's nothing more the Hexenzirkel can do.
We can't afford to stay here much longer. So, just to be on the safe side, we ought to be heading off now.
Snezhnaya is as cold as ever. And yet... something seems to have changed since the last time I was here.
Now you're the one being coy.
Oh, don't compare me to that bland device... We are nothing alike. I just couldn't think how best to express myself in the moment, that's all.
...Okay, let me put it this way. Ioanna once complained to me about how she had to work herself to the bone every day in the Veche, because there was simply so much urgent work to be done.

Since I was visiting anyway, I took the chance to stop off there and see how things are going now. And although the Veche continues to argue as ever, most of the issues under debate there seem less pressing than once was the case.
Slowly but surely, you've worked your way through each one of those issues, haven't you, Nastasya? It makes me wonder whether you've had even a moment's rest over the centuries?
That is the least of my concerns. The time for me to rest is still a long way away.
I knew you'd say that. But I also know that Ioanna would be sure to ask about your wellbeing if she were here... So, I say these words for her sake.
Still, at the end of the day, it's your choice to make. Take care, Nastasya. Until next time.
As for you, my dearies, I do hope you make your Auntie proud. Live life to the fullest, embrace the journey, and look after yourselves.
Keep us updated if anything changes. Best of luck with everything... We'll be watching.
Bye Alice, bye Nicole! Thanks for your help!
Your Majesty, Mr. Pierro wishes to speak with you.
Your Majesty, honored guests. I see the mages of the Hexenzirkel have left. Have there been any developments?
You tell The Jester what happened in the Temple of Space.
...So yeah, that's pretty much where we're at.
Six Trials of Usurpation... In total, there are six Nails of Retribution in Teyvat.
Whatever form these trials may take, I do not think we can hope to complete them without cooperation from the other nations.
Since the Hallowing increased in pace, we have received many letters from foreign nations asking for an explanation. They, too, are extremely distressed about the current state of affairs.
Invite the leaders of all nations here. I will negotiate with them.

title: 坏灭肇始之时·迈向未来的一步

heading: 坏灭肇始之时 · 迈向未来的一步

CHS: 你准备在这里告诉我们圣土化的秘密？
准确来说并非是「我」，而是由这里的「光之镜」。
亲眼见到会更加直观，小右，交给你了。
这就是我说的光之镜——无恒预设应答终端。它是天理所造，在主人沉睡期间，可以按照既定规划代行其意志。
天理四影都有访问它的权限。为了确保安全，我们用阿斯莫代的身份来操作，事情就不会牵涉到其他人。
以此地主人之名，查询有关「圣土化」的信息。
经死之执政见证、因「地原胚质」引发的圣土化已正式开始执行。
目标为重置提瓦特至初始状态，消除所有生命遗留的痕迹，为全新的可控文明诞生做好准备。
距离圣土化加速进程剩余时间：30天。
那那那，有办法停止圣土化吗？
其实…嗯…这是一个坏家伙故意触发的，我们想把它停下来！
收到问题。无法回答。需输入特定文字。
不用紧张。既然我们要查询判罚之钉引起的圣土化，那特定文字应该就是光束周围漂浮的那些。
有点像开启秘密的钥匙？阿斯莫代不是那种随身携带钥匙的神明，多半会将它存放在空之神殿各处。
我们去附近看看。相信我，大魔女艾莉丝的直觉可是很准的。
众人在尼可的帮助下，在空之神殿找齐了激活光之镜所需的六枚符印…

回答已收录。解析完成。是否继续补充？

没有，我也是第一次听说这个名字。
光之镜，别卖关子啦，多提供一些情报呀。

或许搞清楚僭续试炼是什么，本身也是试炼的一环。

回去吧。感谢你们的协助，艾莉丝、尼可。
…我的立场不便多说什么。从亥珀波瑞亚时期开始，至冬这片土地寄托了太多人的梦想，希望你能保护好它。
我早已立下誓言，无论付出怎样的代价。
虽然还有不少遗憾，但我们能做的就到此为止了。
保险起见，我们不能在这里停留太久，该准备离开了。
至冬还是和以前一样冷。不过嘛，相较于上次过来，这里好像又有哪里不同了。

请各个国家的领袖来这里，我会和他们商议。

刚开始我还想找他切磋呢，但看他的表情就知道这不是正确的时机，留待下次吧。
有什么让他开心点的办法吗？将来老爷子问起来，我至少可以说自己「努力过了」。
我们也不知道啦。不过，给他送两瓶至冬的水，也许他的心情会变好一点？
真的吗？我记住了。多谢，伙伴。
对了，这次「随行人员」里，估计也有不少你们的朋友。要不要去找他们聊聊？
随行人员…会有谁呢？我们去看看吧。
上次七神有机会相聚，还是在浩劫中的坎瑞亚。
五百年过去，许多熟悉的面孔已经不在，危机却一如既往。今日会议，就是要商定出合适的方案。
安娜丝塔夏女皇。你的名字我听过很多次，今天总算见到本人了。
五百年前我们虽有机会碰面，但出于各种原因没能齐聚。比如我，当时就不得不提前返回纳塔。
像这样坐在一起商议事情的场面，我印象里从来没有过。
坎瑞亚未曾覆灭时，我们就做过研究与分析：对天理而言，七国彼此孤立要远好过紧密团结。
毕竟，为数不多能够动摇秩序的神之心由七位神明保管，疏离虽然会带来许多弊端，却能维持天空岛的统治经久不衰。
这倒是一个全新的观点，从天理的角度来解释事物的合理性。但若不留意，也会滑落到阴谋论的边缘。
而且这听上去也像开脱自己的借口，用来搪塞我们之间曾面临的严重外交事故。
消除隔阂、建立联系有很多种途径，「争端」是其中最恶劣的选择。
一上来就火药味十足啊。
这也是必要的过程哦。往事并不会随风而散，我们都将面对它，而「正面」是我推荐的角度。
关于这点，我赞成珊瑚宫小姐的发言。
各个国家、各个组织之间的摩擦不胜枚举，仅用对错的表象加以评判就落了下乘。
但璃月同样有「定是非以理」的传统。为此我们曾有许多书信往来，而那些回信大多出自普契涅拉先生。
现在，我想听听「你」对过去那些事的态度。
「天权」女士，你的话里似乎藏着某种逼迫的意味。
我认为这是合理的要求。
无妨，这并非不可言说的事情。
愚人众计划收集神之心时，曾讨论过和平的方案：通过召开一场会议，以言语说服各位支持我们。
但那并不现实。众神对反抗天理态度不一，「魔神爱人」的诅咒，也让决策受到掣肘。
甚至对那些有意同行的人，我们也不得不借助一两次「表演」，将风险降至最低。
制定最可能成功的计划，而非寄望于渺茫幻想，这是至冬的行动逻辑，也是我的理念。
为此，我向所有被计划波及的人致以歉意，但我并不后悔开启这一切。
天权凝光，我理解你所说的「定是非以理」。我更喜欢另一句：「无心者公，无我者明。」
恰如其分的引用。有这个态度，我们可以谈合作。
哦？这位凝光女士意外地好说话？
危机当前，合作势在必行。态度友好、歉意诚恳，足以构成合作的基础。
当然，也仅代表「此刻」。至于更久远的未来——也许保持友好，也许摩擦不断，谁又说得准呢？
国家的意志，应当与国民的意志同向而行，并不因我们的喜怒好恶而改变。
嗯…虽然我也支持在危机面前保持合作，但很少听到这么贴切的表达。
我同意。虽然这次危机因至冬而起，但我认为并不能全部归咎女皇与属官。
死之执政若娜瓦，如果她真的是为了报复至冬，完全可以只启动这里的判罚之钉。
但她并没有这么做，这是一封给我们所有人的战书，当然应该由我们共同解决。
我们的态度不必多说…这种团结的感觉真不错。
浮世流云，须臾聚散。当前后际断，今此一心。
海祇岛会保持戒备，但不影响接下来的合作。
看来，我们当中的大多数都达成了一致。保持沉默的这位先生…
哎呀，这就是下一个要讨论的话题了呢。
取回完整权柄的水元素龙王，枫丹的最高审判官…那维莱特先生，这应该是你与我们的初次见面。
兹蹻曾目睹若陀与帝君并肩作战，没想到除却那撼动山岳的岩之龙，还有其他甘愿守护人类的龙王。
审判官先生，虽然我们发出邀请，但并未预期你会回应。
放任圣土化进行，元素力会被还原成提瓦特最原始的光界力，这对龙族来说并非坏事。
坦率地说，坐在这里，与各位商讨各项事宜，我的心情也十分复杂。
和「争端」、「摩擦」不同，龙与神之间是难解的「死仇」。
纵使我并非初代之龙，坐在这里，也能感受到体内躁动的恨意。
这一点我们非常理解。站在龙族的角度，天理和我们都是「卑鄙的僭越者」。
感谢你的理解，草木之神布耶尔。
我今天并非为复仇而来，审判终会落下，但不是现在。
枫丹虽然没有判罚之钉，但圣土化早晚会波及此地民众。我既已赦免枫丹人的罪业，天理便无权判他们死刑。
「无权」，这个说法我喜欢。或许是因为我是从人类登上的神位，天理对我来说很遥远。
比起它如何创造世界、规划未来，我更在意后果。保护好我们国家的人，这是最优先的事情。
龙与神的关系远比想象中复杂。我曾帮助草龙王阿佩普，也曾向它寻求帮助。
旧的关系被打破，我们都在探索应该如何相处。
这么看来特瓦林真是温柔的龙呀。只要带着诗歌与美酒，它就会不厌其烦地倾听我们的想法。
在纳塔，我们与龙也有独特的相处方式。等你有空，欢迎过来看看。
当然，如果有一天你要降下审判，也欢迎你来纳塔，我们痛痛快快地打一场。
各位，我并不打算与你们结下虚假的联盟，无论过去多么漫长的时间，龙也不会原谅神明的僭越。
但我想，天理也未曾预料到尘世之神会与它敌对。至少此刻，我们有相同的目标。
很好。那就让我们交换已知的讯息吧。
关于圣土化…它由判罚之钉开启，是天理灭亡地上文明的终极手段。
因为研究进度受限，火神之心也下落不明，我们短期内无法对天理进行清算。
火神之心，真的不在你们手上吗？
如果我们拿到火神之心，眼下的局面自有办法应对，无需劳烦各位亲至。
火神之心，很长一段时间由我保管，我对它最为熟悉。
但现在，我感知不到它，我们之间仿佛隔着一道看不见的墙。
愚人众已在全力搜寻火神之心，但我们要讨论的，就是在神之心尚未集齐的当下，如何停止圣土化。
在海祇岛，我们应对过圣土化的危机。
咦，珊瑚宫小姐有解决圣土化的方法吗？
知晓一些原理。皮耶罗先生说圣土化是由判罚之钉开启、天理灭亡文明的手段，这个说法并不全面。
光界力变得强势，土地回归原初状态…这种情况都可以归类为圣土化。
为了应对这种危机，我们曾通过「海祇御灵祭」，用海祇大御神的生命力唤醒珊瑚王虫。
珊瑚王虫…难道说，它能逆转圣土化？
没错，珊瑚王虫能够将光界力变回元素力，让土地重新恢复富饶。只是…
蛇神既殁，王虫稀少。即使将它们全部唤醒，也难解提瓦特的困局。
但至少是个好的方向。如果没有更好的办法，我们就全力培养那些王虫吧。
其实，纳塔也曾因为燃素富足、光界力充沛，遭受过判罚之钉的改造。
这根钉子还真是喜怒无常…既不允许光界力扩张，又把元素力打回光界力来惩罚文明。
创造与毁灭，不过随心而已。高天上的主宰有这种想法，不足为奇。
…我的故乡琅玕，本是生产晶砂珠玉的宝地。因为坠入了漆黑恶意，判罚之钉就要将一切摧毁。
我曾违抗高天意志，因此知晓它的冷漠。人类创造的文明，命运却不由人类主宰，连反抗都被视为罪行。
这正是我们想要改变的。
通过可靠渠道，我们已经得知，停止圣土化需要完成六个「僭续试炼」。
与已启动的判罚之钉数量相同。「试炼」…是天理给我们出的题目吗？
有趣，就像是要我们证明什么。
哼…无非是证明「我们有资格存在」。
或许靠近那根钉子，敲一敲，钉子就会突然打开，邀请你进去聊聊天呢。
真的假的…不过就算想靠近判罚之钉也很难，「圣土化」的状况且不论，纳塔的判罚之钉还在夜神之国。
只能先选一个国家进行尝试。
…从须弥开始吧。曾有一位沙漠的魔神研究过判罚之钉，我们留有相关知识。
须弥还在恢复元气，交给我们更合适。圣土化在纳塔也不算新东西，从圣火储存的知识里总能找到办法。
既是凶险之事，便由我们当先。此身武艺，正为今用。
无需争论。事情因至冬而起，我来承担责任，理所应当。
何况我与「已故」的岩王帝君有过契约，于情于理，都应由我来做。
（呵呵，看来不需要继续争论了…老爷子，你做起事来还是那么出人意料。）
在层岩巨渊的深处，钟离自判罚之钉内出现，在他的掌心中，一枚象征着契约的摩拉凝成。天空中，判罚之钉的符号消失了一枚，璃月的试炼似乎已然通过…
奇怪，这到底是怎么回事？
关于这个，让我们听听当事人的说法吧。
一位老朋友托我帮忙，用风将一些新的情报带到这里。开始了哟。
由本仙来？好吧…既然您坚持…咳。诸位能听到吗？
璃月的「试炼」已经顺利完成，有新的线索需要分享。
所谓试炼，就是让「无罪者」进入判罚之钉内部，向天理证明文明仍按它的「神圣规划」发展。
「自由」、「契约」…一些并不陌生的词汇。
名为规划，实为天理对文明的诅咒。至于「无罪者」…
按照这个逻辑，应该就是那些领会「规划」真谛，遵循天理意志的人吧。
例如，为璃月作证的关键线索是摩拉。那是帝君的血肉铸就，象征着帝君与尘世的契约。
帝…总之有一位神秘的仙人，以一枚摩拉为触媒，展开了坚固阵法，进入判罚之钉内部。
其向天理证明了「契约」仍然有效，所以施加给璃月的僭续试炼宣告结束。
线索到此为止，预祝诸位顺利，早日度过危机。
非常有用的线索，多谢。那个——这句话能帮我传过去吗？
进入判罚之钉内部，向天理证明神圣规划仍然有效。
璃月为我们做出了示范。看来不需要另选国家作为尝试，而应当专注于完成各自的试炼。
知道该怎么办，事情就好做多了。此行收获不小，现在嘛，是不是该回去了？
试炼还剩五个，除璃月与枫丹外，我们都需要尽快完成自己国家的试炼。
本着互帮互助原则，璃月仍然会给予适当的协助。
我们同样会做一些力所能及之事。
那就多谢了。虽然不知道什么时候再次相见——愿我们都能迎来想要的明天吧。
愚人众会护送各位离开至冬堡。另外，我们也会调集各处力量，助各位一臂之力。
