...Could not connect. Activating default module. Generating answer...
Inquirer must provide sufficient grounds for seeking to end the Holy Soil phenomenon. Please state your reason.
We don't want the whole world getting wiped out because of the Hallowing... Isn't that reason enough? You can't just reset the world because you feel like it! It's not right!
Response recorded and analyzed. Do you wish to update your response, or continue?
I promised Lumine/Aether that we would meet again at the end of this journey... I don't want that to be in the ruins of a broken world.
I've traveled far and wide since I woke up here. Every nation I've been to has its challenges, but there are many out there doing everything they can to make things work.
Along the way, I've grown to love this world of Teyvat. I've made a lot of new friends here, and many precious memories.
Speaking as a living witness to this world, I believe it has a right to a continued existence. I want to protect it... That is my wish.
Response recorded and analyzed. Do you wish to update your response, or continue?
No further response detected. Sufficient grounds established. Importing data... Complete. Attempting to execute...
Checking Trial of Usurpation completion status... Six trials remaining.
I'm afraid not. This is the first I've heard of it, too.
Come on, Esoptron, don't be so coy. Give us a little more to go on.
Alright... Well, I guess we won't be getting another response out of Esoptron until these so-called "Trials of Usurpation" are completed.
You gotta be kidding... Paimon thought this thing was gonna stop the Hallowing, not give us more work!
And "coy" is putting it mildly. Not a single clear answer — clearly, it loves keeping us in the dark. Hmph, stupid machine!
Perhaps figuring out what a Trial of Usurpation is, is itself part of the trial.
We can only assume so... Nastasya, any thoughts?
Time for us to return. Alice, Nicole, thank you for your assistance.
Wait... If I may, Your Majesty.

...I can't say too much about where I stand. But since the days of Hyperborea, countless people have placed their hopes and dreams in this land we now know as Snezhnaya... So I hope you will protect it.
I swore an oath to that effect long ago. No matter the cost.
I'm sure this will come as quite a disappointment, but I'm afraid there's nothing more the Hexenzirkel can do.
We can't afford to stay here much longer. So, just to be on the safe side, we ought to be heading off now.
Snezhnaya is as cold as ever. And yet... something seems to have changed since the last time I was here.
Now you're the one being coy.
Oh, don't compare me to that bland device... We are nothing alike. I just couldn't think how best to express myself in the moment, that's all.
...Okay, let me put it this way. Ioanna once complained to me about how she had to work herself to the bone every day in the Veche, because there was simply so much urgent work to be done.

Since I was visiting anyway, I took the chance to stop off there and see how things are going now. And although the Veche continues to argue as ever, most of the issues under debate there seem less pressing than once was the case.
Slowly but surely, you've worked your way through each one of those issues, haven't you, Nastasya? It makes me wonder whether you've had even a moment's rest over the centuries?
That is the least of my concerns. The time for me to rest is still a long way away.
I knew you'd say that. But I also know that Ioanna would be sure to ask about your wellbeing if she were here... So, I say these words for her sake.
Still, at the end of the day, it's your choice to make. Take care, Nastasya. Until next time.
As for you, my dearies, I do hope you make your Auntie proud. Live life to the fullest, embrace the journey, and look after yourselves.
Keep us updated if anything changes. Best of luck with everything... We'll be watching.
Bye Alice, bye Nicole! Thanks for your help!
Your Majesty, Mr. Pierro wishes to speak with you.
Your Majesty, honored guests. I see the mages of the Hexenzirkel have left. Have there been any developments?
You tell The Jester what happened in the Temple of Space.
...So yeah, that's pretty much where we're at.
Six Trials of Usurpation... In total, there are six Nails of Retribution in Teyvat.
Whatever form these trials may take, I do not think we can hope to complete them without cooperation from the other nations.
Since the Hallowing increased in pace, we have received many letters from foreign nations asking for an explanation. They, too, are extremely distressed about the current state of affairs.
Invite the leaders of all nations here. I will negotiate with them.
Oh, hey, Tartaglia... What brings you here？
Haha, today is Councilor Tartaglia's big day out.
Entertaining foreign leaders is an important job, and although the Bureau of Ceremonies handles most of the day-to-day work, they still need some oversight from the Veche and the Fatui.
I got roped in by old man Rooster, since I hold posts in both. And because I'm so well-traveled.
Huh, makes sense. Well, good luck, Tartaglia!
Are the leaders of every nation here?
Yep, they've all showed up. Can't say it's made for a particularly cordial atmosphere...
(I've known for a long time now that many other nations aren't on very good terms with Snezhnaya. A cordial atmosphere is the last thing I would expect.)
All in all, though, I don't think there's too much to worry about. I'm sure the Tsaritsa knows what to expect. I'm more focused on whether I'll actually get to meet anyone I already know.
I wondered about Zhongli, for example, even though it was a long shot, but he hasn't shown up. Neuvillette's here... but he's the main reason the atmosphere is so gloomy.

(I guess it makes sense for Zhongli not to get involved. Sounds like Neuvillette's here to represent Fontaine in person. The Hydro Dragon and the archons, all in one place... Last I heard, he wants to put them all on trial. I wonder if he'll bring that up?)
I was hoping to spar with him at first, but from the look on his face, now wouldn't be a good time. Maybe next time.
Got any tips on how to cheer him up a little? I at least wanna be able to tell old man Rooster than I tried my best when he asks.
That's a tough one. Although... maybe you could try giving him a couple bottles of Snezhnayan water? That might help him feel better.
You think so? Okay, I'll keep that in mind. Thanks, comrades.
Oh, one last thing — all the leaders brought delegations with them. I'm guessing they're all people you know. You should go catch up with them.
Ooh... wonder who the delegates are? Let's go find out!
＊ Wait for the outcome of the meeting
The last gathering of The Seven was in Khaenri'ah, during the cataclysm.
Five hundred years on, many familiar faces are no longer with us. Yet the circumstances that bring us together are no less grave. Today, we meet to discuss our options and agree upon a plan.
Hello, Tsaritsa. I've heard the name Anastasya many times in my life. Good to finally meet you in person.
Although we did have the chance to meet five hundred years ago, all sorts of things ended up getting in the way. For my part, I had no choice but to return to Natlan.
I don't believe we've ever had the occasion to sit down and discuss things in this manner.

Before the destruction of Khaenri'ah, we conducted research on this point. Our conclusion was that, for the Heavenly Principles, it is far better for the nations to operate in isolation than in unity.

After all, the Gnoses are the only things with the potential to disrupt the order of the world, and each is in the hands of a different archon. For all the disadvantages that isolation brings, it allows Celestia's rule to prevail.

This is a novel perspective — I don't think I've ever heard things framed in terms of the Heavenly Principles' rationale. But we must speculate with care, or we risk crossing the line into the conspiratorial.
It also sounds like a convenient excuse to explain away the serious diplomatic controversies that have arisen in the past.
There are many ways to overcome the estrangement between our nations and establish lines of communication. Conflict is by far the worst option of them all.
Whew, we're already firing on all cylinders... alright then...
It's all part of the process. Even the wind can't blow off the past — it has to be faced, in which case I suggest we do so head-on.
There has been all manner of friction between our nations and the various organizations within them. To seek to apportion blame based on superficial appearances alone would be beneath us.

Nevertheless, we have a long tradition in Liyue of determining right and wrong through reasoned argument. To that end, we have corresponded with Snezhnaya numerous times in the past, but most of the replies we have received were signed by Mr. Pulcinella.
Today, I would instead like hear to hear you, Anastasya, account for the controversies of the past in your own words.
Lady Tianquan, might I advise you to rephrase your words as a request, not a demand...
I happen to think it's a perfectly reasonable demand.
Very well. These are hardly matters that cannot be spoken of.
When the Fatui was planning the retrieval of the Gnoses, a peaceful option was tabled: Hold a meeting, and verbally persuade the other archons to support our project.

But it was not realistic. The gods hold differing opinions on the notion of defying the Heavenly Principles. Moreover, they are all cursed with a love for humanity that would impair their decision-making.
Even with those who wished to support us, we had no choice but to stage a performance so as to minimize the risk of failure.
Snezhnaya's approach was to devise a plan that might succeed, not rely on a far-fetched fantasy that could never be. It is also the philosophy I live by.
I apologize to all who have been negatively impacted by our plan, but I do not regret starting down this path.
Lady Tianquan, in the spirit of reasoned argument, I would appeal to one of your Liyue proverbs: "Only the impartial see things fairly, only the selfless see with clarity."
Very apt indeed... I respect your position. I believe we can work together.
Already? You took less persuading than I'd imagined, Lady Ningguang.
The crisis we face compels us to cooperate. Under the circumstances, the Tsaritsa's amicable tone and sincere apology are enough for me to work with.
In the short term only, of course. Who can say what the future holds? Maybe this will be the start of a new, more amicable era, or maybe there's a whole lot more friction ahead. We'll have to see.
A nation's will has to reflect the will of its people, not our personal preferences or emotional whims.
Mm... couldn't have put it better myself. I'm all for coming together in times of crisis too.
I agree. Even though Snezhnaya is the source of the present crisis, I don't think we can simply place all the blame on the Tsaritsa and her government.
If Ronova, the Ruler of Death, truly wanted to take revenge on Snezhnaya, she could easily have activated only the Nail of Retribution located here.
Yet, she chose otherwise. Her actions are a declaration of war against us all, and we ought to respond as a united front.
Not much to add from our side, but... It feels great to stand in solidarity with you all.
Worldly affairs are transient as clouds, forming and vanishing in the boundless sky. Let go of these, and all that prevails is this present moment, in which we are of one mind.
Watatsumi Island will remain on guard, but this will not impede any collaborative action.
Looks like most of us are agreed, then. But we have yet to hear from the gentleman who has remained silent so far...
Yes indeed... Which brings us to the next topic we need to discuss.
The Iudex of Fontaine — the Hydro Dragon, with his full authority restored... Monsieur Neuvilette, I believe this is the first time we have met.

Zijiao bore witness when Rex Lapis fought side by side with the great Geo Dragon, Azhdaha, at whose slightest touch the very mountains quake. Never did I think I would encounter another member of dragonkind willing to protect humanity.
Monsieur Iudex, your attendance today comes as a welcome surprise, even though you were very much invited.
To let the Hallowing run its course would restore Teyvat to its original state, turning elemental energy back to Light Realm energy once more. In the eyes of dragonkind, this is no disaster.
I won't deny that as I sit here to partake in these discussions with you all, my mind is filled with a complex array of emotions.
The rift between dragons and gods goes deeper than any "conflict" or "friction." There is a staunch animosity to which I see no easy resolution.
I may not be a first-generation dragon, but even so... as I sit here, I feel a rancor stirring within me.
We completely understand. From the dragons' perspective, both we and the Heavenly Principles belong to the same despicable breed of "usurpers."
Thank you for your understanding, Buer, God of Verdure.
I do not come here seeking vengeance. The day of reckoning will come, but today is not that day.

Though there is no Nail of Retribution in our nation, it is but a matter of time before the Hallowing spreads to Fontaine. But I have absolved the Fontainians of their sins... The Heavenly Principles has no right to cast down the death sentence upon them.
"No right" indeed... I like how you put it. Maybe it's because I'm a human first and a god second, but the Heavenly Principles seems so far removed from everyday life.

I don't care so much about how they created the world or their grand plan for the future — I'm more concerned with dealing with the consequences for Natlan. Protecting the people of my nation will always be my number one priority.

The state of relations between gods and dragons is actually far more complex than you might imagine. For instance, I've helped out the Dendro Dragon, Apep in the past, and sought her help in my hour of need.
From the ruins of a broken relationship, we're all searching for the best way to co-exist.
Now I think about it, Dvalin really is the gentlest dragon. As long as I bring some wine and song with me, he'll patiently listen to whatever I have to say.
We have a pretty unique relationship with the local dragon population in Natlan. We call them saurians. Come see for yourself sometime.
Of course, you're also very welcome to visit when that day of reckoning comes around... It'll be a duel for the ages.
...I will be frank — I have no intention of forming a feigned alliance with the present company. No matter how many eons go by, the Dragons will never forgive the gods for their usurpation.
Yet I doubt that the Heavenly Principles ever envisaged the gods of this world rising up in rebellion against them. In this moment, at least, we share a common goal.
Good. Then let us exchange what information we have.
Regarding the "Holy Soil" phenomenon, or Hallowing... It is a process initiated by the Nails of Retribution — the Heavenly Principles' final recourse, a means of destroying civilization entirely.
Due to roadblocks in our research, we have yet to locate the Pyro Gnosis. Without it, we have no immediate means of challenging the Heavenly Principles directly.
Why should we believe that you haven't acquired the Pyro Gnosis already?
Were it in our possession, I assure you we could resolve this crisis quite swiftly without any need to burden the rest of you.
I'm probably the most familiar with the Pyro Gnosis, since I looked after it for a very long time.
But I can no longer sense it. It's like there's an invisible wall separating us.
The Fatui are searching for it as we speak. But here and now, we must focus our discussion on how to put an end to the Hallowing without the full set of Gnoses to aid us.
We've dealt with the same phenomenon before on Watatsumi Island.
Oh? Then, do you know of a way to resolve it, Miss Sangonomiya?
To an extent, at least in principle. Pierro describes it as a means for the Heavenly Principles to wipe out civilization via the Nails of Retribution, but this isn't the complete picture.
Whenever Light Realm energy increases in intensity, causing the land to regress to its original state, this is a manifestation of the Holy Soil phenomenon.
When we've faced this crisis in the past, we hold a ritual called the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, which awakens the Sangacorexes using the Watatsumi Omikami's life force.
Sangacorexes... They can reverse the Hallowing process?
That's right. The Sangacorex has the ability to convert Light Realm energy back into elemental energy, rendering the land fertile again. However...
The Serpent is dead, and few Sangacorexes remain. Even if we managed to awaken them all, I don't think it would be enough to save Teyvat.
Still, it gives us somewhere to start. If no better ideas come up, we can go all-in on breeding Sangacorexes.
You know, once upon a time, Natlan's terrain was rich in Phlogiston and Light Realm energy, until a Nail of Retribution was sent to change that...

What a temperamental nail it turned out to be... First, it doesn't allow Light Realm energy to spread unchecked, then, it starts turning elemental energy back into Light Realm energy to punish civilization.
One moment a creator, the next a destroyer, all depending on its mood... If that's the way the ruler of the high heavens thinks, it would come as no surprise.

...My homeland of Lang-Gan was once a prosperous land that produced all manner of precious ore and stones. But the moment that we were beset by the dark malice, the Nail of Retribution was ready to destroy it all.

I opposed heaven's will then, and now I know its sheer indifference all too well. Humans created that civilization, yet they were denied any choice over their fate. Even to protest the fate they were handed was treated as a grave sin.
It is precisely this state of affairs that we wish to change.
We have learned from a reliable source that to stop the Hallowing, six so-called "Trials of Usurpation" must be completed.
Six nails, and six trials... So this is the Heavenly Principles' way of testing us?
Interesting... It must want us to prove something.
Hmph... All it wants us to prove is that we deserve to exist.
That, we do not yet know.
Maybe someone should go up to the nail and knock. It might suddenly open and invite you in for a chat.
Are you serious...? In any case, getting close to Natlan's nail would be pretty difficult — not just because of the Hallowing, but because it's hidden away inside the Night Kingdom.
We should pick one nation to test it out first.
...Let's start with Sumeru. There was once a god of the desert who researched the Nail of Retribution, and we still have the records of what he had learned.

Isn't Sumeru still getting back on its feet, though? Natlan would be a better choice. The Hallowing is nothing new for us, and with all the knowledge stored in the Sacred Flame, we're bound to figure something out.
Inazuma should take the lead. It is to face perils such as this that I mastered the martial arts.
There need be no debate on the matter. This started in Snezhnaya, thus is it my responsibility to bear.
Besides, I made a contract with the "late" Rex Lapis. I am obliged, both by conscience and principle, to do this myself.
(Hehe... Well, that should settle the debate... I doff my cap to you, Sir — you truly do work in mysterious ways.)

In the depths of The Chasm, Zhongli emerges from within the Nail of Retribution. In his palm, a Mora that symbolizes contracts takes shape. One of the Nail's runes disappears. It seems Liyue has passed its trial...
That's strange. What could have caused it?
Might I suggest we hear it from the parties involved?
An old friend, with a little help from yours truly, has some information to bring to us on the wind. The floor is yours~
Must I? Very well then... since you insist... Ahem, I trust everyone can hear one clearly?
Liyue's trial has been completed without incident. It has yielded some new information, which must be shared with you all.
The trial requires one who is free of sin to enter into the Nail of Retribution and demonstrate that their civilization is progressing in accordance with the Heavenly Principles's divine plan.
"Freedom, "contracts"... Terms with which I'm sure all of us are very familiar.
A "plan" in name alone — in truth, they are curses placed on our civilizations by the Heavenly Principles. As for those "free of sin"...
Logically speaking, that should mean those who grasp the true meaning of the plan and act in accordance with the Heavenly Principles's will.
Incidentally, the key to Liyue's proof was Mora, which is made from Rex Lapis's flesh and blood and represents his contract with the mortal world.
Re... Regardless, a mysterious adeptus deployed a magic array using a Mora coin as a catalyst, and entered inside the nail.
In doing so, said adeptus evidenced to the Heavenly Principles that the contract is still valid, and with that the Trial of Usurpation given to Liyue was declared complete.
That is all the information I have. May you all overcome this crisis swiftly and successfully.
That's extremely useful information, thank you! ...Uh, could you pass that along for me?
In conclusion, each trial requires someone to enter the Nail of Retribution and prove to the Heavenly Principles that their divine plan is still in effect.
Now that Liyue has shown us the way, we no longer need to select a test nation. Instead, each should focus on completing the trial assigned to them.
Now that we know what we're doing, this'll be much easier. Good meeting, everybody. We made a lot of progress today. Guess it's time for us to head back now?
Five trials remain. With the exception of Liyue and Fontaine, all of us need to complete our nations' trials as quickly as possible.
In the spirit of collaboration, Liyue will continue to provide assistance as needed.
We, too, shall do whatever is within our means to help.
Thanks, genuinely. I don't know when we'll meet again, but for each one of us, may the new dawn bring us the future we're hoping for.
The Fatui will escort everyone out of Snezhnograd. We will also liaise with our forces around the world to provide what assistance we can.

title: 坏灭肇始之时·迈向未来的一步

heading: 寄自彼岸的昨日 · 叩响终幕之门

CHS: 原来大家已经到了啊…欸欸，芙宁娜？怎么是你来了，那维莱特呢？
哎，我想他对这里会发生什么有所预料，对自身龙族的身份有些介怀。
是啊，毕竟你看，来自天空的邀请就在眼前呢。
和前往空之神殿的门有点类似…
里面应该是天理的领地吧。
没错，所以他的判断是对的，谁知道龙族进入天理的地盘会不会触发什么莫名其妙的防御或者惩戒呢。
他联系了我，虽然我早就不是水神了，但他认为我出面依然比他更合适。
没办法，如果不是我还能有谁呢？哎，不过这地方真不好走，幸好有玛薇卡在。
嗯？难道说她捎了你一程？
是全程哦，芙宁娜那时候就在纳塔嘛，我们就一起过来啦。
怎么样，驰轮车很刺激吧？
是挺刺激的，名不虚传，如果起飞的时候能再慢一点就好了…
哈哈哈，记下了，下次我注意。
以前只在传闻中听过沉玉谷的山清水秀，亲眼一看，依然是超过了我的想象啊。
呃，你还有心思看风景，难道完全不紧张的吗？
哈哈，有什么可紧张的，到目前为止一切顺利不是吗？每个国家都做得很好。
问心无愧，便不会自乱阵脚。
呵呵，有你们两位镇场，我也有了更多的底气呀。
他还在忙于对抗圣土化引起的各种事件，毕竟现在圣土化只是暂停了，还没消失呢。
他说，这种决定世界命运的大事，还是应该交给「尘世七执政」来做。
同感，若帝君在世，他一定最适合代表璃月出面。
没有啦，你过谦了，像你这样把魔神的职责扛在肩上的人类，才真是不容易呢。
谬赞了，璃月靠的都是群策群力，绝非我一人之功。
这么看，钟离还是不打算露面啊…
也是，反正就像试炼的时候，真有大事他还是会出手吧。
既然各国代表已经到齐，客套话就到此为止吧，我们需要尽快出发。
门的背后，应该就是属于天理的领地。不知道它是否愿意逆转这些已经被圣土化的地方…
这都是我们需要探究与争取之事，走吧。
检测到受邀者来访，尝试联系中央数据库。
欢迎来到天空岛的统合演算阵列「神之座」。
天空岛…我们真的到天空岛上来了啊。
开始阐述本次邀请的目的：你们已触犯无可饶恕的禁忌。依照预设程序，提瓦特需要进行「重置」。
生命，文明，管理者都需要回归初始状态，以保证提瓦特的稳定。
但你们通过完成试炼，证明了自身的价值，所以圣土化进程现已暂停。
你们很优秀，做得很好，值得肯定。
没想到都闹到这种程度了，你还愿意公正地审视我们。
理应被毁灭的文明并非都是失败的文明，文明最终会步入歧途，也是数据库与规划不完备的体现。
只要你们足够优秀，于我便有价值。
在空之神殿的初次接触，我曾问询，你们为何想要参与试炼，拯救世界。
我已知晓你们的答案，在试炼完成之后，我将基于这份答案给予最合适的奖励。
在最后的42天内，请挑选出你们各自心中最值得保留下来的一位神之眼持有者，也就是「原神」——
他们将作为本次文明最后的记录，登上天空岛。
这算什么合适的奖励啊？你、你难道根本没打算放过我们？！
重申：理应被毁灭的文明并非都是失败的文明，同理，证明自身价值的文明，依旧需要被毁灭。
我那时候告诉你，我喜欢提瓦特这个世界，因为它给我留下了很多美好的回忆，让我认识了很多朋友。
它对我而言非常重要，就像是第二个故乡一样重要，你为什么曲解了我的愿望！
无法理解。你说你因为提瓦特很美好所以想要守护它，所以我给了你们把最好的东西留下来的机会。
他们会作为「命运的向量」，将下一轮文明引导至更好的方向，这是名为永生的超越。
这也是「原神」最伟大的作用，之于提瓦特最重要的价值。
那我不得不提问，曾经已经登上天空岛的原神，比如温妮莎，她现在在哪里？
稍等，数据检索中…完成匹配定位，载入展示程序。
闪亮之处，即「剥离式神识、实在本体与心智存储核心」。
亦可简称为温妮莎的存放处。
存、存放？你怎么把人说得跟杂物一样！
生命的存在形式无关紧要，原神最重要的职责是引导命运，他们只需要专注于此即可。
这就是原神最后的下场…
既然你如此反感生命的僭越，为何不完全框定这所谓的命运，还要用原神来引导变数？
这是经由非常复杂与漫长的计算后得到的最优结果。
唯有运用这种规则创造的人类，才能和数据库中有关人类的记录取得最大程度的拟合。
我所诞生的世界已然消亡，无从获取外部信息，只能利用文明的衍化反哺系统，以取得进步。
简而言之，只有这套系统，才能让你们变得越来越好。
所以，我们只是你的养料，对吗？
极端情况下，是的。以「薪柴」形容更加贴切。
我不认为这应当招致怨恨，虽然真相稍显冷酷，但我已经足够宽容，我的视线也不会只停留在你们身上。
既然你有那么多文明样本，难道没想过反叛是一种必然？
就是，你话都说到这份上了，我们肯定会反抗到底！
世界的命运不该由你决定。
视角不同，结论不同，你们拥有畅想与行动的自由。
期限只有42天，在那之后，真正的毁灭将会降临。
不可理喻，没必要留在这里了。
我还以为，原神是个好词呢，登上天空岛，不就是去当神吗？多令人羡慕的事啊…
在这之前谁都是这么想的，哎…也算是确证了这个不得了的秘密吧。
它过去都不想让天空岛上的事被地面上的文明知晓，这次愿意告诉我们…
虽然很不想这么说…在它看来，这就是某种「临终关怀」吧…
说起来，在解决纳塔试炼的时候，圣土化的力量接触到了圣火，解除了一部分信息的封锁。

「灰烬中如果留下了最初的心，那他就达成了原神的真实。」
原本还以为这句话和深渊战争有关，没想到，是和原神的秘密有关啊。
原神成为薪柴，能让世界去往更好的方向…
与纳塔传承不息的火焰最大的区别，就是天理的这份「崇高愿景」，并未把当下的「我们」包含在内。
总之，我想没人会接受天理的提案吧。

欸，这样吗？我只是很气愤而已…当然，现在也很气愤！
留给我们的时间，只剩下42天…灭世的预言，又是这种东西。
这次也会有办法的，芙宁娜。
嗯，抱歉，我只是有点…哈啊。
顺应天上的意志是不会有出路的。在它的眼里，我们是柴薪，是样本，是沙箱中的试验品。
今日会面，应该粉碎了诸位心中最后有关和平的念想。我们唯有反抗到底。
能定义原神的，只有原神自己啊。
哎，可是火神之心依然下落不明…
对不起，我只是很担心，顺嘴说出来了…我知道大家都很紧绷，怪我这时候提…
不用在意，它本来就是我们绕不过的问题。不止派蒙你会这么想，我们需要共同面对它。
大家都想办法找找火神之心吧，找遍提瓦特也要把它找出来。现在大家都在一条船上了。
是啊，只要大家能团结到一起，我、我也不紧张…不行不行，骗人的，还是很紧张啊。
我已经有过一次旅行。所以，你也要像我一样抵达终点，才能在自己的眼中，留下这个世界的沉淀。
我已经有过一次旅行。所以，你也要像我一样抵达终点，才能在自己的眼中，留下这个世界的沉淀。
（不知不觉，我心中的提瓦特，已经像是她/他心中的坎瑞亚了吧…）

EN: ＊ Go to the place where the light converges
Oh, everyone's here already... Wait, what? Furina? Where's Neuvillette?
*sigh* I guess he suspected what might happen here, and being a dragon, he had his misgivings about showing up in person.
Of course. I mean, look — that's an invitation from the heavens, right in front of us.
It reminds me of the doorway to the Temple of Space...
I guess beyond that door is the Heavenly Principles' domain.
Exactly, so Neuvillette made the right call. Who knows what kind of crazy defense systems or punishments might be triggered if a dragon came strolling through the front door.
He reached out to me. Apparently, even though I stopped playing the Hydro Archon ages ago, he still thought I'd be the better candidate.
I couldn't really say no — I mean, if not me, then who else? This terrain, though — absolutely horrendous. Can't imagine trying to walk it. I'm lucky Mavuika gave me a lift.
Huh? Did Mavuika pick you up halfway, or something?
Nope, I brought her the whole way. Furina was in Natlan anyway, so it made sense to travel together.
So, how was your white-knuckle ride on the flamestrider? Live up to the hype?
It most certainly did. White-knuckle is right... I wouldn't have objected to a gentler take-off when we started flying, though.
Hahaha, okay, got it. I'll know for next time.
Y'know, I'd heard of Chenyu Vale's stunning scenery before, but seeing it for myself... it's even more beautiful than I imagined.
Uh... How are you in the mood to admire the scenery right now? Aren't you nervous?
Haha, there's nothing to be nervous about. Everything's gone pretty smoothly so far, hasn't it? Every nation's done an admirable job.
When the conscience is clear, the mind does not succumb to panic.
Hehe, even I'm feeling more confident with you two here to steel our nerves.
Varka didn't come along this time?
He's still busy dealing with the fallout of the Hallowing. It might've stopped spreading, but that doesn't mean it's gone away.
He also said that since the fate of the world hangs in the balance, the Seven Archons are now our most suitable representatives.
I couldn't agree more. If Rex Lapis were still with us, he would without question be best placed to represent Liyue.
Hey now, don't underestimate yourself. Being a god is one thing, but for a human being like you to step up and fill the boots of a god? That's what I call impressive.
You flatter me. My personal contribution to the administration of Liyue is but one piece in a large puzzle. We rely on a group effort, from planning to execution.
Guessing Zhongli doesn't plan on showing up, then...
It can only mean that he trusts and respects Ningguang.
True. Anyway, he'll always be sure to step in when he's really needed — like during the trial.
Since all nations are accounted for, I suggest we end the pleasantries here and head off at once.
Beyond that door is most likely the Heavenly Principles' domain. Let's hope they're willing to reverse the damage that has already been done by the Hallowing...
Indeed. We shall see what we are up against, and make our case. Let's go.
Invitees detected. Attempting to connect to the central database.
Welcome to the "Divine Throne," Celestia's integrated computational array.
Celestia... We actually made it to Celestia...
Proceeding to explain the reason for inviting you here: Your kind has committed a transgression for which there is no pardon. The default program requires Teyvat to be reset.
Life, civilization, and administrators are to be restored to their initial states to maintain the stability of Teyvat.
However, in completing the trials, you have proven your value. The Holy Soil phenomenon has therefore been suspended.
You have distinguished yourselves and performed admirably. This deserves recognition.
I'm pretty surprised you're willing to judge us fairly after all this ruckus.
Not every civilization that must be destroyed is a failed civilization. When civilization goes astray, it also reflects database and planning insufficiencies.
So long as you are sufficiently distinguished, you are of value to me.
When we first came into contact at the Temple of Space, I asked why you wished to undertake these trials and save the world.
I now have your answer, and with the trials complete, I shall grant you a reward that best meets your terms.
In these final 42 days, each of you is to select a single Vision bearer — or "allogene," as they are also known — whom you deem to be most worthy of preservation.
They shall ascend to Celestia as the final record of this civilization.
What kind of reward is that!? You... So you never had any intention of letting us survive!?
I reiterate: Not every civilization that must be destroyed is a failed civilization. Likewise, a civilization that has proven its value must still be destroyed.
What I told you was that I love this world because of all the friends I've made and the precious memories it's given me.
Teyvat is essential to me — it's like a second home. You've flagrantly misrepresented my terms! How dare you!
I do not understand. You expressed that you wished to protect Teyvat because of the wonderful things it has given you, so I have granted you the chance to preserve the very best of it.
As "Vectors of Fate," they shall guide the next cycle of civilization toward a better future. This is the definition of transcending and attaining immortality.
It is also the highest calling of the allogenes, and their greatest value to Teyvat.
Then I have to ask... Where are the allogenes who ascended to Celestia in the past? Where is Vennessa right now, for instance?
Please wait, retrieving data... Match found, location identified. Loading display program.
The flashing light marks the "Disembodied Divine Consciousness, Essential Self, and Mind Storage Core."
Or, more simply, where Vennessa is stored.
Stored!? How can you put people in storage like they're inanimate objects!?
The form life takes is insignificant. An allogene's foremost duty is to guide fate. They need only devote themselves to that task.
So that's what becomes of the allogenes...
If you find the arrogation of living beings to be so distasteful, why not delineate Fate as you see fit? Why give the allogenes any control over the variables at all?
This is the optimal result arrived at through immensely complex and extremely lengthy calculations.
Only humans created according to these rules can most closely model humanity as recorded in the database.
The world in which I was born is gone, and I cannot receive information from beyond. Progress is possible only by feeding the evolution of civilization back into the system.
Put simply, this is the only system that can allow you to become better and better over time.
So we're nothing more than fodder to you? That's what you're saying?
In extreme cases, that is correct. Although "fuel" would be a more accurate descriptor.
I do not believe this warrants resentment. The truth may appear somewhat cruel, but I have been lenient enough. My gaze extends far beyond you alone.
With so many samples of civilization to draw on, have you never considered that rebellion may be inevitable?
Yeah! After everything you've said, you can bet we're gonna fight back tooth and nail to the bitter end!
The fate of the world should not be yours to decide.
Different perspectives yield different conclusions. You have the freedom to imagine what you will and act as you choose.
Only 42 days remain. After that, true annihilation shall descend.
There is no point staying here. This entity cannot be reasoned with.
＊ Leave the Divine Throne and discuss the current situation
...All this time, Paimon thought being an allogene was a good thing. You know, ascend to Celestia, become a god... It's everyone's dream.
That's what everyone thought until now. *sigh*... I guess this confirms the truth. What an unbelievable secret.
In the past, Celestia never would've wanted the civilizations of the world below to find out what happens up there. But this time, it told us the truth...
As much as I hate to say this... I suppose that, from its perspective, it is allowing us to die with some sort of dignity...
Now I think about it, when I was dealing with Natlan's trial, the Hallowing encroached on the Sacred Flame and released some of the sealed information.
Among that information was that verse we've chanted since ancient times:
"If the intention yet remains, achieved the allogene's truth he has."
I always assumed that verse had something to do with our war against the Abyss. Who would've thought it was referring to the secret of allogenes.
Allogenes are turned to fuel that drives the world in a better direction...

The biggest difference between that and Natlan's everlasting flame is that the Heavenly Principles' grand vision for the future doesn't have any place in it for us... the people living in the here and now.
I think I speak for us all when I say, the Heavenly Principles' proposal is completely unacceptable.
Absolutely. Paimon took the words right out of my mouth back there.
Oh... Really? Paimon was just livid, that's all... And still is, obviously!
I can't believe we only have 42 days left... As if one apocalyptic prophecy wasn't enough for one lifetime...
Furina... We've beaten prophecy once before. We can do it again.
Mm... Sorry, yeah, it's just all a little... Mm.
Following the will of heaven can only lead us to a dead end. In Celestia's eyes, we are but fuel... samples... test subjects in a sandbox.
Whatever hopes of peace may have remained in any of our hearts have surely been crushed today. Our sole remaining option is to fight until our last breath.
For Rex Lapis. We cannot let him down.
Yeah. We have to find a way through this.
Allogenes should get to define themselves in their own terms.
But we still don't know where the Pyro Gnosis is...
Agh, sorry... Paimon's so overwhelmed, it just slipped out... Probably the worst idea to bring it up now, when everyone's already at breaking point...
Don't apologize. You only said what we were all thinking. There's no point skirting around the issue — we have to face it, together.
Alright, well... let's go search for that Gnosis, then. We'll scour every inch of Teyvat if we have to. We're all in the same boat now.

You're right. As long as we all stick together, Paimon's confident that... that... Nope, forget it — can't fake it. Paimon's not feeling confident at all right now. She's losing her mind with anxiety...
I have already traveled through this world once. Once you reach the end of your journey as I did, you will see for yourself the true nature of this world.
I have already traveled through this world once. Once you reach the end of your journey as I did, you will see for yourself the true nature of this world.
(All of a sudden, Teyvat is to me what Khaenri'ah is to her/him...)
(I understand now, Lumine/Aether. What a lonely thing it would be if memories were all that was left of this world...)

哎，我想他对这里会发生什么有所预料，对自身龙族的身份有些介怀。

这么看，钟离还是不打算露面啊…
也是，反正就像试炼的时候，真有大事他还是会出手吧。
既然各国代表已经到齐，客套话就到此为止吧，我们需要尽快出发。
门的背后，应该就是属于天理的领地。不知道它是否愿意逆转这些已经被圣土化的地方…
这都是我们需要探究与争取之事，走吧。

title: 寄自彼岸的昨日·叩响终幕之门

CHS: 虽说是不那么正式的谈话，我仍要对诸位致以感谢。感谢诸位来到这里，与我们并肩而立。
谢斯芬赫和贝努目前正在帮助学者们维护阿如，还请原谅他们的缺席。
至于已不在的赫曼努比斯，我们诚挚地怀念他。
不是没想过有朝一日与你们几位见面的状况，真像这样聚在一起，还是有些唏嘘。
时间带走了许多东西，还使留下的那些变得牢固。
有一点我很惊讶，也必须指出。

怎么会…就连阿佩普的力量也没用吗？
别担心，派蒙。不是没有用哦。
只不过我与世界树的联系过于深厚，在世界树的问题解决之前，我是不可能完全恢复的。
你们淡出的日子里，须弥经历了巨大变化。魔神离去势必招致信仰减弱…你们已经察觉到，自己的力量不如从前。
我则因为世界树的影响变得虚弱。此时此刻，我们几个都很狼狈。
非常时期，需要更多助力。
须弥是我们共同的家园，我与诸位，神明与人类，一切的力量，都应在此刻联合起来。
无论神王阿赫玛尔在或不在，三王的盟约都将持续生效。而我等作为赤王的臣子，也有责任支撑须弥度过灾难。
何况，将我等从阿如这牢狱中放出的，正是须弥的子民。时代变化，如今的人们比从前更具有智慧了。
唉，说漂亮话还得是老羊。
那么，我们应当更进一步了解你们的计划。
教令院的学者，那些人类中的佼佼者，着手开放并改造了阿如。他们宣称跟世界树有关。
世界树最初便存在于提瓦特，在龙族掌控一切的时代，它并不具有如今这般重要性。
「天理」降临后，使光界力化分为元素力，将世界树改造为记录一切信息的存续装置。
自此，世间万事与世界树息息相关。
我作为草神，肩负着保护世界树的责任。而对须弥来说，世界树既是宝贵之物，也是客观存在的危机。
近些年提瓦特变故颇多，一段时间前，挪德卡莱更是爆发出重大危机。须弥不得不警惕起来。
我设法管理着所有可从外部传送至世界树内的途径，然而世界树依然出现了重大问题…
我认为，有某种存在主动入侵了它。入侵者没选择走那些途径，而是用了最常见也绝对无从阻止的办法。
如果是这样，的确无从阻止。你总不能因为不知何时才发生的入侵而无限期阻拦灵魂回归地脉。
是的，防止外敌很重要，我也同样无法认可逝者的灵魂得不到安息。
请理解草神大人的苦衷。
守护从来都是一件难事。
世界树被入侵后，极短的时间内，我的权限便遭到限制。紧接着，世界树拒绝了一切连接…
你一定很自责，但无需如此。谁都无从预测所有灾难，世界总要经受磨难。
可须弥的子民不该承受这些。我们必须找到办法突破封锁连接世界树。
是的。放眼整个须弥，在综合效能上足以匹敌世界树的存在，只有阿赫玛尔留下的阿如。
陷入昏迷前，我能做的仅仅是对世界树稍加干涉。阿如是大家不得已的选择，也是极为冒险之举。
学者们最初的计划，是借用阿如的力量重启虚空，以此连接并调查世界树。
但可惜，在世界树恶化程度远超预期的今天，这一举措失去了意义。
想解决问题，就不得不将计划推进到更严峻、更不计成本的地步。于是另一些预案诞生了。
为了夺回世界树，最聪明的学者们再次改造阿如，尝试通过它达到多个目的。也感谢你们，同意了他们的请求。
千年不见，人类的智慧确有提升。另外，除了我们，镇灵、兰那罗与花灵也愿意帮助你们。
我们会竭尽全力拯救世界树。
对了，刚才你谈到入侵者的口吻，就好像你认识他，知道他会做出这种事来。
EN: Even though this isn't a formal meeting, I'd still like to start by saying how grateful I am to each and every one of you. Thank you all for coming here and standing by our side.
Shesepankh and Bennu are currently assisting the scholars with the maintenance of Aaru. Please forgive their absence.
As for Hermanubis, may he rest in peace. We remember him with great fondness.
There have been times when I've imagined what it might be like to meet you all. Now that it's really happening, I feel quite emotional.
Time has taken many things away, but that which remains is all the more resilient.
I must say, there is one thing that rather surprises me.
You appear to be in good spirits, Lesser Lord Kusanali. But even so, I can sense that the life force given to you by the Dendro Dragon has far from fully resolved the problem of your vitality...
Oh no... So even Apep's power didn't work?
Don't worry, Paimon. It worked very well indeed.
The issue is how closely I am tied to Irminsul. Until the problem with it is resolved, there's no way I can fully recover.

Sumeru has undergone tremendous changes during your absence. When gods pass away, inevitably people's faith in them grows weaker... You must have sensed it already. Your power is not what it once was.
I, too, have grown weaker due to the effects of Irminsul. Right now, we're all in quite a sorry state.
We take all the help we can get.
Sumeru is our shared home. You and I, gods and humans alike, we must unite all our strength in this moment.
Though Al-Ahmar is no longer with us, the alliance between the three gods remains in force. Regardless, as subjects of our King, we have a responsibility to support Sumeru through this catastrophe.
Not to mention that it was the people of Sumeru who released us from this prison of Aaru. Times have changed, and the people of today possess greater wisdom than those of the past.
Heh, you really know how to give a rousing speech, Goatie.
Now then, let us learn more about your plan.
The brightest minds of the Sumeru Akademiya are busy opening and renovating Aaru. They claim it has something to do with Irminsul?
Irminsul has existed in Teyvat since the very beginning. But during the age of the dragons, it did not possess the significance it holds today.
After the Heavenly Principles arrived, the power of the Light Realm was divided into elemental energy, and Irminsul was refashioned as a device that records and preserves all information.
Since then, everything in this world has been inextricably linked to it.
As the Dendro Archon, I have a duty to protect Irminsul. To Sumeru, it is both a national treasure and, undeniably, a major threat.
Teyvat has seen many upheavals in the last few years. The most recent of these was a major crisis in Nod-Krai, which forced Sumeru to be even more vigilant than usual.
I made sure to monitor all the pathways through which an outsider could potentially transmit themselves into Irminsul. But despite my efforts, a major problem still arose within...

I still believe that someone has actively invaded Irminsul. But rather than taking any of the pathways I referred to, the intruder chose instead to utilize the most direct route... and the only one that cannot be protected against...
I see what you mean. You cannot simply stop all deceased souls from returning to the Ley Lines because of a potential invasion that could occur at any time.
That's right. As important as it is to guard against external threats, I couldn't allow myself to stop the souls of the departed from finding peace.
Please understand how difficult this predicament was for the Dendro Archon.
Defense has never been an easy task.
After Irminsul was invaded, my authority was quickly restricted. Soon after that, the tree began denying access to any connections...
I'm sure you feel responsible, but you are not to blame. No one can predict every possible disaster. There will always be trials and tribulations for the world to endure.
But the people of Sumeru should not have to endure this. We must find a way to break through the lockdown and connect to Irminsul.
And this is why you need Aaru.
Yes. The only thing in Sumeru capable of rivaling Irminsul in terms of overall function and performance is Al-Ahmar's legacy — Aaru.
All I managed to do before falling into a coma was make some minor adjustments to Irminsul. Using Aaru is a last resort, and a move that comes with enormous risks.
The scholars' initial plan was to borrow Aaru's power to reboot the Akasha, then use the Akasha to connect to Irminsul and investigate.
Unfortunately, Irminsul has suffered far greater damage than they first thought, rendering that plan futile.
To rise to the challenge, we had to resort to more extreme and far costlier means. This has led to a number of new contingency plans.
To reclaim Irminsul, our brightest scholars have made further modifications to Aaru with multiple goals in mind. I thank you all for giving them your blessing in this endeavor.
Human wisdom has clearly improved over the millennia. You have not only our support, but that of the Jinn, the aranara, and the pari.
Together, we will do everything in our power to save Irminsul.
By the way... When you spoke earlier of an intruder, it almost sounded as if you knew who you were dealing with, and what they were capable of.

CHS: 很高兴能见到你的计划更进一步，我的声音并没有造成不可挽回的损失。
果然啊…是夜神，她被唤醒了。
什么，夜神？就是夜神之国的那个夜神？！
我掌管魂灵的国度，由于力量所剩无几，只能以沉睡换取存在的延续。
而今日我被这台装置唤醒，难以克制本能的哀嚎，这种声音，足以唤起灵魂的激荡…
但你们的灵魂都很完整，所以影响比较小。而他灵魂有残缺，因而产生了强烈的波动，几近瓦解。
然而他竟然以意志守住了灵魂，艰难地度过了最危险的时候，真是了不起的人类。
所以，他会做出异常的行为，也是由于这次波动的影响吗？
不是，还有另外的灵魂也受到了影响，它发现了这处残缺，想要躲避起来，却又被赶了出去。
但这个灵魂并不是来自纳塔或者夜神之国，我也不知道它的来源在何处。
眼前的「秘源机关」是为了重新构造地脉，可是为什么启动它的结果，却是唤醒了你？
因为，我曾是纳塔地脉，夜神之国的「构建者」啊。
在远古时期的龙与降临者的战斗中，世界边缘被破坏，深渊由此侵入，纳塔的地脉破损最为严重。
为了帮助居住在这里的纳塔人，夜神整合了旧地脉的残片，重构其脉络，「夜神之国」由此诞生。
后来初代火神希巴拉克强化了它，并建立了用于对抗深渊的规则，即沿用至今的「还魂诗」与「归火圣夜巡礼」。
原来是这样…我想起来了，你曾说过，来自「天空」的力量。
眼前的装置，是远古的巨龙试图强化地脉的道具，会将力量注入到地脉的中枢。
在遥远的过去，这种做法算不上有效，因为相较于地脉精妙的结构，他们的技巧实在粗糙。
而且现在地脉的结构早已变化，这种力量只能由我承受…
虽然方式很粗暴，我会承受巨大的痛苦，但至少我汲取到了一些力量，能让我醒来与你们交谈，再为你们做一些事。
比如，以我完全消失为代价，再为你们重构一次地脉。
为、为什么你愿意牺牲到这种程度？
纳塔的人崇拜我，为我冠上夜神之名。在过去我们消亡之前，还有另一个名字，名为「天使」。
但对于你们冒险家来说，更亲切的名字，应该是我们退化之后的形态…「仙灵」吧。
怪不得这里会有仙灵出现，在夜神之国的时候，也有突然出现的仙灵帮助了我们…
纳塔遗留的天使很少，所以仙灵也所剩无几，大家都围绕着我，为人类献上力量，重构了地脉。
眼看如今人类顽强生活，将我视为信仰，我很满意。
玛薇卡，希巴拉克意志的继承者，纳塔如今的领袖——
虽然误解重重，但我醒过来了，我也获得了由这位愚人众执行官和烟谜主英雄赋予的力量…
只要你一声令下，我仍然会像几千年前那样，尝试执行我的使命。
为了纳塔的人类，你只需要向我点头。为了跨越深渊的灾难，请你向我下达命令吧。
在大规模的重构之后，你会彻底消失，建立在「夜神之国」的纳塔规则也会不复存在。
记载于旧地脉中的记忆和传说也会消失，纳塔人会面临许多精神上的问题，譬如失忆，记忆紊乱，认知障碍…
这和动用「神之心」，用灵魂与记忆织网一样，都是不可接受的代价。
生命的延续高于你提到的所有代价，一旦深渊失控，留下的只有尸骸与废墟。
那之后怎么办呢，当新的地脉再次被深渊入侵的时候，纳塔人要怎么办，他们还有什么武器？
不再受到夜神与规则庇护的土地，能延续到什么时候呢？
多一天算一天，无法度过现在，就没有资格考虑未来。
非要等到大规模的牺牲出现，你才能明白这个道理吗！
牺牲什么的…还、还没到那种时候吧？
你为何对现状如此悲观？
为什么…因为我是坎瑞亚的幸存者，我亲眼见到过深渊带来的恐惧与绝望。
没错，我的家人，我的故乡，我的战友与同胞，都在深渊的侵袭中永远地消失了。
这种刻骨铭心的痛苦，哪怕是五百年的岁月，依旧宛如昨日。有过相似经历的你，玛薇卡，一定知道我在说什么吧。
嗯，痛苦万分，追悔莫及，即便现在还会在梦中见到灾厄肆虐的景象…
如果回到那个时刻，我不会再心存侥幸，即使不择手段，也要让他们活下来。
现在这个选择就摆在面前，为什么不做呢！
因为我们没有权力做出这个决定。
我们之所以深爱这个世界，是因为它记载了我们的幸福与感动，也塑造了我们的思想与意志。
放弃记忆与历史，等同刷新所有人的认知，他们会变成完全不同的人，只是使用了同一具躯壳而已。
但时间也会塑造新的文明，如果你相信人类，就应该相信他们还能创造出新的繁荣。
也可能重蹈覆辙，深渊再度袭来，一切都毫无意义。
我曾经是众望所归，也心怀急躁，认为「队长」你的主张是顾全大局的做法。
但在弥留之际，记忆中的人和事，重新唤起了我那强烈的愿望。
我蒙受过太多人的恩惠，无法接受就这么忘却一切，甚至舍弃我必须「奉献」的使命。
无论是前路还是归途，总有一个我们应该去的地方，如果迷失在原地，我将失去作为「我」的意义。
没错，纳塔的英雄用生命践行了与深渊抗争的意志，每一代人的牺牲都是对下一代人的「祝福」。
这一切都有价值，在我看来，也是通往胜利的道路，我还不想认输。
是啊，这不只差一个人了吗？
从装置里获得的力量，能让我清醒一段时间，我始终就在这里，也随时做好了准备。
哪怕是你们再一次失败，只要还有人能活着回到我的面前，现在的办法就依然可行。
但人类是让天上的神明都刮目相看的存在，比如你们每一个人，在我的眼中，都如太阳一般耀眼。
我想，你与这片土地有深厚的渊源，才会如此强烈地想要拯救它。
你想要守住的究竟是土地，还是人呢？
既然欧洛伦也继承了属于英雄的记忆，眼下只差一个人了，我们还能再等等。
如果你的计划真的能成功，那将会是最好的结果。
在这期间，我和我所率领的愚人众都会向你们提供帮助。
感谢，能有这么强的执行官作为助力，对我来说也是十足的好消息。
可能我们永远无法在生命的看法上达成一致，但至少现在我们可以并肩作战。
那赶紧让外面的人都停手吧，肯定还在交战呢。
哦，对啊，得马上去说明情况才行。
那外面交给我们吧，之后我们在竞技场见面。
EN: I'm happy to see your plan advance one step further. It seems that my cry did not cause irreversible damage.
Just as I thought... The Lord of the Night has awakened.
The Lord of the Night? As in... the one who rules over the Night Kingdom!?
I preside over a realm of souls. Due to my limited power, sleep is the only way I can extend my existence.
When you activated the device, I awoke and could not hold back my cry. It is a sound that agitates souls.
Most of you were unaffected because your souls are intact. But, with a damaged soul, the effect on your friend was heightened, and his soul almost shattered as a result.
And yet, his soul remains in one piece. He managed to overcome this obstacle through sheer strength of will... A truly impressive feat for a human.
So, was that what caused all his strange behavior earlier?
No. An additional soul was affected. It tried to take refuge in the missing part of your friend's soul, but was ultimately expelled.
However, this soul does not hail from Natlan or the Night Kingdom. Its origins remain a mystery to me.
Activating the Source Mechanism was supposed to reconstruct the Ley Lines. Why did it awaken you instead?
Because I was the one who originally constructed Natlan's Ley Lines... otherwise known as the Night Kingdom.
The ancient battle between the Descender and the dragons destroyed the corner of the world, allowing the Abyss to invade. Natlan's Ley Lines took the worst of the damage.
To aid the people of Natlan, the Lord of the Night used the fragments of the old Ley Lines to reconstruct a similar network. That's how the Night Kingdom was born.

The first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque, strengthened that realm and established the rules that aid our fight against the Abyss — the Ode of Resurrection and the Pilgrimage, both of which are practices that survive to this day.
Oh, right... You said before it all came from the "power of the heavens."
The ancient dragons tried to use this device to strengthen the Ley Lines by imbuing them with power.
Back then, this method was rather ineffective. They lacked the skills to navigate the intricate structure of the Ley Lines.
And now, the structure of the Ley Lines has also completely changed. I am the only possible vehicle for the power generated by the device.
It was an incredibly crude and painful method, but I managed to absorb some of that power. Now, I can speak to you like this and provide you with aid.
Such as rebuilding the Ley Lines once more... at the cost of my own existence.
But, why would you make that kind of sacrifice?
The people of Natlan worship me, and call me their "lord"... In the ancient past, before we died out, we were also known by a different name... "Angels."
But, adventurers like you are probably more familiar with our devolved form... Seelies.
No wonder there are Seelies around here. A Seelie also helped us in the Night Kingdom...
Few angels remain in Natlan, so the same is true of Seelies. Everyone rallied around me and offered their power to humanity to reconstruct the Ley Lines.
Now, I have witnessed your determined pursuit for survival, and I have become your faith... I am very pleased.
Mavuika, inheritor of Xbalanque's will, and leader of Natlan...
Despite all the obstacles and misunderstandings, I have awoken, and the efforts of this Harbinger and the young hero have imbued me with power.
Say the word, and I will once again work to fulfill my mandate, just as I did thousands of years ago.
You need only nod your head. For the sake of your people and your nation, for the sake of overcoming the invasion from the Abyss, give me your orders.
After reconstructing new Ley Lines, you will cease to exist. The rules of Natlan are founded in the Night Kingdom. If you disappear, so do they.
Not to mention, all the memories and legends recorded within the old Ley Lines will disappear along with you. The people of Natlan will face memory loss, mental disorders, and cognitive issues...
Just like the consequences of using the Gnosis, that is a price I refuse to accept.
Humanity's survival is worth any price. Once the Abyss runs rampant, all that remains will be a land of corpses and ruin.
And when the new Ley Lines are invaded again by the Abyss? What then? How are future generations supposed to survive?
A land without the Lord of the Night, without the protection of the rules... is doomed from the start.
You presume too much. If you cannot ensure survival in the present, you have no right to think about the future.
What will it take for you to realize that? How many hundreds or thousands will have to die!?
The situation hasn't gotten that dire yet... has it?
Why are you so pessimistic about the situation?
Why...? Because I am a survivor of Khaenri'ah. I've witnessed the devastation and terror of the Abyss with my own eyes.
That's right. My family, my comrades, my homeland... were all lost to the Abyss.
It is an unforgettable pain, one that no amount of time could ever dull... not even five hundred years. You've experienced something similar, Mavuika. You should know exactly what I mean.
You're right. The pain, the regret, the catastrophe... they all haunt my dreams to this day...
If I could go back, I would reject all false hope. I would do whatever it took to ensure their survival.
You have that chance before you now. Why do you refuse to take it!?
Because we don't have the right to make that decision.
We love this world because it contains everything we hold dear... everything that has happened here has moved us, shaped us, and turned us into who we are today.

Giving up our memories and history would mean rewriting everything. The people of this world would then become fundamentally different beings, their physical bodies the only connection to their former selves.
Even so, given enough time, a new civilization would inevitably flourish. If you believe in humanity, you should trust in their ability to create a new future.
Or, history could repeat itself, the Abyss could invade once more, and it would all be for nothing.
I once carried the hopes of many people, and I was also desperate to save our nation. In The Captain's plan, I saw a chance to ensure our survival.
But, as I was on the brink of death, my wish for life and purpose was rekindled.
I've been very fortunate to be well cared for by all the people in my life. I refuse to forget that. My feelings were so strong, they overrode my compulsion to sacrifice myself for their safety.
No matter what path lies before us, we still have a destination. If we lose our way now, we will lose the meaning of our existence.
That's right. Natlan's heroes gave their lives so we could have this chance against the Abyss. Their sacrifices are our blessings.
Not only are their deeds and spirits exceptionally meaningful, they may also well be our path to victory. I don't want to give up just yet.
Yeah! We're just one hero short!
The power from the device will allow me to remain awake for some time. I stand at the ready should you change your mind.
Even if you fail, you need only send someone my way. My offer still stands.
Humanity is truly remarkable. Even the gods in the heavens hold you to be special. Even now, you stand before me, dazzling like the sun.
You must have a profound connection to this land, since you're so determined to save it.
But, what are you really trying to protect? The land? Or its people?
Pretty sure he wants to hear what you have to say, 旅行者.
I suppose we can wait. Now that Ororon has inherited the memories of his forebear, there's only one hero left.
Your plan does have the potential to generate the best outcome.
In the meantime, you shall have the aid of all the Fatui under my command.
Thank you. Having such a powerful Harbinger on my side is a big advantage.
I know we may never completely see eye to eye on what it means to protect life, but for now, I'm willing to fight by your side.
Alright, we should let everyone else know about the plan. They're probably still at each other's throats outside.
Good idea. We need to explain the situation.
I have a few more questions for the Lord of the Night.
Oh, guess we'll stick around then...
I'll update everyone outside. Let's meet back up at the Stadium.

CHS: 你们，和之前的所有人都不一样。你们是人类吗？
旅行者肯定是人类啦！只不过不是海祇岛本地人就是了。
是吗？我还以为人类成年了会失去飞行能力。深海龙蜥的幼崽拥有辨别色彩的能力，成年之后反而就看不见了。
阿祇小姐对深海龙蜥好像很了解的样子啊。
你们为什么知道我的名字？
啊，是你帮助过的伤兵们说的。
在下名叫上野，是剑鱼一番队的代理队长。这次是下来保护伤员撤离，同时尽力辅助这位调查渊下宫异状的。
之后剑鱼一番队会稍作休整，然后开始行动。那么我先告退了。
你们是来帮忙解决问题的吗？
那可太好了。我现在维持这里的千灯长明就已经很吃力了。要去解决黑暗蔓延实在是力有不足。
阿祇知道这是怎么回事吗？
是虚无界的入侵。白夜国的住民认为存在三个世界：龙蜥界、人间界和虚无界。
渊下宫的黑暗是虚无深渊的东西，龙蜥和人都无法忍受。
可是深海龙蜥不是喜欢黑暗的吗？
深海龙蜥只是讨厌光，因为在这深渊之下，光就代表着人类的活动。
实际上龙蜥界指的就是纯粹、原始的元素生物世界，它在书上的名字叫做「光界」。
「光界」的七王，则是代表蛮荒、原始元素力之顶的元素七龙。
所以这就是露子把这次行动叫做「三界路飨祭」的原因啊。
「三界路飨祭」…和真实情况相去不多。不过它真正的名字应该叫「三角路飨祭」。
因为虚界黑雾的根源就是渊下宫边陲三角的高塔。
那三个高塔，是之前试炼的地方！
话说，阿祇小姐为什么要戴着这个奇怪的面具呢？
为了遮丑吧。我在成长的过程中发生了一些事情。我担心吓到一般人，仅此而已。
你们会因为这个不相信我吗？
不会的不会的。阿祇小姐一直在帮助受伤的人，我想大家都应该很感谢你。只不过…
EN: You are... different from all the others. Are you human?
Well 旅行者 is, obviously! Just not a native of Watatsumi Island, that's all.
Oh, really? Because I thought that humans lose the ability to fly when they reach adulthood, just like Bathysmal Vishaps lose the ability to see in color when they reach maturity.
Tsumi, you seem to know a lot about vishaps.
Wait, how do you know my name?
Oh, the wounded soldiers mentioned you.
We came to investigate the darkness.
Greetings, my name is Ueno, acting captain of Swordfish I. We're here to evacuate the wounded and support the Traveler's investigation.
Swordfish I needs to rest and reorganize before commencing the evacuation. I'll see you later.
So you're here to help resolve this, hmm?
Very well. It's taking all the energy I have to keep this light shining. I don't have the strength to try and combat the spreading darkness, too.
Do you understand what's going on?
The Void Realm is invading. The people of Byakuyakoku believe that there are three realms: the Vishap Realm, the Human Realm, and the Void Realm.
The darkness spreading in Enkanomiya comes from the Void Abyss. Neither vishaps nor humans can endure it.
But don't Bathysmal Vishaps like the dark?
No. They hate the light, but only because down here in the depths, the presence of light signifies human activity.
In fact, the Vishap Realm is the realm of pure, primordial elemental beings. It's actually referred to as the Light Realm in most books.
The Seven Sovereigns of the Light Realm are the seven foremost elemental dragons at the pinnacle of the raw and primitive elemental forces.
So that's why Tsuyuko called this the "Three Realms Gateway Offering."
"Three Realms Gateway Offering"... Not far off the mark, actually. But technically, I think it should be called the "Triangle Gateway Offering."
Because the source of the darkness from the void is the three towers at the corners of Enkanomiya's triangular borders.
Oh, the three towers! The ones where we did those trials.
By the way, Tsumi, what's up with the weird mask?
To hide my face. It has to do with some things that happened as I was growing up. I just don't want to scare anyone, that's all.
Does that make me untrustworthy in your eyes?
No, not at all. You've been helping the wounded all this time, everyone must be super grateful to you. It's just that...

CHS: 看来你已经学会怎么使用睦疏之匣了。那么我来为你说一下行动的最终目的。
之前也说过，我们需要推进到渊下宫边陲的三处高塔那里。那些塔是深渊的家伙依照形制和传统复原的虚界之塔。
他是一个满嘴鬼话的家伙。不知如何，他知晓了渊下宫三界与三角的事情。之后就用深渊的技术，带来了那些东西。
并且利用虚界塔开始散布深渊的力量。这会让珊瑚王虫和深海龙蜥都十分痛苦。
我并不知道他这么做有什么意义。对我们来说，深渊像是强烈毒素；对他们来说，也是慢性且成瘾的鸩酒。
可能只是喜欢背叛和玩弄他人吧。
我确定了，一定是那个家伙！
你们认识吗？那他就是共同的敌人了。
想要消除黑雾，需要登上虚界塔的最高处，然后启动上面的光界之锥凿，把光界的力量放进来。
渊下宫确实是人界之地脉、光界之元素奔流，以及虚界之暗流都很强的地方。
另外，我只是按照书上写的步骤施行的仪式。好像千灯的核心是面前这个人像。
对它供奉光界力量结晶的话，可以让睦疏之匣变得更厉害。在此处休息的话，也可以恢复匣子的能量。
另外请你收下这个手绘地图吧，三座塔的位置为你标记好了。探索需要循序渐进，推荐你从这里的塔先入手。
那么，我能帮助你的地方就到这里了。我在这里静候你的佳音。
EN: It seems that you have mastered the Bokuso Box. Now, let me tell you about the ultimate purpose of this operation.
As I said, we need to proceed to the three towers on Enkanomiya's borders. They are Towers of the Void, restored to their original form by a certain Abyss adherent.
Abyss adherent? Wait, do you mean...
He's a purveyor of incessant nonsense. Somehow, he found out about the Three Realms and the three corners, and brought those things in using Abyssal technology.
Then, he started disseminating Abyssal energy using the towers. This caused great suffering for both the Sangacorallia and the Bathysmal Vishaps.
I don't know why he is doing this. For us, the Abyss is highly toxic, for them... intoxicating is more the word. Addictive, but still destructive.
Maybe he just likes to toy with people and stab them in the back.
Paimon knows exactly who you're talking about.
You know him? Then it seems we have a common enemy.
To get rid of the darkness, you need to climb to the very top of the Towers of the Void and activate the Light Realm Chisel, which will let in the energy of the Light Realm.
In Enkanomiya, the Ley Lines of the Human Realm, the elemental currents of the Light Realm, and the dark currents of the Void Realm are all exceptionally strong.
Also, I only performed the Sentou Ceremony going off the steps in the book. But I believe the key to the ceremony is the statue in front of us.
You can offer crystals of Light Realm energy to it to increase the Bokuso Box's power. Also, resting here can restore the box's energy.
Please take this hand-drawn map. I've marked out the locations of the three towers for you. You'll need to explore one step at a time, and I'd recommend you start with this tower.
Well, that's as much help as I can offer you. I'll be waiting here for the good news.

CHS: 赋予武器突破之力的材料。
提瓦特沿海的诸国把超越七神庇护的外部称之为「暗之外海」，据说许多战败的魔神不愿意活在新的七神秩序之下，于是逃到了远岛，化作了邪神。不过它们的力量和岩王帝君的力量本就同源，和这个吞噬一切的漆黑并不一样。
EN: The coastal nations of Teyvat refer to the region beyond the protection of The Seven as the Dark Sea. It is said that many defeated gods refused to live under the new order of The Seven, so they fled to remote islands and became evil gods. However, their powers came from the same source as Rex Lapis, separate from this all-devouring darkness.

title: 物品说明·漆黑陨铁的一角

CHS: 我在穿越虚假之天的时候，曾见过三枚围绕提瓦特的月亮。其中两枚已经碎裂，冰冷的残骸漫无目的地漂流。完整的那枚也了无生气，但它的意志并未完全消散。或许有一天，在虚假的天幕上，能够诞生独属于这世界的「真实」。
EN: I once saw the three moons of Teyvat when I was passing through the false sky. Two are utterly destroyed, their lifeless remains drifting aimlessly through space. The one that remains intact shows no signs of life either, but its will has not faded completely. Maybe there's a chance that one day, a glimmer of truth will emerge in the false sky — a truth belonging to this world alone.

heading: 真实之月 · 月之将坠

CHS: 你们将成为第一第二个见到我得意之作的人…或者飘浮灵？
不管了。来，都不许眨眼，仔细地看清楚。
哇，是个从来没见过的东西！
这个计程仪直观表现了「术式」的进展。目前，它还在构建最重要的联结。
进程完成时，我会将它送到你身边。这样才能迎回哥伦比娅。
送到身边？如果只是计算结果的话，直接用通讯仪告诉我们不就行了？
…啧。你这小东西还真是没见过世面。这不是简简单单的「算式」，而是能够构建某种规则的「术式」。
…算了，说多了你们也不明白，总之只要知道它是哥伦比娅回来所需的必要条件就行了。
我把这些数据分享给你。尼可同意我使用她构建的信息通道，所以可以通过嘟嘟通讯仪，像这样…
好了。现在你也可以查看进程了。
废话，我一直很厉害，哈哈哈哈。
嗯，我需要交代给你的就这些。接下来要是有空，也去看看其他人，监督一下他们，别让任何人掉链子。
在愚人众，这类监督不属于苛责的范畴。我只是希望一切顺利。
目前术式还在运转，我不方便移动。你就作为我的第二双眼睛，去完成使命吧。
旅行者，派蒙，很高兴见到你们。
菲林斯！你这边准备得怎么样？
还不错。我已经做好正面迎战多托雷的准备了。
哦哦，这一次看起来比平时还认真些呢。
说真的，我平时不怎么喜欢全力以赴。那不利于隐藏身份，对吧？再说，一个人应当有选择地展露实力。
养精蓄锐，更好地赢下关键之战。目前我正处于这个状态。
能看到你认真，心里都踏实了几分。对吧旅行者？
能得到两位的信任，我很荣幸。
还请好好休息。我衷心希望，能在决战中见到精神抖擞的你们。
你对我的称呼还真奇怪。咏月使小姐、咏月使女士…都叫过了。
是啊，不行吗？这不都是你吗。
但我已经想好直接叫你奈芙尔了。
我本来就叫这个，有什么奇怪的。
意思是不加任何称谓，直呼其名。
也许可以证明我们的关系变融洽了。
我们来看看你们的情况！准备得还顺利吗？有好好休息吗？
放心吧，不会拖大家后腿的。
我也会全力帮助大家取得胜利。
对了，请允许我给你们稍微检查一下…
…好了。两位的状态都不错，真是再好不过了。
不用客气。你不比我们任何人轻松，所以你也要好好休息，直到迎战多托雷的那一刻。
放心吧，我会监督他/她的。
那就好。派蒙自己也要注意休息哦。
尼可小姐送来了支援，那夏镇附近现在已经构筑起完整的防御工事了！
泛着金色的火光…是尼可女士的力量。
加上刚才法尔伽团长送来的信息…嗯，他们果然商量好了。
有她帮忙，情况应该会稳定一些。至少大家可以得到最基本的保障。
是旅行者和派蒙！你们好。
按照计划，那夏镇交给我和阿贝多。
虽说多托雷的能量界域一直在不断向这里拓张…我们会竭尽全力守住阵地的。
我们并肩作战过很多次，每一次都取得了好的结果。
这次一定也是如此，所以，尽管去战斗吧。
（有什么东西过来了…是「博士」的爪牙吗？）
在击退「博士」的爪牙后，「博士」也现身在你们面前，并亲手为你们划定了战场，战斗一触即发…
我知道你们在搞些自以为挣扎的小花招，不过看起来，似乎没能坚持到进程的最后一步啊。
让我猜猜，你们是想让哥伦比娅回来吧，那怎么没见到桑多涅？难道你们在为她争取时间？
有趣…这两位的性格可不常规，居然也与你们建立了如此深厚的联系。
说到哥伦比娅，我也曾将她视作妹妹。她在愚人众那些年，我们一度关系良好，相处愉快。
只是后来突然有一天，她不再愿意参与任何实验。我至今都不明白，是什么事让她不高兴？
多令人惋惜啊，我本可以有一个妹妹，一个家人的。她竟然不怎么喜欢我了，唉。
那么多人热衷于扮演这陈旧的戏码，世界真是太迂腐了。
还有你，本来也可以走向正确答案的。想到要这样杀了你…呵呵。
但我向来具备诚意，再给你一次机会吧。要不要与我合作？在我数到十之前，做出决定。
桑多涅？真难得，你居然也跑到这么高的地方来。
做事风格依然那么倒胃口呢。可别以为人人都要感谢你给的机会。
（桑多涅？可现在术式的进度还没完成...）
来得真巧。我原本在和旅行者谈合作，看见你，我必须得说，真是太浪费了。
我说过，会平等地给所有人一次机会。但你主动送上门来…那就是浪费了一次机会。
哈！骗谁呢，以为我会信吗？
原本还想着解决完上面的事再慢慢处理你那个术式，也好，辛苦你特地上来，帮我省了不少力气呢。
在战局濒临崩溃时，「木偶」与她的造物普隆尼亚抵达了战场，并对「博士」发起了攻击。但手握三月之力的「博士」轻松压制了普隆尼亚的攻势，你们二人的攻击也没有伤到他分毫。在将你们击退后，「博士」决定先将你彻底杀死，不过，「木偶」却替代你承受了「博士」的攻击，在「博士」发起最后一击后，「木偶」彻底停止了运转，就此没了声息…
你看。机械造物是如此脆弱，轻轻一弄…就碎掉了。
不论桑多涅再怎么醉心发明，她一死，存在于她体内的术式也会停止。
当然，能坚持到现在也值得夸奖了。同事一场，我有能力欣赏她顽固的态度。
你，到这里来。在我身旁找个位置吧。
刚才，计数被打断了。但我破例给出的第二次机会还在，你依然可以趁现在加入我。
你分明已经理解这力量与权能，为什么不愿意迈向更完美的可能性？
不想跟我说话？好吧，今天的你和平时不太一样，话变少了。
那聊点实在的吧。就以桑多涅作为话题好了，她以前就这样，从不真正相信别人，也很不喜欢分享研究成果。
严格来说，她并非毫无长处，能从无数的信息中提炼并优化出如今这个世界式，当真不可思议。
但她总是不愿给出信任。要是能将术式交给别人来看护或执行，你们说不定还有一丝胜算。
击败顽固而笨拙的人，真令人痛心。
你大概从没想过，人是会变的吧。哥伦比娅逃离那次也是，桑多涅这次也是。
任你摆出何种姿态，我都能感觉到，你才是信不过别人的那种人。
在你看来，我是那样的吗？
现在的你，还能做什么呢？
「博士」自以为击溃了所有人，但「木偶」的计划早已如期实现，法尔伽与「仆人」在尼可的帮助下，试图将「霜月」拉入虚假之天，即使「博士」闭合了天帷，但「霜月」依旧撞破穹顶，重临世间。在下一个刹那，获得了「三月权能」的哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅，也与月亮一同重临提瓦特。
哥伦比娅展现了自己的权能，战场被她完全接管。随后，哥伦比娅夺回了月髓，之前被「博士」禁锢起来的同伴们也尽数回归。众人合力向「博士」发起了新一轮攻势，最终，「博士」被你们所击败了。
EN: Glad you asked. You two are about to become the first people to lay eyes upon my masterpiece... Or should that be the first person and the first, uh... Specter?
Eh, whatever. Come. Feast your eyes on this.
Wow, we've never seen something like this before!
This meter displays the progress of my formula. Currently, it's still making the most important connections.
Once it's finished running, I'll deliver it right to your side, and then, we can finally bring Columbina back.
What do you mean, deliver it? Can't you just tell us over the Dodocommunication Device? It'll just be some numbers, right?
Ugh. You're such a greenhorn. This isn't the kind of formula you solve in math class. It's a highly complex algorithm capable of constructing a framework of rules.
...Whatever. We'll be here all day if I start trying to explain it. All you need to know is, the formula must be completed before we can bring Columbina back.
I'll share the data with you. Nicole's agreed to let me use her information channel, so we just need to use the Dodocommunication Device like so, and...
There. Now you can check in on my progress.
Wow, look at that! You're amazing, Sandrone!
Pfft, about time you recognized my genius! Took you long enough! Hahaha.
Anyway, that's all from me. You should check on the others if you have time — make sure we don't have any weak links in the chain.
That might sound harsh to you, but close supervision is a common practice in the Fatui. Not looking to catch anyone out — I just care about everything going smoothly, that's all.
I'm kinda stuck here while the formula's running, so I need you to be my second pair of eyes in the meantime.
旅行者, Paimon. A pleasure to see you both.
Fairly well, if I do say so myself. Personally, I am ready to confront Dottore head-on.
Ooh, you sound much more serious than usual.

To be honest, I am not usually fond of exercising my full strength. For one thing, it's hardly conducive to maintaining a low profile. Besides, I believe one should have the right to choose when to show their hand.
I am conserving my strength until the moment of battle is upon us. Anything to boost our chances of victory.
Seeing you get in the zone like this really puts Paimon at ease. Huh, 旅行者?
I consider it an honor to have your trust.
Rest well. I look forward to seeing you both in your element during the battle.
Yes, Miss Moonchanter? What are you staring at?
You always address me in the strangest ways. "Lady Moonchanter" one minute, "Miss Moonchanter" the next...
Yes, and? Are either of those incorrect?
Not as such. It's just that I simply call you "Nefer" nowadays.
Uh-huh, that's my name. What's your point?
The point is, I don't add any honorifics or titles.
That... maybe we're on friendlier terms now than we used to be.
Is that how you see it? And I thought I was the one with eye damage.
Just swinging by to check in on you! How are things going? Did you manage to get some rest?
Don't worry about me. I won't slow us down.
And I give my all to ensure our victory.
Ah, yes. Allow me to give you two a quick checkup...
...All done. You're both in good shape.
We're lucky to have your support.
You're welcome. You'll have your work cut out for you in this battle against Dottore, so make sure to get some rest in first.
Paimon will keep an eye on him/her, don't you worry!
I'm glad to hear it. Take good care of yourself too, Paimon.
Thankfully, Miss Nicole has come to our aid. Nasha Town is now looking very well defended!
Golden flame... Yes, that's Nicole's power, alright.
Based on the latest message from Grand Master Varka, it sounds like they've reached an agreement.
The situation should be more stable with her assistance. Everyone will have at least some degree of protection.
Thanks for your concern. I'm doing alright.
As per the plan, Albedo and I will be in charge of Nasha Town.
As Dottore's energy field expands, it's creeping ever closer in that direction... but we will do our best to hold our position.
We've fought side-by-side many times before, and always with great success.
I believe this time will be no different. So don't worry about us — focus on fighting Dottore.
(Hostiles incoming... Are these The Doctor's minions?)
Here they come. That's quite a horde.
Take your positions and prepare to engage!
After you drive back The Doctor's lackeys, he emerges before you and carves out a battlefield. The fight is about to begin...
I'm aware you've been working on some little tricks to surprise me with, but it appears that none of them have come to fruition.
My guess would be that you're trying to bring Columbina back. But then, where is Sandrone? Or are you trying to buy time for her?
Heh... I always found their friendship to be a curious phenomenon. Two highly incongruent personalities, and yet they share a deep connection.
Speaking of Columbina, I once saw her as like a younger sister. We got along quite amicably while she was with the Fatui.
But then one day, she suddenly decided she would refuse to take part in any further experiments. To this day, I truly don't understand what I could have done to upset her so much.
It's such a pity. I could have had a sister, a family... But alas, she grew to dislike me...
You're not fit to be family to her.
So many people, all obsessed with playing out the same tired old dramas. This world is rotten to the core.
And then there's you... You had every opportunity to reach the right conclusion. The thought of killing you off like this... Hehe.
But I maintain that I approached you in good faith. So I will offer you another chance. Will you work with me? You have until I count to ten to make your choice.
Sandrone? What a pleasant surprise. I didn't think you'd join us all the way up here.
You're as sick and twisted as ever. Don't fool yourself into thinking anyone's grateful for the chances you're offering them.
(Sandrone? But the formula hasn't finished running yet...)
Funnily enough, I was just discussing a collaboration opportunity with 旅行者. And then I see you... who, I must say, is a good example of an opportunity gone to waste.
I said that everyone would get one chance. And you've used yours to march right back into the lion's den... So yes, it's an utterly wasted opportunity.
Hah! And what makes you think I believe a word that comes out of your mouth?

I was planning on disposing of your little formula after wrapping up more urgent business here. But since you've taken the trouble of serving it to me on a silver platter, I can simply bring it forward in the schedule.

As the battle teeters on the verge of collapse, Marionette arrives with her creation Pulonia and attacks The Doctor. However, armed with the power of the Three Moons, The Doctor crushes Pulonia's assault effortlessly. Neither of your attacks can wound him. After driving you both back, he decides to deal with you first. Marionette takes the blow in your place. After The Doctor delivers his final strike, her body stops working and falls silent...
Now you see how fragile mechanical contraptions are. Just a gentle tap... and they fall to pieces.
However keen of an inventor Sandrone may have been, her death spells the end of the formula that was running inside her body.
Of course, I have to commend her for making it this far. As her colleague, I have to admire her stubborn tenacity.
Now, it is time for you to take your place by my side.
My count was interrupted, but the second chance I extended to you still stands. Once again — you are welcome to join me.
By now, I'm sure you have gained a greater appreciation for the power and authority I wield. What is stopping you from embracing a new world of endless possibilities?
Not in the mood to talk? As you wish. You seem less talkative than usual today.
I'll change the topic to something more... apropos. Sandrone was always like this. Never trusting anyone, always so reluctant to share her research with them.
Objectively speaking, she had her strengths. It is remarkable how she extracted and even optimized the world-formula from so much data.
But her inability to trust was her undoing. Had she allowed someone else to monitor or run the formula for her, you might still have a chance at victory even now.
But regrettably, she was a stubborn fool. As much as it pains me, she had to go.
Maybe this is news to you, but people can change. Columbina surprised you when she escaped... And I think Sandrone would surprise you, too.
You can twist the truth however you want, but I see it, clear as day: You're the one who can't trust other people.
Is that how you see me?
By this point, what can you hope to do about it?

The Doctor thinks he has defeated everyone, but Marionette's plan has already been fulfilled. Varka and The Knave attempt to pull the Frost Moon into the false sky with the help of Nicole. Even after The Doctor has sealed the barrier in the sky, the Frost Moon still shatters the dome and returns to the world. In the very next instant, Columbina Hyposelenia, now wielding the power of the Three Moons, descends alongside the moon itself, returning to Teyvat.

Columbina shows her full authority and takes complete control of the battlefield. She then reclaims the Moon Marrow, and all companions previously imprisoned by The Doctor return at once. United, everyone joins forces to fight The Doctor, and in the end, he is finally defeated.

title: 《月之将坠》·任务叙述

CHS: 嗯，这里地形开阔，天空也很清澈。
我要开始占卜了，请你们后退，不要占据我的视野。
虽然不明白发生了什么，但好厉害的样子呢！
群星的使者，你的双眼是否已将命运的默示录探寻清楚？
对对对，占卜出什么了吗？
好神奇，我也是第一次看到。
根据占卜结果，这些陨石似乎是某个人的命之座。
命之座？可是，命之座不是占星学上的概念吗？
一般来说，普通人都会这么想。但我研究占星术已久，知道一些你们不知道的事。
「命之座」上的「命星」，是真实存在于天空深处的星体，并不是仅存于概念中的东西。
奇怪的是，不知为何，它们化作陨石坠落了…原因暂时还不清楚，给我一点时间。
本皇女驰骋星间，已从黑暗的幕帘之后窥见真相的一角。被诅咒的大地，「人」的恶念…
唯有死状十分痛苦的人，才会留下如此深重的怨恨。
应该质问这片土地的住民，究竟是何人犯下不可容赦的罪孽！谁让亡灵诞生，谁就是真正的凶手！
等一下，我有点糊涂了…诅咒？凶手？
不不，你不用太把她的话放在心上啦！
（什么情况，派蒙和旅行者都在疯狂对我眨眼？）
菲谢尔是一个…活泼的人哦。
是吗？你能明白真是太好了，群星的使者！
取得共识是团队协作的第一步。莫娜女士，欢迎你加入我们。
领受这份契约，向皇女献上你的力量，切记，我们有责任拨开黑暗。
嗯咳咳！你应该庆幸遇到的是我，我能让你们事半功倍哦！
啊哈哈哈，当然当然！尽情夸奖我吧！
我的星盘已经捕捉到命运的轨迹。接下来，我会为你们算出陨石坠落的位置。
关于命之座的详情，我会继续推算。你找到线索记得尽快通知我。
哼哼，不用在意，这种程度的占卜对我来说只是小菜一碟。
菲谢尔是一个…神奇的人哦。
EN: I will now begin the process of hydromancy. Stay back, and do not impede my vision.
...Whatever it was you just did, it looked awesome!
O, astral emissary, have thine eyes now discerned the secrets of the stars?
Yeah, what did you find out?
How strange... I've never seen this before.
The divination shows that these meteorites came from someone's constellation.
Constellation? But they don't have anything to do with real astrology... Do they?
That's what most people tend to think. But I've studied astrology for a very long time, and I know a few things about them that you might not.
The stars that make up a constellation — the Stella Fortuna — are genuine celestial bodies in the depths of space. They are not simply notional.
The strange thing is that they turned to meteors all of a sudden, and fell from the sky... Why this happened I am not yet sure. I need some time.
A curse! A wretched curse, I say!
I, too, have journeyed to the stars, gazed beyond the veil of darkness, and glimpsed a shred of the truth... There, I saw a world cursed by human malice...
Only one who died the most agonizing of deaths could leave behind such a vengeful spirit...
We must interrogate the population! Find the doer of this diabolical deed! The one who created this sinister specter is the true killer!
Sorry, I'm not quite following you... What curse? And what killer?
Ah... don't take every word she says too literally...
(What's going on here? Why are the Traveler and Paimon frantically winking at me?)
Fischl is full of, uh... enthusiasm.
Thou dost? Marvelous! The astral emissary understands at last!
Mutual understanding is the crucial first step towards effective teamwork. Welcome to the team, Mona.
You are hereby appointed as an honored servant of the Prinzessin. Unleash thy power, in service of our solemn duty to dispel this darkness once and for all!
Honored? Heh... You should feel honored to have found me! Without me, you'd be doing ten times the work for half the results.
Paimon likes you, Mona, you seem like the real deal!
Hahaha, well, I'm glad you agree! Feel free to keep the compliments coming.
With my astrolabe, I have ascertained the trajectory of fate. Next, I'll calculate the locations of the fallen meteorites for you.
I need to look into the constellation issue in more detail. In the meantime, let me know ASAP if you find anything else out.
You're a star, Mona! Thanks so much!
Don't worry about it. As far as the astrological aspect goes, this will be a piece of cake.
Fischl is full of, uh... mysteries.

CHS: 伟大如他，理应不再有命星照拂。毕竟「命运」只是这个世界目前的主人对于生命的玩弄罢了。
现在的他取回了尘世七分之一大权，重铸了「完全之龙」的王座与头衔。与「人的世界」分庭抗礼，按照常理来说，他并不需要进入「命运」这么一个系统。
他可以看到，在命运的星空中，诸多星曜互相纠缠，构成了眼前复杂而又脆弱的世界。他原本也并不关心，这套被粉饰为「神圣规划」的木偶悬丝迟早有一日会被审判的烈火烧光。只是他也被一些花言巧语说服了。
「既然这样，你就看着枫丹的人们好了。既然也出自胎海之水，那就说明也是这个星球的原生生命，属于需要你照顾的一类。」
他绝对不会承认，自己对于人间的悲喜看得有些入迷了。他会辩解，人也会看着雨天水洼的波纹入迷；他会解释：「尼伯龙根王」的态度是错误的，唯有所有生命团结在一起，才有可能抵抗漆黑的虚无。
他最终走入了「命运」之中。天空为他预留了特殊而且尊贵的位置——唯有执政者与匹敌世界之人才拥有的，自己的映影。
——当然，他生来就是人的姿态。那为什么他的命之座却是巨灵龙的样子呢？这一切或许就有另一个没有那么多世界命运牵扯的版本了：
在「那维莱特」这个名字下的他，偶尔也会被美露莘们（尤其是希格雯）缠上。她们拿着蒸汽鸟报的星座专栏或者须弥的占星术小册子，想要算算命的时候，那维莱特可不好意思说自己没有命之座或者自己的命之座是「那维莱特」座。
EN: One as great as he should have no need for a constellation to shine over him. After all, "fate" is merely the manner in which the present ruler of this world plays with living beings.

Now that he has obtained one part of seven of the authority over the mortal realm, and reforged the throne and title of a "Fully Fledged Dragon," he is one strong enough to equal and rival "the human realm," and logic would dictate that he need not subscribe to this system known as "fate."

He can see, in the skies of destiny, how many stars contend with one another, creating a complicated, fragile world. He did not initially care much about such, for the puppet strings glossed as "divine rules" would one day be burned away by the fires of judgment. But he too was taken in by certain pleasing rhetoric.

"In that case, why don't you just watch over the Fontainians? They were born from the Primordial Sea, after all. That makes them part of this planet's native life, too, and a form of life that requires your care."

He would never admit that he himself had become quite fascinated with the joys and sorrows of humanity. Was it not so, he would argue, that humans find their gaze stolen by the ripples from falling raindrops in puddles? And could it not be, he would explain, that King Nibelung had been wrong, and that the black void could only be opposed if all life were to band together as one?

Thus did he, in the end, come into his own "fate." The skies had left a special, ennobled place for him, one reserved for the overseers and those who could defy the world itself — that of his own reflection.

—Of course, he was born in the form of a human. But why, then, is his constellation the image of the great leviathan? Well, this leads us to a more mundane explanation for the situation, one quite separate from grave matters of the world's fate:

As the one named "Neuvillette," he would often be roped by Melusines (especially Sigewinne) into a bit of astrology via The Steambird's constellation columns or astrology guides from Sumeru. Would it really do, at that point, to tell them that he "didn't have a constellation" or that his own constellation was just "Neuvillette"?

CHS: 树间的风很好，有我喜欢的气味…
哈哈，上次我也是这么说的呢。唉，为什么每次说这句话，都是在运气不顺的时候呢？
唉…这本来不是能和普通人谈论的话题。但，悄悄告诉你也没关系。
你应该知道，「神之眼」是这世上极少数人才拥有的外置魔力器官。他们通过「神之眼」来引导元素力。
其实，每一位「神之眼」的拥有者，都是有资格成神的人，因此被称作「原神」，拥有登上天空岛的资格。
「原神」？以前好像从来没听过这个词…
哼哼，因为这是真正神灵才知道的秘密呀。总之，我们是不需要「神之眼」这种初级器官的——
作为替代，神灵的魔力器官与天空岛共鸣相连…也就是「神之心」了。
欸嘿。只是发光的玻璃球而已，用来避免无谓的猜疑啦。
那么，刚才那个见面就把我吹飞、还抢走温迪「神之心」的坏女人，到底是谁…？
她是「女士」——愚人众十一执行官的第八席，代号「女士」。
愚人众的每一位执行官，都像她一样，被至冬国的女皇赐予了神灵般的权柄，获得超越了凡人的力量。
至冬国的…女皇？那不就是…
嗯，七神之一，端坐于至冬宫的「冰之女皇」，全体愚人众执行官的唯一效忠对象。
虽然七神之间的关系，并不全都非常融洽，但我也没想到，她居然正在谋夺其他神灵的「神之心」…
我认识「五百年前的她」，但对「现在的她」已经很陌生了。
五百年前的一场大灾之后，她就断绝了和我的一切交流…
不过，有关冰之神和愚人众的事，还是过一会再说吧。
旅行者，你要寻找全部七神，旅途中恐怕还有许多艰难之处。
先往蒙德的邻国去吧——那里的「岩」之神与我不同，亲自治理着「璃月」全境。
他每年只会正式降临一次，赐下神谕，指引这一年里经营璃月的方向。
即使是这样，听起来工作频率也比某位大人高多了呢。
…总之，今年的「请仙典仪」好像就快开始了。嗯，错过的话，就要再等一整年咯。
哇？！这么重要的信息怎么不早说？那就再见了，旅行者，我们快走——
旅行者…当你重新踏上旅途之后，一定要记得旅途本身的意义。
提瓦特的飞鸟、诗歌和城邦，女皇、愚人和怪物…都是你旅途的一部分。
终点并不意味着一切。在抵达终点之前，用你的眼睛，多多观察这个世界吧…
嗯！风神的告诫到此为止！接下来是温迪时间。
不好意思，擅自借用了七天神像的风…
哈哈，心怀感激地用吧——能请我一杯蒲公英酒就更好了。
又欺骗感情，但我已经习惯了。
EN: The wind amongst the branches is good, I love the way it smells...
Haha, I said the exact same thing the last time. *sigh* Why do I only say these things when I'm down on my luck?
*sigh* This isn't something I'm meant to discuss with ordinary people. But I suppose I can let you in on the secret.
As you know, Visions are external magical foci that only a small minority of people possess. They use these Visions to channel elemental power.
In truth, every wielder of a Vision is one who can attain godhood and ascend to Celestia. We call such people allogenes.
Allogenes? Paimon's never heard of them before.
Hehe, that's because this is a secret that only archons are privy to. We don't need primitive tools like Visions.
Instead, each archon has an internal magical focus that resonates directly with Celestia itself... known as a Gnosis.
What about the thing hanging off your hip?
Eh-he. It's just a glowing glass ball I carry around to avoid suspicion.
So who was that nasty woman who sent Paimon flying and stole your Gnosis?
Her name is Signora, No. 8 of the harbingers.
