But as far as the Tsaritsa is concerned, she has quite clearly overstepped the bounds of her authority, and that is sufficient grounds for punishment.
...Haha, just kidding. No need to be so nervous.
Ronova was just punished, and Naberius and I could arguably be considered accomplices, so Celestia is keeping a close eye on us right now.
I'd rather not have the Authority of Life reclaimed as well, if it's all the same to you.
...You're using that as an excuse? Don't tell me... You intend to spare the Cryo Archon?
I must say, I've gained a lot of admiration for your courage and resourcefulness. You've proven yourself to be quite a worthy rival after all.
I think we'll leave things here for today. It's hardly polite for a guest to impose upon their host for too long.
I do hope your stay wasn't too unpleasant.
Allow me to set aside my identity as the "Ruler of Life" for a moment, and speak solely as Mage R, "Gold," descendant of Khaenri'ah...
I'm beginning to suspect Snezhnaya might be capable of achieving some monumental things indeed.
I am most dissatisfied with how you've handled this, Rhinedottir. Snezhnaya will surely escalate things after this...
Hm? What did you say, Naberius? The signal seems to be quite poor on my end...

title: 《于饯别之时散落的黑羽》·莱茵多特与女皇

CHS: 嗯？已经理清思绪了吗？哥伦比娅。
告诉我们吧，你想如何离开这里？
嗯…我将在此刻「死去」，然后在朋友们的帮助下，于未来重新「诞生」。
啊？你…你在说什么呀？死去的人，还如何重新诞生？
而且…未来的朋友？你要怎么告诉他们你的计划？留下神谕吗？可这里连一束月光都传不出去…
如果他们没发现你留下的消息…你不就…
他们一定会发现的。我知道。
首先，我要将自己的「灵魂」，留在这里。
嗯。我曾在未来留下了自己灵魂的一小部分。小到几乎没有被这个囚牢发现。
它能够与我此刻的灵魂相呼应。
而到了关键的时候，我相信它能够作为将我此处的灵魂，唤回未来那个「现实」所需要的锚点。
就像…将大地与月亮相互联系起的「引力」。
没错。在我生活的未来，月亮被抛出了虚假之天，但我仍能够感受到它的存在。
而我留下的那一部分灵魂，此刻也同样联系着我。朋友们能借它感受到我的存在。
可…灵魂，真的能就这么留在这里吗…
来这里的路上，我见到了一位曾经误入此地的普通人。
她的身体早已消散，但灵魂却一直留了下来。
再之前还遇到过一位曾经的敌人，他同样得以保留了完整的灵魂，而那种侵蚀他身体的力量反倒散去了。
也就是说…这个空间的规则意在囚禁我们的「神格」和「权能」，对「身体」的逃逸反倒没那么重视…
可就算身体能够穿透囚笼，少了「神格」去支配它，不就只是具无主的躯壳吗？
难道…你刚才说「不是活着离开」…
没错。我要将自己的「身体」化作月光，洒向挪德卡莱。
它将化作庇护挪德卡莱的一种力量，静静融入这片大地，等待着未来我灵魂的归来。
但…仅凭我自己的力量是无法做到这些的…
我需要你们的帮助。我…想请求你们的帮助。
哈…我亲爱的妹妹，你无需对我们表现得如此恭谨。如我所说，我们已不过是旧日历史中的余辉罢了。
而你独自一人诞生在未来，走过了漫长而又孤独的岁月，我又怎么会忍心让你的故事停留在这座监牢中呢？
别忘了，我们可是你的姐姐，你的「家人」啊。
…艾莉亚姐姐说得对。我其实很久很久以前，就想要一个妹妹了。不然总是被两个姐姐这里那里指指点点。
现在终于有了当姐姐的机会，能帮助这么一位可爱的妹妹回到自己的世界，我又怎么可能犹豫呢？
…抱歉，我知道这是一个任性的请求。属于你的「霜月」仍未破碎…
我只是…不禁回想起了我们三姐妹曾经度过的岁月…
你无法想象听你提到未来的世界、未来的「霜月之子」、还有可爱又友善的朋友们的时候，我有多高兴。
知晓地上的人们活出了如此丰富的未来，作为维系提瓦特安宁的我们来说，再欣慰不过了。
而若是你的计划能够拯救他们，拯救挪德卡莱。那我当然会给予你我所能献出的一切。
更何况，我们三姐妹从出生时就一直在一起。我不会抛下她们独自活下去的。
不过，容我再问最后一个问题，哥伦比娅。
为什么…你要蒙起自己的双眼呢？
对啊，我刚见你的时候也在好奇，但怕牵扯到希珀塞莱尼娅你的隐私，就忍着没问。
我…曾经不愿去看这个世界，认为它充满了虚假的谎言。
我曾想封起自己的感受…封起自己的内心…直到回到我真正的「家」。
你或许的确没有再看到那虚假的天空，但你同时也会错过一些真实而宝贵的东西，例如朋友们的笑容。
答应我，哥伦比娅。当你回到未来的时候，多睁开眼看看这个世界，还有你的朋友们吧。
我想，如此渴望回去的你，内心已经明白了…
…我们曾是永不完结的叙事歌，如今轮到你继续歌唱。
…我们曾是时间之河的潮汐，如今潮退，你的涟漪泛起。
…我们是疯狂与灵感的使者，如今谎言消散，你的真实要继续。
…我们是等待着太阳的灵魂，你应该回到对你微笑的人们身边去。
EN: Have you figured it out, Columbina?
Tell us, how do you plan to leave this place?
I... I intend to "die" here, in this moment, and then be reborn in the future with the help of my friends.
What? Wh—What are you saying? How can the dead be reborn?
And how will you inform these future friends of your plans? You can't exactly leave oracles — nothing can escape this place, not a single ray of moonlight...
And even if you found a way, what if they never find the message you've left for them? You'll... you'll...
They will find my message. I'm sure of it.
...I'm not following. How exactly will you achieve this?
First, I will leave my soul here.
Your soul? You mean, your divinity?
Yes. I once left a portion of my soul in the future — one so small that this prison barely noticed anything.
In this very moment, she can resonate with my soul across time.
When the time comes, I believe that she can serve as an anchor to pull my soul from here back to the future reality...
...Just as gravity connects the world to the moon.
Exactly. In the future, where I came from, the moon has been cast beyond the false sky, but I can still feel that it is there.
In a similar way, I can feel a connection to the soul fragment I left behind even now. My friends can use it to detect my presence.
But... How do you just... leave your soul here? Is that even possible?
On my way here, I met an ordinary mortal who entered this place long before I did.
Her body is long gone, but her soul remains.
And before that, I encountered an old enemy whose entire soul survives here intact, while the power that once corrupted his body has faded away.
So perhaps this space is specifically designed to imprison divinity and authority, but not the physical body...
Still, even if your body can escape, would it not just be a lifeless husk without the soul inside?
Wait... Is that what you meant when you said you wouldn't leave alive...?
Yes. I shall turn my body into moonlight, and pour it over Nod-Krai.
That power shall protect the land and quietly blend into it, awaiting my soul's return in the future.
However... I cannot do this on my strength alone.
I would need your help to do this... So I'm humbly asking for your assistance.
Hah... Oh, dear sister, you need not be so formal. As I said before, we are but remnants of a bygone age.
You, on the other hand, were born alone in that distant future, and you have walked a long and lonesome road since then. How could I bear to let your story end here in this dungeon?
Don't forget — we are your sisters. Your family.
...Aria's right. Actually, I always wanted a little sister. Can you imagine how it's been for me, getting nagged by two older sisters all this time?
Now, I finally get to be the big sis — and not just that, but I get to help you return to your world, too. How could I say no to that?
...I'm sorry. I know this is a bold request. The Frost Moon is rightfully yours, and it remains intact...
...Oh — no, please don't misunderstand me, Columbina.
I was just... thinking back on the years that the three of us once spent together...
You cannot imagine how happy I am to hear of the future world you describe... the Frostmoon Scions, your lovely, kindly friends...
For the three of us, whose purpose in life was to maintain the peace in Teyvat, it is a great relief to know that the people of this world live in such an abundant future.
If your plan can save them and save Nod-Krai, I will gladly give you all that I can.
Besides, the three of us have been together since the day we were born. I could never abandon them to live on alone without them.
Still, I do have one question I would like to ask you before we proceed.
Why do you cover your eyes?
Yeah, I was curious about that, too... but it seemed personal, so I didn't wanna intrude.
I... There was a time when I refused to look upon the world. I believed it was full of nothing but lies and falsehoods.
I wished to hide my feelings... seal my heart... until I could return to my true home.
Perhaps that decision saved you from ever having to see the false sky again. But at the same time, you likely missed out on many true and precious things, like the smiles on your friends' faces.
Promise me this, Columbina: When you return to the future, open your eyes, take a look at the world around you... and see your friends.
I'm sure that you know this already, given that you long to return...
But that is your true home.
...We once were the song sung for eternity, but now it is you who must continue to sing.
...We once were the tides in the great river of time, but now we subside, and you arise.
...We were the messengers of madness and inspiration, but now, the lies have faded, and your truth must endure.
...We are souls awaiting the sun. You must return to be with those who smile when they see your face.

title: 《最初的那抹月光》·哥伦比娅与卡侬

CHS: 伏行于深黯的裂隙，窥伺此世的深渊魔物。据说那怪异、亵渎的无面形貌不过是投射于世界上的影像，其真实姿态乃是以纯粹深渊能量形式存在的无形之物。
即便是妄图支配这个世界的入侵者，也不得不在一定程度上遵从世界原本的法则。直至高天的面纱破碎、地骨的护堤崩毁，来自群星的失乡者都只能像这般匿避于世界的边缘，以疯狂与谵妄的低语，徒劳无功地渗入此世吧…但世界安稳的秩序，又会持续到何时呢？

EN: An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy.

Even invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?

title: 生物图鉴·深黯魇语之主

CHS: 这是薇斯纳托我们带回来的报告。
圣土化，是这种现象的名字吗？
（奇怪，这个词好像在哪里听到过？）
据记载，那是天理对地面文明触犯禁忌后的最终惩戒，将一切重置到提瓦特原初的光界力状态。
一切可见之物都会在这个过程中湮灭，什么都不剩下。
判罚之钉有很多种功能。它由天空岛降下，被用于惩戒僭越者，以及对抗深渊。
圣土化是它达成目标的最终手段，大部分时候这个惩戒机制并不会启动。
仅仅是天钉降下引起的气候异常，就足以消除大部分地上的生灵。
也就是说，分散在提瓦特各处的钉子，虽然常年保持沉寂，但仍然具备开启圣土化的能力…
现在，它们被「激活」了…是这样吗？
可以这么理解。有人激活了判罚之钉，想要让至冬、让世界一起走向毁灭。
我们推测是若娜瓦在濒死时运用了某种手段，具体细节就无从得知了。
根据「丑角」大人的判断，权能被回收的若娜瓦大概率已经拥抱死亡，跟她有关的线索到此为止。
如何才能令这危险的装置停下…或许按计划杀死高天上的那一位，事情会迎来转机？
判罚之钉由天理创造，理论上确实存在这种可能。
没有了若娜瓦的干扰，槲寄生计划可以继续实施了。问题只在于…时间。
我们已经集中了所有的资源，全力推进实验。但是包含调试和应用在内，至少还需要两个月。
…那就麻烦了。如果要将「停止圣土化」作为单独执行的任务，几乎找不到入手的地方。
壁炉之家有得到过「圣土化」相关的情报吗？
有一些消息，但只是传闻。
据说某些特殊生物能够吞噬光界力，将其重新转化为元素力，这样就能逆转圣土化的进程。
那毕竟只是传说。与其将希望寄托于缥缈的神奇生物，还不如我们自己研发类似的装置。
原理上可行，但「转化」本身也需要消耗大量的能源。
以我们紧缺的能源储备，即使开发出这种装置，也难以逆转如此大规模的圣土化现象。
哼…看来直接与「圣土化」对抗的思路，目前是无解的。
眼下还有个让我在意的东西，那就是伴随光柱变化，出现在天空中的那六个符号。
符号往往携带某种信息，就像文字、音符那样，如果…那些符号是打算向我们传达什么呢？
可那是我们未曾见过的图案，想要准确猜出它的含义并不容易。
圣土化是判罚之钉引起的，如果我们直接「破坏」那根钉子呢？
并非完全没有希望，但风险实在太高。
我看过桑多涅小姐的报告…判罚之钉内部蕴藏着恐怖的力量，如果处理不好，可能引起更大的灾难。
不过，从判罚之钉入手，是正确的思路。
既然有开启圣土化的办法，应该也可以让它停下来。陛下…我想到了一个人。
皇都评议会初任议长，普契涅拉的前辈。同时，也是那个「魔女会」的成员，代号为J。
因为她，至冬与魔女会积累过一些情谊。也许，我们可以向魔女会打听有关圣土化的情报。
去信给艾莉丝。以我的名义，邀她来至冬一叙。
艾莉丝！上次和她见面，还是在挪德卡莱呢，没想到能在至冬堡再会。
她…应该知道怎么停下圣土化吧？一定要想想办法呀，这种现象实在太危险了。
让薇斯纳继续关注前线情况。潘塔罗涅，抽调北国银行的紧急能源储备，你和普契涅拉亲自调度，加快实验进程。
会议就到这里，众卿去做该做的事。
EN: Vesna gave us this report to pass along to you.
Holy Soil phenomenon? So that's the proper term for what's happening?
(Strange... Haven't I heard that somewhere before?)
Records describe it as the final punishment Celestia imposes upon a transgressing civilization. Everything is to be reset to Teyvat's original state — that is to say, the Light Realm.
All the eye can see is erased from existence in the process. Nothing is left behind.
Is it caused by the Nail of Retribution?
The Nail of Retribution serves many functions. It is a tool used by Celestia to punish transgressors and combat the Abyss.
The Holy Soil phenomenon, or "Hallowing," is its last resort — the final means of achieving its goal. It is a form of punishment rarely activated.
A nail's initial appearance causes major environmental changes, which are enough to destroy the majority of life on the land.
So all these nails around Teyvat... This whole time that they've been dormant, they've had the power to activate the Hallowing...
In a nutshell, yes. Whoever activated them wants the whole world to perish, starting with Snezhnaya.
Our suspicion is that Ronova somehow put this in motion in her final moments. But we have no way of knowing how she did it.
The Jester's view is that Ronova, having been stripped of her authority, is almost certainly dead by this point — in which case, she took this secret to her grave.
How then do we stop this device from running? Might the plan to kill the one in the high heavens yield some hope of turning the tide?
There's a good chance it might, at least in principle. The Nails of Retribution are creations of the Heavenly Principles, after all.
Well, without Ronova around to interfere, Project Mistilteinn can now resume. The question is... how long will it take?
Testing is already underway, and we've dedicated every available resource to the project. But factoring in time for troubleshooting and final application... we'll need another two months minimum.
...Then we're back to square one. Our task is to stop the Hallowing as soon as possible... yet, we don't even know where to begin.
Has the House of the Hearth come across any intelligence regarding the Hallowing?
Some, but nothing confirmed. Only rumors.
Supposedly, there exist certain lifeforms capable of consuming light realm energy and converting it back into elemental energy, thus reversing the Hallowing process.
That's just a folk tale. We'd be better off trying to develop our own conversion solution than hoping some fantastical creature no one's ever seen will do the job for us.
It's theoretically feasible. But the conversation process would require an enormous amount of energy.
Considering the scale of the Hallowing, and how limited our energy reserves are, even if we did manage to develop such a technology, it would be difficult to fully reverse the process.
Hmph... So basically, there's nothing we can do right now to tackle the Hallowing head-on.
The other thing that's bothering me is those six symbols that appeared in the sky after the beam of light grew stronger.
Symbols are used to convey information, like written glyphs or music notation... What if they're trying to tell us something?
No one has ever seen the like of these symbols before. We would be relying on mere guesswork to decipher their meaning.
The Hallowing is caused by the Nail of Retribution. What if we were to destroy the nail?
I'm not saying it couldn't work, but... it's much too risky.
I've read Miss Sandrone's report... The Nail of Retribution contains a terrifying power within it. One misstep, and we could trigger an even worse disaster.
Nevertheless, I believe we are right to focus on the nail itself.
Since the nail can be used to activate the Hallowing, it must also be capable of stopping it. Your Majesty... a certain individual comes to mind.
Pulcinella's predecessor — the first chair of the Snezhnograd Veche. She was also a member of the Hexenzirkel... "J" was her codename.
She established a degree of friendship between Snezhnaya and the Hexenzirkel which persists to this day. Perhaps we can seek further information on the Hallowing from her fellow mages.
Send a letter to Alice. Tell her the Tsaritsa invites her to Snezhnaya.
Alice! The last time we saw her was in Nod-Krai. Paimon didn't think we'd get to see her again in Snezhnograd.
She has to know how we can stop the Hallowing... right? She better had, anyway. This is one of the biggest dangers we've ever faced.

Tell Vesna to keep monitoring the situation on the ground. Pantalone, mobilize the Northland Bank's emergency energy reserves — testing must proceed at maximum pace. You and Pulcinella are to see to this personally.
The meeting is concluded. Resume your duties.

CHS: 这应该是第二次以这种形象正式与你见面了。
是力量受到正确引导后，令你短暂拥有的「成熟之龙」的形态。如若不然，狰狞的力量会让你的形体发生畸变。
当初，支撑纳塔的富燃土地，天空之上的掠夺者视为所谓「圣土化」，用天钉将之摧毁…
龙裔本身具有的「极度适应」与「进化」的能力反而被利用，无数的龙裔只能进行退行性的演化以适应现在的纳塔…
但是血统并未变得驳杂过。
即使修库特尔不愿意承认，出现在角上的印记也是证明…因为火龙之王最初以角传递焰光与智慧。
所以去除「焰主之祝」是你的谎言…
有所保留而已。如果不受到正确引导，无序的力量确实会杀死大部分有「焰主之祝」的龙。
只不过问题就变成了…是否能控制「焰主之祝」的产生。答案是，有很大几率成功。
不过你说的也没错，我确实想利用人类之手清除火山的「封绝」，利用与希巴拉克达成的契约驱人带回另一块「通牒金盘」…
为此，为了达成这个目的，我创造了传说…这并不是什么光彩的手段，很多了不起的人类因此死去。
…不过你之后会明白的，时至今日，我已别无选择。
是选定之龙，也是将龙带来此处的被选定的人。
只不过，人类的使命在将你带到这来时就已经结束了…
现在，踏上最终之路的只有你自己了。
（咦，这句话在脑子里嗡嗡作响…为、为什么？）
好了，龙裔驱使语言的方式你已通晓，那是有别于现在纳塔龙众粗糙叫声的东西…
如果你愿意，你可以让任何有智慧的生物听懂你说的话。
甚至…你身躯里的燃素，其从亘古之前就传承的源火的信息与智慧，也会逐渐浮现。
那是人类取的称号…瓦萨克拉胡巴肯，那也只是我幻化的诸多名字之一。
库库尔坎…算了，虽然，一切的名字在很短的时间之后就会失去效用，不过现在，你就先这样称呼我吧。
（唔…奇怪，感觉忘记了很重要的东西…）
感到迷惑吗，重新获得智慧时，自我会被淹没在如海的信息之中，感受到迷茫是正常的。
或者，为了打消你的不安，我就变作你熟悉些的形象好了…
怎么样，挺方便的不是吗，如果你愿意的话，只需一个念头，转换身形的方法就会浮现在你脑中…虽然要借助一些小小的灵魂。
不用了，我对「自己」很满意。
好吧，「恕我僭越」…故事就是这么开始的，那我们也这样开始吧。
该如何称呼你…库库尔坎？
那是我最原初的名字，也是那个对「我」的束缚最强的名字，但是后来我拥有的名字逐日增多，这个名字的效用也显得无足轻重…
EN: Open your eyes, descendant of the Flamelord.
I believe this is the second time I have formally met you in this form.
You have briefly achieved the form of a "mature dragon" after your power was channeled with the proper guidance. Were that not the case, that savage strength would have warped your form.
In an earlier eon, the phlogiston-rich soils that sustained Natlan were regarded by the heavenly reaver as a form of so-called "Holy Soil" phenomenon. They cast sky-nails down to destroy the land...
We dragons boast extreme adaptability and evolutionary capacity, but this was used against us — countless Dragonborn could only devolve so as to survive in present-day Natlan...
But their bloodline has not changed.
That which Xiuhcoatl would not admit, the mark on one's horn would prove... For in the beginning, it was through his horn that the Pyro Dragon Sovereign first transmitted flaming light and wisdom.
So the removal of the Blessing was a lie you made up...
Only one of omission. If not guided correctly, this disordered power would indeed kill most saurians who bear the Blessing.
The only question became whether... we could control the Blessing's occurrence or not. The answer was... that we had a high chance of success.
But you do not speak falsely even so. I did intend to use a human to unseal the volcano, and use Xbalanque's oath to have a human bring back the other "Golden Entreaty"...
Which is why I created that legend in the first place. And I would not name it an honorable tactic — many are the great humans who have died for this cause.
...But you will understand, in time, that I no longer had any other choice.
So, the so-called Chosen of Dragons...
Refers to both the chosen dragon, and the chosen human who brings the dragon here.
It's just that, once you were brought here, the human's duty had already ended...
Now, only you can tread the final path.
(Huh? Wait a minute, those words... They ring in my head... Why?)
Now, you have mastered the way Dragonborn speak — a distant thing, indeed, from the brute cries of Natlan's saurian-kind...
And if you willed it, you could have any intelligent being understand your words.
Indeed, the phlogiston within your body, and the information and wisdom passed down from antiquity through the primal flame will also begin emerging.
You're... the Sage of the Stolen Flame?
That is what the humans named me... Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, too, is also one of the many names I created.
But "Kukulkan" was... Ah, forget it. Though all names will very soon become meaningless, you may simply call me that for now.
(Hmm... Strange. I feel like I've forgotten something very important...)
Confused? Well, it is quite normal to, after having re-attained wisdom, be flooded by the sea of information.
But if you'd like me to assuage your discomfort, allow me to change into a form you'll find more familiar...

Well, what do you think? Quite convenient, no? Should you desire it, our transformative arts will reveal themselves to you with but a thought... though you will require the help of some little souls too.
It's fine. I'm happy the way "I" am.
Fair enough. "Forgive me for being presumptuous"... That is how the story began, no? In that case, let us start this way, too.
So, what should I call you... Kukulkan, then?
That was the first of my names, and also the one that bound "me" most tightly. Later, however, as my list of names grew, it grew to be insignificant...

title: 《毁灭预兆与最后的通牒》·库库尔坎

CHS: 永恒绿洲遭受了严重的「圣土化」影响，已无法前往。
EN: The Eternal Oasis has been severely affected by the Holy Soil phenomenon and is no longer accessible.

title: 区域状态提示·永恒绿洲

CHS: 「伊啊，伊啊，潘！那偃卧大洋之物啊！」
这句用在仪式上的祷文作用是舍弃自我，沉入深渊。然后在深渊中，迎来圣婴形态的新生。
似乎源自一出悲剧，不知经何人之手流传此世。剧目的名字是「阿贾克斯」或者「埃阿斯」。他是他们联盟第二强的战士。
「偃卧大洋」这一句也十分有趣。这个词如果以须弥古语写来，应该读作「那菈延」，另一个意思就是「原初之人」。
这也正是我的目标。不是所有的外来物都可以被叫做「降临」的。唯有匹敌一个世界的强大意志才能被称为「降临」。
如何成为一个守护世界、维持世界、毁灭世界、创造世界的强大意志。
EN: "Io, Io, Pan! That which lies beneath the great sea!"
The purpose of this line in the ritual scripture is to forsake the self and sink into the abyss, and in the abyss, to welcome rebirth as a holy infant.

The origin of this is a tragedy of unknown provenance that has been passed down by persons unknown to this day. Said play is called "Ajax," or "Aias." He was the second-strongest warrior in his alliance.
"Lies beneath the great sea" is, itself, an interesting phrase. It comes from ancient Sumeru texts, and should be read as "Narayana," which also means "primordial human."
This, too, is my goal, for not all that comes from beyond may be as one that "descends." That title belongs only to wills that can rival an entire world.
That is what I seek, the way to become just such a will, one that can protect the world, sustain the world, destroy the world, and create the world.
JP: 「イーア、イーア、パン！あの大海洋に眠るもの！」
儀式では、この祈禱文の意味は自我を捨て、深淵に落ちるということ。そして深淵の中で、聖なる幼児の状態で新生を迎えるのだ。
出典はある悲劇のようで、誰かによって後世に残された。演目の名前は「アヤックス」あるいは「アヤス」。彼は連盟で二番目に強い戦士だ。
「大海洋に眠る」、この一文もとても興味深い。この単語はもしスメールの古語で書く場合、「ナラヤナ」と読むべきで、もう一つの意味は「原初の人間」だ。
これこそが私の目標——すべての外来する者が「降臨」と呼ばれるわけではない。一つの世界に匹敵するような強い意志こそ、「降臨」と呼ばれるのだ。
如何にして世界を守り、世界を維持し、世界を滅ぼし、世界を創る強い意志になれるか。
KR: 「이오, 이오, 판! 바다에 드러누운 것이여!」
이 의식에서 쓰이는 기도 문구는 자아를 포기하고 심연에 빠지게 한다. 그리고 심연 속에서 신성한 갓난 아이의 형태를 지닌 새 생명을 맞이한다.
어느 비극에서 기원한 이것은 누군가의 손을 거쳐 이 세상에 전해졌다. 연극의 이름은 「아약스」 또는 「아이아스」로 연맹에서 두 번째로 강한 전사의 이름에서 따왔다.
「바다에 드러누운」이라는 문구도 아주 흥미롭다. 만약 이 단어를 수메르의 고어로 쓴다면 「나라연」이라 읽을 수 있으며 다른 의미로는 「원초의 인간」을 뜻한다.
이것은 또한 내 목표다. 외부에서 온 모든 것을 「강림」했다고 하진 않는다. 오직 세계에 필적할 강대한 의지만이 「강림」했다 할 수 있다.
어떻게 세계를 수호하고, 유지하고, 파괴하고, 창조할 강대한 의지가 될 것인가.

title: 水仙十字结社遗留《笔记》

CHS: 人们常会假设一些群体性的规律，去试图解释某些现象。
在「现场清理人」的工作中，艾梅莉埃会接触到大量人体组织，有些是枫丹人的，有些不是。她在调配对应的清理药剂上十分细心，于是渐渐发现，枫丹人在身体组织构造上，似乎和其他国家的人有着极其细微的差异。
她悄悄探查，发现绝大多数人根本没有察觉到异样，即便极少数有所发觉的人，也只是将此归结为枫丹特有的水土问题。就像有些地方的人天生容易脱发，有些地方人的天生手指细长…都只是生活在同一环境下的衍生结果罢了。
艾梅莉埃暂时接受了这样的解释，但隐约觉得事情并没有那样简单。
直到「预言」终结后，她又接到几起新的清理委托。先前那些异国人之间的细微差异，仿佛从不存在一般，无声无息地消失在了水流之中。
经过再三思忖，艾梅莉埃决定给自己一个答案。
她拜访了据称在欧庇克莱歌剧院解释过枫丹人类起源的最高审判官那维莱特先生，向他提出了心中的疑问。
最高审判官稍作思考，最终告诉她：枫丹人现在已经是真正的人类了。
「现在已经」，言下之意等于在告诉她，枫丹人在「预言」前后的确发生过转变。
这就足够了。无需多么精确，她只需要一个确认。她能够感觉到，这其中的具体事宜，不是她一个普通人类应当去深究的。在与执律庭合作的过程中，她早已签署过大大小小的保密协议。而这一次，她无需任何书面证明，也知道应该保持沉默。
又或许，这也并不是什么大事。她的生活并无改变，甚至药剂配方不再需要因为对象的国籍差异而做出差分，反而简单了不少。
她将这个秘密和她见过的那些悲欢离合一起，封存心底。
EN: People often propose rules for groups in an attempt to explain certain phenomena.

In her work as a forensic cleaner, Emile encounters large quantities of human tissue, some Fontainian, and others not. Being meticulous in her preparation of the relevant cleaning agents, she gradually discovered that Fontainian human tissue structures seemed to have minuscule differences from those of other nations.

Discreetly investigating, she discovered something strange that very, very few had ever noticed. Even those who had some awareness would simply attribute it to Fontaine's special natural environment. After all, people in some places experienced greater hair loss, while people in others had naturally slim fingers... All a matter of their living in the same environment giving rise to those traits.
Emilie sensed that the truth might not be so simple, but she tentatively accepted that explanation.

At least, she did until after the "prophecy" had already come to pass and she received some new cleaning commissions. She found that those minute differences between Fontainians and humans from other nations had silently slipped away, like so much water flowing between one's fingers. Indeed, it was like they had never existed.
After giving it much thought, Emilie decided that she would seek the answer for herself.
She paid Iudex Neuvillette — who had allegedly once given a full account of the origin of Fontainians at the Opera Epiclese — a visit, and related her doubts to him.
He considered this for a moment, before informing her: "Fontainians are now true humans."
"Are now," he had said. Some change in Fontainians, then, must have indeed occurred in the fulfillment of the prophecy.

That was enough for her. She needed no further details, having only desired confirmation. Indeed, she could already perceive that the details constituted a threshold ordinary humans should not trespass, let alone seek to. In her work with the Maison Gardiennage, she had already signed many confidentiality agreements, both great and small, but no document was needed to tell that silence was the best course here.
Perhaps this was even, in truth, no big deal. Her life had not changed, and in fact, things were simpler now that her concoctions needed to make no distinction based on national differences.
And so, she would keep this secret in the same place where she held all those joys and sorrows, reunions and partings — locked deep in her heart.

CHS: 最初的时候，演出谢幕，暴风雪开始变大，大家都还以为只是普通地被大雪困在了这里。
直到在这里的第二天早上发现尸体，我们才察觉到这次的事件非比寻常。
可现在想想，事情明明从「那个时候」就已经开始了，从那位名叫德莫夫的先生走进暴风雪再也没有回来开始。
也就是说，德莫夫先生才是第一位牺牲者，并非第一晚的索布列娃与托尔戈夫…
如果把那个时候作为事件的开端，有件事情就很明显了…
在没有「招魂曲」的情况下，阿罗夏，你是唯一一个走进暴风雪后还能回来的人。
或者说阿罗夏并没有回来，回来的是…「死神」。
不错啊，把我逼到这个程度的话，也没什么演下去的必要了。
我不喜欢那些传说里的俗套名字，凡人当称我为「死之执政」。
在「全灭」之前，解决了两名「死者」，甚至还察觉到了我的存在…这份「成绩」超过了我的预期，值得鼓励。
听说你可以引渡灵魂，夜晚时分的那些死亡是你的所为么？
你们可以相信自己最初的判断。由于你们所说的两位「死者」的存在，地脉是如此渴求那些久久未归的灵魂…
每个夜晚都要吞噬同等数量的灵魂来填补空缺，无需我代劳。当然，引渡灵魂也的确是我的权能。
今日份的两人…这样就算结束了。
别那么紧张。你们本来就是已死之人，灵魂也本应去往地脉。
我知道我们已经死了，是你杀的吧。
「杀」？不，杀戮是凡人对我权能的僭越，我本就掌管死亡…我需要谁去死，无需通过「杀人」这样拐弯抹角的方式。
你们只是达成了「条件」，触发了我的「死之诅咒」罢了。
（我知道「不死诅咒」的存在，原来还有其他关于死亡的诅咒么…）
诅咒？你什么时候诅咒了我们，为什么要这么做？
人类时常向我祈祷，祈求了解死亡何时降临，死亡将以何种形式降临…
少有人会问死亡因何而降临，如果一定要有一个答案，那死亡的降临只会是因为「死期已至」。
收起你的小伎俩吧，你本该连与我交谈的资格都没有。
只怪曾经那些天使对这里的地脉胡乱改造，才让我此次的工作变得这么复杂，令人恼火。
工作？把我们困在这里，看着朋友一个又一个死去就是你的工作？
既然你有这么多问题，作为你们这几天出色表现的奖励，我可以为你们解答一些不算过分的疑问。
肉体死去以后，灵魂回归到地脉，才能视为一次完整的「死亡」。
我的工作包罗万象，其中当然也包括为你们所熟知的…引导灵魂进入地脉。
旅行者很熟悉纳塔的夜神之国吧？当初是我支持了夜神之国的构建，毕竟对引导纳塔的灵魂有利，能够带来方便。
而这座剧院连接的地脉也经由天使进行过改造，试图使其能够容纳一些特殊造物的灵魂…
这反而一定程度上阻隔了对普通灵魂的接纳。
等你们在剧院因诅咒而死亡以后，这种影响便显现了出来，使你们只能滞留在这「死后的世界」，无法达成完整的死亡。
可如果因为「死之诅咒」而死亡的灵魂没能在短时间内回归地脉，错过了「时机」…
便会永远处于生与死之间，也不再受到死之权能与生之权能的影响。
相当于如果你无法在短时间内处理完这件事，让我们的灵魂全部回归地脉，我们就会脱离你的掌控…
（米提亚很敏锐，这应该就是若娜瓦担心会发生的事情，也是她会参与这次事件的理由。）
可是以你引渡灵魂的权能，为什么不直接现身把问题解决，而是要化身成阿罗夏潜伏在我们之中呢？
你在试图理解神的想法？好吧，那我就告诉你。
这里可是剧院啊，我对近距离观赏这场「死亡戏剧」很感兴趣，甚至还引导你们把舞台作为主要活动区域。
不知不觉有些沉浸其中了，就当是为了弥补你们没有「乖乖去死」给我造成的麻烦吧。这个答案你满意么？
居然不满意？人类对神明，不是一向都有这样的刻板印象吗？
你刚才明明还抱怨了这次工作的复杂性，使你恼火。
工作嘛，我很清楚，肯定有不得已而为之的部分吧？
你这个人类，看法倒是有些独特。那好吧，确实有棘手的部分。
由于剧院地脉阻隔的存在，每天地脉能够接收的灵魂数量有着明确的限制，使得我无法一次性引渡你们所有灵魂。
贸然亮明身份必然会遇到无谓的抵抗，而那些选择逃跑的灵魂则会有逸散的风险。
其次是关于那两名你们口中的「死者」，我确实有意诱导了你们去解决「死者」的问题。
这也是我想问的部分，如今看来明明我们和他们一样，都是死去之人的灵魂，为何他们的存在如此特殊？
数百年来，他们主观拒绝着回归地脉，利用天使文明创造的阻隔在抗拒地脉的引导…
在这个过程里累积了数百年的执念。这种执念也可以等同于死者的怨念，百年份的怨念将是随时可能引爆的「炸弹」。
那已经是无法放任的程度了，唯有帮助他们认知自己的死亡并解开心结，让「死者」心甘情愿地走进暴风雪里…
再经由我的引导，才能使他们真正回归地脉。否则…你们不会想要知道后果的。
我好像隐约记得…见过一个十分令人恐惧的塔诗佳小姐，是在梦里么？难道那就是可能存在的后果？
你似乎通过梦境得到过很多启示啊。「死亡」其实也会给予凡人智慧，灵魂连接着世间万物与一切因果，没什么奇怪的。
总之，我不擅长对灵魂进行「心理辅导」…
这件事涉及天使级别的位格又无法直接利用权能解决，不如把「拆弹」的事交给你们。
而两名「死者」的存在又会导致每个夜晚你们的灵魂被动地回归地脉…在我看来是一举两得的事。
两个难题在我面前彼此消耗，我只需要在尽量近的地方把控局面，并在最后使用我的权能进行收尾就好了。
顺便…好好观赏一下这出以凡人视角去诠释死亡的「戏剧」。
打得一手好算盘啊，「死神」。
我刚才计算了一下，你说每天此处的地脉能够接收的灵魂数量有着明确的限制，应该是「两人份」？
即便是对庸才来说，这也是显而易见的事。
（是时候回顾一下整个过程了，地脉每天只能接收两个人的话…整理一下这些天的「死亡」情况吧。）
EN: When all this began, right after the performance ended and the snowstorm began to pick up, no one suspected anything unusual. We just assumed we were snowed in.
It wasn't until we discovered the bodies the morning after that we realized something out of the ordinary was going on.
But it's clear now that the oddities actually started earlier than that — when Dymov walked into the snowstorm and never came back.
Right, so Mr. Dymov was the first victim, not Soboleva and Torgov...
And if we pinpoint that moment as the beginning of this incident, then one thing becomes clear:
...Alyosha, you are the only person who walked into the snowstorm and came back without the help of Vodyanitsa's requiem.
More precisely, Alyosha never came back at all. The one who came back... was the Grim Reaper.
Not bad. Well, since you've backed me into a corner, I suppose there's no point in keeping up the act anymore.
I am no such tired cliche. Mortals should address me as the "Ruler of Death."
Before being wiped out for good, you identified the two deceased and even sensed my presence... A commendable achievement. Far beyond what I expected.
I heard you can ferry souls. Those deaths each night — were they your doing?
Your initial conclusion was correct. Due to the existence of the two deceased, the Ley Lines yearned to reclaim those long-lost souls...
Every night, they devoured an equal number of souls to fill the void. This required no intervention from me — though of course, ferrying souls is indeed my authority.
That takes care of today's two...
Don't get so worked up. You are already dead, and your souls must return to the Ley Lines.
I know we're already dead. You murdered us, didn't you?
"Murdered"? No, murder is when mortals usurp my authority. Death is my jurisdiction... If I require someone to die, I need not resort to such laborious methods as murder.
You simply met the criteria to trigger my Curse of Death.
(I know about the Curse of Immortality... So there's another death-related curse, too?)
You cursed us? When? And why would you do such a thing?
So often, humans pray to me, begging to know when their death will come, and what form it will take...
But few people ask "why." If you must have an answer, know that death comes simply because one's time has come.
So you're not going to tell us the truth?
Hold your tongue. By all rights, you shouldn't even be allowed to speak with me.
Those angels from the past are to blame for their reckless renovation of the Ley Lines here. It's made my work on this occasion infuriatingly complicated.
"Work"? So trapping us here, making us watch our friends die... that's just another day at work for you?
You clearly have a lot of questions. Fine — as a reward for your remarkable accomplishments over the past few days, I shall answer a few of your inquiries, provided they aren't too unreasonable.
After the physical body dies, the soul must return to the Ley Lines for that person's "death" to be considered complete.
My work encompasses the entire process of death — including, naturally, the guiding of souls into the Ley Lines, with which you are now so familiar.
You must also be rather familiar with Natlan's Night Kingdom, I presume? It was I who supported the creation of the Night Kingdom. It provided a convenient means of guiding the souls of Natlan.
Here, too, the Ley Lines connected to the theater underwent some modifications. The angels hoped to make them capable of accommodating the souls of some special creations...
But this actually hindered their ability to accept ordinary souls to some degree.
This effect manifested itself after you died from the curse in the theater, leaving you stranded in the afterlife, unable to achieve a complete death.
But if souls who die from the Curse of Death fail to return to the Ley Lines within a short window of time, they will miss their chance for good...
Then, they will remain forever suspended between life and death, no longer subject to the authorities of either.
...So if you don't resolve this matter soon and see all of our souls returned to the Ley Lines, before long, we'll escape your control...
(Mitya is sharp. This must be what Ronova was worried might happen, and the reason she got involved to begin with.)
But if you have the authority to guide souls, why didn't you just show yourself and get it over with? Why hide among us in the form of Alyosha?
You seek to understand the mind of a god? ...Hmph, very well. I'll tell you.
This is a theater, and I decided I wanted to watch a show about death. That's why I encouraged you to take the events to the stage.

I found myself getting quite immersed. I suppose the entertainment you provided makes up for all the trouble you've caused me by being so defiant in the face of death. There, are you happy with my answer?
Really? But it fits the stereotypes you humans have about gods.
Just moments ago, you were complaining about how infuriatingly complicated your work here has been.
Work is work, I get it. There are times when it's a huge pain, but you just have to get it done, right?
That's a rather unique perspective for a human... You are in fact correct. There is a pain point in this case.
Due to the obstruction in the theater's Ley Lines, there is a hard limit on the number of souls they can receive each day, making it impossible for me to ferry all your souls at once.
Revealing my identity too soon would inevitably have led to futile resistance, and there was a risk that any souls who chose to run would disappear.
Then there was the issue of the two lost souls you called the "deceased." The way you resolved that quandary was all part of my design.
That's what I don't understand. If all of us were souls of the dead, what made their presence among us special?
For centuries, they have refused to return to the Ley Lines, exploiting the issues created by the angel civilization to resist being drawn in...
Centuries of obsession accumulated during this process. You may think of this obsession as the resentment of the dead, and in this quantity it was a bomb that could have detonated at any moment.

It reached the point where I could not afford to leave it unchecked. But the only way to fix it was to help them acknowledge their own deaths, make peace with their regrets, and willingly walk into the snowstorm...
Only then, with my guidance, could they finally return to the Ley Lines. Otherwise... you would not like to know what the consequences would have been.
I vaguely remember seeing... Ptashka, but in the most terrifying form. Was that in a dream? Is that what would have become of her if she hadn't returned to the Ley Lines?

I see your dreams brought you many revelations... So you see, death in fact grants wisdom to mortals. Souls connect to all things in the world and see the chain of cause and effect between them. It's nothing unusual.
Anyway, giving psychological counseling to lost souls is not my strong suit...
That is more of an angel's role. It was something I could not resolve directly using my authority, so I decided it was easier to leave the "bomb defusal" to you.
Meanwhile, of course, their presence caused the souls of other members of your party to return to the Ley Lines each night... From where I stand, that was killing two birds with one stone.

As both issues slowly resolved one another without me having to lift a finger, all I had to do was stay close by and keep the situation under control. Then use my authority to wrap things up at the end.
And, of course, while I was at it... I thoroughly enjoyed watching this drama, dealing with death from a mortal perspective, play out on the stage.
Sounds like you had it all figured out, "Grim Reaper."
I just did the math. You said there's a hard limit to the number of souls the Ley Lines here can receive each day. It's two, isn't it?
That much is obvious, even to a fool.
(It's time to review this whole affair. If the Ley Lines can only take in two people per day... I need to go over the deaths from these past few days again.)

title: 《死魂灵的夜曲》·若娜瓦说明剧院地脉与死亡

CHS: 这个大概就是桑多涅说的「生命力」吧，我喜欢叫它「生之印」。
人的生命力往往并不会单独存在，它源自于那些美好时光留下的印记。
那些热烈的生活的碎片，会让一个人充满力量，甚至对抗死亡带来的虚无。
很早以前我就发现自己能够提取这种物质。刚刚桑多涅提醒了我，如果收集足够多的生之印，也许真的能够对抗死亡。
光是在它的周围，就能感受到火焰般的温暖。
你能从我们的身上也提取生之印吗？所有人的力量汇聚在一起，肯定能做到什么事情。
就像过去我们进行过的医疗和能源储备计划一样。
这么做会有什么副作用吗？
生命本身是很坚韧的，这点生命力对每个人来说就像是大海中的一杯水。
不过…按照薇斯纳的说法，生之印本身跟回忆是高度相关的。如果出现破损，里面的回忆也会一同消失。
我觉得这份代价能够接受。至少我愿意报名——那位生之执政说得对，任何方案都必然伴随着风险。
只是失去一部分回忆…已经是比较小的代价了。
以风险回报比来考虑，是个不错的选择。
嗯…那我就直接问了，有人持反对意见吗？
（既然决定合作，像这样的场合就不该置身事外。）
全票通过？那我开始了哦。
不用那么紧张啦，各位。放轻松——
薇斯纳从众人身上提取了生之印…
（陛下的生之印中没有任何回忆！只是一片白茫茫的大雪，仿佛身处在冷冽的冻原之上。）
（这怎么可能？难道陛下的生命中连一点快乐的回忆都没有吗？）
（但这份生命力又确实存在…真是奇怪。）
这些生之印够吗？想要对抗死之执政…
前期研究足够了。如果需要更多，我们再想办法。
米提亚，你协助桑多涅一起进行实验。
研究生命力的用法，用其对抗死之执政——这是当前最重要的事情。
今天就到这里，众卿可以行动起来了。
…陛下，我还有些担忧，希望向您汇报。
可以，跟上来吧，边走边说。
EN: This must be the "life force" that Sandrone was talking about. I like to call it a "Seal of Life".
People's life force doesn't exist in a vacuum. It comes from the deep impressions left by precious times in a person's life.
Those vibrant fragments of life are what fill a person with enough strength to fight back against the looming emptiness posed by death.
I discovered long ago that I could extract this substance. Sandrone reminded me that if we gather enough of these Seals of Life, we might truly be able to defy death after all.
Just being in its presence, I can feel the warmth that radiates from it like a flame.
Can you extract Seals of Life from us as well? Surely our combined strength has to amount to something.
Just like with the medical and energy campaigns we've run in the past.
Are there any side effects to extracting Seals of Life?
Life is very resilient. For most people, the amount of life force contained in a single Seal of Life is just a drop in the ocean.
However... As Vesna points out, Seals of Life are closely tied to memories. If they are damaged, the memories inside will disappear along with the life force.
You mean... people would lose those memories for good?
I think it's a price worth paying. At least, it wouldn't stop me from participating. I have to agree with the Ruler of Life on this point: Every plan comes with its risks.
In the grand scheme of things... Losing a few of my memories is a small price to pay.
In terms of the risk-to-reward ratio, I have to agree — it is a rather good choice.
Okay... Then lemme ask this. Does anyone have any objections?
(Since we've decided to cooperate, I can't just sit this one out.)
All in favor? Then I'll get to work.
There's no need to be nervous, everyone. Just relax...
Vesna extracts Seals of Life from everyone in the group.
And finally, Your Majesty. Forgive the intrusion... Huh!?
(There are no memories within Her Majesty's Seal of Life! Just an endless expanse of white snow, like standing alone on the tundra...)
(How is this possible? Is there not a single happy memory in Her Majesty's life...?)
(And yet, her life force persists all the same... Huh, how strange.)
Will these Seals of Life be enough? Let's not forget, we're fighting the Ruler of Death...
This is plenty for initial research purposes. If we need more, we'll figure something out.
Mitya, please assist Sandrone with the experiments.
You will conduct research into applications of life force and how it may be used to fight the Ruler of Death. This is now our single most important task.
That will be all for today. You may proceed with your duties.
...Your Majesty, I still have some concerns I wish to voice to you.
Very well. Come, we'll walk and talk.

title: 《溯见光影交织》·生之印与记忆损失

CHS: 又到军械宫来了。嘿嘿，这里还蛮大的，要是只有我自己来，说不定会迷路呢。
路都是这样。多走几次，就会熟悉了。
呼啊…皮耶罗还没回来，实验不会要延期到明天吧？
米提亚，你以前参与过无偿献血吗？
你说前几年举行的「医疗储备计划」？参加过啊，为什么突然问这个？
嗯~你会害怕吗？那种针头刺入皮肤的感觉。
也就是说你小时候会害怕，对吧？
根据我的观察，比起针扎的疼，在那之前的心理暗示更容易让人产生害怕的情绪。
有没有感觉就像现在的我们？听从召唤过来，但具体要做什么却完全不清楚——
放心吧，薇斯纳，这次实验并不会带来任何疼痛。
你终于回来了，皮耶罗先生！
这位是薇斯纳，冬契军司令官，也是「风仙」一族的妖精。
进入正题吧。从头讲述，确保我们的盟友也能理解。
如同各位所知道的一样，因为死之执政的干预，能源研究和槲寄生计划都被迫暂停了。
但这种情况不能一直继续下去，我们必须找到破局的办法。其中最需要搞清楚的，就是死亡与复活背后的真相。
死去的人为什么会复活？那些天理的走狗，使用力量时必定存在某些限制…我们要找到答案。
我还是第一次见到这么大的棱晶。
这是军械宫的研究成果，对普通的棱晶进行强化与固化后的产物。我们将其命名为「溯见之镜」。
棱晶可以封存世间的记忆，而且有一定调取记忆的能力。当它被激活的时候，会自动关联与之接近的人或事。
（原来如此。难怪那时候经过军械宫的时候，会看到派蒙的过去…）
我大概听明白了，不过你们打算怎么用这个…「溯见之镜」？
死之执政做事谨慎，想通过蛛丝马迹找到她的线索非常困难。
好在我们手上，其实已经有生死两种力量的拓片了。
「死」，不必多说。经历了那些事之后，米提亚的灵魂中就有死之执政的印记。
那之后我做了好几天噩梦，真没想到这份形同诅咒般的东西居然还能派上用场。
但生之执政的力量…等等，薇斯纳，难道说你——
哎呀，要在这里公布如此重量级的秘密吗？
能够在情报界引起超级地震，听过的人只敢一笑置之的坊间传闻，风仙一族保守数百年的绝对机密——
亥珀波瑞亚时期，前天使长曾窃取一小部分生之执政权能，几经辗转后，交给风仙一族保管。
薇斯纳继承了最初那位风仙的血，也继承了这份力量。
咳，总之就是这个样子啦。皮耶罗先生，你是希望让棱晶关联到我们体内的两种力量，窥探两位执政的记忆？
是的，这是效率最高的方案。
可以是可以，不过这么做的话，有没有可能也会误看到我们两个本身的记忆啊？
毕竟「生」与「死」的力量都只占我们体内很小的一部分…
（糟了。之前经常找理由溜去歌剧院的事情…！）
有什么不希望被看到的记忆吗？
要从海量的情报中找到生死执政的信息，需要一点时间。请各位稍作休息。
EN: Your Majesty, everyone — this way, please.
Here we are back at the Armory Palace again. Hehe, it's such a huge place, Paimon would probably get lost if she was here all by herself.
The same is true of all roads. But walk the same path enough times, and you learn to recognize it.
*yawn* Pierro still isn't back. Are we postponing the experiment till tomorrow?
Mitya, have you ever donated blood before?
Are you talking about that Medical Stocks Campaign a few years back? Yeah, I donated... Why do you ask?
Mm-hmm~ Were you scared? About the needle piercing your skin?
...Of course I wasn't scared. I'm not a kid.
So you were scared of needles as a kid, yes?
What point are you trying to make?
From what I've observed, it's the anticipation of the needle prick that causes people most of the fear, not the actual pain itself.
Feels a lot like the situation we're in right now, doesn't it? We've been summoned here, but have absolutely no idea for what purpose—
Rest assured, Vesna, this experiment will not cause any pain.
This is Vesna, Commander of the Druzhna, and a fae of the Vila race.
Let us proceed. Please explain from the beginning, so our new ally might understand.
As you will all be aware, intervention by the Ruler of Death has forced us to suspend both our energy research and the Mistilteinn Project.

But this situation cannot continue indefinitely. We must find a way to turn the tables. To this end, the most important thing we need to understand is the truth behind the phenomenon of death and resurrection.
Why do the dead return to life? Clearly, there are limits to how the lapdogs of the Heavenly Principles can use their power... We must find where those limits lie.
I've never seen a prism of this scale before.
This is a recent innovation by the Armory Palace, produced by enhancing and solidifying an ordinary prism. We call it the Mirror of Remembrance.

Prisms can be used to securely store memories from the world. They also possess a limited ability to obtain memories from their surroundings. When activated, this device automatically connects to nearby people and events.
(No wonder... That's why I saw Paimon's past the last time I was passing through the Armory Palace...)
Okay, more or less with you so far... But what exactly are you planning to use this Mirror of Remembrance for?
The Ruler of Death is a cautious operator. She rarely leaves a trace of her actions, making it extremely difficult to infer much about her.
But we are in luck. Fortunately, we now possess traces of the powers of both life and death.
As for the Ruler of Death's power, we have Mitya to thank. After recent events, his soul now bears the mark of the Ruler of Death.
You could say I'm cursed — I had nightmares for days after that... At least it's proving useful now. I definitely didn't see that coming.
But what about the Ruler of Life's power? Wait... Vesna? Don't tell me you were—
Ah... Is it finally time to divulge my great secret?

Prepare to learn the truth that could send shockwaves through the intelligence community... Dismissed as a rumor, a joke, by all who have heard it to date, it is in fact the Vila's best-kept secret, closely guarded by my people for centuries—
During the Hyperborean era, the former Archangel stole a small portion of the Ruler of Life's power, and after changing hands multiple times, it was ultimately entrusted to the Vila for safekeeping.
Vesna inherited the blood of the first Vila, and this power along with it.
Your Majesty...! I was gonna build up to it!
Ah, ahem, anyway... what she said. So, Mr. Pierro, I presume your plan is to link the prism to the two powers within us and peer into the memories of the two rulers?
Correct. This will be the most effective approach.
I mean, it sounds feasible, but... isn't there a chance that our own memories might leak out as well?
After all, the powers of Life and Death only make up a tiny fraction of us...
(Oh no... All those times I skipped work and snuck off to the theater...!)
Are there any memories you would rather other people did not see?
I will endeavor to pretend I didn't see anything.
There is a colossal amount of information here. It will take some time to search through it for the details on the Rulers of Life and Death. I thank everyone for your patience.

title: 《溯见光影交织》·棱晶、灵魂印记与风仙权能

CHS: 大家都到齐啦——咦，达妮卡、薇斯纳，你们也在？
来这里吃饭正好碰上了，你们聊，不用在意我们。
人齐了，快和我们讲讲昨天晚上发生了什么吧。
北国银行的地下传来了震耳欲聋的吼声，至冬堡像是地震了一样。随后生之印飘回了我们的身体里——
今早评议会发出公告，说生之印已经完成了它的使命，于昨晚归还。
损耗的部分，北国银行会协商怎么赔偿…看来不用我们再去一趟彩冰镇了。
出什么事了？你们没受伤吧？
跟众人简单地讲述了昨晚发生的事情…
没想到事情这么复杂，就连那位极其神秘的大人物都亲自现身了。
看来陛下早就知道收集生之印可能会引起她的警觉，所以才留了这样的后手。
不过薇斯纳小姐的力量被收走了…
叫我？不要紧啦，这力量本来也不属于我，就当是物归原主了。
薇斯纳小姐真洒脱，我要是也有这么好的心态就好了。
是啊。接下来你们有什么计划？
陛下既然说接下来还有安排，我会在愚人众那边待命。
我应该会回科洛列夫茨基剧团，事情告一段落，要好好准备接下来的演出了。阿罗夏，你呢？
我也准备回凝露镇，雪停了，终于可以去打猎了。
我和旅行者暂时没什么事，可以在附近散散心。
唉…下次再见面又不知道是什么时候。
这话可一点都安慰不到人！旅行者、派蒙，没什么事记得来看我的演出哦。
你们还住在旅馆吗？如果我碰到稀有的猎物，也给你们寄一点。至冬很冷，肉类能保存很久…
看招！上当了吧达妮卡，你的烤肉排归我了！
这些青菜是我送你的回礼，哈哈。
有人跟你说过吗？你真胡闹和装胡闹的表情不太一样。
失去力量不是什么好事吧。
哼。追随陛下的人，会在意这点牺牲吗？
在意是一码事，会不会因此难过是另一码事，再怎么说也是风仙一族传承上千年的东西。
…还好啦，亲爱的达妮卡，我没有那么脆弱。
似乎我来得正巧，没有错过这个话题。
潘塔罗涅先生，你怎么来了？
来归还你寄存在北国银行的东西。
我不是已经取走了吗？虽然过程有点曲折…
不是指你通过正规渠道寄存的那些，而是这个。
通过分离生之执政的力量制作的明灯，由北国银行代为保管，用来收集生之印。现在，我将它归还给你。
我说过，我们总是信守承诺。当然，也要感谢那位不拘小节的生之执政。
她似乎并不会细究力量是否完整回收，只要我们不再大规模收集生之印。
真是一份意外之喜，多谢，潘塔罗涅先生。
不必谢我，一切都是陛下的安排。她说虽然你并不喜欢使用这份力量，但还是留下一些当做陪伴吧。
朝夕相处的事物一旦失去，难免会感到怅然。北国银行的委托就此告结，再见，各位。
不必了…这里的菜不合我的口味。
好吧，不管怎么说，多谢你将它交给我，如果能把你们地下闲置的车借我开两天就更好了。
你的信誉不足以支持我们做这样的交易，在我活着的时候大概是没可能了。
没想到陛下连这种事都考虑到了。果然，陛下她…
七天后，陛下就会和那个女人展开谈判，我相信陛下一定能够找到破局的办法。
林尼！还有琳妮特、菲米尼！好久不见啦！
真的是你们啊。没想到这么巧，会在这里碰到。
来至冬以后，还没见过你们呢！你们最近还好吗？
虽然很忙，但没什么大问题。这段时间我们与父亲大人，还有壁炉之家的其他同伴一起执行任务。
要干的活儿不少，像是收集并整理各种情报、给想要叛逃的官员一点小惊喜等等。
嗯，父亲大人让我们休息几天，她去军械宫见「丑角」大人，商量接下来要做的事。
你好，我要这个、这个、这个，还有这个…
菲米尼，你去盯一下她，不要让她点太多甜点。
你们呢，最近还顺利吗？适应至冬的气候了吗？
刚来的时候不太习惯，现在好多啦。你们呢？我记得你们大多数时间好像都在枫丹，那里可没有这么冷。
我的妹妹比较怕冷，我和菲米尼稍微好一些。
你们吃过了吗？要不要一起吃点？
我们刚吃完。嘿嘿，你们先吃，有机会再慢慢聊。
（连派蒙也能看出来林尼等人身上深深的疲惫。眼下确实不是叙旧的好时机，让他们先好好休息一下吧。）
也好，那我们先填饱肚子，下次再聊。
能在至冬再会是一件很开心的事，你们也多保重。
EN: Looks like everyone's here... Huh? Danica and Vesna? You're here too?
We came for a bite to eat and happened to run into them. Don't mind us, you catch up with your friends.
Alright, everyone's here. You have to tell us what went down last night!

First there was that deafening roar from somewhere underground beneath the Northland Bank... felt like Snezhnograd had been hit by an earthquake. Then, the Seals of Life came floating back into our bodies...
This morning, the Veche announced that the Seals of Life had fulfilled their purpose and were returned during the night.
For those that were damaged or missing, the Northland Bank will negotiate with the affected individuals to arrange compensation. Looks like we won't need to make another trip to Svetloledovka.
What happened? You're not hurt, are you?
You briefly explain last night's events to the party...
...Wow, so much more complicated than I was expecting. The Ruler of Life actually showed up in person? She sounds as enigmatic as they get.
Her Majesty must have known all along that collecting Seals of Life might alert her. That's why she prepared a backup plan.
But Vesna's power was taken away...
Who, me? Not to worry! That power never belonged to me in the first place. All that happened is, it got returned to its rightful owner.
Vesna is so easygoing... I wish I had such a positive attitude.
I know, right? Anyway — what are your plans next?
Since Her Majesty said there will be further action, I'll be on standby with the Fatui.
I'll probably head back to the Korolevskiy Troupe. Now that things have settled down, I should get ready for my next performance. What about you, Alyosha?
I'm planning to head back to Sretomorozsk. Now that it's stopped snowing, I can finally go out hunting again.
Paimon and 旅行者 don't have anything going on right now. We'll probably just chill out in the local area.
*sigh*... Who knows when we'll see each other next?
I'm sure we'll meet again soon.
That's not comforting at all! 旅行者, Paimon, if you really don't have anything going on, make sure you come watch the show.
Are you still staying at the inn? If I come across any rare game, I'll send some your way. Snezhnaya's so cold that meat keeps for a pretty long time...
Take that! You fell for it, Danica! Your steak is mine!
In return, you get the gift of my veggies, hahahaha.
You know, your facial expression is a little different when you're actually in a mischievous mood than when you're just pretending. Has anyone ever told you that before?
Surely, it can't feel great to lose your power.
Hmph. You think I mind making such a trivial sacrifice in Her Majesty's service?
Just because you don't begrudge the sacrifice doesn't mean you don't grieve the loss. This is your people's heritage we're talking about, passed between generations of Vila for over a thousand years.
...I'm quite alright, dearest Danica. I'm not that fragile.
It seems I timed this perfectly. I'd hoped not to miss this conversation.
Mr. Pantalone? What brings you here?
I've come to return what you deposited at the Northland Bank.
What do you mean? I withdrew it already, didn't I? As convoluted as the process was...
I'm not referring to any of the items you deposited through official channels. I'm talking about this.
A beacon, crafted from the small sample of the Ruler of Life's power that you provided, held in trust by the Northland Bank for the purpose of collecting Seals of Life. Now, I'm returning it to you.
Like I said, we always keep our promises. Of course, we must also thank the Ruler of Life for her charitability.
She appears to be uninterested in reclaiming her power down to the very last morsel, so long as we refrain from further large-scale efforts to collect Seals of Life.
This is a very pleasant surprise indeed. You have my gratitude, Mr. Pantalone.
You needn't thank me. This was all part of Her Majesty's design. She said that as much as you don't like to use this power, you should still be able to continue enjoying its company.
A sense of grief is inevitable when parting with something you've long grown accustomed to having around. Thus concludes the Northland Bank's business in this matter. Goodbye, all.
Won't you stay and have a bite with us?
That won't be necessary. The food here... isn't quite to my taste.

Fair enough... Well anyway, thanks for handing this over to me. And, y'know, if you ever felt like letting me borrow one of the spare train cars in your underground garage for a couple of days... Ooh, that'd be the icing on the cake.
Your credit score is insufficient to justify such a transaction — and I'm afraid this will likely remain the case for as long as I live.
How considerate of Her Majesty to factor something like this into Her plan... It just goes to show, she really...
...In seven days, the Tsaritsa will hold negotiations with the Ruler of Life. I, for one, firmly believe that Her Majesty will find out what she needs to turn the tide.
...Lyney! And Lynette and Freminet, too! Hey there, it's been ages!
I thought that was you. What a stroke of luck, running into you here.
We haven't seen you since we got to Snezhnaya! How've you guys been?
Pretty busy actually, but otherwise very well. Lately, we've been working on a mission with "Father" and the others from the House of the Hearth.
There's been quite a lot to do. We've been gathering and organizing all kinds of intel, preparing some little surprises for officials looking to defect, and so on.
Yeah, "Father" gave us a few days off. She went to the Armory Palace to meet with The Jester and discuss our next steps.
Hello. I'll take this, this, this, and this...
Freminet, go keep an eye on her. Don't let her get too carried away with the desserts...
Anyway, how about you? Has everything been going smoothly for you? How are you finding the climate in Snezhnaya?
It was... definitely a bit of an adjustment when we first got here! But we're pretty much used to it now. What about you guys? You spend most of your time in Fontaine, right? Much warmer than here.
Lynette is quite sensitive to the cold, but Freminet and I don't mind it so much.
Have you eaten yet? Care to join us for a bite?
Oh, we actually just finished eating, hehe. You guys go ahead and get some food — we can catch up more later.
(Even Paimon can tell how exhausted Lyney and the gang are. This isn't the best time for a proper catchup — best to let them get some rest first.)
Sounds good. We'll go get a good meal in us, and catch up some more soon.
I'm so happy we got to meet again in Snezhnaya. Please take care of yourselves.
Do you get to take a break at all?

title: 《仅此一着》·明灯归还与权能回收的实际边界

CHS: 找到了一些残留的画面。一起看看吧。
死亡是不能被滥用的，若娜瓦女士，你应该很清楚。
天理深爱着人类，没有它的指令，擅自对人类降下死亡的惩罚…在天理眼中是很大的罪过。
我当然知道。不过在那位大人沉眠期间，天空岛只会周期性地监测我们的行为。
只要在两次监测的间隔，完成死亡与复活，罪业就不会产生。
看来你早就研究过加在我们身上的束缚。
通过降下死之诅咒，并对其施以明确的触发条件，能够在第一时间阻止他们取得实质性的进展。
而我在短时间内将他们复活，就不会引发天空岛降下的惩罚。
真是简明的方案，但也伴随着一些风险。
明明是为了守护天空岛的统治，守护天理的规则，却要用这种拐弯抹角的方式…
亲爱的莱茵多特，这似乎并不能构成拒绝的理由。
任何方案都必然伴随着风险…
而且天理的沉睡是我们当下必须接受的事实，在既定规则下排除风险，本就是「四影」应当承担的职责。
你的唠叨还是那么及时，纳贝小姐。
如果我拒绝的话，接下来的话题是不是又要围绕身份与责任来继续展开了？
我们对彼此都太过了解。如果让人改变想法的不是唠叨的内容而是唠叨本身，那这种过程我希望能够省略。
好吧。我同意帮忙，若娜瓦女士。
不过嘛，和你不同，我在至冬还有很多熟人。
和以前一样，我就待在幕后，不主动露面，可以吧？
当然，莱茵多特女士。我尊重你的想法…只要你履行好自己的职责。
以上就是所有能找到的记忆了。
所谓的「死之诅咒」，其实不止是由死之执政完成的，生之执政也参与了这个过程。
而且，天理为了防止她们滥用力量，也在周期性地监测她们的行为…死去的人必须在下次监测到来前被复活。
这么一看，若娜瓦也没有想象中那么吓人？
受规则束缚，她甚至没办法真正杀死我们。那我们只要不断向她发起挑战，总会有拿下胜利的一天。
很遗憾，我们未必能撑到那一天到来。
在若娜瓦权能作用下的反复死亡会产生记忆损伤，进而连灵魂也会出现磨损。
已经有一些研究人员出现了相当麻烦的精神问题，我们还是需要尽量避免这类死亡发生的。
刚刚的谈话里，还有一个值得注意的细节。
死之执政若娜瓦，似乎早就研究过如何避开天理施加的束缚。
现在决不能大意。当我们进行各种实验的时候，对方也不会坐等。说不定某一天，她就能找到杀死我们而不必复活的手段。
（气氛再次变得很沉重。虽然知道了死亡与复活的真相，对现状却没有太多帮助。怎样对抗死之执政呢？）
既然薇斯纳小姐可以用一点生之执政的力量，我们可否直接用它来对抗死亡呢？
咦…潘塔罗涅，还有桑多涅！你们也来啦。
这就打上我的主意啦？唉，可能要让你失望了。
先不说我能否真正驾驭这种规格的力量…根据先祖留传的信息，我体内的权能规模极小，更像是一种「样本」。
面对上位的存在，任何单一的力量都难以与其抗衡，这是基于现实的判断。
但如果转换思路，不寻求对抗，而是将生之执政的权能当作开启宝库的钥匙…
生与死是彼此抵消的两极，这意味着每个活着的生命，本身就是一个持续对抗死亡的过程。
如果我们用生之执政的权能收集这些「生命力」，将其聚合、放大，或许就能介入生死之间的那道界限。
生命力…让我想想，好像有灵感了。
EN: I've found some snippets. Let's view them together.
When ■■■■■■ awakens... there will be a reckoning...
Death is not a power to be abused, Lady Ronova. You should know this well.
The Heavenly Principles has a deep love for humanity. To punish humans with death without the Heavenly Principles' approval would be a grave sin in their eyes.
I am well aware. But during this period of slumber, Celestia only monitors our actions periodically.
As long as we complete the death and resurrection process in the interval between two monitoring periods, no sin will be incurred.
Clearly, you have been studying the shackles placed upon us for some time.
I have indeed. So, do I have your help or not?
By casting a curse of death and establishing a precise trigger condition, we can render their efforts futile at the first sign of any substantial progress.
Provided that I revive them within a short enough timeframe, we will not invite Celestia's punishment.
An elegantly simple plan. Still, it entails a degree of risk.
There's something... counter-intuitive about resorting to a method like this to defend Celestia's rule and uphold the laws of the Heavenly Principles...
That hardly seems like a good reason to refuse, dear Rhinedottir.
Every plan comes with its risks...
We must face the reality that the Heavenly Principles slumbers. Part of the responsibility we bear as the Four Shades is to eliminate risks within the established rules.
Your nagging is as timely as ever, Naberius.
I suppose that if I refuse, a long conversation will ensue concerning the notions of identity and responsibility.

I feel we know each other too well for that. If the nagging itself is what convinces you to change your mind, and not the content of the discussion, then I would prefer to skip that process altogether.
Fine. I will agree to help you, Lady Ronova.
However, unlike you, I still have many acquaintances in Snezhnaya.
Per our previous arrangements, I will remain behind the scenes and out of view. I trust this is acceptable?
Of course, Madam Rhinedottir. I shall respect your wishes... as long as you fulfill your duties.
This is the only memory I was able to find.
So this "Curse of Death" isn't just the Ruler of Death's doing. The Ruler of Life also plays a role in the process.
And it turns out that the Heavenly Principles monitors their activity periodically to prevent them from abusing their power... The dead must be resurrected before the next monitoring period arrives.
Looks like Ronova isn't nearly as frightening as we imagined, huh?
Because she's bound by the rules, she can't even truly kill us. So, as long as we continue to challenge her, victory will one day be ours.
Unfortunately, we may not last until that day comes.
Over time, repeated deaths at Ronova's hand result in memory damage. Eventually, even the soul will suffer erosion.
Some members of our research team have already developed fairly significant psychological issues. So, we need to act carefully to avoid triggering too many further deaths of this nature.
There was another detail worth noting from the conversation we witnessed.
For a long time now, The Ruler of Death, Ronova, has been studying how to circumvent the restrictions imposed upon her by the Heavenly Principles.

This gives us all the more reason for us to remain vigilant. Our opponent will not sit idly by as we continue to conduct our various experiments. For all we know, she may yet find a means of killing without necessitating our resurrection.
(The atmosphere's getting heavy again. Even knowing the truth behind the death and resurrection cycle doesn't do much to help our current situation. How are we supposed to fight the Ruler of Death?)
Since Miss Vesna possesses a fraction of the Ruler of Life's power, I wonder whether we might use it to directly counteract the power of death?
Huh...? Pantalone and Sandrone! You're here too.
Greetings, Your Majesty. Good afternoon, everyone.
If you think I'm the solution, I'm afraid I might have to disappoint you.

Firstly, we have to assume I'm even capable of wielding such a power... And even then, according to the information passed down by my ancestors, there's only a tiny measure of the Ruler of Life's authority within me. Think of it as just a sample.
It's highly unlikely that my or anyone else's power alone can contend with a higher being. That's the honest truth.
...There are other avenues to explore here. Instead of trying to pit Vesna's power against Ronova's, we could treat the Ruler of Life's authority as the key to access the vault of life...
Life and death are opposites that cancel each other out. By definition, every living being is fighting a constant battle against death by merely existing.
What if we could use the Ruler of Life's authority to extract life force from living beings? With enough critical mass, we might be able to move the needle...
Extract life force... One second — I think I have an idea.

title: 《溯见光影交织》·天空岛监测与死生配合

CHS: …目前手上的任务基本都告一段落了，下一阶段的实验什么时候开始？
我有必要重申实验的风险性，后续风险也可能会进一步提升…请你确保自身不论精神还是肉体，都处在最佳状态。
好了，你从不是一个优柔寡断的人，统括官。你我都知道实验必须继续进行，因为时间不多了，我们需要更强的力量。
旅行者和派蒙，你们不需要回避什么。大敌当前，至冬现在也没什么秘密需要瞒着「盟友」。
啊哈…那就好，我们也有事找「丑角」，看你们在忙有点不好意思打扰…
有段时间没见了，阿蕾奇诺。
阿蕾奇诺，以你目前所知的情报，旅行者的能力是否有助于降低实验的风险性？
你指的是…净化深渊的能力？嗯…或许可行。
虽然我们做了诸多应对风险的预案，但实操起来未必全都有效，多一道保险总归是有好处的。
怎么人人都知道我能净化深渊？
毕竟你也没有刻意隐藏过这份能力嘛。
既然你们的话题没准备回避我们，那快说说，你们又准备搞什么「实验」呀？
「邪眼」？这东西你们还在搞啊，在我印象里可不是什么好东西…
一直以来，愚人众内部使用的邪眼都是半成品，对使用者的生命力有损耗。
愚人众也会本着自愿的原则，执行重要任务或者应对突发情况时可以按需申请使用，没有强制要求。
如今与若娜瓦的正面冲突几乎是必然情况，武力升级非常迫切。
如果在这个时间点能够完成「邪眼」，至少把握会大一些。
而阿蕾奇诺，「赤月的后裔」…便是邪眼完成的关键。
啊？邪眼又是怎么跟「仆人」扯上关系的，我好像没见「仆人」用过邪眼呀？
邪眼那损耗生命换取力量的能力，要说的话，属于「死亡」相关的权能范畴。
在挪德卡莱的时候，你们见识过「三月」的力量了。
很久以前，世间「生」、「死」、「时」、「空」的权能都属于「三月」。其中，虹月分到了最多的「死」之权能。
「三月」消亡以后，这些极高位格的权柄本来已经被天理回收，在新的规则之下分给了「四影」。
但破碎的虹月与深渊结合，深渊为其「拟造」了曾经的权能，或者说展现了「权柄未被夺走」的可能性。
至此，「死」之权柄仍以另一种形式存在于提瓦特，存在于赤月以及赤月子民的血脉之中，「两界之火」便是佐证。
想当初在坎瑞亚的时候，深秘院便从来没有停止过对赤月的研究。
如今想要完成邪眼，以同等位格的力量与若娜瓦分庭抗礼，赤月之中蕴藏的可能性是我们不容忽视的机会。
原来是这么一回事，以我现在的理解…
之前我们打算用「生」之权能对抗若娜瓦失败了，现在又准备尝试同样用「死」之权能与她对抗？
可以这么说。不过…应用「死」之权能的邪眼计划其实很早就有了雏形。
我们发觉佩露薇利是赤月遗民的时候，就认识到完成邪眼的机会来了。
只是当初获取这份力量的理由还没有那么迫切，刚刚成为「仆人」的阿蕾奇诺，实力也尚未成熟。
我或许应该对你道个谢，皮耶罗。如果是多托雷那家伙统管这项研究，可绝不会把实验人员的命当回事。
当然，如果是他负责，我也没打算配合就是了。
应该是愚人众乃至整个至冬向你道谢才对，阿蕾奇诺。你主动找到我要求配合实验的时候，我的确有些惊讶。
不必了，我没那么高尚。毕竟我们已经谈过条件了…
「壁炉之家」将会独立，不再是愚人众下属的情报机构，不再将孩子们培养成间谍。他们以「赤月」的名义追随你…是这样吧？
你找到了壁炉之家最本质的矛盾：爱与利用总是混杂着一起。很多人都清楚这一点，但只有你愿意和我做这个交易。
孩子们曾问我什么是真正的家。我想在讨论这个问题之前，应该先摆脱最不像家的部分。
只要你依旧效忠女皇，以至冬人的立场行动，你手下的人独立与否并没有什么差别…
不值得与一位执行官所要担受的风险相提并论。
谢谢，事不宜迟，那我就先去做准备了。
原来阿蕾奇诺也有着自己的目的呀。
阿蕾奇诺那边就拜托你了，短时间内我还要继续去遍历棱晶提供的回忆和信息，以求新的发现。
好了，那么…两位找我有什么事么，好像你们还没提过这次的来意。
女皇为何要约见莱茵多特？
如果我说，应对若娜瓦的计划确实已经存在，但身为愚人众「统括官」的我，也不知道它的全貌…你会相信吗？
连你也不知道？我、我不太相信…你都是愚人众最大的官了吧？
我们要对抗的是天理「四影」级别的存在，没人知道这些上位者会有多少对付我们的手段。
所以…我们最好假设所有地方都在被若娜瓦监视，所有地方都在被若娜瓦窃听。
要公布作战计划的话，无异于是邀请敌人来参加我们的作战会议，这样的事情毫无意义。
唯有相信女皇陛下，相信女皇陛下的力量与智慧。
虽然她尚未集齐七颗神之心，但我相信如今的女皇陛下已经拥有足以撼动提瓦特规则的能力。
早些时候，她已经做出过战略部署，计划被拆分成诸多目标和环节…约见莱茵多特想必也是其中一环。
后续我们也只需完成自己被分配到的任务就好，了解的越多…风险反而越高。
把计划拆解开，每个人知道一部分，以此来躲过敌人的耳目，是这个意思吧？
感觉这种做法，要建立在绝对的「信任」之上呢，不仅你们要相信女皇，女皇也要相信你们能够把每一个环节都做好…
别看执行官们总是各自为政，现在出了事，总觉得至冬人好像比谁都团结…
那么我也在计划之中吗？
至冬没有立场为你「分配任务」，但女皇曾刻意强调过，尽量在决战时争取你的协助。
你我所要面对的「战场」将会是同一个，至于具体要做的…
而且的确有点没头没尾的，就算若娜瓦听到了，也只会跟我们一样一头雾水吧…
现在阿蕾奇诺的部分也需要你的协助了，这算是额外的工作。
实验的准备应该差不多已经完成，我那位同事就交给你了。
还有哪些我不知道的计划？
感觉你一直很忙的样子。
EN: ...Most of my current assignments have come to a close. When will the next phase of experiments begin?

I must first reiterate the high-risk nature of the experiment. The risks may even escalate further as we advance to the next phase... Please ensure that you are in peak condition, both mentally and physically.
Now, let's not pretend you're having second thoughts, Director. You and I both know that the experiments must continue, because time is running out and we need a stronger source of power.
旅行者, Paimon, there is no need for you to excuse yourselves. Faced with an enemy of this caliber, Snezhnaya has no need to keep secrets from our allies.
Ahaha... Okay, cool. We actually were hoping to speak with The Jester too, but you guys looked busy, and we didn't wanna interrupt...
Arlecchino, based on what you know so far, do you believe that 旅行者's abilities could help to reduce the risk of the experiment?
You mean... the ability to purify the Abyss? Mmm... there's a chance.
Although we have numerous contingency measures in place already, they may not all prove effective in practice. An extra line of defense would be well worth having.
How does everyone know I can purify the Abyss?
Well, it's not like you've ever done much to try and hide it.
So, anyway, what is this experiment about? No secrets between allies, and all that.
We're developing a new model of Delusion.
Delusions? Why are you guys still messing around with those? In our experience, they're nothing but bad news...
The Delusions used by the Fatui have always been an unfinished product that drains the user's life force.
But they are allocated on a strictly voluntary basis. Members of the Fatui may apply for them as needed for important missions or emergencies — nobody is forced to make use of them.
Since a direct confrontation with Ronova now seems all but inevitable, upgrading our combat capabilities has become a matter of great urgency.
If the Delusion can be completed in time for the battle, we will at least stand a better chance.
And as a descendant of the Crimson Moon... Arlecchino is the key to completing the Delusion.
Huh? What do Delusions have to do with The Knave? As far as Paimon remembers, you've never even used one before.
Technically speaking, the ability of a Delusion to drain its user's life force in exchange for power comes under the authority of Death.
You witnessed the power of the three moons when you were in Nod-Krai.
Long ago, the authorities of Life, Death, Time, and Space all belonged to the moons. Of the three, the Iridescent Moon received the greatest share of the authority of Death.
After the moons' demise, these highest of authorities were reclaimed by the Heavenly Principles, who redistributed them between the Four Shades under a new system of rules.

But the broken Crimson Moon merged with the Abyss, which simulated its former authority. Or, you could say, the Abyss manifested the possibility that the authority had never been taken away in the first place.
Thus, the authority of Death continues to exist in Teyvat in another form. It resides within the Crimson Moon and its people's bloodline, as evidenced by the Two Worlds' Flames.
Back in the days of Khaenri'ah, the Universitas Magistrorum never ceased its research into the Crimson Moon.
And still today, if we are to complete the Delusion and attain a power to rival Ronova's own, the Crimson Moon's potential presents an opportunity we cannot afford to ignore.
We already tried using the authority of Life to fight Ronova, but that didn't work out. So now, we're gonna try using the authority of Death instead.
That is one way of looking at it. However... our efforts to complete the Delusion using the authority of Death first began long ago.
When we discovered that Peruere was a survivor of the Crimson Moon lineage, we realized our opportunity had arrived, and thus began the project.
However, the need to attain this power was not as pressing back then. Arlecchino had just been appointed as The Knave and had yet to fully mature in strength.
Perhaps I should thank you, Pierro. If Dottore had been in charge of this project, he wouldn't have given a second thought to the lives of his test subjects.
Then again, had he been in charge, I wouldn't have cooperated anyway.

On the contrary, it is the Fatui, and indeed all of Snezhnaya, who owe you our thanks, Arlecchino. I was admittedly a little surprised when you took the initiative to approach me and request participation in the experiment.
Agree to disagree. I wasn't exactly motivated by moral imperative. You know the terms we agreed upon...

The House of the Hearth will become an independent organization, no longer serving as a Fatui intelligence agency, and no more children will be trained as spies. Instead, they will follow your leadership in the name of the Crimson Moon... Is that correct?

This strikes at the fundamental contradiction of the House of the Hearth: the inseparable mix of love and exploitation. Many are aware of this, but you are the only one willing to make this deal with me.
The children once asked me what a real family looks like. Before I can even discuss that with them, I should first free them from the least familial elements of their home environment.
Provided you remain loyal to the Tsaritsa and act in the interests of Snezhnaya, it makes little difference whether your subordinates are independent or not.
For a Harbinger to shoulder such great risk is of far greater consequence.
Rest assured, I am well aware of the risks.
Thank you. Then I shall go and prepare — time is of the essence.
Sounds like Arlecchino has her own agenda here, then.
Thank you for looking out for Arlecchino. I will continue to explore the memories stored in the prism, in case they should yield further discoveries.
Now, then... What brings the two of you here? I don't believe you have mentioned the purpose of your visit.
Oh yeah~ Hehe, almost forgot about that...
Why does the Tsaritsa want to meet with Rhinedottir?
If I told you that a plan to deal with Ronova is already in place, but that even I, as the Director of the Fatui, am not privy to its full scope... would you believe me?
Even you don't know? Uh... That's a little hard to believe... Aren't you the highest-ranking member of the Fatui?
We contend with the Four Shades of the Heavenly Principles, beings of an altogether higher order. No one knows what methods these higher beings may have at their disposal.
For this reason... we work on the assumption that wherever we are, Ronova is always watching, always listening.
To announce our battle plan would be tantamount to inviting the enemy to our strategy meeting. It would render our efforts meaningless.
We can but place our trust in Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and in her power and wisdom.
Though she has yet to gather all seven Gnoses, I believe the Tsaritsa has already amassed enough power to strike at the rules of Teyvat.
She has already begun unfolding her strategy. The plan is broken down into stages, each with its own objective... I can only presume that meeting with Rhinedottir is one of them.
Moving forward, we need only complete the tasks assigned to us. The more we know... the greater the risk of jeopardizing the entire project.
So the plan's broken up into pieces, everyone involved only gets to know their own part, and that way, we keep the enemy in the dark. Is that the idea?

Seems like something that can only work if everyone trusts each other unconditionally. Not only do you have to trust the Tsaritsa, but she has to trust all of you to pull the whole thing off successfully...
Feels like recent events have turned Snezhnayans into the most united people around. Which is saying something, considering how much the Harbingers enjoy their autonomy...
So, am I part of the plan too?
Snezhnaya is in no position to assign tasks to you, as such. But the Tsaritsa has emphasized that we are to do our utmost to secure your help in the final battle.
No need to be diplomatic about it.
You and I will both face the same battlefield. As for the precise action you will need to take, the details are as follows...
Honestly, it didn't seem to make a whole lot of sense... Even if Ronova heard it, she'd probably be just as confused as we are.
We'll see when the time comes...
In the meantime, we have some extra work for you, since Arlecchino requires your assistance.
Preparations for the experiment should almost be complete. I leave my colleague in your capable hands.
I'll trust the Tsaritsa and take you at your word.
I've already said that I'll help.
Do I play a role in this "game of chess"?
What else is she planning that I don't know about?

title: 《邪眼》·三月权能转移与赤月拟造

CHS: 纳西妲你没事吧？！欸，我们怎么回来了…
梦境的推演结束了，不用担心，只是做梦而已。
那还好，那还好，吓死我了。
EN: Nahida! Are you okay? Wait, we're back...
The simulation is complete. Don't worry. It was just a dream.
Thank goodness! That scared Paimon half to death!

title: 寄自彼岸的昨日·草和智慧：梦境推演结束

CHS: 你可算来了，艾弗提尔维特，迟到可不是你的风格。
（这种真实感…这绝不止是回忆。）
（依照他笔记里的内容，面前这个海洛塔帝应该就是…他「最后的人性」吧。）
（那个家伙将自己的人性封存在了这段记忆里么？哼，行事果然还是那么不正常…）
艾弗提尔维特？怎么不说话，感觉好像你很不情愿过来一样。
我的确很不情愿见到你。
啊？你难道还在在意上次论文选题的事吗？我都道过歉了，真的只是碰巧方向一致…
毕竟对于咱们这样的学者来说，赤月的魅力难以抗拒。
我可不想把自己和你归为一类。
…你今天攻击性好强啊，艾弗提尔维特。
那这样吧，作为补偿，今天研讨会的论题由你来指定怎么样，我会全力以赴帮你一起想。
以你这时候的水平和对赤月的理解程度，应该帮不上我。
哦？你刚刚说的话，我可没法当做没听见，你这是什么意思？
喂，艾弗提尔维特，把题目说出来，别瞧不起人。如果我能解决的话，我要你…
…把下个月的研究经费划一半到我的研究室来，你敢么？
…假设有一种武器，通过利用赤月中「死亡」相关的权能来发挥作用…
虽然觉得只是浪费时间，「丑角」依旧以假设的形式，描述了存在于未来的「邪眼」所遇到的难题…
你在这里自己想吧，我要先走了，还有很多事情要做。
谢谢你，艾弗提尔维特，这真是太让人兴奋了。
你刚刚所说的那些理论，虽然是假设，但感觉在未来都有可能实现，让我大开眼界。
不用谢，要谢也可以谢谢你自己，里面有很多基础的理论依托都是你自己的成果。
我觉得…这个假设的问题在于，那枚「武器」的设计是不是有点太温柔了？
如果最终目的是为了提高位格，以达到「规则级」的力量，怎么能把精力花费在消除副作用这种事上呢？
不贯彻「死亡」，又怎么能够攫取「死亡」的权能？
你这家伙，果然是个混蛋。
…这样的结构，可以将赤月的其余权能作为引导，达成力量的瞬间爆发，引发真正的「必杀技」。
或许可行…我的确没想到你能在短时间内理解到这个程度，海洛塔帝。
呵呵，毕竟你说的这些我也不完全是门外汉，之前利用碎片时间有做过一些研究。
原来早在这个时候就已经产生差距了么。
唉，不过我们刚刚聊的这些方案，虽然理论上可行，但终究还是空中楼阁…
用一次，使用者就会死亡的武器…又有什么实战意义呢？
未必没有意义…未来的我就可以使用。
你在未来过得如何，艾弗提尔维特？感觉你好像真的很辛苦啊。
被你察觉到了么，我并不是这个时间点的艾弗提尔维特。
是啊，我还不至于迟钝到这个程度，何况你好像也没打算隐瞒。
能告诉我吗，未来是个怎样的世界？那时候的我又是个什么样的人？
未来并不美好，你也是个混账东西。
EN: You're finally here, Eftirvit. It isn't like you to show up late.
(It feels so real... This is more than a memory — of that, I am certain)
(Hroptatyr stands right in front of me. From what he wrote in his notes... this must be the last trace of his humanity.)
(So he sealed his humanity inside this memory? ...Just the bizarre behavior I would expect from him...)
Eftirvit? Aren't you going to say something? You... seem like you really don't want to be here.
Correct. You are the last person I wish to see right now.
Huh? Wait, you're not still upset about that thesis topic from last time, are you? I don't know how else to say I'm sorry... The overlap in our research topics was purely coincidental, I promise...
After all, the allure of the Crimson Moon is irresistible for scholars like us.
I do not put myself in the same category as you.
Tell you what. To make up for it, how about you pick the topic for today's seminar? I'll do my best to help come up with some ideas.
Given your current level of scholarship and understanding of the Crimson Moon, I doubt you can be of any help to me.
...What? I can't just pretend I didn't hear what you said there. What is that supposed to mean?
Hey, Eftirvit, quit putting me down and just state the problem already. We can bet on it: If I solve it, then you have to...
...Transfer half of next month's research funds to my lab. Dare to play?
...Suppose there were a weapon that worked by utilizing the authority related to Death within the Crimson Moon...
Although he considers it a waste of time, The Jester poses the future problems plaguing the Delusion project to The Wise, albeit speaking in hypotheticals...
You can think about it by yourself. I have to leave now. There is much for me to do.
Thank you, Eftirvit. This is all so exciting...
These theories you brought up... Even though they're just hypothetical, I feel like they could be a reality in the future. It's a real eye-opener.
Don't thank me. If anyone, thank yourself — many of the basic theoretical foundations behind it are the result of your own work.
My feeling is... the problem with your hypothesis is this: Don't you think the design of this "weapon" is a little too... gentle?
If the ultimate goal is to raise your status enough to achieve rule-level power, why waste so much energy on something like mitigating side effects?
How can you hope to reject death and seize authority over it at the same time?
...Here. With a structure like this, you could use the remaining authorities of the Crimson Moon as a conductor to provide an instant burst of power, dealing a true finishing blow.
That may actually work... I truly did not expect you to gain such a thorough grasp of this material in so short a time, Hroptatyr.
Heh, well, I'm no amateur when it comes to this stuff. I've researched in my spare time before.
Then the gulf began to form far earlier than I thought...
*sigh* Anyway, these plans are just a pipe dream at the end of the day. Fascinating to discuss, and theoretically feasible, of course, but...
A weapon that kills its user after a single use? Seems... pointless. When would there ever be a use for it in actual combat?
In fact, it may not be pointless... the future me can use it.
...How are you doing in the future, Eftirvit? It seems like you're having a really tough time.
So you've noticed. I am not the Eftirvit you know from this point in time.
Yeah, I'm not that oblivious. Besides, it didn't seem like you were making much of an effort to hide it.
Can you tell me what the world is like in the future? What kind of person am I in your time?
The future is a dark place... and you are the scum of the earth.

title: 《被镌刻的时光》·皮耶罗与记忆中的海洛塔帝

CHS: 怎么样了，「笔记」还完好吧？
嗯。笔记在这里，如果我翻看的时候发生什么意外，请各位务必果断处理。
和旅行者预料的一样，当初这本笔记并不是这样的。
现在很多内容已经变成了空白，想必应该是被抹去的禁忌知识。
剩下的，有一些是海洛塔帝个人的思考记录，一些是深秘院各阶段的研究成果。
你们一直疑惑的那个问题呢，他原本想要用来救老师的神秘办法，找到了吗？
「…猜想没有错，赤月果然具备与死亡相关的权能，这份发现得益于近来院内对深渊力量愈发深刻的理解。」
「如今深秘院的技术手段，已经能够初步提取这部分权能并加以掌控。」
「没错…这是迄今为止最有希望的一次，不，应该说这次必然能够成功。」
「应用世界规则级位格的力量，能够让人彻底远离死亡，这样密麦梅斯老师也就能活下来了。」
「要尽快通知艾弗提尔维特，哦对，还应该给这个成果起个名字…」
「不死祝福」？怎么听着有哪里耳熟，答案就是这个吗？怎么了皮耶罗，然后呢？
这个名字…后面又被海洛塔帝划掉了，补上了修改之后的名字…
「贤者」当时在深秘院，自己研究出了「不死诅咒」？
「我怎么早没想到呢，一心只想老师能活下去，后来又被取得成果的喜悦冲昏头脑。」
「它不是祝福，绝不会是祝福…这种东西只会给人带来无尽的痛苦和折磨，还不如让老师就这么死去…」
「我想艾弗提尔维特不会明白的，也没必要解释了。他的世界很纯粹，很多时候只有黑白对错。」
「这项研究应当彻底封存，任何人都不该承受这样的折磨…」
我已经大概猜到故事的全貌了。当初的「贤者」一定想不到，将来的你会以这种方式理解他。
你会因此而原谅他么，皮耶罗？
命运好像永远在寻找机会嘲弄你，活得越久，体会得越深刻。
我并不会因此对他转变看法。这件事只是我与海洛塔帝产生隔阂的源头，并非我对他的恨意的源头。
就算他没有背叛老师，他依旧背叛了国家，背叛了坎瑞亚的人民，乃至背叛了这个世界。
可我觉得，既然他有这么细腻的心思，可能未必是个彻头彻尾的「恶人」。
他不是还提到，这本笔记里有他「最后的人性」吗？那又指的是什么呢？
画片？又好像不是…这页笔记有写什么东西吗？
「我决定走了。我在提瓦特的人生即将结束。」
「接触到真正的深渊，我才意识到我这一生是如此空洞，如此乏善可陈。」
「像是永远受困于一个透不过光的茧，却毫不自知。」
「可即便如此，我还是会频频怀念起『树下研讨会』，怀念起树下的风景和那段一切都充满着希望的时光。」
「但是这很没有必要，对于我即将面对的未来，太没有必要了。」
「我决定『镌刻』下那段记忆，连同这片土地为我塑造的『人性』一起留在提瓦特。」
「正如人生所有的『相见』，也都应该留在最好的时刻。」
最后两句是什么意思啊…「镌刻」记忆？
仔细看的话，这上面画着的难道就是那个「树下研讨会」的风景吗？
「镌刻」…这不是画片，这东西的材质似乎是「棱晶」，用深渊力量雕刻出了画面的棱晶。
「贤者」留下的棱晶？那个能储存记忆的材质？
深渊力量波动好像更强烈了…
我隐约从中感受到一些深渊气息…
EN: Well? Is the notebook still intact?
Yes. The notes are here. If anything goes wrong while I am looking through them... please do not hesitate to do what must be done.
Wh—What do you mean, "do what must be done"?
I don't think there'll be any trouble.
It is as 旅行者 predicted. This notebook is not as it once was.
Much of its contents are now blank, presumably forbidden knowledge that has been erased.
What remains are some of Hroptatyr's personal thoughts as well as research findings at various stages of progression from the Universitas Magistrorum.
What about the big question you've been waiting to answer all these years? Is there any mention of the mysterious method he tried using to save your teacher?

"...My hypothesis was correct: The Crimson Moon does possess an authority related to Death. This discovery was made possible thanks to recent research, which has given us a deeper understanding of the power of the Abyss."
"With the technology now available at the Universitas Magistrorum, we should tentatively be able to extract this authority and harness its power."
"Without a doubt, this is the most promising line of inquiry to date. In fact, I'd go so far as to say that this time, we are sure to succeed."
"With the power of an authority on the level of the very rules of the world, it's possible to avoid death entirely. Professor Mimameith will surely be able to survive."
"I must tell Eftirvit as soon as possible. Oh, and of course — I should give a name to this great achievement..."
"I think I'll go with... the 'blessing of immortality.'"
The Blessing of Immortality? Why does that sound so familiar... So is that the answer? ...Pierro, what's wrong? What comes next?
This name... Hroptatyr crossed it out, and replaced it with a revised version...
So The Wise managed to research the Curse of Immortality all by himself at the Universitas Magistrorum?
"How did I not realize this sooner? I was so focused on keeping the professor alive that I let the excitement of those results go to my head..."
"It is no blessing at all. It could never be... 'Immortality' of this kind offers only endless pain and suffering. Even leaving Professor to die would be a kinder fate..."
"I don't think Eftirvit would understand, and there's no need to try and explain. His worldview is so pure, so black and white... to him, there is right and wrong and little else besides."
"This research should be permanently sealed away. No one should have to endure that kind of suffering..."
I think I have a general idea of the story now. Surely, back then, The Wise never imagined that you would one day come to understand him in this way.
Is this enough for you to forgive him, Pierro?
Fate is always looking for opportunities to mock you... The longer you live, the more apparent this becomes.
This changes nothing of my opinion towards him. The rift between myself and Hroptatyr began with this incident, but it is not the source of my hatred for him.
Perhaps he did not betray our teacher after all. Yet still, he betrayed our nation, the people of Khaenri'ah, even this entire world.
Mind you, he was clearly a sensitive and thoughtful individual. It would appear to me that he is no out-and-out villain.
Did he not say that this notebook contains the last trace of his humanity? What do you suppose he was referring to?
Hmm...? There's something wedged between these pages.
What is it? Let Paimon see...
A picture? Huh, maybe not... Well, is anything written on this page of the notebook?
"I have decided to leave. My life in Teyvat is coming to an end."
"Only after making contact with the true Abyss did I realize how empty, how utterly unremarkable, my life has been."
"It is like I have always been trapped inside a sealed cocoon where no light can reach, and completely oblivious to it all along."
"And yet, even so, I still find myself looking back fondly upon the seminars under the tree... Reminiscing about the view there, and about that precious time when everything seemed so hopeful."
"But I need reminisce no longer. When I look to the future I'm about to embark upon, it seems entirely unnecessary."
"I have decided to engrave those memories and leave them behind in Teyvat, along with the 'humanity' this land fostered in me."
"For all of life's encounters should be defined by their finest moments."
What's he talking about in those last couple of lines? Engraving memories?
Huh, now that Paimon looks more closely... is this supposed to be a picture of one of those "seminars under the tree"?
"Engraved"... This is no picture. The material seems to be that of a prism... Yes, a prism with an image carved upon it using the power of the Abyss.
So The Wise left a prism behind? Isn't that the material that can store memories?
The Abyssal energy is growing stronger...
I sense a faint Abyssal presence coming from it...
Everything makes much more sense now.

title: 《被镌刻的时光》·禁忌知识空白与贤者的镌刻
