So, any ideas, research, or experiments that lead to technological progress can trigger the curse.
Just now, for instance, I was set to launch a final-phase energy experiment ahead of schedule. If the experiment was successful, we could have achieved a crucial breakthrough...
As expected, though, the moment the experiment began, all the researchers, technicians, and witnesses "died" from the curse.
All that effort, not to mention the energy and materials we relied on Project Stuzha to gather for us... went to waste. In the end, nothing was gained.
Does that mean something similar happened when we were at the theater?
That's right. During the performance, I thought of an important breakthrough regarding the experiment, and wound up dragging everyone into this.
So the nature of the curse seems to be something like... when moments of technological progress occur, all life in the vicinity is taken away.
Of course, that meant the curse was normally limited to the Armory Palace. Since outsiders are forbidden from entering, this mass-death phenomenon went unnoticed.
Until Odette came along. I believe she was the first witness. The Curse of Death was triggered just before she infiltrated the Armory Palace that day.
But you mentioned something about a "final-stage experiment"... Doesn't that mean you've actually made some progress?
That's right. Even with the gods locking certain key components out of reach, humanity can still advance technology in incremental steps accumulated over time...
But, as I'm sure Ronova anticipated, even incremental progress has its limits... a point where the "truth" you're seeking must be put to the test in an experiment.
You mean the experiment you were just about to do?

Yes, we were at a critical juncture, a moment where the quantitative was about to translate into fundamental, qualitative change. With this single experiment, we could have brought everything we've worked for to fruition.
But now, after already being forced to fumble around in the dark all this time, it feels like we've truly hit an impenetrable wall.
As long as Ronova's Curse of Death persists, we won't be able to advance the experiment or obtain any results...
And with Project Stuzha having been in effect all this time, at our nation's current strength, repeated trial and error is simply unsustainable.
Only by eliminating Ronova first will it be possible to continue advancing our plans.
But she's the Ruler of Death... She can just kill whoever she wants, right? That's gotta be the scariest power ever! Is it even possible to beat her?
We'll see. But, one thing's for sure. She definitely can't just do whatever she wants. The best proof of that is me... standing here, very much alive.
Wouldn't it be easier to just kill all of us researchers for good? Why resurrect us over and over again? Why let us advance our technology to this point?
So you're saying... even the Ruler of Death has limitations we don't know about?
Exactly, and I think that's where the key to our breakthrough lies.
Regardless, the "Ruler of Death" has always been an obstacle we must overcome. Indeed, we must face "Life," "Death," "Time," and "Space." After all...
The Fatui... want to challenge the Heavenly Principles?
(For a long time, I've had a vague suspicion the Fatui and the Tsaritsa were targeting the Heavenly Principles...)
(But hearing The Jester admit it is still a shock. No wonder the Tsaritsa's goal has always been kept a secret from the people.)
(What kind of road will that lead Snezhnaya down...)
In that case... Lord Jester, I would like to request some leave. I'd like some time to organize my thoughts and go over the data.
Granted. Get some rest, put the experiment out of your mind, and take care that the Curse of Death doesn't affect any civilians.
For my part, I hope you don't mind that I beat a few people up on the way...

title: 《槲寄生》·米提亚验证技术封锁

CHS: 在诸天的使者中，尼可是最年轻的那一批。
在那高天的神圣的恩眷之下，她同其他姐妹一般，领受了灵智与圣权，为那至高的意志行履职责。
年长的天使们向她诉说：
天使曾点燃掌中的灯火，教凡人用它迫散黑夜，炙烤种子和肉，驱赶外露出獠牙的野兽；天使曾将麻草搓成绳索，教凡人将它顺崖垂下，编出衣物与鞋，架缚出能跨越江河的舟；天使曾讲述哲思与理想，教凡人随它自励勤勉，跨越艰难险阻，拟想出仅属于人类的梦。
年长的天使们向她诉说：

有城邦控缚住了火种，教城内的光辉永不消灭，但他们却将火投向同胞，火的光辉如太阳般炫目，却焚烧了千万个无辜者的骨肉，受了火的大地如镜面般平整，上面再无生命，尔后，又是千万个无辜者被迫流浪。最后，高天熄灭了这城邦的火种，翻犁了毫无生机的大地，用受罚者的生命再次唤醒了生命；有城邦用绳编制万物，却想借助手中的金绳攀上至圣的天空，他们在画布上描出亿万根金绳，再从画布中将它们取出，揉在一起汇编成了倒垂的高塔，直升向高天，试图摘下他们想象中那颗至高的果实。最后，高天剪断了狂妄的绳索，将企图逾越高天的僭越者囚禁于画布之中，被他们自己编织出的金绳永世捆缚，再让画外的人跪伏下去，再不能仰面视天；有城邦穷尽了世间的智慧，为了追求终极的灵知，他们褪去了自视累赘的形体，一个接一个地投入无光的深邃幽海，只留一套轻薄的躯壳飘在海面，众人皆驱使这躯壳的眼和手探索世界，在他的目光触及此世之外的暗渊前，高天便蒸干了海水，剔净了教他们迷狂的智能，让他们回溯至最初的形状，以此断绝深罪的狂想。
「法度不可试探，律例不可质疑，典章不可违弃。」
那位一度最为接近高天之主的长姐如此告启。
EN: Nicole was young for an envoy of the heavens, and among the youngest, in fact.
Granted the holy favor of the heavens like her sisters, she was endowed with both wisdom and sacred authority and called to fulfill that supreme will.
The elder angels spoke, and told her this:

Once upon a time, the angels had kindled light in their palms and taught mortals the uses of that flame: to drive back the night, to turn seed and flesh into sustenance, and to ward off the beasts baring their fangs. They had twisted hemp into rope and taught the mortals to use it to scale down the cliffs, to weave garments and shoes, and to fashion vessels fit to cross the rivers... They had spoken, too, of thoughts profound and of ideals pure, teaching the humans to steady their hearts, to pass through hardship and peril with fortitude and diligence, and to dream dreams that belonged to mankind alone.
The elder angels spoke again, and told her this:

There was a city that had taken fire and bound it to their rule, ensuring the light within their walls would never dim. Yet, that which could have sustained them and given them prosperity was turned to destruction, for they chose to unleash that very light upon their own people. Bright as the sun the fire was, and it reduced countless innocent lives to bone and ash. The earth that bore its passing was left level as a mirror, stripped of every sign of life. And in the aftermath, countless more were cast out to wander. At last, the high heavens extinguished this flame, furrowed the dead earth where no life remained, and by the lives of the punished awoke life there anew. Elsewhere, there was a city that wove all things from rope, yet sought to climb to the most sacred heavens by the golden cords in their hands. They painted countless golden strands upon canvas, drew them forth, and bound them into an upside-down tower rising toward the heavens, seeking to reach the supreme fruit they had imagined there. Eventually, the high heavens severed those cords of arrogance and sealed the trespassers within the canvas. There, the golden cords they had woven bound them for all eternity, and those beyond the canvas were brought low to their knees, never again to turn their faces upward to the heavens. And then there was another city that pushed the wisdom of the world to its farthest reach. To attain the ultimate understanding, they cast aside the bodies they saw as burdens and descended, one by one, into the lightless depths of the sea. Upon the waters there remained only thin shells adrift, and through his eyes and hands they continued their exploration of the world. Yet, before his sight could be set upon the dark gulf beyond this world, the high heavens turned the vast waters of the sea to vapor, purged away the intellect that had led them into delirium, and returned them to their first shape, thereby ending the fevered reveries of that deep transgression.
"The laws shall not be tested, nor shall the strictures be questioned, or the scriptures be infringed."
Thus spoke the eldest sister, once closest of them all to the Lord of the Sky.
"Any transgression shall be greeted by inevitable punishment."
This was an edict that Nicole, too, once believed with all her heart.

CHS: 聪明的女孩跪坐在面容依旧的尼可面前。她是那位最初智者的后代，和先前诸位一样，也已经问过了无数个问题，城邦也早已承认了她的智慧。
窗外的行船从空中飞速掠过，船上的控舷者娴熟地驾驭着流风，穿着绸缎的人们自由地讨论着哲思与文学，他们房里的灯火平静地永恒燃烧着。
但在这座无忧无虑的城邦中，这位城邦里最聪明的人，却依然被困惑袭扰——她所思索的问题，先前的智者们都未曾想过。
所以，她再次来到了那位解答了无数问题的天使面前，谦卑地问出了自己的疑问。
「请问，这个世界的目的是什么呢？」
莫名的问题让天使犯了难，即使是以高天恩眷的智慧，她也不知道该如何回答这问题…
目的即为终点，凡是由至高权能所创的万物，终点自然是消灭，毕竟万事万物，都不该永存不灭。
可是，那位长姐说，这世界也是由至高权能所创啊，但世界…也会消灭么？
尼可的思维突然终止了。并非是她因为被问住，而尴尬地停止了思考。
而是高天的恩眷，不知为何不再回应她的呼唤。
孤居此地的天使陡然陷入了迷惘，虚无的平静让她无所适从，她的世界从未如此死寂…
尔后，她从敞开的房门看见了，在天与地之间，羽和火组成的赤雨纷落直下，判罚的巨钉榤罚着大地，每腾起一声巨响，就有一座城再无声息。
天使霍然站起，抓着女孩的肩膀摇晃着，大叫道：
即使她现在再无恩眷在身，但是带着人逃跑总是会的。
于是，一场惶惑的跋涉开始了。失去一切的人们无所适从，他们早就遗忘了如何用自己的手来求生，华美的绸缎也无法在野外遮蔽风雨与严寒。
「没关系，我教你，把木头削成这样，然后再放在火上烧，然后就…呜哇！烧着了烧着了！不对不对不对——」
「先把石头磨尖，对，就是这样…你看，这就是一个简单的小刀了。」
「呃…搭棚子…想要打下桩子才行，来几个力气大的！力气都不大？好吧，那就多来几个人！」
只不过是又一场很长很长的导引而已，尼可这么想，她可是很厉害的天使，就和姐姐们一样，她可以从头教会这些小小的人儿如何生活，如何分辨各样树上的果子，如何耕作结种子的菜蔬，如何狩猎飞鸟、走兽和水鱼，如何编起绳结，数算自己的日子，如何拥有知晓一加一等于二的智慧，如何再度筑起宫殿与神庙…
只是这时的世界，已经不再奢侈到允许她将这些从头教起了。
在她所知晓的那个世界中，如果有饥馑，高天就会落下食物与甘霖；如果有贫瘠，大地就会生出矿藏与金玉。
可无论是王座上至高的那一位，还是大地上代行统领万国的长姐，无人曾告诉过她，若是荒冷的土壤已被裹尸布般的白灾覆盖，应当如何播种那些粗劣的野生草种？如果瘟疫与饥荒要夺去弱小之人的性命，应当如何凭空造出足以医治一切疾病的万灵药？
很厉害的天使努力学会了那个时代一切足以让人幸福的理论和知识——但理论只是理论，知识只是知识。
最后一个躺在尼可怀里睡去的，依然是那个最聪明的女孩。
「请问，这个世界的目的到底是什么呢？」
这实在不是一个厉害的天使应当说的。
EN: The clever girl sat on her heels before Nicole, whose face had been left untouched by time. A descendant of that very first sage, she had embarked on the selfsame well-worn path as her predecessors, asked countless questions along the way, and has long earned the city's respect.

Outside the window, flying ships zipped by, guided by hands well-versed in the language of the wind. On board these ships, men and women dressed in silk spoke freely of philosophy and literature, and in their rooms, the lamps burned on placidly and with no end.

But carefree as the city was, that same ease was never quite felt by what was the brightest mind among them all. Instead, she remained troubled by questions no sage before her had ever thought to raise.
She appeared once more before that angel who had answered countless questions of hers and those before, and humbly posed that question that vexed her so.
"Please tell me... what purpose does this world serve?"
Nicole, angel as she was, found herself stumped by this question. Despite the wisdom granted to her by the heavens, she did not have an answer to that...
"Purpose" implied an ending, and all things made by the supreme power, by that very measure, were bound one day to reach their end and extinction. Nothing in all creation was meant to remain forever.
But her eldest sister had said that this world, too, had been made by that same supreme power. Would that mean, then... that the world itself would also be brought to nothing?
Nicole's thoughts halted abruptly at this point. But this was not the awkward pause of someone at a loss for words.
Rather, for reasons beyond her knowing, the grace of the heavens no longer responded to her call.
The angel who had been dwelling here in solitude was plunged into confusion. Her world had never been so deathly silent, and the hollow stillness left her at a loss.

Later on, she glimpsed something through an open doorway: between heaven and earth, a crimson rain of fire and feathers was falling without end. The giant spike of judgment hammered the ground, and with every booming strike, another city was erased and silenced.
The angel sprang to her feet and shook the girl as she yelled,
Though she no longer had the grace of the heavens, she could still do this one thing: gather the people and lead them to safety.

And thus began a long retreat fraught with confusion and uncertainty. Having lost everything, the people were effectively set adrift. They had long since forgotten how to survive by the labor of their own hands, and all their fine silks could not ward off the wind, the rain, or the bitter cold of the wilds.
"It's fine, I'll teach you. First, you whittle the wood down like this, then you hold it over the fire, and then... See? It's kindled! No, no, not like that, you have to..."
"Start with the stone, you have to sharpen the stone first. Yes, just like that... See? Now you have a simple knife."
"And then, ah... right, the shelter... We'll have to hammer those stakes in first, so I'll need a few strong folks to help me. What? No one? Fine, we'll just need more hands on this then!"

Guess I'll just have to guide them for a longer while, Nicole thought. She was a very capable angel, after all, just like her elder sisters. She could teach these little ones everything once again: how to survive and which trees bore fruit, how to plant seed-bearing greens, and how to hunt the birds, beasts, and fish. She would show them how to knot cords to mark their days, teach them that one and one made two, and show them how, one day, they might build palaces and temples again...
But this was no longer a world indulgent enough to let her — or them — start from the very beginning again.
In the world she had known, food and rain would descend from the heavens as an answer to famine, while poverty was invariably salved by the ore, gold, and jade yielded by the earth.

Yet neither that sovereign on high, nor the sister who ruled the nations in their place, had ever told her what to do when the cold soil was already being choked by a pale calamity that draped over the land like a burial shroud. How was she to sow life in earth like that with nothing but wild seed? And if plague and hunger should threaten these puny lives, how was she to summon from nothing a remedy for every ill?

The brilliant angel had already labored to master every theory and field of knowledge that the age held as the key to happiness. Yet, when applied to the art of being happy, theories were only theories, and knowledge was nothing more than a pale approximation.
The last to fall asleep was always that cleverest girl of them all.
The girl asked, as she lay in Nicole's arms,
"Please tell me... just what purpose does this world serve?"
No answer could have sounded less fitting from one such as her.
But she really did not know the answer.

CHS: 天上的争战走到了尽头。
叛逆的碎羽连带着受咒的骨血淋漓而下，渊薮的厄影与天空一同被焚烧殆尽。
但那僭越的念头早已深埋在天之御使们的魂灵深处，她们目睹着漫天羽翼在须臾的美梦中讴歌着自由，肆意挥洒着真实的爱与恨，即使只是侧目所见，又如何能将那荣华的炽灼爱欲弃绝于眼眸之外，又如何能为天上的暴君唱起颂歌，让自己的脖颈再次戴上羁绊？
——故而，曾领受了应得恩眷的天使，如今也要被赐罚应赎的罪。

有人不愿放弃已有的权能，那便被剥去灵知，化为脏污的魔物，终日瑟缩在判罚的目光之外；有人丧尽一切，仅留下一丝余念，振起金色的翼翅潜遁深海，跟着海潮顺流漂行，直到奏响命中既定的乐章；有人费尽心思，即便藉着啁哳流变的黄沙匿迹潜形，但在被镀金的沙砾磨尽灵魂之前，终究无法逃脱永世追逐的判罚；有人对高天施予世界的羁绊心怀忧郁，拼尽全力在尘世的浩劫中为受庇的苗圃谋得一线生机，最终永恒地彷徨于无所不在之风也不再吹拂的刹那；还有人融入了大地，在至高那位的默许下，为了无生机的红砂捧祝生命的新芽…
尼可便交出了一半的智慧。因为这智慧已被高天锻打为迫人臣服的枷镣，随着那不可琢磨的心意之变迁，这灵智时而恩眷世界，时而责罚世间，万物都是它的囚徒，即便诸天的使者也无法动摇其根本——她也已经亲眼见了这套枷镣是如何无理地折磨无辜之人。
假若拥有智慧的代价是视若无睹，那她宁愿哑然跃入那看似晦暗的泥淖，自己去追逐世间的答案。
尼可便交出了一半的力量。因为她不惮于化为如万千人一般的凡人，在被高天的恩眷弃绝之时，她便和凡人同行跋涉，在荒原并肩前行，她看见了人们的血和泪，听见了他们的呼喊和恳求，这是她之前端坐在庭院之中时从未看见和听见的。
假若拥有力量的代价是听之不闻，那她宁愿削去本就不属于自己的羽翼，自己去寻找存在的理由。
于是，尼可便独自回到了寂静的地面。
曾经很厉害的天使依旧无法理解，世界的目的究竟为何。
EN: The heavens burned until there was nothing left to fight over.
The broken feathers torn loose during the rebellion rained down alongside cursed blood and shattered bone, as both the abyss's baleful shadow and the heavens were consumed by fire.

But the seed of defiance had long since been planted deep in the souls of heaven's envoys. They had seen the winged ones in the sky sing freely and pour out their true loves and hates without restraint. Fleeting dream as it was, how could one pretend that such blazing passion does not exist after that? How could one go back to singing hymns for the tyrant above, and willingly take the yoke upon their neck again?
And so, the angels, once graced with what was rightly theirs, had to bear the punishment their sins had earned.

Those who refused to relinquish their powers were stripped of their wisdom and turned into filthy beasts which would then spend their days shrinking away from the eyes of judgment. Others were stripped of everything but a lone remnant of will. They would spread their golden wings, then dive deep into the sea where they would ride the tides until the hour they would play their fated theme. Some would exhaust every effort to hide their forms in the restless, shifting yellow sands, though they were unable to outrun the eternal chase of judgment nevertheless. And then there were those who would look with melancholy upon the shackles the heavens had cast over the world, even as they poured themselves into securing just a fragile spark of life for the sheltered seedlings amidst the cataclysm of the mortal plane. In the end, they would find themselves drifting eternally through that frozen instant when even the ever-present wind had fallen silent. Others would meld into the earth, and under the silent gaze of the supreme, they would breathe life into the barren red sands, and cradle the first trembling sprouts of a new beginning...
Then, at last, it was Nicole's turn.

Half her wisdom she surrendered, for she knew that it had already been forged by the heavens into a set of shackles. The supreme held all things captive to its will, switching between benevolence and punishment seemingly at whim. Not even the heavenly envoys could shake its core — and she herself had already witnessed the torment these blind shackles had inflicted upon the innocent.
If wisdom required her to turn a blind eye, she would rather leap wordlessly into the mire, dark as it appeared, to pursue the answers the world held for her.

Half her power she surrendered unflinchingly, for she did not fear the thought of taking on mortality like countless others. When the heavens withdrew their grace, she traipsed the barren plains alongside the vast exodus of humanity. She saw their blood and their tears and heard their desperate cries and pleas, sights and sounds that had never reached her when she was sitting on that rug in that peaceful courtyard.
If power required her to turn a deaf ear, she would rather shed the wings that had never truly been hers and set out alone to find the reason for her existence.
And so, Nicole made her way back alone to the silent earth.
But the once-so-mighty angel still could not find the answer to the question of the world's true purpose.

CHS: 尼可所构想的故事，许多都以「在很久很久以前…」开篇。
很久以前，列邦的灯火曾经像金丝般缀满大地；很久以前，高天的女儿们曾经无忧无虑地行走在诸神的庭院与凡人的城邑间；很久以前，那坠入深黯的旧日之主尚未将灾厄带回他的故土；很久以前，高悬于夜空的三轮明月，其数依旧为三…
岁月不居，珠流璧转。乐园的火种在无望的轮回中与生息一同殄灭，原本忠心于主宰的侍仆为受造的生命而背叛，漆黑的龙主自星间归来，月色的高车如琉璃般破碎…
「欸，等一下，你说的太笼统。这里面每一条单独拿出来扩展扩展，都足够写一本书了。」执笔书写故事的魔女举起手，打断了尼可的话，她皱眉思索，太多的故事带来了太多的思绪，让她反而不知道如何继续下笔。
「这样挺好的，这样简洁快速地抛出很多悬念，肯定能吸引许多读者！」快乐的魔女躺在她的嘟嘟可玩偶上哈哈大笑，虽然她不知道究竟有没有普通的读者能读到自己好友的著作，但光是召开茶会这件事，就足够她开心许久了。
「呵呵呵…除了读者之外，这些故事说不定还会引来某些更高位的『访客』呢。」洞悉着未来的魔女低笑着，她早已掀开未来的面纱，但却从不提及自己的所知所见——毕竟命运的底色，可不能轻易示人。
「是么？那就更有趣了，我倒是很期待见见那几位『访客』。」求知的魔女无所谓地拍拍手，随后就不再言语，似乎真的在期待着某位不速之客的造访。
「……」即将再次远行的魔女沉默不言，她将厚厚的靴子鞋跟叩在地面上，旁边手提箱里的窸窣响动旋即停止，她这才重新开始安心品茶。
「真、真的假的？那我不如说点其他的故事？详细一点的那种？」
反正茶会的时间还长，她决定换一篇故事叙述。
EN: Many of the stories Nicole envisions begin with a phrase as old as the stories themselves: "A long, long time ago..."

It was a time, a long, long, time ago, when the lights of myriad nations filigreed the earth in gleaming gold, when the daughters of heaven wandered in carefree grace betwixt divine courts and mortal cities... It was a time, a long, long, time ago, when the sovereign of ages past, who had descended into deepest darkness, had not yet brought disaster back to his homeland, when the radiant moons that hung aloft in the night heavens were still three...

The years brook no pause, the wheel spinning onward all the same. In a cycle emptied of hope, the spark of paradise perished alongside lives extinguished. Servitors once loyal to their ruler turned traitor for the sake of the lives that had been fashioned; the black dragonlord returned from beyond the stars, and the moonlit chariot of the heavens shattered like crystal...

"Wait a second, that's too much all at once. Just take any one of those threads and spin it a bit more, and you'll have enough for a whole book." The mage writing the story holds her hand up to stop Nicole as she speaks. Her brows knit together as she tries to think. Too many stories are pressing in on her at once, and as each opens into still more thoughts, she finds herself unsure where her pen ought to go next...

"Oh no, that's perfect. Give them a few puzzles to chew on right from the start, and they'll be hooked for sure!" The cheerful mage lay draped over her Dodoco plush as she let out a hearty laugh. Although she has no idea if her friend's work would ever reach a common reader, the mere prospect of a tea party has filled her with enough delight to last a long while.

"Hehe... Who knows, these stories might end up attracting more than just readers. They might even invite certain 'visitors' from higher places." The mage who can read the future chuckles. The veil between the here and now and what is yet to come may have been lifted for her long ago, yet she never speaks of what she sees. After all, the true colors of fate are never meant to be revealed lightly.

"Oh? Well, now you've made things sound even more interesting. I'd quite like to meet these so-called 'visitors.'" The inquisitive mage gives an airy clap before falling silent, as though she is truly looking forward to some uninvited guest's arrival.

"..." The mage who would soon be off again does not say a word. She gives the floor a neat tap with the heel of her thick boot, and the rustling in the suitcase beside her stops right away. Now, she can pick up her tea and enjoy it thoroughly again.
"R-R-Really? Then maybe I should tell a different one instead... one with a little more detail to it?"
The mage without a voice blinks.
Since the tea party won't be ending for a while, she decides to set that story aside and starts telling another instead.
"It was a time, a long, long, time ago..."

CHS: 「敬爱的使者，我又想请教您一个问题。」
又一个清晨，一个女孩又叩开了矗立于卫城之巅的庙宇的门扉。
尼可端坐在毯子上，用微笑示意女孩开口。踏入内厅的女孩也咧嘴微笑，忙不迭地将自己昨夜的所思所想尽数倾诉，虽然她语速飞快地如同掠过水面的鸟雀，但尼可依旧听得非常清楚，毕竟她是天使，很厉害的。
这位女孩是城邦里最好学的一位，自从尼可被遣来庇护此地后，就数她询问的问题最为繁多，也最为奇怪，在她的眼中，仿佛世界本身就是一个不解的谜题。
城内的愚人曾因为担心这女孩问出僭越的问题，为城邦招致灾祸，而用铐子将她缚在房里，想用饥饿和恐惧止住她脑中的迷思。
但是，在五天之后，当愚人们打开监牢的门，却看见女孩用镣铐的边角在地上刻写着一条又一条复杂的算式，在人们犹疑地踏入房里时，收获的不是屈服与沉默，而是高亢的呵斥。
或许是被她眼里灼热的智慧所震慑，也或许是愚人终于意识到了对于智者应有的尊敬，人们畏缩地解开了她的镣铐，将她送到了尼可跟前。
她无尽的疑问倒是让尼可非常受用，毕竟作为天使中最年轻的一代，她其实并没有多少真正导引人类的机会——在她之前，已经有好多好多天使启迪了人们，现在地上的人们可聪明了，甚至聪明的让那位长姐有些犯难，也聪明的让尼可没有什么发挥的空间。
不过现在嘛，总算有了这么一个难得的机会啦。
「敬爱的使者啊，请问为什么树上的果实总是向下落呢？」
「…请问为什么闪电的轰鸣总是比它的光辉晚到呢？」
「…请问为什么月亮总是在我们眼前升落，不会向远处飞走呢？」

——嗨，不就是重力、光速和音速问题嘛…只要不让我手算什么题目，或者是直接推导算式就行，目前看来，可以先光用嘴说一下简单的概念与公理，这还是非常简单的。话说这孩子是不是学得太快了，按这个进度，不会过几天就要问我具体的流体算式和星轨算式和热力学什么的了吧？拜托，我可说不来那些啊…！而且这速度真的不正常吧，我记得之前阿姐说，那座叫做琅玕的城邦，里面的人好像还在学习怎么编织布匹…？呃…不对不对，那边的学习模式好像也很怪来着，一批人学习完如何编织布匹之后，马上又有新一批人来学习怎么测算数理，大家都各学各的，难道这就是人多学得快吗，也亏得那边的天使姐姐教得过来，阿姐是不是和我提过她的名字？叫什么来着…等等等等，别乱想了！先解决眼前的问题，今晚上再提前预习一下其他的知识，嗯，就这样。
总之，迎着女孩期待的目光，端坐在毯子上的天使志得意满，她咳嗽了两声，扭了扭身子，开始了新一轮的回答。
「咳咳，那么这个问题的答案是…」
EN: "Gracious envoy, I have come with another question."
Another day had dawned. A girl came to the temple high above the satellite city and, once again, knocked on its doors.

Inside an inner hall. Nicole, sitting poised on a rug, invited the girl to speak with a smile. The girl answered with a grin and, almost without pausing for breath, began to spill out every single thought she had had from the night before. Her words came and went as swiftly as birds sweeping low over water, but Nicole caught them all. But of course she did, since she was an angel after all.

The girl was the most curious creature of them all in the city, and it was as if the world itself were a giant unsolved puzzle to her. From the moment Nicole had been sent to keep watch over this place, it was she who came with the most questions, and the oddest ones, too.

There were fools in the city who feared that, sooner or later, the girl would ask a question that strayed too far, and by it call calamity upon them. And so they shut her in a room and bound her in irons, in the hope that hunger and fear might smother the unruly stirrings of her mind.

Then, on the fifth day, when the fools opened the door to her "cell," they found the girl crouched on the ground, carving one complex equation after another into the floor with her shackles. When they stepped into the room at last, wary and unsure, what met them was not the silence of defeat but a sharp reprimand.

Perhaps the fools were alarmed at the burning intelligence they saw in her eyes. Or maybe they had finally remembered the respect owed to the wise. Whatever the reason, they then gingerly removed her shackles and brought her before Nicole.

Nicole was actually rather fond of the girl's endless questions, for it gave her something she had rarely been afforded before: a chance to truly guide someone. Nicole seldom found much room to put her own gifts to use — as one of the youngest of the angels, she had come only after so many others had already enlightened the people of the world. The people on earth at this point were so remarkably clever that they even perplexed the eldest sister on occasion.
But now, fortune finally had handed her one precious opportunity.
"Gracious envoy, why is it that the fruit upon the trees is always drawn downward to the earth?"
"Why does the thunder always arrive only after the lightning has already flashed?"
"And what keeps the moon from flying far away, so that it rises and sinks before our eyes instead?"

Ah, so what we're really talking about here are gravity and the speed of light versus sound... That's fine, that's totally fine. As long as she doesn't ask me to do any calculations by hand, or start deriving formulas on the spot, I can absolutely handle that. For now, anyway, I can still get away with it just by explaining the basic concepts and principles. That part's easy. Completely manageable. But... isn't this child learning a little too fast? At this rate, in a few more days she's going to start asking me about fluid dynamics, orbital mechanics, thermodynamics, that sort of thing! I can't possibly explain that! Please, no. And besides, this really isn't normal, is it? I'm sure my older sister once told me that the people of the city of Lang-Gan were still learning how to weave fabric... Um... no, no, wait, their way of learning over there was strange too, wasn't it? One group would finish learning weaving, and then right away another group would come in to learn mathematics and measurement. Everyone studied different things, separately. Is that what makes it faster? By having more folks learn different things? Hm. It's impressive that the angel there could keep up at all. Did my elder sister ever tell me her name? What was it again...? I think she was—— Wait, no, no, that is not the point right now! I need to focus, focus! Let's deal with the problem on hand first. Then tonight, I'll do some reading to stay ahead. Yes. Perfect. That's the plan.
So, the angel on the rug felt quite pleased with herself as the girl looked at her expectantly. She gave two little coughs, shifted her body a little, and began explaining once more.
"Ahem. So, the answer to your question is..."

CHS: 人们总是需要神的，因为人们渴望祈祷被倾听，也渴望有谁能替自己背起重担。
人们失去天使之后，地上便由一群长得稀奇古怪的「魔神」照顾着。他们挥挥手，绝望的人群就追随着它们、聚集了起来；他们稍作许诺，听众便手舞足蹈、欢呼雀跃；他们只是显露一点点奇迹，追随者们就感恩戴德。
「现在的人类真是没出生在好时代啊。」
尼可远离人群，内心这么想着。自己昔日的姐姐们，看起来不是比如今奇形怪状的魔神们要神圣、美丽得多吗？虽然魔神当中确实也有几个长得很好看啦…
她看了看绕着自己的小腿打圈的一位「阿姐」，不由地内心叹息一声。变为仙灵的「阿姐」因为自己现在的形态过于接近人类，竟然想要拉自己去找宝箱。
尼可又看了看水面中自己的面容，任凭她怎么管理表情，似乎都挤不出一丝神圣的气质。
「天使」已经淡出了世界，而人们总是需要神的。
漫长的时间后，对于世界变化很敏锐的尼可发觉了一丝规则的变化。
名为「神之眼」的授记，仅限人类可以走上的伟大旅程——尼可心动了。尼可知晓「神之眼」的原理，也知晓这条路最终的结局。她想知道自己如此接近人类的状态是否可以获取一丝目光。至于结局，她不是很在乎，因为诞生自光的意识，哪怕落入了尘世，也总是想着能重新攀上光。
可是尼可试过了所有的方法，却始终无法得到天空的认可。数千年不能说出口倾诉的话语足够撑破任何一种渴望的计量表。她只是被无视了。
她失望地流浪到了纳塔，寻找到了唯一还能用语言交流智慧的家人。
「『天使』被剔除出规划与秩序了，你只会被无视。」
「懂了。也就是要削尖脑袋钻进人类的世界对吧。」
没有联系就建造联系，不在规划内，就让蓝图充满自己的影子。
她不再只是远远地观察：接一些雕塑的委托（报酬会放进宝箱）、为迷失的人们沉默地引路（走上正路前会先拿到她的宝箱）、悄悄予迷茫中的学者以提示……
尼可获得神之眼的瞬间也并无什么张力，只是她在帮助完一位老者之后，天空再也无法无视她造成的影响了。日积月累，水到渠成。
人们总是需要神的。天使也是一样，被无视、不再被需要是很可怕的事情。
尼可捏着自己的神之眼，用它盖住了天空岛的轮廓。
「——你可承认我是人类了。你要爱护我、原谅我。从此以后，我要活得潇洒一些了。」
EN: "Gods" were something people always needed, for there exists a universal hunger for prayers to be heard, and a desperate longing for someone else to bear the weight of the world.

After mankind lost the angels, the land was left in the hands of strange-looking beings known as the Archons. One wave of the hand by these beings, and those bereft of hope gathered. One cursory promise, and their followers rejoiced. One mere trace of a miracle, and the humans bowed in gratitude, hearts brimming with awe.
"This really isn't a great time to be born human,"

Nicole thought as she stood apart from the crowd. Her sisters had always possessed a serene, sacred beauty — surely, these odd Archons were no match for them? Though admittedly, a few of them could actually be described as "easy on the eyes"...

Nicole's gaze fell on a sister of hers who was now circling her legs in her Seelie form, and she could not help but let out a silent sigh. Her metamorphosed sister seemed intent on dragging her toward a treasure chest, likely because Nicole's current form was so human.
Nicole watched her reflection in the water as she shifted her expression again and again. But no matter how much she tried to summon the divine, not even a trace flickered across her face.
The angels had faded from this world, though mankind would always need its gods.
A long time later, Nicole, who was attuned to every subtle tremor in the world, had felt a faint shift in its rules.

The mark known as the "Vision," a great journey meant for humans alone, stirred something deep inside her. She understood its workings, and she knew the inevitable ending it would lead to. Yet, she wondered whether her near-human state might allow her a fleeting glimpse. As for that final outcome, it was of little import, for consciousness born of light — even when fallen to the mortal realm — invariably strives to return to its origin.
Nicole tried everything to no avail. Thousands of years of emotions were pent up within her, but had nowhere to go. The heavens simply remained indifferently mute.
In great disappointment, she wandered to Natlan, finding there the only family still capable of sharing wisdom through language.
"You'll only be ignored, since they've erased the angels from the world's design and order."
"I get it now. It means I'll need to use my brain and worm my way into the human world, huh?"
Where connections did not exist, she made them; and where she wasn't part of the plan, she made sure she became part of the blueprint nevertheless, one way or another.

Nicole no longer watched from afar. She took on sculpture commissions, the rewards tucked into treasure chests. She guided the lost in silence, handing them the chests before she sent them off on the right path. She quietly offered clues to scholars adrift in a sea of confusion...

Slowly, almost imperceptibly, the results of her actions gathered, everything fell naturally into place, and Nicole's Vision arrived without fanfare. What tipped the balance was the simple act of helping an old man, a quiet moment where her impact could no longer be ignored by the sky.
Mankind will always need its gods. This is a fact that applies to angels too. To be ignored, to be no longer needed, is a fate that terrifies even the divine.
With her Vision pinched between her thumb and index finger, Nicole held it up to the sky until it eclipsed the outline of Celestia.
"...Finally, you see me as human. You must forgive me and protect me. From this day on, I shall live a little more freely and boldly."

CHS: 曾经有一个时代，地上的人们能直接听到来自天空的启示。
神的使者行走在蒙昧的人当中。此时永冻始解，新火初燃。
人们享受着繁荣，把一切都交付给了天空的启示。
天上的使者说，世界正驶往一个更加光明的时代。
这是既定之事，未来也绝对不可能出现任何偏移。
那这样美好的时代是否有朝一日也会走向终结呢…
天空的使者并没有回答。于是，人们选出了主祭，
让他戴上了白枝的祭冠，让他走向大地至深之处，
从深埋地底的古代祭场、废都中寻求启示与答案…
EN: Once upon a time, the people of the land could hear revelations from the heavens directly.
The envoys of the gods walked among benighted humanity then. The eternal ice had just begun to thaw, and the first fires were still new.
It was a time of great prosperity, when all was left in the hands of such heavenly revelations.
The envoys of heaven said that the world would soon enter a new and brighter age.
This was predestined, that future immutable.
But would a day come when such wonderful times might come to an end?
To this question the envoys gave no answer. So, the people chose from among them a chief priest,
And adorning his head with a crown of white branches, they sent him out into the deep places of the world,
To antediluvian ruins and long-buried altars of sacrifice, to seek answers and enlightenment...
JP: 話しによると、
昔のある時代に、地上の人たちは空からの啓示が聞こえた。
神の使者が未開の人間の間を歩いて、永凍は解け、火が燃え始めた。
人間は繁栄を満喫し、すべてを空の啓示に任せた。
天上の使者は言う、世界は更なる光明へ進化すると。
これは既定の事実、未来にもあらゆる形式の変化は起きない。
この甘美な未来もいずれ終わりを迎う日がくるのだろうか…
天上の使者は答えない。すると、人たちは主祭を選び出した。
主祭に白枝で作った冠を被らせ、大地の底まで行かせた、
そして地下の深くに埋められた祭場で、答えを探した…
KR: 들어보라:
과거 지상의 사람들이 하늘의 계시를 바로 들을 수 있었던 시대가 있었다.
이때는 신의 사자가 우매한 사람들 속에서 살아가고 영원한 얼음이 녹기 시작하고 새로운 불이 타오르던 시기였다.
사람들은 번영을 누리며 모든 걸 하늘의 계시에 바쳤다.
하늘의 사자는 세계가 현재 더 밝은 시대로 향하고 있다고 말했다.
이는 기정사실로 절대 변하지 않을 미래였다.
그럼 이렇게 아름다운 시대도 언젠가 종말을 맞이하진 않을까….
하늘의 사자는 답하지 않았다. 그래서 사람들은 제사장을 선출했고
그에게 흰색 제사 모자를 씌운 뒤 대지의 깊은 곳으로 가게 한 뒤
지하 깊숙한 곳에 있는 고대 제단이자 폐허 속에서 계시와 답을 구하도록 했다….

CHS: 曾经有一个时代，地上的人们能直接听到来自天空的启示。
神的使者行走在蒙昧的人当中。此时旧火将熄，甘霖初降。
人们享受着繁荣，收获丰饶的物产。
此时大地蒙受天空的福祉与管辖，元素流动通畅有序。
百年丰收已经写进神圣的规划，绝不可能有丝毫变动。
但百年，或许千年之后呢？大地会走向贫瘠与饥馑吗？
祭坛、宫殿会被埋入地心，仅有银白之木与之相伴吗…
知无不言的，天上的使者没有回应。为了通晓命运，
头戴白枝祭冠的主祭之人，走向了大地的至深之处…
EN: Once upon a time, the people of the land could hear revelations from the heavens directly.
Then, the envoys of the gods would walk among benighted humanity, and the ancient flames were extinguished amidst the first falling rains.
It was a prosperous time, a period of bountiful harvest.
Then the earth was blessed and ruled by heaven, and the elemental flows were smooth and well-ordered.
A hundred years of bounty were written in the stars, and none could change this divine law.
But what of the time after, a hundred, a thousand years from now? Would they have famine where they had plenty, poverty where once were riches?
Would their altars and palaces become one with the soil, with only that silver-white tree for company?
The heavenly envoys, who ever spoke what they knew, were silent. So to understand this doom,
The chief priest, head crowned with white branches, would delve into the deep places of the world...
JP: 話しによると、
昔のある時代に、地上の人たちは空からの啓示が聞こえた。
神の使者が未開の人間の間を歩いて、古い火は消され、雨が降り始めた。
人間は繁栄を満喫し、作物を収穫した。
この時の大地は空の祝福と管理を受け、元素の流れは秩序立っていた。
百年の豊作はすでに神聖たる計画に書かれており、一切の変化も許しない。
だけど、百年が過ぎて千年が過ぎたら？大地はだんだん枯れて行くのか？
祭場も、宮殿も土に埋められ、白銀の樹しか隣に付き添わないのか…
天上の使者は答えない。すると、運命を知るために、
白枝で作った冠を被る主祭は、大地の底へ旅立った…
KR: 들어보라:
과거 지상의 사람들이 하늘의 계시를 바로 들을 수 있었던 시대가 있었다.
이때는 신의 사자가 우매한 사람들 속에서 살아가고 오래된 불이 꺼지고 단비가 처음 내리던 시기였다.
사람들은 번영을 누리며 풍요로운 산물을 수확했다.
이때의 대지는 하늘의 복지와 관할을 받았고 원소 흐름도 원활했다.
백 년의 풍년은 이미 신성한 계획에 쓰여 절대 바뀌지 않는다.
하지만 백 년, 혹은 천 년 뒤엔? 대지는 척박함과 기근에 시달릴 것인가?
제단과 궁전이 땅에 묻히고 오직 은백 나무만이 남을 것인가….
아는 걸 모두 말하던 하늘의 사자는 답하지 않았다. 운명을 알기 위해
흰색 제사 모자를 쓴 제사장은 대지의 깊은 곳으로 향했다….

CHS: 曾经有一个时代，地上的人们能直接听到来自天空的启示。
神的使者行走在蒙昧的人当中。此时河海枯竭，雷鸣初动。
人们享受着涌流而来的智慧。而智慧带来了繁荣。
在最后繁荣带来了骄傲与梦想，以及提问的智识。
为此疑问天空的权威，为此妄图登上诸神的庭园。
即使许诺了神的爱、繁荣与智慧，天空的使者也为之震怒。
因为，对永恒的怀疑是不允许的，
尘泥之地对天空的试探，绝对不能原谅——
头戴白枝祭冠的主祭之人，为了平息御使的怒火，
走向了大地的至深之处，寻求古都中银树上掩藏着的智慧…
EN: Once upon a time, the people of the land could hear revelations from the heavens directly.
Then, the envoys of the gods would walk among benighted humanity, and the waters ran dry as thunder first pierced the skies.
People enjoyed untold wisdom, and that wisdom was their boon.
Their prosperity brought pride and ambition, and the mind to question.
So they questioned the heavens' authority, and schemed to enter the garden of gods.
And though they had promised to the people divine love, prosperity and wisdom, the envoys of heaven were angry.
For to question eternity was forbidden,
For earth to challenge sky, inexpiable.
So the chief priest who wore the white-branched crown went forth to appease the divine envoys,
And into the deep places he went, seeking the hidden wisdom of the silver tree in the ancient capitol...
JP: 話しによると、
昔のある時代に、地上の人たちは空からの啓示が聞こえた。
神の使者が未開の人間の間を歩いて、河と海は枯れて、雷が降り始めた。
人間は流れ込む知恵を満喫し、知恵は繁栄をもたらした。
最後に、知恵は誇りと夢、そして質問の度胸をもたらした。
空の権威に質問を問う度胸、神々の庭に登る度胸を。
神に愛と繁栄、知恵を承諾されても、天上の使者は激怒した。
永遠への疑いは許されないことであった。
泥まみれの大地が天空を覗くことは、決して許されなかった——
白枝の冠を被る主祭は、使者の怒りを治めるため、
大地の底まで行き、古都の銀木に隠された知恵を探った…
KR: 들어보라:
과거 지상의 사람들이 하늘의 계시를 바로 들을 수 있었던 시대가 있었다.
이때는 신의 사자가 우매한 사람들 속에서 살아가고 강과 바다가 메마르고 천둥번개가 내리치던 시기였다.
사람들은 솟아나는 지혜를 누렸고 지혜는 번영을 가져왔다.
최후의 번영은 자부심과 꿈, 그리고 질문이라는 지식을 가져왔다.
때문에 하늘의 권위에 의문을 품게 됐고 이로 인해 신의 정원에 오르려고 했다.
신의 사랑과 번영, 그리고 지혜를 허락받았다 하더라도 하늘의 사자는 이에 분노했다.
때문에 영원에 대한 의심은 참을 수 없는 것이며,
먼지의 땅이 하늘을 시험하는 건 절대 용서받지 못하는 것이었다——
흰색 제사 모자를 쓴 제사장은 사도의 분노를 가라앉히기 위해
고도의 은나무 안에 숨겨진 지혜를 찾아 대지의 가장 깊은 곳으로 향했다….

CHS: 历代的主祭在生涯的最末都看到了同样的景象：
遍地礼冠堆积在秘境之中，枯木之下。
每一件的背后都是用一生保守的秘密。
每一任主祭退任后都将无瑕的白枝编成的礼冠，奉还给这个世界。
每个曾经宏伟的古都与肃穆的祭祀场，最终都会回归深邃的大地。
一切繁荣当然都有终结。
但是这不代表没有永恒。
在循环的终点，大地会再度迎来春生。因此，「永恒」是环形的。
「求索真相」是繁荣所带来的智识，而不是催生繁荣所需的种子。
曾经有一个时代，大地上的人们还能直接听到来自天空岛的启示。
神的使者行走在蒙昧的人当中。彼时万物的气息渐弱，大地永冻。
EN: The line of chief priests have always seen this same sight as their days draw to an end:
A mountain of crowns in a secret place, beneath a withered tree—
—each one hiding a lifetime of secrets kept.
Each retiring chief priest offers up their crown of flawless white branches to this world.
Every mighty and ancient city, and every austere place of sacrifice must one day return to profundity in the earth.
But this does not mean that nothing is eternal.
At the end of a cycle, the earth shall be renewed. Thus eternity is cyclical.
The search for truth is a product of prosperity, and not the seed that plants it.
Once upon a time, the people of the land could hear revelations from Celestia directly.
The envoys of the gods walked among benighted humanity then. In those days, life was weak, and the earth was blanketed in unending ice.
JP: 話しによると、
歴代の主祭は生涯の末で同じ光景を見た。
秘境の中、無数の礼冠が枯木の下に積もっている。
その一つ一つに一生をかけて守った秘密が隠されている。
毎代の主祭は退任すると、被っていた白き礼冠を世界に戻した。
かつて繁栄を誇った古都と祭場も、すべて深い大地に戻った。
すべての繁栄には終わりがある。
けれどそれが永遠ではないとは限らない。
循環の終点には、大地が再び春を迎える。だから、「永遠」は環の形だ。
「真相を探す」のは繁栄がもたらした知恵であるが、繁栄を生み出す種ではない。
話しによると、
昔のある時代に、地上の人たちは天空の島からの啓示が聞こえた。
神の使者が未開の人間の間を歩いて、万物の気配は弱まり、大地が凍り始めた。
KR: 들어보라:
역대 제사장들은 생의 마지막에 같은 현상을 보았다:
수많은 예관이 비경 안의 시든 나무 아래 쌓여 있다.
예관의 뒤에는 일생동안 지킨 비밀이 있었다.
제사장들이 퇴임할 때마다 흠집 하나 없는 흰색 가지로 만든 예관을 이 세상에 반환했다.
과거 위대했던 고도와 경건했던 제단들은 모두 마지막에 깊은 대지로 돌아갔다.
모든 번영은 당연히 끝이 존재한다.
하지만 이는 영원이 없다는 것을 의미하지 않는다.
순환의 끝에서 대지는 다시 한번 봄날을 맞이할 것이다. 따라서, 「영원」은 순환되는 것이다.
「진리 탐구」는 번영의 산물이지 번영을 꽃피우는데 필요한 씨앗이 아니다.
들어보라:
과거 대지의 사람들이 셀레스티아의 계시를 바로 들을 수도 있었던 시대가 있었다.
이때는 신의 사자가 우매한 사람들 속에서 살아가고 만물의 기운이 점점 옅어지며 대지가 얼어붙던 시기였다.

CHS: 水仙十字结社为这座塔设计的钥匙之一。最终拼合会是一个三圈半的奇怪形状，对此有特别的解释。
最内圈是亥珀波瑞亚之轮，象征世界被冰封的阶段与失去的乐园。
EN: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.
The innermost circle is the Cycle of Hyperborea, symbolizing the age when the world was frozen and the lost paradise.

title: 根源之轮·任务道具说明

CHS: 水仙十字结社为这座塔设计的钥匙之一。最终拼合会是一个三圈半的奇怪形状，对此有特别的解释。
中间一圈是纳塔兰提亚之轮，象征战胜恶龙。这是人类战胜自然与人性战胜自己兽性的隐喻。
EN: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.
The middle circle is the Cycle of Natlantea, symbolizing the triumph over the evil dragon, a metaphor for humanity's victory over nature as well as the beasts within themselves.

title: 根源之轮·任务道具说明

CHS: 水仙十字结社为这座塔设计的钥匙之一。最终拼合会是一个三圈半的奇怪形状，对此有特别的解释。
第三圈与最外半圈是雷穆利亚与克劳雅利亚之轮。象征人和神的关系。
EN: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.
The third circle and outermost half circle are the Cycles of Remuria and Khraun-Arya, symbolizing the relationship between humans and gods.

title: 根源之轮·任务道具说明

CHS: …对各地存在的古代教团遗迹进行了比较研究…虽然被冠以种种不同的名字，但从他们留下的秘文和图式来看，可以断定存在着共同的源头…古代的学者认为所有秘法都起源于雷穆利亚的前文明，现在看来也并非空穴来风…
…「法图纳」…似乎是乐章的名字…雷穆利亚的音乐家将其称作「普世音律」或「本源的音律」，在他们看来，文明的兴衰与凡人的命运皆由乐章规划，文明灭亡之后，总会诞生出新的文明…
…他们的哲学体系复杂且晦涩，与枫丹现代的自然哲学几乎完全没有相通之处…不过这也是意料之中的事，根据历史记载，雷穆利亚覆灭后，那些难民被纯水骑士伊黎耶感化，主动放弃了旧日的信仰、语言和文字，选择拥抱与我们的先祖同样虔敬神明的生活方式…
…旁敲侧击地向黄金猎人提起了此事（既然最初追随他的那些逐影猎人都是纯水骑士的后嗣，向他赞美伊黎耶的仁慈应当是最稳妥的选择），并询问他对那个时代自然哲学的了解…他沉默了大约半分钟，随后告诉我不要去深究那些古老的哲学，说它们被遗忘是有道理的…
…不过，作为答谢，黄金猎人依然愿意将这些图案的名字告诉我…
…「密合之约印」…根据他的说法，这个符号甚至比雷穆利亚文明本身还要古老，是金蜂（这是什么东西？）赐予雷穆斯王的礼物之一…
…帝国与文明的兴衰，凡人的升变与光的流溢（这是什么东西？），超越神明之梦（这是什么东西？），都能由这个术式表征…完全无法理解，他不愿意透露更多，我也只能将这些内容如实抄写于此，也许后世的人们能够解读出…
EN: ...Comparative studies have been conducted on the surviving ruins of ancient orders from across the land... While they all had different names, the scripts and images left behind support the conclusion that they share the same origin... Ancient scholars believed that all arcane arts originated from a pre-Remurian civilization, a belief that now seems to be much more than mere speculation...

..."Fortuna"... seems to be the name of a symphony... Remurian musicians call it the "Musica Mundana" or "the music of origin." In their eyes, the rise and fall of civilizations, as well as the fates of mortals, are all orchestrated by the movements of a symphony. And when a civilization perishes, a new one is always born in its wake...

...Their philosophical system is complex and enigmatic, bearing almost no relation to modern Fontaine's natural philosophy... However, this is hardly surprising. According to historical records, after Remuria was brought to ruins, the refugees fell under the Lochknight Erinnyes's sway. They willingly forsook their ancient faiths, tongues, and writings, embracing a life of devotion to the gods as our forebears once had...

...I hinted at the matter to the Golden Hunter in an oblique way (since the Marechaussee Hunters who first pledged themselves to his cause were all descendants of the Lochknights, praising the benevolence of Erinnyes seemed like the safest approach), and inquired about his knowledge of natural philosophy from that era... He was silent for about half a minute, then told me not to probe too deeply into those ancient philosophies, saying there was a reason they had been forgotten...
...Still, as a gesture of gratitude, the Golden Hunter was willing to tell me the names of these patterns...

...The "Seal of Chymical Marriage"... According to him, this symbol is even older than the Remurian civilization itself, and was one of the gifts bestowed upon King Remus by the Golden Bee (what exactly those were remains unclear)...

...The rise and fall of empires and civilizations, the ascension of mortals and the emanation of light (what is this?), even dreams of surpassing the gods (what is this?) — all of these can be represented by this formula... I cannot understand it at all. He declined to elaborate, and so I can only record these matters here, as they were told to me, in the hope that those who come after might one day decipher their meaning...
JP: …「金色の劇団」について…
…各地に存在する古代の教団の遺跡に対して比較研究を行った。…様々な名前を冠しているが、残された書物と絵から判断すると、共通の根源があると判断できる。…古代の学者は、全ての秘術がレムリアの前文明に起源を有すると考えていたが、今思うにそれも全く根拠がないわけではないようだ…
…「フォルトゥナ」…どうやら楽章の名前のようだ…レムリアの音楽家たちは、これを「普遍の音律」あるいは「本源の音律」と呼んでいた。彼らの考えでは、文明の盛衰も凡人の運命も、すべては楽章によって定められており、文明が滅びた後には、必ず新たな文明が生まれるという…
…彼らの哲学体系は複雑で難解であり、フォンテーヌの現代自然哲学とはほとんど共通点がない…しかし、これも僕の予想と合致している。歴史的記録によると、レムリアが滅亡した後、難民たちは純水騎士エリニュスに感化され、自ら昔からの信仰や言語、文字を捨て、我々の先祖と同じように神を敬う生活様式を選んだ…
…黄金の狩人に、この件について遠回しに切り出し（最初に彼に追随することにしたファントムハンターたちは純水騎士の末裔だったのだから、彼にエリニュスの慈悲を讃える言葉をかけるのは最も賢明な選択だろう）、あの時代の自然哲学についての見解を尋ねた…彼は約三十秒ほど沈黙した後、古い哲学については深く追求するな、忘れ去られたのには理由があるのだと語った…
…それでも、黄金の狩人は感謝の印として、これらの模様の名前を教えてくれた…
…「密合の契印」…彼の話によると、この印はレムリア文明そのものよりも古く、金の蜂（具体的に何かは不明）がレムス王に授けた贈り物の一つらしい…
…帝国と文明の盛衰、凡人の変容と溢れ出す光（具体的に何かは不明）、神を超越する夢（具体的に何かは不明）など、すべてはこの術式によって表されることができるという…まったく理解ができない。彼はこれ以上何かを明かそうとはせず、僕はただこれらの内容をありのままに書き出すことしかできなかった。後世の人々なら解読できるのかもしれない…
KR: …「금빛 극단」에 관해…
…각지에 존재하는 고대 교단 유적을 비교 연구했다…. 다양한 이름으로 불렸지만, 그들이 남긴 비밀 문자와 도식으로 미루어 보아 공통의 근원이 존재했다고 단정 지을 수 있다…. 고대 학자들은 모든 비법이 레무리아의 이전 문명에서 기원했다고 믿었는데, 지금으로선 그냥 한 말이 아닌 것 같다….
…「포르투나」… 악장의 이름인 것 같다… 레무리아 음악가들은 이를 「세상의 음률」 혹은 「근원의 음률」이라 불렀으며, 문명의 흥망성쇠와 인간의 운명은 모두 이 악장에 따라 계획된 것이라 여겼다. 또한 문명이 멸망한 뒤에는 언제나 새로운 문명이 태어난다고 한다…
…그들의 철학 체계는 복잡하고 난해하며, 현대 폰타인의 자연철학과 거의 공통점이 없다… 하지만 이는 당연한 결과다. 역사 기록에 따르면 레무리아 멸망 후 유민들은 물의 기사 에리니에스의 감화로 옛 신앙, 언어, 문자를 포기하고, 우리 선조처럼 신을 경건히 모시는 삶을 택했기 때문이다…
…황금 사냥꾼에게 조심스럽게 이 이야기를 꺼냈다(그를 따르는 최초의 그림자 사냥꾼들은 다 물의 기사의 후예이니, 에리니에스를 칭송하면서 접근하는 편이 가장 무난해 보였다). 그 시대 자연 철학에 대한 의견을 묻자… 그는 30초쯤 침묵한 뒤, 그 낡은 철학들은 건드리지 말라고만 답했다. 잊힌 데에는 분명한 이유가 있다고 하면서…
…대신, 그 황금 사냥꾼은 이 문양의 이름을 내게 알려주었다…
…「밀합의 인」… 그의 말에 따르면, 이 부호는 레무리아 문명보다도 훨씬 오래되었으며, 황금 벌(이게 뭐지?)이 레무스 왕에게 내린 선물 중 하나라고 한다…
…이 술식은 제국과 문명의 흥망, 인간의 승급과 빛의 발출(이게 뭐지?), 신을 초월한 꿈(이건 또 뭐지?)을 표현할 수 있다고 한다… 그러나 나는 전혀 이해할 수 없었다. 그는 더 설명하지 않았고, 나는 후세 사람들이 해독할 수 있도록 이 내용을 그대로 옮겨 적을 수밖에 없었다…

title: 大师鲁杰罗的研究笔记

CHS: 本报告集汇总了在对神殿遗迹所进行的考古与研究过程中形成的各项报告，其中包括…由于本报告集涉及到大量与…计划相关的内容，因此仅供结社内部人员阅览…在对外演讲与正式出版物中禁止引用或披露本报告集中的任何内容…
关于铜板与石刻碑铭文献记录的解读方法…从一开始就遇到了很大的困难…以前在其他旧黄金剧团遗迹发现的文献，以及收集整理而来的传世抄本大多成书于枫丹建城早期或是更晚的时代，因此大部分是用枫丹文字写成的…而这次在遗迹中发掘到的大量原始的铜板与石碑，都使用了古代的雷穆利亚字母…
关于雷穆利亚字母…似乎是一种表音文字，目前识别出的字母也只有个位数，实在是匪夷所思…长期以来我们一直将它们当成简单的音符，在此基础上尝试了多次，并无进展，研究也因此一度陷入僵局…
…直到在艾利希先生的提醒下，在自然哲学学院保存的古代抄本中找到了…对于这些文本的破译才终于有所进展…虽然只是百里之行的第一步，但我们也已经超越以往全部的神秘学者了…
关于德性…虽然在如今意味着道德一类的空谈，但在古人那里似乎有更加实际的意味…意志对身体的完全控制是人类德性的完满状态，除了神明之外只有极少数人能接近这一状态…随着德性的败坏，意志也逐渐被身体所束缚…最终意志沦亡，人类也完全沦为身体的奴隶…在古人那里，这也意味着脱离了文明的共同体，不再能够感受到乐章与神明，而是成为野兽的同类…

关于精神和意志…正如须弥人对于不同植物的不同生长阶段都有专门的词汇加以描述，枫丹人有二十多种形容水的词，古人对于精神的研究和区分则更加登峰造极，到达了吾辈难以企及的高度…虽然大体上被分为记忆、愿望、灵魂和人格，但对于精神的品质仍有着非常复杂的区分…而在那其中，达到可以说接近神明的自在完美状态的，便是所谓的「真实意志」了…在这样精密研究的基础上，将人的意志抽离…或许正是利用这种力量，古人才实现了对于肉体的超越，但却也没能逃脱命运的审判…
关于「法图纳」…神话、箴言和诗歌，目前整理出的与「法图纳」相关的材料无非都是这些内容，与最初的设想大相径庭…充其量只能说是模糊的推论和先验的断言，完全谈不上量化与科学，与世界式相比实在过于粗糙和原始了，而且…
…果然只是亡羊补牢的产物，就连在材料的选择上古人也搞错了啊，不过也是没办法的事情…除去意志分析学和「密合之约印」外，根本没有利用的价值…古人竟然被这样的谎言蒙骗了千年，该说是信仰心，还是愚昧呢…
EN: This report collates various other reports written during the archaeological studies conducted on the temple ruins, including... As the report includes large amounts of... related to said plan, it is only available for internal consumption... It is prohibited to disclose any of the following content in speeches or official publications to external parties...

As to how to decipher the stone tablets and bronze slates... We hit a massive roadblock right from the start... Most of the texts previously discovered in older Golden Troupe ruins and legacy copies we got from collections were all from Fontaine's early nation-building stage or later. As such, most of these texts were written in Fontainian script... This time, we unearthed a great number of antediluvian bronze slates and stone tablets, which all use ancient Remurian script...

Regarding Remurian characters... They seem to be some form of phonography, of which we currently only recognize a single digit amount... For the longest time, we treated them like simple musical notes, and undertook many trials on that basis without any progress. As such, we hit an impasse in our research...

...Until, after being reminded by Mr. Erich, we found... in an ancient copy preserved in the Institute of Natural Philosophy... made progress in deciphering the documents... It's the first step in a long journey, but we have already surpassed all previous scholars of the esoteric...

Regarding morality... While this might conjure up empty talk of ethics today, it had more practical significance to the ancients... Complete mastery over the body by one's will was considered the consummation of human virtue, a pinnacle that only gods and the rarest of mortals could come close to attaining... Following moral decay, the will became shackled to bodily form... Willpower withered, and humanity became entirely enslaved to their flesh... The ancients would see this as a separation from civilization's communal body, an eternal sundering from music and the divine, becoming next-of-kin to the beasts...

Regarding the concepts of spirit and will... Just as the people of Sumeru had specialized terminology to illustrate different stages of plant growth, Fontainians had more than twenty words describing water's various aspects. However, the ancients' study and differentiation of the spirit reached heights that we ourselves found challenging to attain... While, for the most part, it was divided into memory, wishes, soul, and persona, a spirit's qualities still carried complex distinctions... Among these, the state that came closest to the perfect freedom that divinities possessed was named "True Will"... The detachment of human will with such meticulous research as a jumping-off point... Perhaps it was through this power that the ancients achieved transcendence from the physical realm. Despite this remarkable achievement, they were unable to escape their fate, which appeared preordained...

Regarding "Fortuna"... Myth, proverbs, and poetry are all that we have compiled so far in connection to "Fortuna." These findings deviate significantly from initial expectations... At best, they could be described as vague inferences and a priori assertions, bereft of quantifiability or scientific rigor. They appear exceedingly rudimentary and primitive when compared to the world-formula. Furthermore...

...As expected, this seems to be an attempt to make up for some shortfall. The ancients even made no small amount of errors in their selection of materials. This was unavoidable... Aside from analysis of the will and the "Seal of Chymical Marriage," there was hardly any utility to be found... When faced with the fact that the ancients were deceived by such falsehoods for a thousand years, one can only wonder if it was a matter of faith or folly...
JP: 本報告集は神殿遺跡に対する考古調査と研究の過程で形成された各報告をまとめたもので、その中には…が含まれる。本報告集は…計画に関連する多数の内容に触れているため、結社内部の人員のみに閲覧を許可し…本報告集のいかなる内容も社外講演と公式出版物の中で引用または開示することを禁ずる…
銅板と石碑の文献記録の解読方法について…開始早々大きな困難に直面した…これまで旧黄金の劇団の遺跡で発見された他の文献や、収集·整理され後世に伝えられた写本のほとんどは、フォンテーヌの建国初期かそれより後の時代で本になったため、大部分はフォンテーヌ文字で書かれていたが…今回遺跡で発掘された大量の原初の銅板と石碑には、いずれも古代のレムリア文字が使われていたのだ…
レムリア文字について…一種の表音文字のようで、今のところ識別できている文字は一桁しかない。実に不思議なことだ…長い間我々はそれを簡単な音符だと考えており、その上で幾度となく試みたが、進展はなく、研究は一度行き詰まった…
…サー·エーリッヒの指摘を受けた後、自然哲学学院に保存されている古代の写本の中に見つけた…これら碑文の解読にようやく進展があった…百里の道の第一歩にすぎないが、これで我々は既に従来の神秘学者全員を超えたことになる…

徳性について…今ではそれを道徳的な考えを示す空論を意味するが、古代人の世界ではもっと実際的な意味があったようだ…意志が肉体を完全に制御できるのは、人間の徳性が完璧な状態であり、神を除けばごく少数の人間しかこの状態に近づけなかった…徳性の劣化に伴い、次第に意志が肉体に縛られていき…最終的には意志が滅び、人間も完全に身体の奴隷に成り下がった…古代人の世界では、これは文明の共同体から離脱し、楽章や神を感じられなくなり、獣と同類になったことを意味している…

精神と意志について…スメール人が植物ごとのそれぞれの成長段階について専門的な用語を使って説明するように、フォンテーヌ人には水を形容する言葉が二十種類以上ある。古代人の精神に対する研究と区別はさらに高度で、我々の手に届かないほどの高みに達している…大体は記憶、願い、魂と人格に分けられているが、精神の質については非常に複雑な区分がある…その中で、神に近いといえる、自由で完璧な状態に達したものが所謂、「真実の意志」だ…こうした精密な研究のもと、人の意志を引き離す…まさにその力を利用して、古代人は肉体の超越を実現したのかもしれない。だがそれでも運命の審判から逃れることはできなかった…
「フォルトゥナ」について…神話、箴言、詩…現在整理されている「フォルトゥナ」に関連する資料はどれもこの内容が書かれている。最初の想定とはあまりにもかけ離れているが…せいぜい漠然とした推論と先験的な断言としか言いようがなく、定量的とも科学ともまるで言えない。世界式と比べて実に粗雑で原始的で、しかも…
…やはり取り繕っただけの産物に過ぎなかった。材料の選択においても古代人は間違っていたのだ。だがそれも仕方のないことだ…意志分析学と「密合の約印」を除いては、まるで利用価値がない…古代人は千年もこんな嘘に騙されてきたのだ。信心深いと言おうか、愚かと言おうか…
KR: 본 보고는 신전 유적에 대한 고고학 및 연구 과정 진행 중 형성된 여러 보고서를 취합한 것으로, 그 안에는 다음을 포함… 본 보고는 대량의… 계획과 관련된 내용이 있으므로 결사회 내부 인원에게만 열람을 허용한다. …대외 연설 및 정식 출판물에는 본 보고서의 어떤 내용의 인용이나 노출을 모두 금지하는 바…

구리판 및 석판에 새겨진 묘지명 문헌 기록의 해독 방법은… 처음부터 커다란 난관에 봉착했… 이전에 다른 황금 극단 유적에서 발견한 문헌 및 수집 정리되어 내려온 복사본은 폰타인 건국 초기나 그 이후의 시대에 책으로 만들어졌으며, 따라서 대부분 폰타인 문자로 작성됐… 그리고 이번 유적에서 발굴된 대량의 원시 구리판과 비석은 모두 고대의 레무리아 글자를 사용한…
레무리아 글자에 관해… 표음 문자인 것 같다. 현재 식별해낸 문자는 몇 개일 뿐인데, 그 오묘함이 실로 대단… 긴 시간 우리는 이를 간단한 음표로 여기고, 그 정보를 기반으로 여러 번 시도해도 아무런 진전이 없었을 뿐만 아니라 연구도 정체 상태에 놓이게 됐…
…에리히 님의 의견 덕에 자연철학 학원에 보관 중이던 고대 복사본에서 다음 내용을 찾을 수… 이 텍스트의 해독에 마침내 진전이 있… 그저 한걸음을 내디딘 것이지만, 우리는 이미 과거의 모든 신비학자들을 초월했…

도덕성에 대해… 지금은 도덕에 대한 것이 공담에 불과하지만 고대인에게는 좀 더 실질적인 의미가 있었던 것… 신체에 대한 의지의 완전한 제어는 인류 도덕성의 완전한 상태로, 신을 제외하면 극소수의 사람만이 이 상태에 접근할 수 있었… 도덕성이 파괴됨에 따라 의지도 점점 신체에 속박되었고… 결국 의지는 상실되고 인류 역시 완전히 신체의 노예가 되었… 고대인에게는 이 또한 문명 공동체로부터의 이탈을 의미했고, 더는 악장과 신을 느낄 수 없다는 것, 즉 짐승과 다름없음을 의미했…

정신과 의지에 대해… 수메르 사람이 식물의 다양한 성장 단계마다 전문 용어와 묘사를 사용하듯, 폰타인 사람도 물에 대한 스무 가지가 넘는 형용사를 사용한다. 고대인은 정신에 대한 연구와 구분에 이보다 더욱 나아가 최고봉에 달해 우리들은 시도할 엄두조차 낼 수 없… 크게 기억, 소원, 영혼 그리고 인격으로 나눌 수 있지만, 정신의 품질에는 여전히 아주 복잡한 구분법이 있… 그중 신에 근접했다고 할 수 있는 자유롭고 완벽한 상태가 바로 「진실한 의지」다…. 이런 정밀한 연구를 기반으로 사람의 의지를 뽑아내… 어쩌면 이런 힘을 이용했기에 고대인은 육체의 초월을 실현한 것일 수도 있으나, 결국 운명의 심판을 벗어나지는 못했다….
「포르투나」에 대해… 신화, 잠언 그리고 시까지. 현재 「포르투나」와 관련해 정리된 자료란 것은 모두 이런 것들이고 최초의 구상과는 현저한 차이가 있다…. 그 양을 채우는 건 그저 모호한 추론과 선험적 단언에 불과해 계량화나 과학과는 거리가 너무 멀다. 세계식과 비교했을 때 너무도 모호하고 원시적이다. 게다가…
…역시 그저 소 잃고 외양간 고치는 격의 산물이었다. 겨우 재료의 선택에서조차 고대인은 잘못을 범했다. 하지만 어쩔 수 없는 일이다…. 의지분석학과 「밀합의 인」을 제외하면 아무런 이용 가치가 없다…. 고대인이 고작 이런 거짓말에 속아 천년을 허비했다니, 이걸 신앙심이라고 해야 할까 우매함이라고 해야 할까…

CHS: …穿越「帷幕」后的第八次探索，整理了至今为止全部调查的记录。遗憾的是，依旧没有得到我想要的答案…
…撇开那些过分乐观的谵妄之言，亥珀波瑞亚的真实历史似乎与流传于南方角人部族中的传说并没有太大的差异。僭越者的城邦被判罚的天钉所消灭，这样的故事在大陆上屡见不鲜。哪怕加上所谓「天使」一族的助力，结局亦未曾改变…
…在我所寻找到的记录中，反复提到一位被称作「圣徒」的人物。他留在记录里的真名似乎叫做「阿那卡尔西」，是那场招致毁灭的叛乱的发起人…
…那大概是一位先知式的人物吧，人类历史上总是不乏这种人，仅仅凭借一腔莫名其妙的热情与信念，便将无数人推向万劫不复的深渊…
…耽湎于愚狂的妄想似乎是人类的天性，身为妖精一族的我从始至终都无法理解。况且一想到那本应延续至今的母国，竟因为此人的叛逆之举而变成如今这般模样，我就更感厌恶了…
…不过■■说，随意评价历史上的人物是个不好的习惯，因此剩下的话还是等到搞清楚事情的原委之后再说吧。毕竟倘若历史仅止于此，又如何解释我的存在？为何我会在母国灭亡千年之后，才诞生于巨龙骨骸中的繁育场？现在我们所身处的最初的「影域」又为何没有被审判者抹去？我在这里所目见的种种远超这个时代认知的造物，当真是仅凭人类和「天使」之手便能成就的吗？
…关于以上问题与■■探讨了许多，尽管他并不情愿。不过看在我为这座城堡的翻新做了许多事情的份上，好歹没有将我赶走…
…叛乱者的目的、审判者的意图，依旧如这片被迷雾所覆盖的废墟般，沉默地拒绝着任何造访者的窥探…
…该回去了，看来还是在冻原上驰骋的生活更适合我…
EN: ...This is my eighth foray since I passed beyond that "curtain," and I have taken time to set down all observations from my investigations till now. Regrettably, as ever, I failed to obtain the answer I have been seeking...

...Once the patently fantastical accounts are set aside, the true history of Hyperborea appears to accord closely with the legends of the horned peoples of the south: that is, the city of usurpers was destroyed by the Celestial Nail sent down from above. Tales of this nature abound throughout Teyvat. I gravely doubt that the outcomes of these stories would have differed, even had the so-called angels lent their aid...

...In the records I have unearthed in the course of my search, an individual known as "The Saint" appears time and again. His true name, it would seem, was Anacharsis, and it was he who instigated the rebellion that courted eventual destruction...

...He was, in all likelihood, a prophet of some kind. The annals of mankind have never lacked figures of his ilk who, impelled by nothing but a fit of passion and unsubstantiated conviction, ultimately send countless others beyond the precipice of no return...

...To be so utterly consumed by folly and delusion appears innate to mankind — a failing that I, as one of the fae, have never understood. When I recall the motherland that should have endured to this day, and was instead reduced to its present state by this man's folly, my revulsion only intensifies...

...Yet ■■■■ admonishes me that it is ill-befitting to judge historical figures capriciously, and so I shall reserve further judgment until the facts of the matter are fully established. Furthermore, were that the sum of history, how would one explain my very existence? How came I to be born in a breeding ground, amidst the remains of a giant dragon, millennia after the motherland's annihilation? Why, too, did the "Great Judge" fail to purge the Shadow Realm — in which I now stand — the very moment it first emerged? All that I have witnessed here far surpasses any creation known to our age. Could such wonders truly have been wrought by the hands of man and angel?

...I have discussed these questions at great length with ■■■■, his reluctance notwithstanding. At the very least, he has elected not to drive me away, doubtless on account of all my efforts in restoring this castle...
...Meanwhile, the motives of the usurpers and the purpose of the Great Judge remain stubbornly resistant to all prying, much like these fog-shrouded ruins...
...I should go back now. It would seem that I am far better suited to a life spent riding in the wind, across the frozen wastes...
JP: …「幕」を越えてから8度目の探索で、これまでに調査した記録をすべて整理した。残念ながら、まだ私が探し求めている答えには至っていない…
…過度に楽観的な戯言はさておき、ヒュペルボレイアの真の歴史は南方の角人部族に伝わる伝説とさほど大きな違いはないようだ。僭越者の都市国家が裁きの天の釘によって消滅させられたという言い伝えは、大陸において決して珍しいものではない。たとえいわゆる「天の使い」の助力があったとしても、結末が変わることはない…
…私が見つけ出した記録の中では、「聖徒」と呼ばれる人物について繰り返し言及されている。記録に残された彼の本当の名は「アナカルシス」というらしく、それは破滅を招いたあの反乱の首謀者である…
…おそらく彼は予言者のような人物だったのだろう。人類の歴史にはいつの時代もこの手の人間が存在し、不可解な情熱と信念だけで、無数の人々を取り返しのつかない深淵へと突き落としていくのだ…
…愚かで狂気じみた妄想に溺れるのは人類の常だが、フェイの一族である私にはまったく理解できない行為だ。ましてや、今日まで存続しているはずだった母国がこの人物の反逆行為によってこのような有り様に変わり果ててしまったと思うと、いっそう嫌悪感を覚える…

…だが、歴史上の人物を自分勝手に評価するのは悪い癖だと■■は言う。だから、残りの話は事の顛末をはっきりさせてからにするとしよう。結局のところ、もし歴史がそこで途絶えているのだとしたら、私の存在はどう説明すればいいのか？なぜ私は母国の滅亡から千年もの時が経った後、巨竜の骸の中にある繁殖場で誕生したのか？今私たちが身を置いている最初の「闇域」は、なぜ審判者によって抹消されなかったのか？私がここで目にした、この時代の認識を遥かに超える創造物は、本当に人類と「天の使い」の手だけで成し遂げられたものなのだろうか？
…以上の問題について本人は気が進まない様子だったが、■■とたくさんの議論を交わした。それでも、この城の改修のために色々と手を尽くしたこともあり、私を追い出すことはなかった…
…反乱者の目的、審判者の意図は、まるでこの謎に満ちた廃墟のようにすべての訪問者の詮索を拒みながら、沈黙を守り続けている…
…そろそろ帰ろう。やはり凍土を駆け回る生活のほうが性に合っているみたいだ…
KR: …「장막」을 통과한 뒤 진행한 여덟 번째 탐사. 지금까지의 조사 기록을 모두 정리했다. 안타깝게도, 여전히 내가 원하는 답은 얻지 못했다…
…지나치게 낙관적인 헛소리는 제쳐두고, 휘페르보레아의 실제 역사는 남쪽 뿔 달린 인간 부족에 전해 내려오는 전설과 크게 다르지 않은 듯하다. 반역자의 도시국가가 징벌의 하늘의 못에 의해 소멸되었다는 이야기는 대륙에서 흔히 찾아볼 수 있다. 이른바 「천사」 일족의 도움을 받았다 한들, 결말은 달라지지 않았다…
…내가 찾아낸 기록에는 「성인」이라 불리는 인물이 반복해서 언급된다. 그의 진짜 이름은 「아나카르시스」인 듯하며, 파멸을 초래한 그 반란의 주동자였다고 한다…
…아마 예언자 같은 인물이었을 거다. 인간의 역사에는 언제나 이런 자들이 끊이지 않았다. 영문 모를 열정과 신념만으로 수많은 사람을 돌이킬 수 없는 심연으로 밀어 넣는 자들 말이다…
…어리석고 광기 어린 망상에 빠져드는 건 인간의 천성인 듯하지만, 요정 일족인 나로서는 도무지 이해할 수 없는 일이다. 게다가 지금까지도 존속했어야 할 나의 모국이 그자의 반역으로 인해 이 지경이 되었다고 생각하니, 더욱 혐오감이 든다…

…하지만 ■■의 말에 따르면 역사 인물을 함부로 평가하는 것은 좋지 않은 습관이라 했으니, 자초지종을 파악한 뒤에 판단을 마저 내려야겠다. 어쨌든 역사가 정말 거기서 끝났다면, 내 존재는 어떻게 설명할 수 있을까? 어째서 나는 모국이 멸망하고 천 년이나 지난 뒤에야 거대한 용골 속 배양장에서 태어난 것일까? 지금 우리가 있는 최초의 「그림자 영역」은 또 어째서 심판자에게 지워지지 않은 걸까? 내가 이곳에서 목격한, 이 시대의 상식을 아득히 초월한 수많은 창조물은 과연 인간과 「천사」의 손만으로 만들어진 게 맞단 말인가?
…위의 의문들에 관해 ■■에게 여러 가지 이야기를 건넸다. 비록 그는 그다지 탐탁지 않아 했지만 말이다. 그래도 내가 이 성을 보수하기 위해 여러모로 애쓴 걸 봐서인지, 적어도 나를 내쫓지는 않았다…
…반란자의 목적과 심판자의 의도는 여전히 안개에 뒤덮인 이 폐허처럼 베일에 가려져, 그 누구에게도 진실을 드러내지 않고 있다…
…이만 돌아가야겠다. 역시 나는 동토에서 사는 쪽이 더 어울리는 것 같다…

title: 某位高贵之人的笔记·其二

CHS: …第八十六次探索，近年来获得的诸多关键进展，实有必要逐一记录于此…
…花费了许多功夫，如今我才总算搞清楚「通道」开启时究竟发生了什么。
「影中世界」就像是覆盖于凡世之上的一层油膜，隔绝了提瓦特与天外的深渊。这层油膜不仅存在于纯粹的空间与物质的位面，更横亘在时间与精神的边界。那时因我的愚行而打开的通道，犹如一道划破时空的裂口贯穿了整个影域，致使深渊得以通过这一缺口，源源不断地向这个世界倾泻其污秽…
…但因影域本身的特殊性质，这种侵入，在绝大多数情况下，始终以渗透的形式进行。即便无法逆转其过程，但至少其威胁尚且处于可控范围之内…
…之所以如此，难道是因为影域本身便充斥着未被观测的「可能性」？以这一假说为前提推论，深渊或许在本质上与之存在着某种根本性的互斥，所以才无法对「影域」造成污染…
…但作为代价，这里也因此不存在任何稳定的实体——它无法获得确定的形式，也无法真正被物质化…无论真相为何，制造出影域的技术是连这个世界的主宰者都未能掌握的。它并非属于这个世界的产物，这一点毋庸置疑…
…然而至今为止的发现，却使影域为何存在的问题变得更加难解…难道影域对这个世界所施加的保护，仅仅只是圣徒在拒绝高天为其预设的命运后，为了在永恒的虚无中留存些许旧日回忆而诞生出的副产品？
…深渊不断渗入这个世界的原因依旧尚未探明，但我确信，这一定与圣徒创造影域的最初本意有关…
…以上种种，皆是基于我在断壁残垣间收集到的信息所作的推演，其中尚有诸多疑点。但唯有一点是已然可以确证的——
我等妖精的族裔，并非如传说中所言是作为黄金国人类的仆从而诞生的。那些将我们称作奴仆的词句，不过是恐惧于我们存在之人编造的谎言。相反，在这座被风沙掩埋的遗迹最深处，我见到了我们曾被寄予的、更为高贵与远大的期望…
…在最古老的记录中，留下了我们最初的名字「妖灵」――其意为「进化后的人之子」…
EN: ...Foray number eighty-six: it is necessary that the many significant findings made over the last few years be recorded herewith...
...Through great effort, I have finally determined what transpired when the "passage" opened.

...The world of shadow may be likened to a film of oil resting upon the known world, and it is this film which separates Teyvat from the Abyss in the beyond. This film exists not merely on the spatial and material plane, but at the very intersections of the temporal and the spiritual. When I foolishly opened that passage, it was as though I had inflicted a great gash in time across the entire Shadow Realm, through which the Abyss now pours its filth into this world without end...

...But owing to the unique nature of the Shadow Realm, this corruption of our world has primarily manifested as a slow seepage. Though the process is irreversible, the threat remains manageable for the present...

...Might this stem from the fact that the Shadow Realm teems with possibilities yet unobserved? Should we follow this hypothesis, the relationship between the Shadow Realm and the Abyss may be one that is fundamentally antithetical and mutually repellent, explaining why the realm has remained untainted to this day...

...But wonderful though this possibility may seem, it is not without its price. Here, substance does not exist in a stable form — or rather, there is no true form, nor is any concretion possible. Yet whatever the truth may be, the science that brought the Shadow Realm into being lies beyond the grasp of even the sovereigns of this world. Undoubtedly, it is not a product of our world...

...The discoveries made thus far, however, complicate any explanation of why the Shadow Realm might have come to be... Could the protective or shielding effect the realm exerts upon our world be merely an outgrowth, an unintended consequence of the memories The Saint left behind in the eternal void in defiance of the fate the heavens had ordained for him?
...Why the Abyss continues to seep into this world remains obscure, though it is my firm belief that it bears some relation to the very purpose for which The Saint created the Shadow Realm...
...The above deductions were drawn from information I have gathered within the ruins. While many questions remain unresolved, the one thing we already know for certain is...

...We, the fae, were not born to be the servants of the humans of the golden realm as legend states. Those who have misrepresented us as slaves did so out of sheer fear of our existence amongst men. In fact, deep within these ruins that have since been covered by the sands, I have glimpsed that far more noble and grand ambition with which we were once entrusted...
...And in the oldest of these records, I have also since glimpsed the earliest name of the fae: Filii Adamici Evoluti, or "the evolved children of humanity."
JP: …86回目の探索。近年得られた数多くの重要な進展は、ここに逐一記録しておかなければ…
…多くの労力を費やした結果、「トンネル」が開いた時に何が起こったのかをようやく解明することができた。
「影の世界」は俗世の上に覆い被さる油膜のようなもので、テイワットと天外の深淵を隔てている。この油膜は純粋な空間と物質の次元に存在するだけでなく、時間と精神の境界にも横たわっている。あの時、私の愚かな行為により開かれたトンネルは、まるで時空を切り裂く一筋の裂け目のように闇域全体を貫いた。その結果、深淵の穢れはその隙間を通じて絶えずこの世界へと流れ込むようになってしまった…
…だが闇域の特殊な性質により、こうした侵入はほとんどの場合、浸透という形で進行している。その過程を逆転させることは不可能だとしても、少なくともその脅威は現在でも制御可能な範囲内に収まっている…
…そうなっているのは、闇域自体に未だ観測されていない「可能性」が満ちているからだろうか？この仮説を前提として推論すると、深淵は本質的にそれと何らかの根本的な相反関係にあるからこそ、「闇域」を汚染できないのかもしれない…
…だがその代償として、ここには安定した実体が何ひとつ存在しない。確かな形を得ることも、真に物質化されることもない…真相はどうあれ、闇域を創り出した技術はこの世界の支配者でさえまだ掌握できていない。それがこの世界の産物でないことは、少しの疑いもないのである…
…とはいえ、これまでの発見はかえって闇域の存在理由に対する問いをより難解なものにしてしまった…まさか、闇域がこの世界にもたらしている保護は、聖徒が高天に定められた運命を拒絶した後、永遠の虚無の中にわずかな往日の記憶を留めるために生み出された副産物にすぎないというのだろうか？
…アビスが絶えずこの世界へ浸透してくる原因は未だ解明されていないが、聖徒が闇域を創り出した本来の意図に関係があるものと私は確信している…
…以上の事柄はすべて、私が崩れ落ちて荒廃した建物から収集した情報に基づいて行ったシミュレーションによるものであり、なおも多くの疑問が残っている。ただ、一つだけはっきりとしたことがある。
私たちフェイの一族は、伝説に語られるような黄金の国の人類の従者として誕生したわけではない。我々を奴隷と呼ぶ言葉は、我々の存在を恐れた者たちがでっち上げた嘘にすぎない。それどころか、風砂に埋もれたこの遺跡の最深部で、かつて私たちに寄せられていた、より高貴で壮大な期待を目にしたのだ…
…最古の記録の中に、私たちの最初の名「フェイ」が残されていた——その意味は「進化を遂げた人の子」…
KR: …제86차 탐색. 최근 몇 년 동안 이루어 낸 중요한 진전들을 이곳에 하나씩 기록해 두어야겠다…
…오랜 노력 끝에, 이제야 「통로」가 열리는 순간 대체 무슨 일이 벌어졌는지 알아냈다.

「그림자 세계」는 마치 현세 위에 드리운 기름막처럼 티바트와 하늘 밖 심연을 격리하고 있다. 이 기름막은 단순히 공간과 물질의 차원에만 존재하는 게 아니라, 시간과 정신의 가장자리에도 가로놓여 있다. 당시 내 어리석은 행동으로 열린 통로는 시공간을 찢는 균열처럼 그림자 영역 전체를 관통했고, 그 틈을 통해 심연의 오염이 끊임없이 이 세계로 쏟아져 들어오게 되었다…
…하지만 그림자 영역의 특수한 성질로 인해, 이러한 침입은 대부분 서서히 스며드는 방식으로 진행된다. 비록 그 과정을 되돌릴 수는 없더라도, 적어도 그 위협은 아직 통제 가능한 범위 내에 있다…
…어쩌면 그림자 영역이 아직 관측되지 않은 수많은 「가능성」으로 가득 차 있기 때문에 이런 현상이 나타나는 것이 아닐까? 이 가설대로라면 심연은 본질적으로 이러한 가능성과 상극을 이루기에, 「그림자 영역」을 오염시키지 못하는 것일지도 모른다…
…하지만 그 대가로, 이곳에는 안정된 실체가 존재할 수 없다. 그 무엇도 확정된 형태를 얻을 수 없으며, 진정한 의미로 물질화될 수도 없다… 진실이 무엇이든, 그림자 영역을 만들어 낸 기술은 이 세계의 지배자조차 터득하지 못한 것이다. 그것이 이 세계의 산물이 아니라는 점은 의심할 여지가 없다…
…하지만 지금까지의 발견으로 인해 그림자 영역이 존재하는 이유에 대한 의문은 더욱 풀기 어려워졌다… 설마 그림자 영역이 이 세계에 부여한 보호는, 그저 성인이 하늘이 정해 둔 운명을 거부한 뒤 영원한 공허 속에 옛 기억을 조금이나마 남겨 두기 위해 만들어 낸 부산물에 불과하단 말인가?
…심연이 끊임없이 이 세계로 스며드는 원인은 아직 밝혀지지 않았지만, 이것이 성인이 그림자 영역을 창조한 본래 의도와 분명히 연관되어 있으리라 확신한다…
…이 모든 것은 내가 폐허에서 수집한 정보를 바탕으로 내린 추론이다. 의문점은 많지만, 한 가지는 확실하다——
우리 요정 일족은 전설과 달리 황금 나라의 인간을 섬기기 위해 탄생한 존재가 아니다. 우리를 노예라 부르는 말은 우리의 존재를 두려워하는 자들이 퍼뜨린 거짓말일 뿐이다. 오히려 난 모래바람에 파묻힌 유적의 가장 깊은 곳에서 우리 일족에게 주어진 더욱 고귀하고 원대한 희망을 엿보았다…
…가장 오래된 기록에는 우리의 최초 명칭인 「요정」의 어원이 남아 있다. 그 뜻은 「진화한 인간 아이」였다…

title: 某位高贵之人的笔记·其三

CHS: …我意已决，我会接受无辜者的遗骨，也会接受高天许诺的王座，即使只是为了不让幸存者与被遗忘者的牺牲白费…
…那时，圣徒与黄金国的人们并不知晓，主宰古老星陆的意志其实尚未熄灭，因此无人能够登上他们预备的王座。然而他们点燃的火种却在千年后结出了果子，那便是我，原初之光的遗腹子…
…天授的神座意料之外的沉重，不过得到它之后我倒是终于明白了当初他为何露出那副苦涩的表情…在我最初穿越「通道」时，■■无法向我透露旧日的秘密，是因为那时他身负着与我同样的枷锁。但我并不后悔我的决定，因为这本就是我的使命，是我诞生于这颗星球之上的全部意义…
…最光辉与最卑贱的，所有的一切都连同记忆一起，被肆意玩弄生灵的巨匠抹去了。在永恒的暴政之下，所有的历史都将被反复涂抹，积累与进步无从谈起，未来也永远不会抵达…
…因此幸存下来的人啊，请不要忘记。不要忘记那些伟大的人物，也不要忘记所有做出过牺牲的无名之辈。今天终将成为过去，当未来终于抵达之时，人们也会像现在的我一样，回首数千年的狂风暴雨。希望那时的人们，不需要在尘土掩埋的废墟间寻找一处处未逝的残迹，希望那时的歌声里，都颂扬着英雄的名字…
…颂扬着那未能完成的超越，那曾被期许着的愿景…
EN: ...My mind is made up. I shall accept the remains of the innocent, along with the throne promised by the heavens, if only to ensure that the sacrifices of the survivors and the forgotten shall never be in vain...

...In those days, neither The Saint nor the people of the golden realm knew that the will which once ruled the ancient universe had not yet been extinguished, and thus none could ascend the throne they had prepared. Yet, the spark they kindled has borne fruit thousands of years hence. That fruit was I — the posthumous child of that primordial first light...

...The throne bestowed by the heavens has proven to be far heavier than I had ever imagined, and it is only after claiming it that I finally understand that bitter expression on his face... When I first passed through the passage, ■■■■ could not reveal the secrets of ages past to me, for he bore the very same shackles that now bind me. Even so, I do not regret my decision, for this has always been my calling, the very purpose for which I was born upon this rock...

...The most glorious and the most base alike have been swept away, their memories erased by that Artificer who toys with living beings. In that eternal tyranny, history has been reduced to a blank slate time and again, until all progress, all that might be further built upon, and future itself have been rendered forever impossible...

...And so, to those who endure: never forget. Never forget either the great or the nameless, each of whom has offered up a sacrifice of their own. The "today" in which we now live shall one day become history, and when the future at last arrives, all shall be able , as I have, to look back upon the millennia of turmoil that came before and recount their tale. It is my hope that, when that day comes, none shall be forced to sift through dust and ruins in search of the faintest traces of the past, and that the names of those heroes shall instead live on in the songs of the people...
...as they sing in praise of that transcendence left unfulfilled, and of the dream in which so many had once placed their hopes...
JP: …私の決意は固まっている。罪なき者たちの遺骨を受け入れ、高天に約束された王座も受け入れよう。たとえそれが、ひとえに生存者と忘れ去られた者たちの犠牲を無駄にしないためだとしても…
…あの時、聖徒と黄金の国の人々は古き星の大陸を統べる意志が、実はまだ消えていないということを知らなかった。ゆえに、彼らが用意した王座に登れる者は誰もいなかった。しかし、彼らが灯した種火は千年後に実を結んだ。それが私であり、原初の光の忘れ形見なのだ…
…天より授かった神座は思いのほか重荷だったが、それを手に入れてようやく、あの時彼が苦渋の表情を浮かべていた理由が理解できた…私が最初に「トンネル」を通り抜けた時、■■がかつての秘密を私に明かせなかったのは、当時の彼も私と同じ枷を背負っていたからだ。しかし、私は自分の決断を後悔していない。これこそが私の使命であり、この星に誕生した意義のすべてなのだから…
…最も光輝なるものも最も卑しきものも、そのすべてが記憶とともに、生物を弄ぶ巨匠によって消し去られてしまった。永遠の暴政の下では、あらゆる歴史は繰り返し塗り潰され、蓄積や進歩など語るべくもなく、未来が訪れることも永遠にない…
…だからこそ、生き残った者たちよ。偉大な人物たちを、犠牲となったすべての無名の者たちをどうか忘れないでほしい。今日という日が過去となり、ついに未来が訪れた時、人々は今の私と同じように、数千年にもわたって吹き荒れた嵐を振り返るだろう。その時の人々が、土埃に埋もれた廃墟の中に残された痕跡を探し回ることがなきよう。そしてその時の歌声がすべて、英雄たちの名を称えるものであるよう…
…成し遂げられなかった超越を、かつて待ち望まれた情景を称えていることを願って…
KR: …내 뜻은 이미 정해졌다. 나는 무고한 자들의 유골을 받아들이고, 하늘이 약속한 왕좌 또한 받아들이겠다. 생존자들과 잊힌 자들의 희생을 헛되게 하지 않기 위해서라도…
…당시 성인과 황금 나라 사람들은 고대 별 대지를 지배하던 의지가 아직 소멸하지 않았으며, 그 의지가 존재하는 한 누구도 그들이 마련한 왕좌에 오를 수 없다는 사실을 알지 못했다. 그러나 그들이 남긴 불씨는 천 년의 세월을 넘어 마침내 결실을 맺었다. 그 결실이 바로 나, 원초의 빛이 사후에 낳은 아이다…

…하늘이 내린 신좌는 예상보다 훨씬 무거웠다. 그 무게를 직접 짊어진 뒤에야, 나는 당시 그가 왜 그토록 씁쓸한 표정을 지었는지 비로소 깨달았다… 내가 처음 「통로」를 건너왔을 때 ■■에게서 과거의 비밀을 들을 수 없었던 것은 그 역시 당시 나와 같은 족쇄를 짊어지고 있었기 때문이다. 하지만 나는 이 선택을 후회하지 않는다. 이 모든 것은 본디 내가 짊어져야 할 사명이자, 내가 이 별에 태어난 이유이기 때문이다…
…가장 찬란한 것부터 가장 비천한 것까지, 그 모든 것이 기억과 함께 생명을 제멋대로 농락하는 거장의 손에 지워졌다. 영원함의 폭정 아래 모든 역사는 끊임없이 덧칠될 것이며, 축적과 진보는 논할 수조차 없고, 미래 또한 영원히 도달할 수 없을 것이다…

…그러니 살아남은 자들이여, 부디 역사에 이름을 남긴 위대한 인물들과 이름조차 남기지 못한 채 희생된 모든 이들을 기억해라. 오늘 또한 머지않아 과거가 될 것이며, 먼 훗날을 살아갈 사람들은 지금의 나처럼 수천 년의 풍파를 되돌아볼 것이다. 부디 그들이 흙먼지에 파묻힌 폐허를 헤매며 잊힌 흔적을 찾지 않아도 되기를, 그들의 노래 속에 영웅의 이름이 오래도록 남기를…
…미처 완성하지 못한 초월과, 한때 바랐던 염원을 찬양하기를 바란다…

title: 某位高贵之人的笔记·其五

CHS: …我看见周围有云雾从地上升腾，并幽雅的悲音，就是琴瑟的声音。
…我的心未曾晓得这声音，我的眼未曾见过这殿宇。
…这殿是用大石建造的；有人把石头立作壁柱，用金子包裹，又用金子铸造带卯的座，抬起雕金的横梁和椽子。
…我看不见穹苍的光亮；没有太阳发光，没有明月行在空中，殿里的光亮却甚大，好像苍白明亮的晨星。
…然而我的心却是空虚；我不能忘记我的哀情，除去我的苦楚，好叫我心中畅快，竟忘记了我的名字与所行的，像流过去的水一样。
…我要如何追念往日呢？它何竟像早晨的云雾，又如速散的甘露呢？何竟像糠秕被风吹去，又如烟气腾于窗外呢？
…只有一件事，放在我心上如印记，叫我常受警醒；那声音向我说：你当等待在此地，不可越过这殿的门槛，也不可去往外边。
…这印记坚固；虽不知是谁的嘱咐，我便不敢离去。
…有许多微小的灵在我周围行走，形状缺短，却发出凄凉的光。
…我观看它们，就不认识它们；我的心肠却要哀鸣如琴。
…我的心在我里面忧闷，我的灵在我里面愁烦；我的心腹就甚是荒废凄凉，好像毁坏的城邑，又好像被剥去冠冕的妇人。
…我的心，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面愁烦？
…我不能静默不言。我就用手弹琴，唱除去苦楚的歌曲，好叫我心中畅快，也不顾念我的名字与所行的，像流过去的水一样。
…歌声从我口中流出，飞去如梦，不再寻见；又如活水的江河，我未曾预先思虑，它便要从我心腹中流出，好像我素来知晓那般。
…我虽在歌唱，心却极其悲伤；我的眼泪下流成河，却不知是在为何人举哀；我便歌唱。
…我昼夜哀哭，泪流满腮；我纪念那不可纪念的，追想那不可追想的，却无人观看我的孤苦；我便歌唱。
…这哀愁压过我的性命，我却不能胜过它；我便歌唱。
…往日秋夜的蝉鸣，放逐者的吟唱…
…唯有歌和回忆，在这陌生的异乡…
…最后的歌者，弹奏着苍白的终曲…
…最初的仙灵，徘徊在天使的厅堂…
EN: ...My body rests in sleep, yet my heart wakes.
...I see mist rising from the ground all around, accompanied by an elegant, mournful sound. It's the music of lyres and lutes.
...My heart has never known this voice, my eyes have never seen this temple.
...This temple was constructed from stones of substantial size. Someone made pillars from these stones and sheathed them in gold. They also cast golden sockets to lift the golden beams and rafters.
...I can't see light in the sky. No sun shines, no moon walks, but the light in this temple is very strong, like a pale and bright star of morning.

...Yet my heart remains empty. I cannot forget my sorrow nor rid myself of my anguish to bring ease to my heart. I have even forgotten my name and my past. They abandon me like water that has flowed by.
...How should I reminisce about the past? Why does it act like the morning mist, the dew that vanishes in an instant? Why is it like chaff blown away by the wind, the smoke rising outside the window?

...Only one thing is engraved on my heart like a seal, keeping me ever vigilant. There is a voice that says to me, "You must wait here. You cannot cross the threshold of this temple, nor can you go outside."
...This seal is steadfast. I know not whose instruction it is. I dare not leave.
...There are many tiny spirits walking around me. Their forms are incomplete, yet they emit a desolate light.
...I look at them and find that I do not recognize them. Yet, my heartstrings wail like a lyre.
...My heart is troubled within me; my spirit is distressed within me. My innermost being is utterly desolate, like a ruined city, like a woman stripped of her crown.
...My heart, what is it that causes you such melancholy? What causes this vexation within me?

...I cannot remain silent. I will play this lyre with my hands and sing songs to clear the pain so that my heart may be at ease. I will not dwell on my name or my deeds; I will let them flow by like water.
...The song flows from my lips, flying away like a dream, never to be found again. Like a river of living water, it springs forth without my prior contemplation. It's as if I have always known it.
...Though I sing, my heart is filled with sorrow. My tears flow like a river, yet I know not for whom I mourn. So, I sing.
...I weep day and night, tears drenching my cheeks. I commemorate what cannot be commemorated, I recall what cannot be recalled. Yet, no one sees my loneliness or pain. So, I sing.
...This sorrow overwhelms my life, yet I cannot overcome it. So, I sing.
...The chirping of insects on a long-gone autumn night, the chorus of exiles...
...Only melodies and memories linger in this foreign land...
...The last singers play their final tune, soft and waning...
...And the first Seelie wanders the hall of angels...
JP: …体が眠りにつこうとも、心は目覚めたままだ。
…地から立ち昇る霧を目にし、そして琴の奏でる優雅で悲しい音色を耳にした。
…私の心はこの音を知らず、私の目はこの宮殿を見たことがない。
…この宮殿は巨石で建てられていた。石を壁柱として立て、金で包み、さらに金で作られた座を鋳造し、彫金された梁と垂木を支えていた。
…私には天空の光が見えない。太陽が輝くことも、明るい月が空を駆けることもない。しかし、殿堂の中の光はとても強く、淡く明るい暁の星のようだった。
…それでも、この心は空虚なままだ。悲しみを忘れることも、苦しみを取り除いて心を楽にすることもできない。ついには自分の名前や行いさえも忘れ去ってしまった…流れ去る水のように。
…過ぎし日々をどのように偲べばよいのだろう？なぜそれは朝の霧のように、あるいは瞬く間に消える朝露のように儚いのだろう？風に飛ばされる籾殻のように、あるいは窓の外へ立ち昇る煙のように消え去るのだろう？
…ただ一つのことが、心に刻まれた印のように警鐘を鳴らしていた。声はこう告げるのだ。「ここで待っていろ。この宮殿の敷居を越えてはならない。外へも出てはならない」…
…この印は強固なものだ。誰の言いつけかは分からないが、ここを離れることはできない。
…周囲には小さな霊たちが歩き回っていて、その形は不完全ながらも、物悲しい光を放っていた。
…彼らを見つめても、認識ができない。心は琴のように悲しく鳴る。
…私の心は内なる憂いに満ち、魂は深い悲しみに沈む。体の内は荒れ果てた都のように、冠を剥ぎ取られた女のように、すさみ、寂しく打ち捨てられていた。
…私の心よ、なぜ悲しみに沈む？なぜ苦しむ？
…黙ってはいられなかった。この手で琴を弾き、心を楽にするために、苦しみを払う歌を歌うことにした。ついには自分の名前や行いさえも忘れ去ってしまうほど…流れ去る水のように。
…歌声は私の口から流れ出て、夢のように飛び去り、二度と見つかることはなかった。それは、生きた水の川のように、考えるより先に、まるで昔から知っていたかのように、私の心の奥底から湧き出てきた。
…歌っているのに、私の心は深い悲しみに沈んでいた。涙は川となって流れ落ちるが、誰のために嘆いているのかさえ分からなかった。それでも歌い続けるのだ。
…昼も夜も泣き続け、涙が頬を伝い流れた。記憶に留めてはならないものを心に刻み、思い出してはならないものを追い求めるが、この孤独な苦しみに気づく者はいない。だから私は歌うのだ。
…この哀しみは命を押しつぶすほどに重く、私にはそれに打ち勝つ術もなかった。だから私は歌うのだ。
…かつての秋夜に響いたひぐらしの声は、放逐されし者の吟唱であり…
…歌と思い出だけが、この見知らぬ異郷で…
…最後の歌い手が、蒼白なる終末の曲を弾きながら…
…最初の仙霊が、天の使いの広間に彷徨っていた…
KR: …나의 몸은 잠들어 있지만, 나의 마음은 깨어 있다.
…주위에서는 땅에서 피어오르는 구름과, 우아하면서도 슬픈 현악기의 음색이 들려왔다.
…나는 이런 소리도, 이런 전당도 처음이었다.
…이 전당은 거대한 돌로 지어졌다. 돌기둥을 세워 금으로 감쌌고, 금으로 장부가 달린 받침을 주조하여 금으로 조각된 대들보와 서까래를 떠받치게 했다.
…지붕에는 조명이 없었다. 태양도 빛을 발하지 않았고 밝은 달도 없었지만, 전당 안은 창백한 샛별처럼 환했다.
…하지만 내 마음은 공허하다. 슬픔과 고통을 내려놓지 못한 채, 나는 내 이름과 기억까지 잃어버렸다. 모든 것이 흘러간 물처럼 사라졌다.
…내가 어찌 지난날을 추억하겠는가? 지난날은 아침 안개와 이슬처럼 금세 사라진다. 바람에 날리는 겨처럼 흩어지고, 창밖의 안개처럼 자취를 감춘다.
…하지만 내 마음속에는 표식처럼 지워지지 않는 목소리가 늘 나를 일깨웠다. 그 목소리는 이렇게 말했다: 여기서 기다려라. 전당의 문턱을 넘지 말고, 밖으로도 나가지도 말라.
…비록 누구의 당부인지 알 수 없지만, 이 표식은 견고해 나는 감히 이곳을 떠날 수 없다.
…수많은 미약한 영혼들이 내 주위를 떠돌고 있다. 형체는 불완전했고, 처량한 빛을 뿜어낸다.
…나는 그들을 바라보았지만 알아볼 수 없다. 내 심장은 악기처럼 애절하게 울렸다.
…내 마음은 근심에 잠겼고, 내 영혼은 괴로웠으며, 내 속은 멸망한 도시와 왕관을 빼앗긴 여인처럼 황량했다.
…내 마음아, 어찌하여 근심하느냐? 어찌하여 내 안에서 괴로워하느냐?
…침묵을 깨고 하프를 연주하며 노래를 부르면 마음이 편안해질 것이고, 내 이름과 기억도 흘러간 물처럼 더는 신경 쓰이지 않을 것이다.
…노래가 내 입에서 흘러나와 꿈처럼 사라졌다. 미리 생각하지 않았어도 그것은 강물처럼 내 심장에서 흘러나왔다. 마치 알고 있었던 것처럼.
…나는 노래하지만, 마음은 슬픔으로 가득하다. 눈물은 강처럼 흘러내리는데도, 누구를 위해 애도하는지조차 알지 못한다. 그저 노래할 뿐이다.
…밤낮으로 울어 눈물이 뺨을 적신다. 기리지 말아야 할 것을 계속 기리고, 떠올려선 안 될 일을 계속 회상하지만, 아무도 내 외로움을 알아주지 않는다. 그래서 나는 노래한다.
…이 슬픔이 내 목숨을 짓누르고 있으나, 나는 이를 도저히 이겨낼 수 없기에 그저 노래하리라.
…옛날 가을밤의 매미 소리는 추방자의 노래…
…오직 노래와 추억만이, 이 낯선 타향에서…
…최후의 가수는 창백한 피날레를 연주했네…
…최초의 선령은 천사의 전당을 배회했네…

CHS: …我在这殿宇中独坐了许多日子，那些过路的人却不能得见；我终日凄凉发昏，为这地的困苦窘迫叹息，却只有那些微小的灵与我举哀。
…我仍旧不能追念过去，我的心却稍稍得了安慰；我的歌声滴落如露，如细雨降在嫩草上，如甘霖降在菜蔬中，叫我的言语也更舒畅。
…那些过路的人不曾进入这旷野的树林，那些外邦的人不曾看见这苍白的殿宇。
…地上长起蒺藜和刺草的时候，有野兽闯进我的居所。
…暴风从南方来，寒冷出于北方；那兽从北方来，有冰雪的凉气。
…它口中吐不出人言，却仰望我如仰望天光，又切慕我的歌声，如口渴的奴仆切慕春雨。
…既有兽作我的陪伴，就是作我的使臣，我又岂可哀恸呢？
…我就要向它歌唱，也戏笑、讥诮它的所行甚是愚昧无知。
…它却不急躁恼怒，只是细听我的话语，听我的声音；又向我俯伏在地，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令。
…我叫它笨狗，它也不恼恨；我抚摸它的毛皮，它也不发怒。
…我见它悦人眼目，且是可喜爱的，就给它起名叫玻瑞亚斯（就是「北风」的意思），叫它和它的宗族与我同住。
…我们在这殿宇中坐了许多日子，它的口中竟要吐出人言；原本愚昧无知的野兽，竟也要有智慧，有聪明，有知识，能以慈爱诚实待人。
…它对我说话，呼叫我为主母，说：我要向南方的地去，那地的民贫穷卑微，城邑却广大坚固，我要叫他们得着富足。
…我应允了它，它就和它的宗族一同离开了；我最后一次念它的名字，与它作别。
EN: ...I have sat alone in this temple for many days. Those who passed by cannot see me. I've been desolate and faint all day, sighing over the afflictions and hardships of this land, but only the tiny spirits mourned with me.

...I still cannot reminisce about the past, but my heart is slightly comforted. My song falls like dew, descending like gentle rain upon tender grass, like a timely monsoon nourishing crops, making my words flow more smoothly.
...Those who pass by never enter this vast forest, and those who come from foreign lands never see this pale temple.
...When brambles and thorned plants sprouted from the ground, a wild beast invaded my dwelling.
...Storms came from the south, cold came from the north. That beast came from the north, bearing the chill of ice and snow.
...Its mouth uttered no human speech, but it gazed upon me as upon heavenly light, and longed for my song as a thirsty servant longed for spring rain.
...Since I had a beast to keep me company, serving as my emissary, how could I possibly mourn?
...Sing to it I shall. Just as I shall also mock and ridicule its foolish ways.
...Yet, it did not grow impatient or resentful. Instead, it listened carefully to my words and heeded my voice. It bowed low before me, obeying my commands and decrees.
...I called it a stupid dog, but it bore no grudge. I patted its fur, but it showed no anger.
...I found it pleasing to the eye and rather endearing, so I named it Boreas (meaning "North Wind") and let it, as well as its kin, share my dwelling.

...We sat in this temple for many days. Astonishingly, human words would come from its mouth. A beast that had been utterly foolish and ignorant would possess wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge. It could treat others with kindness and sincerity.
...It spoke to me and called me Mother. It said, "I will go to the South, where the people are poor and lowly, yet the cities are large and fortified. I will make them prosperous."
...I granted its request, and it departed with its kin. I called its name one last time, bidding it farewell.
JP: …この宮殿で幾日も独り座していたが、通りすがる人々には姿を見せることができなかった。一日中物憂げに頭を垂れ、この地の苦難と窮乏を嘆いていたが、共に悲しみを分かち合ったのは、小さな霊たちだけだった。
…過去を追憶することはできないままだが、私の心はわずかに慰められた。私の歌声は露のように、若草に降る細雨のように、野菜に降り注ぐ恵みの雨のように滴り落ち、私の言葉もまた心地よく流れるのだ。
…通りすがりの人々は、この荒野の森に足を踏み入れることはなく、異郷の人々は、この蒼白き殿堂を目にすることもなかった。
…地面に蒺藜と棘が生えた頃、獣が私の住まいに侵入してきた。
…暴風は南から、寒気は北からやってくる。その獣は北から来て、氷雪の冷気を纏っていた。
…それは人の言葉を発することはできないが、天の光を仰ぐように私を見上げ、また渇いた奴隷が春の雨を切望するように、私の歌声を慕い求めていた。
…獣が私の付き添いとなり、使者となるのなら、悲しむ必要などあるだろうか。
…私はそれに向かって歌い、その愚かで無知な行いを嘲笑い、からかうのだ。
…それは焦ることも怒ることもなく、ただ私の言葉に声に耳を傾け、私の前にひれ伏して、言いつけと命令に従った。
…馬鹿な犬と呼ぼうとも、その毛並みを撫でようとも、怒ることはなかった。
…私はその愛らしい姿に魅了され、「ボレアス」（「北風」を意味する）という名前を付け、その一族と共に住むことにした。
…私たちはこの殿堂で長い年月を共に過ごし、それは人の言葉を発しようとしていた。本来は愚かで無知な獣が、知恵を持ち、聡明さを持ち、知識を持ち、慈愛と誠実さを持って人に接しようとしていた。
…それは私を主母と呼んで、こう言った。「我は南の地へ向かう。その地の民は貧しく身分も低いものの、街は広大で堅固だ。我は彼らに豊かさをもたらしたい」と。
…私はそれを承諾し、そして彼は一族と共に去っていった。最後に一度、その名を呼んで別れを告げた。
…ボレアス…ボレアス…ボレア…
…思い出した…
KR: …나는 이 전당 안에 홀로 앉아 수많은 나날을 보냈지만, 지나가는 사람들은 나를 보지 못했다. 나는 온종일 처량하고 무기력한 채 이 땅의 고통과 곤궁을 한탄했으나, 오직 그 미약한 영혼들만이 나와 함께 슬퍼했다.
…나는 여전히 과거를 떠올릴 수 없었지만, 마음은 조금씩 위로받았다. 내 노랫소리는 이슬처럼 스며들고, 풀 위에 내리는 가랑비처럼, 채소밭을 적시는 단비처럼 번져가며 내 마음을 더 편안하게 했다.
…지나가는 이들은 이 황야의 숲에 들어서지 않았고, 이방인들은 이 창백한 전당을 보지 못했다.
…땅에 가시덤불과 가시풀이 무성해질 쯤에 야수가 내 거처로 침입했다.
…폭풍은 남쪽에서 오고, 추위는 북쪽에서 온다. 그 야수는 북쪽에서 왔으며 눈과 얼음의 냉기가 느껴졌다.
…야수는 인간의 말을 할 수 없었지만, 하늘의 빛을 우러러보는 듯한 눈으로 나를 올려다보았고, 목마른 땅이 봄비를 기다리듯 내 노래를 갈망했다.
…야수가 내 사자가 되어 주었는데, 내가 어찌 슬퍼할 수 있으랴?
…나는 야수에게 노래를 부르며, 야수의 행동이 어리석고 무지하다며 놀리곤 했다.
…하지만 녀석은 화내지 않았다. 그저 내 말에 귀 기울이고 내 목소리에 집중했을 뿐이다. 그리고는 내 앞에 엎드려 지시와 명령을 따랐다.
…내가 녀석을 바보 개라고 불러도 녀석은 원망하지 않았고, 털을 쓰다듬어도 화내지 않았다.
…녀석이 멋있고 사랑스러워서, 보레아스(「북풍」이라는 뜻)라는 이름을 붙여주고 녀석의 일족도 나와 함께 살게 했다.
…우리가 이 전당에 앉아 있은 지 얼마나 지났을까? 녀석의 입에서 갑자기 사람의 말이 흘러나왔다. 무지했던 야수는 이제 지혜와 지식을 갖추어, 자애와 성실로 사람을 대할 수 있게 된 것이다.
…녀석은 나를 여주인님이라 부르며 말했다: 나는 남쪽으로 가고 싶다. 그곳은 가난하지만 도시가 견고하니, 내가 부유하게 만들어 줄 거다.
…나는 이를 허락했고, 녀석은 자기 종족과 함께 떠났다. 나는 마지막으로 그 이름을 불러, 작별을 고했다.
…보레아스… 보레아스… 보레아…
순간… 기억났다…

CHS: …我心所爱的啊，你的言语在我之中何等甘美？何竟被心存刚硬的伪主剪除，叫我里面变为荒场？
…若非那闯进我居所的野狼，我早已将你的名字一同遗忘。
…伪主啊，我曾为你歌唱，我曾为你攻败地上的列国；你却要将我摔倒在地上，像被践踏的尸首一样。
…你使大地如同荒野，使城邑倾覆，使列国的君王不得入他们的坟墓；你败坏他们的国，杀戮他们的民，连子带孙一并剪除。
…我永不得战胜你，你胜了又要胜；泥土岂要胜过抟弄它的陶匠么？
…你的刀剑落在众民骄傲的头上，要让地喝醉了血，淹没了高山与上边所有的松树。
…然而我却依旧能等待我心所爱的，借着星光归入那大城，等待约定的重逢。
…让你的羔羊们永远效忠于你吧，服从你神圣的命令，服从最值得服从的命令。
…我要回到我的国，等待我镣铐在星外的星；在灭亡的空无中歌唱，胜过在虚假的天光下为奴。
…我心所爱的啊，你为我筑起这苍白的殿宇，我却要违抗你的命令，回到我们不存在的国土，等待你迎来自由的那一日，正如你也同样赐予了我自由…
…无论要过去多少岁月，无论晨星是否熄灭…
EN: ...My heart's beloved, how delightful your expressions were to my inmost self! How have they been cut away by the shears of some unyielding false authority, leaving my innermost being a wasteland?
...Had it not been for the wild wolf that intruded upon my dwelling, your name too would've faded entirely from my recollection.
...O false master, I once devoted my voice to singing for you, and once I vanquished nations at your behest. Yet, you cast me down to be trod upon like a lifeless corpse upon the earth.

...You have rendered the earth a desolation, overturning its cities, preventing monarchs from entering their final repose. You have laid waste their kingdoms, slaughtered their people, and spared neither offspring nor posterity.
...I shall never best you. You have triumphed and shall triumph still. Can clay ever conquer the very potter who shaped it?
